br-arroz-feijao-ovo.title: Rice, beans and fried egg
br-arroz-feijao-ovo.tip: Let the rice rest covered for 5 minutes before fluffing it with a fork.
steps: Sauté the garlic in the oil, add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Cover with hot salted water and cook covered over low heat for 15 minutes.
Warm the beans with the sautéed onion for 10 minutes.
Fry the eggs and serve everything together.

br-frango-com-batata-assado.title: Roast chicken with potatoes
br-frango-com-batata-assado.tip: Cover with foil for the first 20 minutes to keep the chicken tender.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season the chicken with salt, lemon and a drizzle of oil.
Arrange the potato wedges and sliced onion around it.
Roast 45 minutes, turning once, until golden.

br-strogonoff-de-frango.title: Chicken stroganoff
br-strogonoff-de-frango.tip: Stir in the cream off the heat so it doesn't curdle.
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes and season with salt.
Brown it in oil with the chopped onion for 8 minutes.
Add the ketchup and mushrooms and cook 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat, stir in the cream and serve with rice.

br-carne-moida-com-batata.title: Ground beef with potatoes
br-carne-moida-com-batata.summary: Stretches far, cheap and well liked.
br-carne-moida-com-batata.tip: Cut the potatoes small so they cook faster.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil and add the ground beef.
Stir until browned, about 8 minutes, and season with salt.
Add the chopped tomato, diced potatoes and the water.
Cook covered for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.

br-omelete-de-queijo.title: Cheese omelet
br-omelete-de-queijo.tip: Medium-low heat keeps the omelet tender.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Pour into a greased skillet over medium heat.
When it starts to set, add the cheese and ham.
Fold in half and cook 1 more minute.

br-macarrao-alho-e-oleo.title: Garlic and oil pasta
br-macarrao-alho-e-oleo.tip: Don't let the garlic burn: it turns bitter.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Brown the sliced garlic in the olive oil over low heat.
Toss the drained pasta with the garlic.
Serve with grated cheese.

br-baiao-de-dois.title: Baião de dois
br-baiao-de-dois.tip: If you like, finish with chopped cilantro.
steps: Fry the sliced sausage with the chopped onion.
Add the rice and sauté 1 minute.
Add the beans, water and salt and cook 15 minutes.
Stir in the cubed cheese at the end and serve.

br-panqueca-de-carne.title: Beef crepes
br-panqueca-de-carne.summary: Thin crepes filled with ground beef.
br-panqueca-de-carne.tip: The first crepe is usually a test: don't worry if it fails.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, flour and salt until smooth.
Sauté the onion and beef with salt and add half the sauce.
Make the crepes in a greased skillet and fill them.
Place in a baking dish with the remaining sauce and bake 10 minutes.

br-arroz-de-forno.title: Baked rice
br-arroz-de-forno.summary: Rice with ham and melted cheese.
br-arroz-de-forno.tip: Great for using up leftover rice.
steps: Mix the cooked rice with the chopped ham, peas and cream.
Add the beaten eggs and salt.
Put in a baking dish and cover with cheese.
Bake 25 minutes at 400°F (200°C), until golden.

br-moqueca-de-peixe.title: Fish moqueca
br-moqueca-de-peixe.summary: Fish with tomato and bell pepper.
br-moqueca-de-peixe.tip: Don't stir the pot: just tilt it so the fish doesn't fall apart.
steps: Season the fish with salt and lemon.
Layer onion, tomato and bell pepper in a pot.
Add the fish, drizzle with olive oil and pour in the coconut milk.
Cook covered over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

br-escondidinho-de-carne.title: Beef escondidinho
br-escondidinho-de-carne.tip: Keep the mash firm so it doesn't sink into the filling.
steps: Boil the potatoes 20 minutes and mash with milk, butter and salt.
Sauté the onion and beef with salt for 10 minutes.
Put the beef in a baking dish and cover with the mash.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 15 minutes.

br-cuscuz-com-ovo.title: Cornmeal couscous with egg
br-cuscuz-com-ovo.tip: Fluff the couscous with a fork before serving.
steps: Moisten the cornmeal with the water and salt for 5 minutes.
Steam for 8 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the butter.
Serve the couscous with the eggs and cheese.

br-tapioca-com-queijo.title: Cheese tapioca crepe
br-tapioca-com-queijo.tip: Sift the tapioca starch so the crepe comes out smooth.
steps: Heat a nonstick skillet with no oil.
Spread the sifted starch into a disc.
When it sets, flip and add the cheese and ham.
Fold in half and let it melt.

br-sopa-de-legumes.title: Vegetable soup
br-sopa-de-legumes.summary: Uses whatever is in the fridge.
br-sopa-de-legumes.tip: Blend part of the soup for a creamier texture.
steps: Cut all the vegetables into cubes.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the vegetables.
Add the water and salt and cook 25 minutes.
Add the pasta for the last 8 minutes.

br-macarronada.title: Pasta with meat sauce
br-macarronada.tip: Save a little cooking water to loosen the sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the onion and brown the ground beef for 8 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce and cook 10 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve with grated cheese.

br-batata-recheada.title: Stuffed potatoes
br-batata-recheada.tip: Prick the potatoes well with a fork before cooking.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 25 minutes and halve them.
Scoop out some flesh and mix with the butter, cheese and chopped ham.
Fill the potatoes.
Bake until golden, 15 minutes.

br-frango-com-quiabo.title: Chicken with okra
br-frango-com-quiabo.tip: Don't stir the okra once it's in, so it doesn't turn slimy.
steps: Brown the chicken seasoned with salt and garlic in oil.
Add the onion and tomato and sauté 5 minutes.
Add a little water and cook covered 20 minutes.
Add the whole okra and cook 10 more minutes without stirring.

br-salada-de-atum-com-batata.title: Tuna and potato salad
br-salada-de-atum-com-batata.tip: Dress the potatoes while still warm so they absorb more flavor.
steps: Boil the diced potatoes until tender and drain.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes and cut into quarters.
Mix everything with the tuna, tomato and onion.
Season with salt, lemon and olive oil.

br-torta-de-frango.title: Blender chicken pie
br-torta-de-frango.tip: Add baking powder to the batter for a taller pie.
steps: Cook and shred the chicken; sauté with the onion and salt.
Blend the eggs, milk, flour, oil and salt.
Put half the batter in a pan, add the filling and cheese, and cover with the rest of the batter.
Bake 35 minutes at 400°F (200°C).

br-ovos-mexidos-com-tomate.title: Scrambled eggs with tomato
br-ovos-mexidos-com-tomate.tip: Take them off the heat while still creamy: they keep cooking on the plate.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and tomato in oil for 3 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs with salt.
Stir over low heat until set.
Serve with bread or rice.

br-frango-a-parmegiana.title: Chicken parmigiana
br-frango-a-parmegiana.summary: Breaded, with sauce and melted cheese.
br-frango-a-parmegiana.tip: Bake instead of frying for a lighter dish.
steps: Flatten the cutlets, season with salt and coat in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry or bake until golden, about 4 minutes per side.
Place in a baking dish and cover with tomato sauce and cheese.
Bake 10 minutes, until the cheese melts.

br-bife-acebolado.title: Steak with onions
br-bife-acebolado.tip: Don't crowd the steaks in the pan: they release water and won't brown.
steps: Season the steaks with salt and garlic.
Sear in a very hot pan 2 to 3 minutes per side and set aside.
In the same pan, brown the sliced onions for 8 minutes.
Serve the steaks topped with the onions.

br-arroz-carreteiro.title: Arroz carreteiro
br-arroz-carreteiro.tip: If the meat is salted, desalt it first and adjust the salt.
steps: Cut the beef into small cubes and brown in oil.
Add the chopped onion, garlic and tomato and sauté 5 minutes.
Add the rice, stir and cover with hot salted water.
Cook covered 20 minutes over low heat.

br-carne-de-panela.title: Pot roast with potatoes
br-carne-de-panela.tip: Let the sauce reduce uncovered at the end so it thickens.
steps: Brown the beef in large cubes in oil in a pressure cooker or regular pot.
Add the chopped onion and sauté.
Add the water and salt and cook 25 minutes under pressure (or 50 in a regular pot).
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook 15 more minutes.

br-salpicao.title: Creamy chicken salad
br-salpicao.summary: Cold, creamy and perfect any day.
br-salpicao.tip: Add the potato sticks only at serving time so they stay crunchy.
steps: Boil the chicken in salted water for 20 minutes and shred it.
Grate the raw carrot and drain the corn.
Mix everything with the mayonnaise and salt.
Serve cold, with the potato sticks on top at the last moment.

br-sopa-de-feijao.title: Bean soup
br-sopa-de-feijao.tip: Blend a ladle of the soup to give it more body.
steps: Sauté the onion and sliced sausage in oil.
Add the beans, diced potato and carrot, and the water.
Cook 25 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Mash some of the beans to thicken and adjust the salt.

br-salada-de-macarrao.title: Pasta salad
br-salada-de-macarrao.tip: Rinse the pasta so the salad isn't sticky.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, drain and rinse under cold water.
Chop the tomato and onion.
Mix everything with the corn, mayonnaise and olive oil.
Adjust the salt and chill for 15 minutes.

br-peixe-assado-com-batata.title: Baked fish with potatoes
br-peixe-assado-com-batata.tip: Cover with foil to keep the fish juicy.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the sliced potatoes, onion and tomato in a pan with salt and oil; bake 20 minutes.
Season the fish with salt and lemon and lay it on the vegetables.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes more, until the fish flakes.

br-farofa-de-ovo.title: Egg farofa
br-farofa-de-ovo.summary: The side that becomes a meal.
br-farofa-de-ovo.tip: Toast the flour 2 minutes in a dry pan for more crunch.
steps: Sauté the onion (and bacon) in the butter.
Add the eggs and stir until cooked.
Add the flour gradually, stirring.
Season with salt and serve.

br-strogonoff-de-carne.title: Beef stroganoff
br-strogonoff-de-carne.summary: A party classic, simple to make.
br-strogonoff-de-carne.tip: Stir in the cream off the heat so it doesn't curdle.
steps: Cut the beef into strips and season with salt.
Brown in oil with the chopped onion for 8 minutes.
Add the ketchup and mushrooms and cook 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat and stir in the cream.

br-omelete-de-legumes.title: Vegetable omelet
br-omelete-de-legumes.tip: Cover the pan to cook the top without flipping.
steps: Chop the vegetables and sauté 3 minutes in oil.
Beat the eggs with salt.
Pour over the vegetables and cook over low heat.
Add the cheese, fold and serve.

br-macarrao-com-frango.title: Creamy chicken pasta
br-macarrao-com-frango.tip: Save a little cooking water to loosen the sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Brown the diced chicken with the chopped onion for 8 minutes.
Add the cream and cook 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and grated cheese.

fr-croque-monsieur.title: Croque-monsieur
fr-croque-monsieur.tip: Add a fried egg on top to make a croque-madame.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Fill two slices of bread with ham and cheese and close with the others.
Lightly butter the top and add grated cheese.
Bake 10 minutes, until the cheese is golden.

fr-gratin-dauphinois.title: Potato gratin dauphinois
fr-gratin-dauphinois.tip: Don't rinse the potatoes: the starch thickens the sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and rub a dish with the garlic.
Peel the potatoes and slice them thin.
Layer them in the dish and pour over the salted cream and milk with the nutmeg.
Bake 45 minutes, until the top is well browned.

fr-quiche-lorraine.title: Quiche Lorraine
fr-quiche-lorraine.summary: The classic, with bacon and eggs.
fr-quiche-lorraine.tip: Prick the dough with a fork so it doesn't puff up.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a pan with the crust.
Cook the bacon in a skillet with no added fat.
Beat the eggs with the cream, salt and nutmeg.
Spread the bacon on the crust, pour in the mixture, add the cheese and bake 30 minutes.

fr-soupe-a-l-oignon.title: French onion soup
fr-soupe-a-l-oignon.tip: The slower the onions cook, the sweeter the soup.
steps: Slice the onions and cook them in the butter for 20 minutes, until golden.
Add the water or broth, salt and pepper and simmer 15 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and top with the bread and cheese.
Broil 5 minutes until melted and browned.

fr-hachis-parmentier.title: French shepherd's pie
fr-hachis-parmentier.summary: Ground beef under baked mashed potato.
fr-hachis-parmentier.tip: Score the mash with a fork for a crisp top.
steps: Boil the potatoes 20 minutes and mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Sauté the chopped onion and beef 8 minutes and season.
Spread the beef in a dish and cover with the mash.
Add the cheese and bake 15 minutes at 400°F (200°C).

fr-poulet-roti-pommes-de-terre.title: Roast chicken with potatoes
fr-poulet-roti-pommes-de-terre.tip: Baste now and then with the pan juices.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the chicken in a dish with the potato wedges and the onion.
Season with salt and pepper, add the thyme and a drizzle of oil.
Roast 45 minutes, turning halfway.

fr-omelette-au-fromage.title: Cheese omelet
fr-omelette-au-fromage.tip: A soft omelet comes off the heat just before it's fully cooked.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a skillet and pour in the eggs.
When the omelet starts to set, add the cheese and herbs.
Fold in half and serve at once.

fr-salade-nicoise.title: Niçoise salad
fr-salade-nicoise.summary: Fresh, complete and no long cooking.
fr-salade-nicoise.tip: Dress at the last moment so the vegetables stay crisp.
steps: Cook the green beans and potatoes, and hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes.
Cut the tomatoes, eggs and potatoes.
Arrange everything in a bowl with the flaked tuna and olives.
Dress with the oil and salt.

fr-ratatouille.title: Ratatouille
fr-ratatouille.tip: It's even better reheated the next day.
steps: Dice all the vegetables.
Sauté the onion in the oil, then add the eggplant and pepper.
Add the zucchini and tomatoes and salt.
Simmer covered over low heat for 35 minutes.

fr-pates-jambon-creme.title: Ham and cream pasta
fr-pates-jambon-creme.tip: Save some cooking water to loosen the sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Cut the ham into strips and warm it 2 minutes in a skillet.
Add the cream and reduce 3 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta and cheese.

fr-gratin-de-courgettes.title: Zucchini gratin
fr-gratin-de-courgettes.tip: Salt the zucchini and let it drain 10 minutes so the dish doesn't get watery.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Slice the zucchini and sauté 5 minutes in the oil.
Mix with the beaten eggs, cream and salt in a dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 25 minutes.

fr-soupe-de-legumes.title: Vegetable soup
fr-soupe-de-legumes.summary: For using what's left in the fridge.
fr-soupe-de-legumes.tip: Add a spoonful of cream when serving.
steps: Peel and cut all the vegetables into pieces.
Sauté the onion in the butter 3 minutes.
Add the vegetables, water and salt.
Cook 25 minutes and blend.

fr-lentilles-saucisses.title: Lentils with sausages
fr-lentilles-saucisses.tip: Salt at the end: salt toughens lentils.
steps: Brown the sausages in a pot with a little oil.
Add the diced onion and carrot and sauté 3 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils and the water.
Simmer 30 minutes over low heat and salt at the end.

fr-quiche-aux-legumes.title: Vegetable quiche
fr-quiche-aux-legumes.tip: Blind-bake the crust 10 minutes so it stays crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a pan with the crust.
Sauté the sliced vegetables 8 minutes.
Mix the eggs, cream and salt, then add the vegetables.
Pour over the crust and bake 30 minutes.

fr-galette-complete.title: Buckwheat crepe complète
fr-galette-complete.summary: Ham, egg and cheese on a buckwheat crepe.
fr-galette-complete.tip: If the crepes are already cooked, warm them a few seconds before filling.
steps: Heat a skillet with a little butter and lay down a crepe.
Add the cheese and ham and crack an egg in the center.
Fold the edges into a square.
Cook 4 minutes, until the white is set.

fr-oeufs-mimosa.title: Mimosa eggs
fr-oeufs-mimosa.tip: Put the eggs in cold water right after cooking so they peel easily.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes and peel them under cold water.
Halve them and remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt.
Fill the whites with the mixture.

fr-poireaux-vinaigrette.title: Leeks vinaigrette
fr-poireaux-vinaigrette.tip: Press them gently to remove the water before dressing.
steps: Wash the leeks and cut into sections.
Boil in salted water 15 minutes and drain.
Make a vinaigrette with the mustard, vinegar, salt and oil.
Serve warm with the vinaigrette and chopped egg.

fr-steak-hache-puree.title: Beef patties and mash
fr-steak-hache-puree.tip: Warm the milk before adding it: the mash will be smoother.
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes 20 minutes.
Mash with the warm milk, butter and salt.
Cook the patties in a skillet 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Serve with the mash.

fr-gratin-de-pates.title: Pasta gratin
fr-gratin-de-pates.tip: Don't overcook the pasta: it will finish cooking in the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cook the pasta al dente.
Mix with the chopped ham, cream and salt in a dish.
Cover with grated cheese.
Bake until golden, 15 minutes.

fr-riz-cantonais.title: Cantonese fried rice
steps: Heat the oil and stir-fry the diced ham with the peas.
Add the cold rice and stir-fry over high heat 3 minutes.
Push the rice aside and scramble the eggs.
Mix and season with the soy sauce.

fr-poulet-a-la-creme.title: Creamy chicken with mushrooms
fr-poulet-a-la-creme.tip: Don't boil the cream hard: it may split.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in the oil.
Add the sliced onion and mushrooms and sauté 5 minutes.
Pour in the cream, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with the sauce.

fr-gratin-de-chou-fleur.title: Cauliflower gratin
fr-gratin-de-chou-fleur.tip: Drain the cauliflower very well so the gratin isn't watery.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Boil the cauliflower florets 8 minutes in salted water.
Arrange in a buttered dish, pour over the cream and cover with grated cheese.
Bake until golden, 20 minutes.

fr-tarte-tomate-moutarde.title: Tomato and mustard tart
fr-tarte-tomate-moutarde.tip: Let the tomatoes drain 10 minutes on paper towels.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a pan with the crust.
Spread the mustard on the bottom.
Arrange the sliced tomatoes, salt them and add the herbs and cheese.
Bake 30 minutes.

fr-oeufs-cocotte.title: Baked eggs in cream
fr-oeufs-cocotte.summary: Eggs baked in cream, ready in 20 minutes.
fr-oeufs-cocotte.tip: Take them out when the white is set: the yolk should stay runny.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Divide the cream and the ham pieces between two ramekins.
Crack two eggs into each, salt and add the cheese.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes in a water bath.

fr-salade-de-pommes-de-terre.title: Potato salad
fr-salade-de-pommes-de-terre.tip: Dress them warm: they absorb the vinaigrette better.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water 15 to 20 minutes and peel them.
Slice them.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, oil and salt.
Pour over the still-warm potatoes and add the chopped onion.

fr-tartiflette.title: Simplified tartiflette
fr-tartiflette.tip: No need to salt: the bacon and cheese already are.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cook the sliced potatoes 15 minutes.
Sauté the bacon and sliced onion.
Mix with the potatoes and cream in a dish.
Cover with cheese and bake until browned, 20 minutes.

fr-soupe-de-potiron.title: Pumpkin soup
fr-soupe-de-potiron.tip: A pinch of nutmeg lifts the flavor.
steps: Peel and cube the pumpkin.
Sweat the onion in the butter, then add the pumpkin.
Cover with water, salt and cook 25 minutes.
Blend, adding the cream.

fr-poisson-en-papillote.title: Fish in parchment
fr-poisson-en-papillote.tip: Seal the parcel well so the steam cooks the fish.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Slice the zucchini thin.
Put each fillet on a square of parchment with the zucchini, salt, oil and lemon, and seal.
Bake 15 minutes.

fr-salade-de-riz-au-thon.title: Rice and tuna salad
fr-salade-de-riz-au-thon.tip: Rinse the rice in cold water so it doesn't clump.
steps: Cook the rice in salted water, drain and rinse under cold water.
Cut the tomatoes and hard-boiled eggs.
Mix with the flaked tuna and the corn.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt.

fr-omelette-aux-champignons.title: Mushroom omelet
fr-omelette-aux-champignons.tip: Sear the mushrooms over high heat without stirring so they brown.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and brown them 5 minutes in the butter.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Pour over the mushrooms and let set over low heat.
Fold the omelet and sprinkle with parsley.

fr-saute-de-boeuf-aux-oignons.title: Beef and onion sauté
fr-saute-de-boeuf-aux-oignons.tip: Sear the meat in two batches so it browns well.
steps: Cut the beef into strips and salt it.
Sear over high heat 3 minutes and set aside.
Soften the sliced onions for 10 minutes.
Return the beef with the mustard and stir.

fr-pates-champignons-creme.title: Creamy mushroom pasta
fr-pates-champignons-creme.tip: Save some cooking water to loosen the sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the onion and sliced mushrooms 6 minutes.
Add the cream and reduce 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and cheese.

it-spaghetti-aglio-olio.title: Spaghetti with garlic, oil and chili
it-spaghetti-aglio-olio.tip: Don't let the garlic burn, or it turns bitter.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Brown the sliced garlic in the oil with the chili over low heat.
Drain the pasta al dente and toss it in the pan.
Add a ladle of cooking water and the parsley.

it-pasta-al-pomodoro.title: Tomato and basil pasta
it-pasta-al-pomodoro.tip: Add the basil off the heat to keep its aroma.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and salt and cook 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta in salted water and drain.
Toss in the sauce and serve with basil and Parmesan.

it-carbonara.title: Spaghetti carbonara
it-carbonara.summary: Eggs, guanciale and cheese, no cream.
it-carbonara.tip: Never cream: the creaminess comes from the eggs and pasta water.
steps: Brown the diced guanciale in a skillet with no oil.
Beat the eggs with the cheese and plenty of pepper.
Cook the pasta in salted water and drain al dente.
Add to the guanciale off the heat and toss with the egg cream, adding a little pasta water.

it-cacio-e-pepe.title: Cacio e pepe pasta
it-cacio-e-pepe.summary: Two ingredients and a bit of technique.
it-cacio-e-pepe.tip: Use little cooking water: it needs to be concentrated to bind the sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in a small amount of salted water.
Toast the pepper in a skillet and add a ladle of pasta water.
Drain the pasta and finish cooking it in the skillet.
Off the heat, toss with the grated cheese.

it-pasta-e-fagioli.title: Pasta e fagioli
it-pasta-e-fagioli.summary: A one-dish meal, hot and hearty.
it-pasta-e-fagioli.tip: A drizzle of raw olive oil at the end adds a nice touch.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the tomato, drained beans and water.
Cook 20 minutes and mash a few beans to thicken.
Add the pasta and cook until al dente.

it-risotto-al-parmigiano.title: Parmesan risotto
it-risotto-al-parmigiano.tip: Let it rest covered 2 minutes before serving.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in the butter.
Toast the rice 1 minute and add hot broth, one ladle at a time.
Stir and cook about 16 minutes.
Finish off the heat with Parmesan and butter.

it-frittata-di-zucchine.title: Zucchini frittata
it-frittata-di-zucchine.tip: Cover with a lid so the top cooks through too.
steps: Slice the zucchini and sauté 6 minutes in oil.
Beat the eggs with the Parmesan and salt.
Pour the eggs over the zucchini and cook over low heat 5 minutes.
Flip the frittata with a plate and cook 3 minutes on the other side.

it-minestrone.title: Vegetable minestrone
it-minestrone.tip: Add a Parmesan rind while cooking for more flavor.
steps: Dice all the vegetables.
Sauté the onion in the oil and add the other vegetables.
Cover with the water, salt and cook 30 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook 10 more minutes.

it-parmigiana-di-melanzane.title: Eggplant parmigiana
it-parmigiana-di-melanzane.summary: Layers of eggplant, sauce and cheese.
it-parmigiana-di-melanzane.tip: Baking the slices instead of frying makes it lighter.
steps: Slice the eggplant and grill it or bake with oil.
Make a simple sauce with the tomato and salt.
In a baking dish alternate sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake 25 minutes at 400°F (200°C).

it-bruschette-al-pomodoro.title: Tomato bruschetta
it-bruschette-al-pomodoro.tip: Use ripe tomatoes: the flavor changes everything.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Rub the garlic on the warm bread.
Dice the tomato and season with oil, salt and basil.
Serve right away on the bread.

it-polpette-al-sugo.title: Meatballs in tomato sauce
it-polpette-al-sugo.tip: Wet your hands to shape the meatballs without sticking.
steps: Mix the meat with the egg, bread, Parmesan and salt; shape the meatballs.
Sauté the onion and add the tomato.
Put the meatballs in the sauce.
Cook covered for 25 minutes.

it-pollo-alla-cacciatora.title: Chicken cacciatore
it-pollo-alla-cacciatora.tip: Add a sprig of rosemary to perfume the sauce.
steps: Brown the salted chicken in a skillet with oil.
Add the sliced onion and the wine and let it evaporate.
Add the tomato and olives.
Cook covered over low heat for 30 minutes.

it-cotoletta-alla-milanese.title: Cotoletta alla milanese
it-cotoletta-alla-milanese.tip: The butter should be hot but not burnt.
steps: Pound the cutlets lightly and salt them.
Dip in beaten egg and then in breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot butter 3 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon wedges.

it-gnocchi-al-pomodoro.title: Gnocchi with tomato sauce
it-gnocchi-al-pomodoro.tip: Don't leave the gnocchi in the water longer than needed: they fall apart.
steps: Warm the tomato with a drizzle of oil and salt for 8 minutes.
Cook the gnocchi in salted water until they float.
Drain and add to the sauce.
Serve with diced mozzarella and basil.

it-pasta-alla-norma.title: Pasta alla Norma
it-pasta-alla-norma.tip: Salt the eggplant and let it rest 10 minutes to reduce bitterness.
steps: Dice the eggplant and sauté in oil until golden.
Add the tomato and salt and cook 10 minutes.
Cook the pasta and drain.
Toss with the sauce and finish with cheese and basil.

it-pasta-e-ceci.title: Pasta and chickpeas
it-pasta-e-ceci.tip: Serve with a drizzle of raw olive oil and black pepper.
steps: Sauté the garlic in the oil and add the tomato.
Add the drained chickpeas and water and cook 15 minutes.
Blend a ladle of chickpeas to thicken and return to the pot.
Cook the pasta directly in the soup.

it-insalata-caprese.title: Caprese salad
it-insalata-caprese.tip: Serve at room temperature for more flavor.
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Alternate them on a plate.
Season with oil, salt and basil.

it-pasta-al-tonno.title: Tuna pasta
it-pasta-al-tonno.tip: Add fresh parsley at the end.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Flavor the oil with the garlic and add the tomato for 8 minutes.
Add the drained tuna and warm 2 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta.

it-spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.title: Spaghetti puttanesca
it-spaghetti-alla-puttanesca.tip: Rinse salted capers to remove the excess.
steps: Flavor the oil with the garlic.
Add the tomato, olives and capers and cook 12 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and drain al dente.
Toss with the sauce.

it-lenticchie-e-salsiccia.title: Lentils with sausage
it-lenticchie-e-salsiccia.tip: If using dried lentils, cook them first for about 20 minutes.
steps: Brown the sausage pieces in a skillet with oil.
Add the chopped onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and the drained lentils with a ladle of water.
Cook 15 minutes over low heat.

it-pasta-al-forno.title: Baked pasta
it-pasta-al-forno.tip: Cook the pasta a couple of minutes less: it finishes in the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cook the pasta very al dente.
Warm the tomato with a drizzle of oil and salt 8 minutes.
Mix the pasta with the sauce, mozzarella and diced ham.
Pour into a baking dish, sprinkle with Parmesan and bake 20 minutes.

it-risotto-ai-funghi.title: Mushroom risotto
it-risotto-ai-funghi.tip: Don't wash the mushrooms: clean them with a damp cloth.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in the butter and add the sliced mushrooms; cook 6 minutes.
Toast the rice 1 minute.
Add hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring, for about 16 minutes.
Finish with the Parmesan off the heat.

it-pizza-veloce.title: Quick margherita pizza
it-pizza-veloce.tip: Drain the mozzarella well so the pizza doesn't get soggy.
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Put the base on a tray and cover it with tomato and a pinch of salt.
Add the diced mozzarella and a drizzle of oil.
Bake 10 minutes and finish with basil.

it-frittata-di-patate.title: Potato and onion frittata
it-frittata-di-patate.tip: Drain the potatoes of oil before adding them to the eggs.
steps: Slice the potato and onion thin and cook in oil 12 minutes, until tender.
Beat the eggs with salt.
Add the drained vegetables to the eggs.
Pour into the skillet and cook 5 minutes per side.

it-spezzatino-con-patate.title: Beef stew with potatoes
it-spezzatino-con-patate.tip: The slower it cooks, the more tender the meat.
steps: Brown the cubed meat in the oil and salt it.
Add the chopped onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and water and cook covered 30 minutes.
Add the potato pieces and cook 20 more minutes.

it-petto-di-pollo-al-limone.title: Lemon chicken breast
it-petto-di-pollo-al-limone.tip: Don't overcook the chicken: it dries out.
steps: Lightly flour the chicken and salt it.
Brown it in the butter 4 minutes per side.
Add the lemon juice and a little water.
Reduce 3 minutes and serve with the sauce.

it-insalata-di-riso.title: Rice salad
it-insalata-di-riso.tip: Rinse the rice in cold water so it doesn't stick.
steps: Cook the rice in salted water, drain and rinse under cold water.
Hard-boil the eggs 10 minutes and cut into wedges.
Mix the rice with the tuna, diced tomato, corn and eggs.
Dress with oil and salt.

it-penne-all-arrabbiata.title: Penne all'arrabbiata
it-penne-all-arrabbiata.tip: For a milder taste, use less chili.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Flavor the oil with the garlic and chili over low heat.
Add the tomato and salt and cook 12 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta.

it-frittata-di-spinaci.title: Spinach frittata
it-frittata-di-spinaci.tip: Squeeze the cooked spinach well to remove the water.
steps: Cook the spinach in a skillet with a little oil until wilted, 4 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the Parmesan and salt.
Add the spinach and pour into the skillet.
Cook 4 minutes per side.

it-crema-di-zucca.title: Pumpkin cream soup
it-crema-di-zucca.tip: A pinch of nutmeg makes it more aromatic.
steps: Peel the pumpkin and dice it with the potato.
Sauté the onion in the oil.
Add the pumpkin, potato and water and salt; cook 20 minutes.
Blend until creamy.

it-pasta-e-patate.title: Pasta and potatoes
it-pasta-e-patate.tip: Mash a few potatoes to make the dish creamier.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in the oil.
Add the diced potatoes and brown 3 minutes.
Cover with the water, salt and cook 15 minutes.
Add the pasta, cook until tender and stir in the cheese.

it-uova-in-purgatorio.title: Eggs in purgatory
it-uova-in-purgatorio.tip: Serve with bread for dipping in the sauce.
steps: Sauté the onion in the oil and add the tomato and salt.
Cook 10 minutes.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them.
Cook covered 5 minutes, until the whites are set.

de-spaghetti-bolognese.title: Spaghetti with meat sauce
de-spaghetti-bolognese.tip: A little pasta water makes the sauce smoother.
steps: Chop the onion and brown it with the ground beef in oil, breaking it up.
Add the tomatoes, salt and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente and drain.
Serve with the sauce and Parmesan.

de-kartoffelsuppe.title: Potato soup
de-kartoffelsuppe.tip: A little marjoram enhances the soup.
steps: Dice the onion, potatoes and carrots.
Sauté the onion in butter, then add the vegetables.
Cover with water, salt and cook 20 minutes.
Partly blend and add the sliced sausages.

de-bratkartoffeln-spiegelei.title: Fried potatoes with fried egg
de-bratkartoffeln-spiegelei.tip: Best with day-old potatoes: they get crispier.
steps: Boil the potatoes, let cool and slice them.
Fry in a skillet with oil 10 minutes until crisp.
Add the onion and bacon and fry along.
Fry the eggs and place them on the potatoes.

de-linsensuppe.title: Lentil soup
de-linsensuppe.tip: A splash of vinegar at the end lifts the flavor.
steps: Dice the onion, carrots and potatoes and sauté in oil.
Add the lentils and broth.
Cook about 30 minutes until tender and salt.
Briefly warm the sliced sausages in the soup.

de-kasespatzle.title: Cheese spätzle
de-kasespatzle.summary: Spätzle with cheese and fried onions.
de-kasespatzle.tip: Put cheese between the layers so it melts everywhere.
steps: Slice the onions into rings and fry golden in butter.
Cook the spätzle in salted water per the package.
Drain and layer with the cheese in a dish.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8 minutes and serve with the onions.

de-kartoffelpuffer.title: Potato pancakes
de-kartoffelpuffer.tip: Let the squeezed-out liquid settle and mix the starch back in.
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion and squeeze well.
Mix with the egg, flour and salt.
Press small portions flat in hot oil.
Fry crisp on both sides, about 4 minutes per side.

de-frikadellen.title: German meat patties
de-frikadellen.tip: Wet hands make the patties easier to shape.
steps: Chop the onion fine and knead with the meat, egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper.
Shape into flat patties.
Fry in hot oil 5 minutes per side.
Serve with a side.

de-nudelauflauf.title: Ham noodle bake
de-nudelauflauf.summary: From the oven, with lots of cheese.
de-nudelauflauf.tip: Don't cook the noodles completely soft: they keep cooking in the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cook the noodles al dente.
Dice the ham and put it in a dish with the noodles.
Whisk the cream with the egg and salt and pour over.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 20 minutes.

de-haehnchenschnitzel.title: Chicken schnitzel
steps: Pound the meat flat and salt it.
Dredge in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs in turn.
Fry in plenty of hot oil 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towels.

de-pellkartoffeln-quark.title: Boiled potatoes with herb quark
de-pellkartoffeln-quark.tip: A splash of milk makes the quark creamier.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins in salted water 20 to 25 minutes.
Mix the quark with the herbs and salt.
Drain the potatoes and let them steam off a moment.
Serve with the quark and a little oil.

de-gemuese-eintopf.title: Vegetable stew with sausages
de-gemuese-eintopf.tip: It tastes even better the next day.
steps: Wash the vegetables and cut into pieces.
Cook with the broth for 20 minutes.
Slice the sausages and add them.
Let steep 5 more minutes and season.

de-reispfanne-haehnchen.title: Chicken and rice skillet
de-reispfanne-haehnchen.tip: Don't stir, so the rice doesn't stick.
steps: Dice the chicken, salt it and brown in oil.
Add the onion and pepper and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and pour in the water.
Cook covered 15 minutes over low heat.

de-flammkuchen.title: Flammkuchen
de-flammkuchen.tip: The thinner the dough, the crispier the flammkuchen.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Roll out the dough and spread with crème fraîche and salt.
Scatter the onion rings and bacon over it.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes, until the edge is crisp.

de-bratwurst-sauerkraut.title: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and mash
de-bratwurst-sauerkraut.tip: A piece of apple in the sauerkraut softens the acidity.
steps: Peel and boil the potatoes and mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Warm the sauerkraut in a pot for 15 minutes.
Brown the bratwurst in a skillet all around.
Serve everything together.

de-gebratene-nudeln-ei.title: Fried noodles with egg
de-gebratene-nudeln-ei.tip: Fry over high heat so the noodles don't stick.
steps: Chop the onion and carrot small and sauté 4 minutes in oil.
Add the noodles and fry over high heat.
Push to the edge and scramble the eggs until set.
Mix everything and season with soy sauce.

de-tomatensuppe.title: Tomato soup
de-tomatensuppe.tip: A pinch of sugar takes away the sourness.
steps: Chop the onion and sweat it in oil until translucent.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth and salt.
Serve with a splash of cream.

de-herzhafte-eierkuchen.title: Savory pancakes
de-herzhafte-eierkuchen.tip: Rest the batter 10 minutes and it works better.
steps: Whisk the eggs, flour, milk and salt into a smooth batter.
Heat a little butter in a skillet and spread a ladle of batter.
After 2 minutes flip and top with ham and cheese.
Fold until the cheese melts.

de-hackbraten.title: Meatloaf
de-hackbraten.tip: Wrapped in bacon it stays juicier.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Mix the meat with the egg, breadcrumbs, chopped onion, mustard, salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf and place in a dish.
Bake 45 minutes and rest 5 minutes before slicing.

de-ruehrei-mit-schinken.title: Scrambled eggs with ham and bread
de-ruehrei-mit-schinken.tip: Take the eggs off the heat while they are still creamy.
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Melt the butter in the pan and let the eggs set over low heat.
Briefly cook the ham strips along.
Serve with chives on bread.

de-gulasch.title: Beef goulash
de-gulasch.summary: Tender meat in a spicy sauce.
de-gulasch.tip: Never leave the paprika long in the hot pan: it turns bitter.
steps: Cube the meat, salt it and sear in oil.
Add the onions and pepper and sweat with the paprika.
Pour in the broth and braise covered 35 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook 15 more minutes.

de-kartoffelsalat.title: German potato salad
de-kartoffelsalat.summary: With vinegar and broth, like grandma's.
steps: Cook the potatoes in their skins, peel and slice.
Chop the onion fine and mix with hot broth, vinegar, oil and salt.
Pour the dressing over the still-warm potatoes.
Mix in the sliced pickles and let sit 15 minutes.

de-spiegelei-spinat-kartoffeln.title: Fried egg with spinach and potatoes
de-spiegelei-spinat-kartoffeln.tip: A pinch of nutmeg goes well with spinach.
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water 20 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in a pot with a little butter and salt it.
Fry the eggs in a skillet.
Serve everything together.

de-nudelsalat.title: Pasta salad
de-nudelsalat.tip: Rinse the pasta in cold water so the salad doesn't stick.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, drain and rinse cold.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix everything with the corn and mayonnaise.
Season with salt and let sit 15 minutes.

de-fischstaebchen-puree.title: Fish sticks with mashed potatoes
de-fischstaebchen-puree.tip: On a hot tray the fish sticks get really crisp on the bottom.
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water 20 minutes.
Mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Bake the fish sticks crisp in the oven or a skillet per the package.
Serve together.

de-currywurst.title: Currywurst with fries
de-currywurst.tip: Warm the curry powder briefly in the sauce so it releases its aroma.
steps: Cut the potatoes into sticks and bake at 425°F (220°C) for 25 minutes until crisp.
Brown the sausage in a skillet all around.
Bring the ketchup to a boil with the curry powder and a splash of water.
Slice the sausage and serve with the sauce and the fries.

de-pilzpfanne-mit-ei.title: Mushroom and egg skillet
de-pilzpfanne-mit-ei.tip: Don't wash mushrooms; just wipe them with a cloth.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and sear them in butter.
Add the onion and cook 3 more minutes; salt.
Beat the eggs and pour over.
Let set over low heat and serve with parsley.

de-hackfleischpfanne.title: Ground beef skillet with peppers and rice
de-hackfleischpfanne.tip: Don't stir, so the rice doesn't stick.
steps: Chop the onion and brown it with the beef in oil, breaking it up.
Dice the pepper and cook 3 minutes along.
Stir in the rice and pour in the water and salt.
Cook covered 15 minutes over low heat.

de-blumenkohl-ueberbacken.title: Baked cauliflower
de-blumenkohl-ueberbacken.tip: Drain well, or the sauce turns watery.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and break the cauliflower into florets.
Boil in salted water 8 minutes and drain well.
Put in a dish and cover with the cream, nutmeg and cheese.
Bake 20 minutes.

de-moehrensuppe.title: Carrot soup
de-moehrensuppe.tip: A spoonful of cream or crème fraîche makes it even creamier.
steps: Peel and dice the carrots, potato and onion.
Sauté the onion in butter and add the vegetables.
Cover with the broth and cook 20 minutes.
Blend smooth and season.

de-nudeln-mit-tomatensosse.title: Pasta with tomato sauce
de-nudeln-mit-tomatensosse.tip: A pinch of sugar softens the tomatoes' acidity.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté the onion in oil.
Add the tomatoes, salt and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with the pasta and grated cheese.

de-bohneneintopf.title: Bean stew with sausages
de-bohneneintopf.tip: A splash of vinegar at the end rounds it out.
steps: Dice the onion, carrot and potatoes and sauté in oil.
Cover with the broth and cook 15 minutes.
Add the drained beans.
Warm the sliced sausages and adjust the seasoning.

milanesas-al-horno-con-pure.title: Baked milanesas with mashed potatoes
milanesas-al-horno-con-pure.tip: Flip them only once so they get golden and crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt; dip the cutlets in the egg and then in the breadcrumbs.
Put them on a tray with a drizzle of oil and bake 10 minutes per side.
Meanwhile boil the peeled, chunked potatoes about 20 minutes.
Mash with a little milk and butter, salt, and serve with the milanesas.

tortilla-de-papas.title: Spanish-style potato omelet
tortilla-de-papas.tip: Drain the potatoes of oil well before mixing them with the egg.
steps: Peel the potatoes and slice thin; chop the onion.
Cook the potatoes and onion in the skillet with oil over medium heat about 15 minutes, until tender.
Beat the eggs with salt and mix with the drained potatoes.
Pour into the skillet and cook 5 minutes per side, flipping with a plate.

fideos-con-salsa-de-tomate.title: Pasta with tomato sauce and cheese
fideos-con-salsa-de-tomate.tip: Save a little cooking water to loosen the sauce if it gets thick.
steps: Boil the pasta in plenty of salted water for the time on the package.
Meanwhile sauté the chopped onion in oil 3 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato (or the can) and cook 10 minutes, salting to taste.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and serve with grated cheese.

arroz-con-pollo.title: Chicken and rice
arroz-con-pollo.summary: A complete dish in one pot.
arroz-con-pollo.tip: Don't lift the lid while the rice cooks.
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces, salt them and brown in a pot with oil.
Add the chopped onion, pepper and carrot and cook 5 minutes.
Add the rice, stir a minute and cover with hot water.
Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes, until the rice is done.
Rest 5 minutes covered before serving.

guiso-de-lentejas.title: Lentil stew
guiso-de-lentejas.summary: Stretches far, warms you up and is very economical.
guiso-de-lentejas.tip: Salt at the end: salt at the start toughens lentils.
steps: If the lentils are dry, soak them 30 minutes (if canned, drain them).
Sauté the onion, carrot and diced chorizo in a pot with oil.
Add the diced potatoes, lentils and water.
Cook covered over low heat 30 minutes, until everything is tender, and salt at the end.

tarta-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Ham and cheese tart
tarta-de-jamon-y-queso.summary: Comes together in minutes with a store-bought crust.
tarta-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Prick the dough with a fork so it doesn't puff up.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tart pan with the crust.
Cut the ham and cheese into pieces and spread them over the dough.
Beat the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt and pour over.
Bake 25 minutes, until golden and set.

tarta-de-zapallitos.title: Zucchini and cheese tart
tarta-de-zapallitos.tip: Drain the vegetables well so the tart isn't watery.
steps: Slice the zucchini and chop the onion; sauté everything in oil 8 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tart pan with the dough.
Mix the vegetables with the cubed cheese and beaten eggs, and salt.
Pour the filling into the tart and bake 25 minutes.

pollo-al-horno-con-papas.title: Roast chicken with potatoes
pollo-al-horno-con-papas.summary: It cooks itself while you do something else.
pollo-al-horno-con-papas.tip: The chicken is done when the juices run clear when pierced.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the chicken in a dish with salt, oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Add the potato wedges and onion rings around it.
Roast 50 minutes, turning everything halfway, until well browned.

ensalada-de-atun.title: Complete tuna salad
ensalada-de-atun.tip: Put the eggs in cold water as soon as they finish so they peel more easily.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool and peel them.
Cut the tomato, lettuce and onion and put them in a bowl.
Add the drained tuna and the eggs in quarters.
Season with salt, oil and lemon.

revuelto-de-zapallitos.title: Zucchini scramble
revuelto-de-zapallitos.tip: Take it off the heat while still creamy: it keeps cooking on the plate.
steps: Cube the zucchini and dice the onion.
Cook them in a skillet with oil 8 minutes, until tender.
Add the beaten eggs with salt and stir over low heat until set.
Add the cheese and serve right away.

sopa-de-verduras.title: Vegetable soup
sopa-de-verduras.summary: Ideal for using up what's left from the market.
sopa-de-verduras.tip: If you blend it, add a drizzle of raw oil on top when serving.
steps: Peel and cube all the vegetables.
Sauté the onion in oil 3 minutes in a pot.
Add the rest of the vegetables and the water, and salt.
Cook covered 25 minutes, until very tender; serve whole or blended.

omelette-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Ham and cheese omelet
omelette-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Use medium-low heat so it doesn't burn outside and stays juicy.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the skillet with the butter and pour in half the eggs.
When it starts to set, put the ham and cheese in the center and fold.
Repeat with the rest and serve hot.

polenta-con-salsa.title: Polenta with sauce and cheese
polenta-con-salsa.tip: Always stir in the same direction to avoid lumps.
steps: Boil the water with salt and pour in the polenta in a rain, stirring.
Cook over low heat 5 to 10 minutes (or as the package says), stirring constantly.
Make a quick sauce with the onion and tomato in oil for 10 minutes.
Serve the polenta with the sauce and cheese on top.

salteado-de-carne-con-verduras.title: Beef and vegetable stir-fry with rice
salteado-de-carne-con-verduras.tip: Stir-fry the meat in batches: if the pan is crowded, it releases water and won't brown.
steps: Cook the rice in the salted water 15 to 18 minutes over low heat, covered.
Cut the meat into thin strips and the vegetables into strips.
Stir-fry the meat in a very hot pan with oil for 4 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables 5 minutes, return the meat and salt.
Serve over the rice.

hamburguesas-caseras.title: Homemade burgers with salad
hamburguesas-caseras.summary: With ground beef and whatever you have.
hamburguesas-caseras.tip: Make a dimple in the center of each burger so they don't puff up while cooking.
steps: Mix the meat with the egg, grated onion, breadcrumbs and salt.
Shape 4 burgers and press them firmly.
Cook in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve with lettuce and tomato, alone or on bread.

pastel-de-papas.title: Shepherd's pie
pastel-de-papas.summary: Grandma's dish, with ground beef and mashed potato.
pastel-de-papas.tip: Make the mash thick so it doesn't sink into the filling.
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes 20 minutes and mash with the milk and salt.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil and add the beef; cook 10 minutes and salt.
Put the beef in a dish, cover with the mash and sprinkle with the cheese.
Broil in a hot oven 15 minutes, until golden.

pizzeta-casera.title: Mini pizzas with pre-baked crust
pizzeta-casera.tip: A drizzle of oil when they come out of the oven makes them tastier.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cover the crusts with the tomato or sauce.
Add the mozzarella in strips and the oregano.
Bake 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and browns.

arroz-salteado-con-huevo.title: Fried rice with egg and vegetables
arroz-salteado-con-huevo.summary: Ideal for using up leftover rice.
arroz-salteado-con-huevo.tip: Day-old rice comes out looser than freshly made.
steps: Grate the carrot and chop the onion; sauté in oil 4 minutes.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry over high heat 3 minutes.
Make a well, pour in the beaten eggs and stir until set.
Mix everything, salt and serve.

fideos-con-atun.title: Pasta with tuna and tomato
fideos-con-atun.summary: A pantry dish that saves the night.
fideos-con-atun.tip: Add a little cooking water if the sauce gets dry.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water for the package time.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the tomato; cook 10 minutes.
Add the drained tuna and warm 2 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta and serve.

ensalada-de-lentejas.title: Warm lentil salad
ensalada-de-lentejas.summary: Complete and fresh, works as a one-dish meal.
ensalada-de-lentejas.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes before serving so it absorbs flavor.
steps: Drain and rinse the lentils; if dry, boil them first until tender.
Dice the tomato and onion.
Mix everything in a bowl and season with salt, oil and lemon.
Top with hard-boiled egg in quarters.

pure-con-huevo-frito.title: Mashed potatoes with fried egg
pure-con-huevo-frito.summary: The simplest thing when there's not much.
pure-con-huevo-frito.tip: The hotter the milk, the creamier the mash.
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them and boil 20 minutes.
Mash with the milk, butter and salt until smooth.
Fry the eggs in a skillet with oil.
Serve the mash with the egg on top.

milanesa-a-la-napolitana.title: Milanesa napolitana
milanesa-a-la-napolitana.summary: The usual milanesa, with sauce, ham and melted cheese.
milanesa-a-la-napolitana.tip: Add the sauce just before broiling so the breading stays crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cook the milanesas in the oven or a skillet until golden on both sides.
Move to a tray and top each with tomato sauce, a slice of ham and the mozzarella.
Sprinkle with oregano and broil 8 minutes, until the cheese melts.

revuelto-gramajo.title: Revuelto gramajo
revuelto-gramajo.summary: Fries, ham and egg: a night classic.
revuelto-gramajo.tip: The fries can be from a bag to save time.
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut into thin sticks and fry in hot oil until golden; drain.
In a skillet, sauté the chopped onion and ham strips 3 minutes.
Add the fries and pour in the beaten eggs with salt.
Stir over low heat until the egg sets and serve right away.

canelones-de-verdura-y-ricota.title: Spinach and ricotta cannelloni
canelones-de-verdura-y-ricota.summary: The Sunday dish, filled with chard or spinach.
canelones-de-verdura-y-ricota.tip: Squeeze the greens dry with your hands: leftover water loosens the filling.
steps: Boil the chard 3 minutes, drain well, chop and mix with the ricotta and salt.
Fill each sheet with a spoonful of filling and roll up.
Put a little tomato sauce in a dish, arrange the cannelloni and cover with more sauce.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake 25 minutes at 400°F (200°C).

empanadas-de-carne-al-horno.title: Baked beef empanadas
empanadas-de-carne-al-horno.summary: Quick to make with store-bought dough rounds.
empanadas-de-carne-al-horno.tip: The filling must be cold so the dough doesn't tear.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and beef in oil with salt and cumin; let the filling cool.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and chop them; mix into the filling.
Put a spoonful of filling on each round and seal with a crimp.
Bake 20 minutes at 425°F (220°C), until golden.

noquis-de-papa-con-salsa.title: Potato gnocchi with sauce
noquis-de-papa-con-salsa.summary: Homemade, cheap and much easier than they seem.
noquis-de-papa-con-salsa.tip: The less flour you use, the lighter the gnocchi.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender, peel and mash while hot.
Mix the mash with the flour, egg and salt into a soft, non-sticky dough.
Roll into ropes, cut into pieces and mark with a fork.
Boil in salted water; when they float, wait 1 minute and drain.
Serve with hot tomato sauce and grated cheese.

matambre-a-la-pizza.title: Pizza-style flank steak
matambre-a-la-pizza.summary: Tender beef covered in sauce and cheese.
matambre-a-la-pizza.tip: If the flank steak is thick, cook it 10 minutes longer before covering.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the steak.
Cook it in a baking dish 30 minutes, until tender.
Cover with tomato sauce, the mozzarella and oregano.
Broil 10 minutes and cut into portions.

pionono-relleno.title: Savory filled roll
pionono-relleno.summary: Cold, quick and ideal for dinner.
pionono-relleno.tip: Roll it up tightly so it doesn't fall apart when sliced.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and chop.
Spread the sheet with mayonnaise and distribute the ham, cheese and egg.
Roll up carefully, using a kitchen towel to help.
Wrap and chill 15 minutes before slicing.

zapallitos-rellenos.title: Stuffed round zucchini
zapallitos-rellenos.summary: A different way to eat vegetables.
zapallitos-rellenos.tip: Use the zucchini flesh in the filling: nothing is wasted.
steps: Boil the whole zucchini 10 minutes, halve and scoop out the flesh.
Sauté the onion in oil, add the beef and cook 8 minutes with salt.
Mix the filling with the chopped flesh and fill the halves.
Cover with cheese and bake 15 minutes at 400°F (200°C).

albondigas-con-salsa.title: Meatballs with sauce
albondigas-con-salsa.summary: With pasta or mash, always a hit.
albondigas-con-salsa.tip: Wet your hands to shape the balls without sticking.
steps: Mix the meat with the egg, breadcrumbs, half the grated onion and salt.
Shape walnut-sized balls.
Sauté the rest of the onion in a pot, add the tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the meatballs and cook covered 20 minutes, turning once.

tarta-de-acelga.title: Chard tart
tarta-de-acelga.tip: Squeeze the chard with your hands to remove all the water.
steps: Boil the chard leaves 3 minutes, drain well and chop.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil and mix with the chard, beaten eggs, cheese and salt.
Line a tart pan with the dough and pour in the filling.
Bake 30 minutes at 400°F (200°C), until set and golden.

ensalada-rusa.title: Russian salad
ensalada-rusa.summary: Potato, carrot and egg: a classic on every table.
ensalada-rusa.tip: Don't overcook the potatoes: they should stay whole.
steps: Boil the peeled, diced potatoes and carrots until tender but firm.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and chop.
Drain and cool everything.
Mix with the peas, mayonnaise and salt, and serve cold.

choripan.title: Choripán
choripan.summary: The grill classic, made in a skillet or the oven.
choripan.tip: Medium heat: too strong and they burn outside and stay raw inside.
steps: Prick the sausages and cook in a skillet over medium heat 15 minutes, turning.
Split them lengthwise.
Warm the bread a few minutes and assemble the sandwich.
Add chopped tomato and onion if you like.

estofado-de-carne-con-papas.title: Beef stew with potatoes
estofado-de-carne-con-papas.tip: If the meat is tough, cook it longer before adding the potatoes.
steps: Brown the cubed beef in a pot with oil and salt it.
Add the chopped onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and water, cover and cook over low heat 25 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook 20 more minutes, until everything is tender.

guiso-de-fideos.title: Noodle stew
guiso-de-fideos.summary: Stretches far and uses whatever you have.
guiso-de-fideos.tip: If it gets too thick, add a little more hot water.
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and diced chorizo in a pot with oil.
Add the diced potato, tomato and water, and salt.
Cook 15 minutes until the potato is almost done.
Add the pasta and cook for the package time, stirring often.

fideos-con-crema-y-jamon.title: Pasta with cream and ham
fideos-con-crema-y-jamon.tip: Don't boil the cream hard: it splits.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water for the package time.
Cut the ham into strips and warm 2 minutes in a skillet.
Add the cream and cook 3 minutes over low heat.
Toss with the drained pasta and grated cheese.

berenjenas-a-la-napolitana.title: Eggplant napolitana
berenjenas-a-la-napolitana.summary: Baked eggplant with sauce and cheese.
berenjenas-a-la-napolitana.tip: Salting the eggplant first removes the bitterness.
steps: Slice the eggplant, salt and let it sit 10 minutes; pat dry.
Brown on a tray with oil in a 400°F (200°C) oven for 15 minutes.
Layer in a dish with tomato sauce, eggplant, ham and mozzarella.
Broil 15 minutes and sprinkle with oregano.

pollo-a-la-cacerola.title: Braised chicken with vegetables
pollo-a-la-cacerola.summary: All in one pot, tender and with lots of sauce.
pollo-a-la-cacerola.tip: Rest 5 minutes before serving: the sauce thickens.
steps: Brown the salted chicken in a pot with oil and set aside.
In the same pot sauté the onion and carrot 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the tomato and water, and cook covered 20 minutes.
Add the potato chunks and cook 20 more minutes, until everything is tender.

tostado-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Grilled ham and cheese
tostado-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Press them with a spatula while they toast.
steps: Make the sandwiches with ham and cheese between two slices.
Spread the outside with a little butter.
Toast in a skillet or sandwich maker 3 minutes per side, until the cheese melts.

sandwich-de-milanesa.title: Full milanesa sandwich
sandwich-de-milanesa.summary: With lettuce and tomato, like at any diner.
sandwich-de-milanesa.tip: Drain the milanesas on paper towels so the bread doesn't get soggy.
steps: Cook the milanesas in a skillet with oil or in the oven until golden.
Open the rolls and spread with mayonnaise.
Assemble with the milanesa, lettuce and sliced tomato.

ravioles-con-salsa.title: Ravioli with tomato sauce
ravioles-con-salsa.tip: Boil them gently: if the water boils too hard, they break.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil and add the tomato; cook 10 minutes with salt.
Boil the ravioli in salted water until they float, about 4 minutes.
Drain carefully and serve with the sauce and grated cheese.

es-tortilla-de-patatas.title: Spanish potato omelet
es-tortilla-de-patatas.summary: The Spanish classic: potato, egg and onion.
es-tortilla-de-patatas.tip: Let the mixture rest 5 minutes before setting it: it gets juicier.
steps: Peel the potatoes, slice them thin and chop the onion.
Fry them over medium heat in oil about 15 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Beat the eggs with salt and mix with the potatoes.
Set the mixture in a skillet 4 minutes per side, flipping with a plate.

es-gazpacho.title: Andalusian gazpacho
es-gazpacho.summary: Cold, fresh and ready in 15 minutes.
es-gazpacho.tip: Taste and adjust the salt and vinegar once it's cold.
steps: Wash and chop the tomato, cucumber and pepper.
Blend everything with the soaked bread, garlic, oil, vinegar and salt.
Strain through a sieve for a finer texture if you like.
Chill at least 1 hour and serve very cold.

es-lentejas-estofadas.title: Stewed lentils
es-lentejas-estofadas.summary: A spoon dish that feels great.
es-lentejas-estofadas.tip: If using jarred lentils, cut the total cooking to 15 minutes.
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and chorizo in small pieces in oil.
Add the paprika, lentils and water.
Simmer covered over low heat 25 minutes.
Add the diced potato and cook 15 more minutes; season at the end.

es-arroz-a-la-cubana.title: Cuban-style rice
es-arroz-a-la-cubana.summary: Rice, fried tomato sauce and egg: simple and very popular.
es-arroz-a-la-cubana.tip: Press the rice into a small mold to shape it into a dome when serving.
steps: Cook the rice with twice the water and salt, covered over low heat, about 15 minutes.
Warm the tomato sauce.
Fry the eggs in very hot oil, and the sliced plantain if using.
Serve the rice with the tomato sauce, fried egg and plantain.

es-huevos-rotos-con-jamon.title: Broken eggs with ham
es-huevos-rotos-con-jamon.summary: Fried potatoes, eggs and ham: a Madrid classic.
es-huevos-rotos-con-jamon.tip: Salt the potatoes right as they come out of the oil.
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut into slices or sticks.
Fry in oil until golden and drain.
Fry the eggs in hot oil with soft yolks.
Serve the eggs over the potatoes, break them at the table and add the ham.

es-pisto-con-huevo.title: Pisto with egg
es-pisto-con-huevo.summary: Garden vegetables with an egg on top.
es-pisto-con-huevo.tip: The slower it cooks, the more flavor the pisto has.
steps: Cut all the vegetables into small dice.
Soften the onion and pepper in oil 8 minutes.
Add the zucchini and tomato and cook over low heat 20 minutes, until thick; season.
Fry the eggs and serve them on top of the pisto.

es-salmorejo.title: Córdoba salmorejo
es-salmorejo.summary: A cold, thick cream soup and very easy.
es-salmorejo.tip: Day-old bread gives a better texture.
steps: Blend the tomatoes with the garlic and salt until no chunks remain.
Add the bread and let rest 10 minutes to soak.
Blend again while pouring in the oil slowly.
Serve cold with chopped hard-boiled egg and ham.

es-merluza-al-horno-con-patatas.title: Baked hake with potatoes
es-merluza-al-horno-con-patatas.tip: Don't overcook the fish: it dries out quickly.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Slice the potatoes thin and the onion into rings; put them in a dish with oil and salt and bake 20 minutes.
Place the hake on top, season and drizzle with lemon and oil.
Bake 12 more minutes, until the fish is opaque.

es-pollo-al-ajillo.title: Garlic chicken
es-pollo-al-ajillo.tip: In their skins, the garlic cloves cook without turning bitter.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in a casserole with oil.
Add the garlic cloves in their skins, lightly crushed.
Pour in the wine and let it evaporate.
Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes; finish with chopped parsley.

es-albondigas-en-salsa.title: Meatballs in almond sauce
es-albondigas-en-salsa.summary: Homemade meatballs in a golden almond and white wine sauce, Spanish style.
es-albondigas-en-salsa.tip: Toast the almonds dry before grinding them: the sauce gains flavor and color.
steps: Mix the meat with the egg, breadcrumbs, minced garlic and salt; shape into balls and roll them in flour.
Brown them in a pan with oil and set aside.
In the same oil, fry the chopped onion until golden, add the wine and let it reduce for 2 minutes.
Blend the toasted almonds with a glass of water, pour into the pan and add the meatballs.
Cook covered over low heat for 20 minutes, shaking the pan from time to time.

es-macarrones-con-chorizo.title: Macaroni with chorizo and tomato
es-macarrones-con-chorizo.summary: The dish for when you're in a hurry.
es-macarrones-con-chorizo.tip: Save a little pasta water to loosen the sauce.
steps: Cook the macaroni in salted water per the package.
Slice the chorizo and brown it in a skillet with no oil.
Add the tomato sauce and cook 5 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta and serve with grated cheese.

es-sopa-castellana.title: Castilian garlic soup
es-sopa-castellana.summary: Garlic soup with egg, simple and from the pantry.
es-sopa-castellana.tip: Take it off the heat as soon as the paprika goes in: it burns very fast.
steps: Fry the sliced garlic in oil without burning it.
Add the bread in thin slices and sauté one minute.
Stir in the paprika and straight away the hot water; season and cook 10 minutes.
Crack the eggs on top and poach 3 minutes in the soup.

es-garbanzos-con-espinacas.title: Chickpeas with spinach
es-garbanzos-con-espinacas.summary: An Andalusian classic, economical and complete.
es-garbanzos-con-espinacas.tip: A splash of vinegar at the end gives it a lot of character.
steps: Drain the chickpeas and wash the spinach.
Sauté the garlic in oil and add the paprika and cumin.
Add the spinach and cook until it wilts.
Add the chickpeas with a little water and cook 10 minutes.

es-revuelto-de-champinones.title: Mushroom scramble
es-revuelto-de-champinones.tip: Don't wash mushrooms under the tap: wipe them with a cloth.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and sauté with the garlic in hot oil.
When they release their water and brown, season.
Add the beaten eggs and stir over low heat.
Remove when set but still creamy.

es-ensaladilla-rusa.title: Spanish potato salad
es-ensaladilla-rusa.summary: The tapa from every bar, at home.
es-ensaladilla-rusa.tip: Mix it when the potatoes are cold or the mayonnaise splits.
steps: Boil the diced potatoes and carrot until tender.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes and chop.
Let everything cool and mix with the tuna and mayonnaise.
Season and serve cold.

es-judias-verdes-con-patatas.title: Green beans with potatoes
es-judias-verdes-con-patatas.tip: Take the beans out while still a bit firm.
steps: Trim the beans and dice the potatoes.
Cook them together in salted water about 20 minutes.
Drain.
Brown the sliced garlic and ham in oil and pour over.

es-berenjenas-rellenas.title: Stuffed eggplant
es-berenjenas-rellenas.summary: Baked, with beef and melted cheese.
es-berenjenas-rellenas.tip: Score the flesh before baking: it cooks faster.
steps: Halve the eggplants and bake 20 minutes at 400°F (200°C).
Scoop out the flesh with a spoon and chop it.
Sauté the onion, beef, flesh and tomato 10 minutes.
Fill the halves, cover with cheese and broil 10 minutes.

es-migas-con-chorizo.title: Migas with chorizo
es-migas-con-chorizo.summary: Crumbled, fried bread, a shepherd's dish.
es-migas-con-chorizo.tip: With a fried egg or grapes on top, even better.
steps: Crumble the bread into small pieces and moisten with water and salt; rest 10 minutes.
Brown the chorizo and garlic in a large skillet with oil.
Add the paprika and the bread.
Stir over medium heat 15 minutes until loose and golden.

es-patatas-a-lo-pobre.title: Poor man's potatoes
es-patatas-a-lo-pobre.summary: Potato, onion and pepper, nothing more.
es-patatas-a-lo-pobre.tip: Cover the pan the first few minutes so they steam through.
steps: Slice the potatoes thin and cut the onion and pepper into strips.
Fry everything over low heat in oil about 25 minutes, stirring.
Season at the end.
Serve with a fried egg on top.

es-arroz-con-verduras.title: Rice with vegetables
es-arroz-con-verduras.summary: A dry rice with whatever is in the fridge.
es-arroz-con-verduras.tip: Use double the water as rice, measured with the same cup.
steps: Sauté the onion and chopped vegetables in oil 8 minutes.
Add the grated tomato and the rice and stir a minute.
Cover with the hot water and salt.
Cook 15 minutes over low heat and rest 5 minutes.

es-pechugas-a-la-plancha.title: Grilled chicken breast with salad
es-pechugas-a-la-plancha.tip: Rest the breast 2 minutes before slicing.
steps: Flatten the cutlets a little and season with salt and lemon.
Cook on a hot griddle with oil 4 minutes per side.
Make a salad with the lettuce and tomato.
Serve together with a drizzle of oil and lemon.

ar-fideos-con-tuco-y-carne.title: Pasta with tuco and ground beef
ar-fideos-con-tuco-y-carne.tip: The longer the tuco cooks, the more flavor it has.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil and add the beef; cook 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the tomato, salt and a little water, and cook covered 20 minutes over low heat.
Boil the pasta in salted water for the package time and drain.
Serve with the tuco on top and grated cheese.

ar-ensalada-de-arroz-con-atun.title: Rice and tuna salad
ar-ensalada-de-arroz-con-atun.summary: Fresh, no oven and stretches far.
ar-ensalada-de-arroz-con-atun.tip: Cool the rice well before mixing so it doesn't clump.
steps: Boil the rice in salted water 15 minutes, drain and cool under the tap.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix the rice with the drained tuna, chopped tomato and onion.
Season with salt, oil and lemon and add the egg.

ar-tarta-de-choclo.title: Corn tart
ar-tarta-de-choclo.tip: If the corn is canned, drain it very well.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tart pan with the dough.
Sauté the chopped onion and mix with the drained corn.
Add the beaten eggs, cubed cheese and salt.
Pour the filling into the tart and bake 30 minutes.

ar-papas-a-la-crema-con-jamon.title: Creamy potatoes with ham
ar-papas-a-la-crema-con-jamon.tip: With pepper and nutmeg it's even better.
steps: Peel the potatoes, slice thin and boil 8 minutes.
Put in a dish with the chopped ham and salt.
Cover with the cream and cheese.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°F (200°C).

ar-pollo-a-la-mostaza.title: Mustard chicken
ar-pollo-a-la-mostaza.tip: If the sauce gets thick, loosen it with a splash of water.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in a skillet with oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook 4 minutes.
Add the mustard and cream and cook covered 20 minutes over low heat.
Serve with the sauce on top.

ar-bife-con-ensalada.title: Pan-seared steak with mixed salad
ar-bife-con-ensalada.tip: Flip it only once so it browns well.
steps: Take the meat out of the fridge 10 minutes ahead and salt it.
Cook on a very hot griddle or skillet 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Rest 3 minutes.
Make the salad with lettuce, tomato and onion and dress with salt, oil and lemon.

ar-tortilla-de-acelga.title: Chard omelet
ar-tortilla-de-acelga.summary: An easy way to eat vegetables.
ar-tortilla-de-acelga.tip: Squeeze the chard with your hands to remove all the water.
steps: Boil the chard 3 minutes, drain well and chop.
Sauté the onion in oil and mix with the chard.
Beat the eggs with salt and add the chard and cheese.
Cook in a skillet 4 minutes per side.

ar-canelones-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Ham and cheese cannelloni
ar-canelones-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: A little cream on top keeps them juicier.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put a slice of ham and cheese on each sheet and roll up.
Arrange in a dish with a little tomato sauce and cover with more sauce.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 20 minutes.

ar-sopa-de-zapallo.title: Cream of pumpkin soup
ar-sopa-de-zapallo.tip: A splash of cream or milk at the end makes it smoother.
steps: Peel and cube the pumpkin, potato and onion.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the pumpkin and potato.
Cover with water, salt and cook 20 minutes until tender.
Blend until creamy and serve hot.

ar-empanadas-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Baked ham and cheese empanadas
ar-empanadas-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Brush with beaten egg so they come out shiny.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Put a spoonful of chopped ham and cheese on each round.
Seal with a crimp or a fork.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until golden.

ar-hamburguesas-de-lentejas.title: Lentil burgers
ar-hamburguesas-de-lentejas.tip: Let the mixture rest 10 minutes so it holds together better.
steps: Drain the lentils and mash with a fork.
Mix with the egg, breadcrumbs, grated onion and salt.
Shape burgers with wet hands.
Cook in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.

ar-zapallo-al-horno-con-queso.title: Baked squash with cheese
ar-zapallo-al-horno-con-queso.tip: Leave the skin on: it's edible and helps it hold together.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut the squash into wedges and put on a tray with oil and salt.
Bake 30 minutes, until tender.
Cover with cheese and broil 8 minutes.

ar-milanesa-de-berenjena.title: Eggplant milanesa
ar-milanesa-de-berenjena.tip: If baking them, brush with a little oil.
steps: Cut the eggplants into 1/2-inch slices and salt; rest 10 minutes and pat dry.
Dip in beaten egg and then in breadcrumbs.
Brown in a skillet with oil 3 minutes per side, or bake 20 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.

ar-ensalada-de-papa-y-huevo.title: Potato and egg salad
ar-ensalada-de-papa-y-huevo.tip: Dress the potatoes while still warm so they absorb flavor.
steps: Boil the diced potatoes until tender and drain.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix everything with the chopped onion, mayonnaise and salt.
Serve cold.

ar-provoleta.title: Grilled provoleta
ar-provoleta.tip: Use a wide spatula to flip it without breaking.
steps: Heat a nonstick skillet or grill over medium heat.
Put the cheese on and leave it 3 to 4 minutes, until browned underneath.
Flip carefully and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve with oregano and tomato slices.

es-crema-de-calabacin.title: Zucchini cream soup
es-crema-de-calabacin.summary: Smooth and light, ready in 30 minutes.
es-crema-de-calabacin.tip: Leave the zucchini skin on: it adds color and fiber.
steps: Peel the potato and chop the zucchini, potato and onion.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the other vegetables.
Cover with water, salt and cook 20 minutes.
Blend with the cheese until smooth.

es-huevos-al-plato.title: Baked eggs
es-huevos-al-plato.summary: With tomato, ham and a little cheese.
es-huevos-al-plato.tip: Take them out when the white sets: the yolk should stay soft.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Divide the tomato sauce between two small dishes and add the chopped ham.
Crack two eggs in each and season.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 8 to 10 minutes.

es-espaguetis-con-atun.title: Spaghetti with tuna and tomato
es-espaguetis-con-atun.tip: Add a pinch of sugar if the tomato is acidic.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water per the package.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil.
Add the tomato and drained tuna and heat 5 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta.

es-ensalada-mixta.title: Mixed salad with tuna and egg
es-ensalada-mixta.tip: Dress at serving time so the lettuce stays crisp.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes and peel.
Chop the lettuce, tomato and onion in a bowl.
Add the drained tuna, eggs in quarters and olives.
Dress with salt, oil and vinegar.

es-arroz-con-tomate-y-huevo.title: Rice with tomato and fried egg
es-arroz-con-tomate-y-huevo.summary: The dish for when there's little time.
es-arroz-con-tomate-y-huevo.tip: Rinse the rice before cooking so it stays loose.
steps: Cook the rice with double the water and salt, covered, about 15 minutes.
Warm the tomato sauce.
Fry the eggs in hot oil.
Serve the rice with the tomato and egg on top.

es-calabacines-rellenos.title: Stuffed zucchini
es-calabacines-rellenos.tip: Bake the hollowed zucchini 5 minutes before filling so they don't release water.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and halve the zucchini lengthwise.
Scoop out the flesh with a spoon and chop it.
Sauté the onion, beef and flesh 10 minutes with salt and the tomato.
Fill, cover with cheese and bake 20 minutes.

es-merluza-a-la-plancha.title: Grilled hake with salad
es-merluza-a-la-plancha.tip: Don't move it until it releases itself from the griddle.
steps: Pat the hake dry and salt it.
Cook on a hot griddle with oil 3 minutes per side.
Make a salad with lettuce and tomato.
Serve the fish with lemon.

es-lomo-con-pimientos.title: Pork loin with peppers
es-lomo-con-pimientos.tip: Cut the cutlets thin so they cook quickly.
steps: Slice the loin into cutlets and salt.
Brown in a skillet with oil 3 minutes per side and set aside.
Sauté the pepper and onion strips 8 minutes.
Mix with the meat and serve.

es-paella-sencilla.title: Simple chicken and vegetable paella
es-paella-sencilla.summary: To get you out of a jam, no seafood.
es-paella-sencilla.tip: Don't stir the rice: that's how the socarrat forms on the bottom.
steps: Brown the salted, cut-up chicken in a paella pan or large skillet with oil.
Add the pepper, beans and grated tomato and sauté 8 minutes with the paprika.
Add the rice, mix and pour in the hot broth.
Cook 18 minutes over medium heat without stirring and rest 5 minutes.

es-tortilla-francesa-jamon-queso.title: French omelet with ham and cheese
es-tortilla-francesa-jamon-queso.tip: Medium heat, and don't let it brown too much.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the skillet with the fat and pour in the eggs.
When it starts to set, put the ham and cheese in the center.
Fold the omelet and serve right away.

ar-pollo-al-verdeo.title: Chicken with scallions
ar-pollo-al-verdeo.tip: Use the white and some of the green part of the scallions for more flavor.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in a large skillet with oil.
Add the chopped scallions and cook 4 minutes.
Add the cream and a splash of water, cover and cook 20 minutes over low heat.
Serve with the sauce on top.

ar-humita-en-olla.title: Humita in a pot
ar-humita-en-olla.tip: Stir often so it doesn't stick to the bottom.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until translucent.
Blend or mash the drained corn and add to the pot.
Add the milk, paprika and salt and cook 15 minutes, stirring.
Add the cubed cheese and cook 3 more minutes.

ar-tarta-pascualina.title: Pascualina tart
ar-tarta-pascualina.tip: Prick the top crust with a fork to let steam out.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tart pan with one crust.
Boil the chard 3 minutes, drain well and chop; mix with the ricotta and salt.
Pour in the filling, make three wells and put a raw egg in each.
Cover with the other crust, seal the edges and bake 35 minutes.

ar-milanesa-a-caballo.title: Milanesa a caballo
ar-milanesa-a-caballo.summary: With two fried eggs on top.
ar-milanesa-a-caballo.tip: If you like, bake them for a lighter dish.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet and brown the milanesas 3 minutes per side.
Move to a plate with paper towels.
In the same skillet, fry the eggs with soft yolks.
Serve each milanesa with its egg on top.

ar-bife-con-papas-fritas.title: Steak with fries
ar-bife-con-papas-fritas.summary: The classic grill dish, in a skillet.
ar-bife-con-papas-fritas.tip: Rest the steak 2 minutes before cutting.
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut into sticks and dry well.
Fry in hot oil until golden; drain and salt.
Salt the steaks and cook in a very hot skillet 3 minutes per side.
Serve the steaks with the fries.

ar-fugazza-con-queso.title: Fugazza with cheese
ar-fugazza-con-queso.summary: Onion and mozzarella on a pizza crust.
ar-fugazza-con-queso.tip: Salt the onion lightly so it releases its sweetness.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and slice the onion thin.
Sauté it 5 minutes in a skillet with oil.
Cover the crust with the mozzarella and onion; sprinkle with oregano.
Bake 12 minutes, until browned.

ar-empanadas-de-pollo.title: Baked chicken empanadas
ar-empanadas-de-pollo.tip: The filling must be cold so the dough doesn't tear.
steps: Boil the chicken 20 minutes and shred it; boil the eggs 10 minutes and chop.
Sauté the chopped onion with cumin and salt; mix with the chicken and egg.
Fill the rounds and seal with a crimp.
Bake 20 minutes at 425°F (220°C), until golden.

ar-zapallitos-a-la-crema.title: Creamed zucchini
ar-zapallitos-a-la-crema.tip: Don't overcook them: they should stay firm.
steps: Slice the zucchini and dice the onion.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the zucchini; cook 8 minutes.
Add the cream and salt and cook 5 minutes over low heat.
Serve with grated cheese.

ar-tallarines-con-salsa-blanca.title: Noodles with white sauce
ar-tallarines-con-salsa-blanca.tip: If lumps form, strain the sauce or whisk it.
steps: Boil the noodles in salted water and drain.
Melt the butter, add the flour and stir 1 minute.
