Add the milk gradually, stirring, until thick; salt.
Toss the sauce with the noodles, ham strips and cheese.

ar-pizza-de-jamon-y-morrones.title: Ham and pepper pizza
ar-pizza-de-jamon-y-morrones.summary: With a pre-baked crust, ready in 20 minutes.
ar-pizza-de-jamon-y-morrones.tip: A drizzle of oil when it comes out of the oven makes it tastier.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cover the crust with the tomato and mozzarella.
Add the ham strips, pepper strips and oregano.
Bake 12 minutes.

ar-guiso-de-arroz.title: Rice stew with ground beef
ar-guiso-de-arroz.tip: If it gets dry, add a little hot water.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil and add the beef; cook 8 minutes.
Add the diced potato and carrot and the tomato.
Add the rice, water and salt and stir.
Cook covered 20 minutes over low heat, until the rice is tender.

ar-revuelto-de-choclo-y-queso.title: Corn and cheese scramble
ar-revuelto-de-choclo-y-queso.tip: Take it off the heat while it's still creamy.
steps: Drain the corn and sauté 3 minutes in a skillet with oil.
Beat the eggs with salt and pour over the corn.
Stir over low heat until set.
Add the cubed cheese and turn off the heat.

ar-hamburguesas-completas.title: Loaded burgers
ar-hamburguesas-completas.tip: Make a dimple in the center of each burger so they don't puff up.
steps: Salt the beef and shape two thick burgers.
Cook in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs.
Build the buns with the burger, egg, lettuce and tomato.

ar-milanesa-de-pollo-al-horno.title: Baked chicken milanesa
ar-milanesa-de-pollo-al-horno.tip: Preheat the tray so the bottom gets crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and flatten the cutlets with a rolling pin.
Salt them, dip in beaten egg and then in breadcrumbs.
Put on a tray with a drizzle of oil.
Bake 10 minutes per side, until golden.

ar-sorrentinos-con-crema-y-jamon.title: Sorrentinos with cream and ham
ar-sorrentinos-con-crema-y-jamon.tip: Boil them gently: if the water boils too hard, they break.
steps: Boil the sorrentinos in salted water until they float, about 4 minutes.
Warm the cream with the ham strips 3 minutes.
Drain the pasta carefully and toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated cheese.

ar-ensalada-caprese.title: Caprese salad
ar-ensalada-caprese.tip: Serve at room temperature: it tastes better.
steps: Slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Alternate them on a plate.
Add the basil, salt and oil.

ar-sandwich-de-bondiola.title: Pork shoulder sandwich
ar-sandwich-de-bondiola.tip: Slicing it thin makes it tender and quick to cook.
steps: Salt the pork and slice into thin steaks.
Cook in a hot skillet 4 minutes per side.
In another skillet, brown the onion rings with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Build the rolls with the pork and onion.

ar-locro-rapido.title: Quick squash and bean locro
ar-locro-rapido.summary: A fast version of the national dish.
ar-locro-rapido.tip: Stir now and then so it doesn't stick.
steps: Sauté the onion and sliced chorizo in a pot with oil.
Add the cubed squash, drained beans and water.
Add the corn and salt and cook 35 minutes over low heat.
Mash some squash to thicken and serve hot.

ar-pechuga-rellena.title: Ham and cheese stuffed chicken breast
ar-pechuga-rellena.tip: Rest 5 minutes before cutting so the cheese doesn't run out.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and open the breasts like a book.
Salt them and fill with ham and cheese; close with toothpicks.
Put in a dish with oil.
Bake 25 minutes, turning halfway.

ar-bondiola-al-horno-con-papas.title: Roast pork shoulder with potatoes
ar-bondiola-al-horno-con-papas.tip: If the top dries out, cover with foil the first 30 minutes.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the pork.
Put it in a dish with the potato wedges and onion; drizzle with oil.
Roast 50 minutes, turning everything halfway.
Rest 5 minutes and slice.

ar-pasta-con-atun-y-crema.title: Pasta with tuna and cream
ar-pasta-con-atun-y-crema.tip: A little lemon at the end adds freshness.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water and drain.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the drained tuna.
Add the cream and warm 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.

mx-huevos-a-la-mexicana.title: Mexican-style eggs
mx-huevos-a-la-mexicana.summary: With tomato, onion and chile, the colors of the flag.
mx-huevos-a-la-mexicana.tip: Take them off while still juicy: they keep cooking on the plate.
steps: Chop the tomato, onion and chile.
Sauté everything in a skillet with oil 4 minutes, until the tomato softens.
Add the beaten eggs with salt and stir.
Cook until set and serve hot.

mx-chilaquiles-rojos.title: Red chilaquiles
mx-chilaquiles-rojos.tip: Toss them right before serving so they keep some crunch.
steps: Cut the tortillas into triangles and fry in hot oil until crisp; drain.
Warm the tomato sauce with salt 5 minutes.
Add the chips to the sauce and toss 1 minute.
Serve with crumbled cheese, cream and onion.

mx-quesadillas-de-queso.title: Cheese quesadillas
mx-quesadillas-de-queso.tip: On medium heat the cheese melts before the tortilla burns.
steps: Heat a comal or skillet with no oil.
Put a tortilla down, cover with cheese and fold.
Cook 2 minutes per side, until the cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

mx-frijoles-refritos-con-queso.title: Refried beans with cheese
mx-frijoles-refritos-con-queso.summary: Creamy, as a side or on their own.
mx-frijoles-refritos-con-queso.tip: If they get thick, loosen with a splash of hot water.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until translucent.
Add the beans with a little of their liquid and mash with a fork.
Cook 10 minutes, stirring, with salt, until thick.
Serve with crumbled cheese.

mx-sopa-de-fideo.title: Fideo soup
mx-sopa-de-fideo.tip: Brown the noodles well at the start: that's where the flavor comes from.
steps: Brown the noodles in oil, stirring, until they take color.
Blend the tomato with the onion and garlic and pour into the pot.
Add the broth and salt and cook covered 10 to 12 minutes.
Serve when the noodles are soft and the broth reduced.

mx-arroz-rojo.title: Mexican red rice
mx-arroz-rojo.tip: Don't lift the lid while cooking so the rice stays loose.
steps: Brown the raw rice in oil 3 minutes.
Blend the tomato with the onion and add with the water and salt.
Add the diced carrot and cover.
Cook 18 minutes over low heat and rest 5.

mx-tacos-de-pollo.title: Chicken tacos
mx-tacos-de-pollo.tip: Warming the tortillas first keeps them from breaking.
steps: Boil the chicken with salt 15 minutes and shred it.
Sauté it in a skillet with a little oil until browned.
Warm the tortillas on a comal.
Fill them with the chicken, chopped onion and cilantro, and lime.

mx-enfrijoladas.title: Enfrijoladas
mx-enfrijoladas.tip: If it gets too thick, add water or broth.
steps: Blend the beans with their liquid and salt into a thick sauce.
Warm it in a skillet 5 minutes.
Dip the tortillas in the sauce and fold in quarters.
Serve with cheese and cream.

mx-pollo-en-salsa-verde.title: Chicken in green sauce
mx-pollo-en-salsa-verde.tip: Serve with chopped cilantro on top.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in a pot with oil.
Add the sliced onion and cook 3 minutes.
Add the green salsa and a little water.
Cover and cook 25 minutes over low heat.

mx-caldo-de-pollo.title: Chicken and vegetable soup
mx-caldo-de-pollo.tip: Skim the broth at the beginning so it stays clearer.
steps: Cook the chicken in the salted water 20 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot in chunks.
Cook 15 minutes more; add the zucchini 5 minutes before the end.
Serve with lime and tortillas.

mx-papas-con-chorizo.title: Potatoes with chorizo
mx-papas-con-chorizo.tip: Cover the skillet the first few minutes so the potato cooks inside.
steps: Dice the potatoes and cook in oil until golden.
Crumble the chorizo into the skillet.
Cook 8 more minutes.
If you like, add the eggs and stir until set.

mx-sincronizadas.title: Sincronizadas
mx-sincronizadas.tip: Press them with a spatula while they cook.
steps: Put ham and cheese on two tortillas.
Cover with the other two.
Cook on a comal 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Cut into triangles.

mx-guacamole.title: Guacamole
mx-guacamole.tip: The lime keeps it from darkening.
steps: Mash the avocados with a fork.
Mix with the diced tomato and onion.
Add lime juice and salt.
Serve right away with tortilla chips.

cl-pastel-de-choclo.title: Chilean corn pie (pastel de choclo)
cl-pastel-de-choclo.summary: Beef, chicken and a corn topping.
cl-pastel-de-choclo.tip: Sprinkle sugar on top so it caramelizes.
steps: Sauté the onion and beef with salt and cumin; put in a dish with the chicken and hard-boiled egg.
Process the corn with basil and salt into a paste.
Cover the meat with the corn.
Bake 35 minutes at 400°F (200°C), until browned.

cl-cazuela-de-pollo.title: Chicken cazuela
cl-cazuela-de-pollo.summary: A hearty soup with potato and corn.
cl-cazuela-de-pollo.tip: The squash breaks down a bit and thickens the broth.
steps: Boil the chicken in the salted water 20 minutes.
Add the squash, potato and corn in chunks.
Add the rice and cook 20 minutes.
Serve with chopped cilantro or parsley.

cl-charquican.title: Charquicán
cl-charquican.summary: Potato and squash stew with beef.
cl-charquican.tip: With a fried egg on top is the classic.
steps: Sauté the onion and beef with salt.
Add the diced potato and squash and cover with water.
Cook covered 25 minutes and mash everything with a fork.
Add the corn and cook 5 minutes.

cl-ensalada-chilena.title: Chilean salad
cl-ensalada-chilena.tip: Soaking the onion takes away its sharpness.
steps: Slice the onion thin and soak 10 minutes in cold salted water.
Cut the tomato into wedges.
Drain the onion and mix with the tomato and cilantro.
Dress with salt, oil and lemon.

cl-completo.title: Completo
cl-completo.summary: The Chilean hot dog with avocado and tomato.
cl-completo.tip: Warm the buns a little so they're softer.
steps: Warm the sausages in hot water 5 minutes.
Mash the avocado with salt and dice the tomato.
Open the buns and put in the sausage.
Top with tomato, avocado and mayonnaise.

cl-lentejas-con-arroz.title: Lentils with rice
cl-lentejas-con-arroz.summary: A pot dish, economical and complete.
cl-lentejas-con-arroz.tip: If using canned lentils, cut the time to 15 minutes.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and carrot in oil.
Add the lentils and water; cook 20 minutes.
Add the rice and salt and cook 15 more minutes.
Serve when everything is tender.

cl-palta-reina.title: Stuffed avocado (palta reina)
cl-palta-reina.summary: Avocado filled with chicken or tuna.
cl-palta-reina.tip: A splash of lemon on the avocado keeps it from darkening.
steps: Halve the avocados and remove the pits.
Mix the shredded chicken (or tuna) with mayonnaise, salt and lemon.
Fill the halves.
Serve cold.

uy-chivito.title: Chivito
uy-chivito.tip: Warm the bread with the cheese so it melts.
steps: Salt the steaks and cook in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs.
Open the rolls and add lettuce, tomato, the steak, ham and cheese.
Top with the fried egg.

uy-chivito-al-plato.title: Chivito plate
uy-chivito-al-plato.summary: No bread, with fries and salad.
uy-chivito-al-plato.tip: Put the ham and cheese on the freshly cooked steak so it melts.
steps: Cut the potatoes into sticks and fry until golden.
Salt and cook the steaks in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs.
Serve the steak with ham and cheese, the egg on top and the fries on the side.

uy-olimpico.title: Olímpico
uy-olimpico.tip: Toast the bread so it's firmer.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and slice.
Spread the bread with mayonnaise.
Build two layers: one with ham and cheese, another with egg, tomato and lettuce.
Cut into four and serve.

co-arepas-con-queso.title: Arepas with cheese
co-arepas-con-queso.tip: The dough should be soft and without cracks.
steps: Mix the cornmeal with warm water and salt and rest 5 minutes.
Form balls, flatten them and put cheese in the center.
Close them and form discs.
Cook on a skillet or griddle 5 minutes per side.

co-huevos-pericos.title: Huevos pericos
steps: Chop the tomato and scallion.
Sauté them in a skillet 4 minutes with salt.
Add the beaten eggs.
Stir until set.

co-calentado.title: Calentado
co-calentado.tip: It's the best use for leftover rice.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil and add the drained beans.
Add the cooked rice and heat everything 5 minutes.
Salt and stir.
Serve with a fried egg on top.

co-papas-chorreadas.title: Papas chorreadas
co-papas-chorreadas.summary: Potatoes with tomato and cheese sauce.
co-papas-chorreadas.tip: A little milk makes the sauce creamier.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and slice them.
Sauté the chopped tomato and onion with butter and salt.
Add the cheese until it melts.
Serve the potatoes with the sauce on top.

co-sancocho-de-pollo.title: Chicken sancocho
co-sancocho-de-pollo.tip: Cut the yuca large: it cooks more slowly than the potato.
steps: Cook the chicken in the water with salt and onion 15 minutes.
Add the yuca and plantain in chunks and cook 15 minutes.
Add the potato and corn and cook 15 minutes more.
Serve with cilantro and rice on the side.

co-patacones.title: Patacones
co-patacones.tip: Soak them briefly in salted water before the second fry.
steps: Peel the plantains and cut into thick slices.
Fry 3 minutes in hot oil and drain.
Flatten them with a plate or press.
Fry again until golden and salt.

pe-lomo-saltado.title: Lomo saltado
pe-lomo-saltado.summary: Beef, onion and tomato over high heat.
pe-lomo-saltado.tip: A very hot pan and speed: that's what makes it 'saltado'.
steps: Cut the beef into strips and the potatoes into sticks; fry the potatoes and set aside.
Stir-fry the beef in a very hot skillet 3 minutes.
Add the onion and tomato wedges and the soy sauce; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Mix with the potatoes and serve with rice.

pe-arroz-chaufa.title: Arroz chaufa
steps: Scramble the eggs in a skillet with oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the cold rice over high heat 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and chopped scallions.
Add the eggs and mix.

pe-tallarines-saltados.title: Tallarines saltados
pe-tallarines-saltados.summary: Stir-fried noodles with beef and vegetables.
pe-tallarines-saltados.tip: A very hot pan keeps the vegetables from releasing water.
steps: Boil the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the meat strips in oil over high heat.
Add the onion, tomato and soy sauce.
Add the noodles and mix 2 minutes.

pe-papa-a-la-huancaina.title: Papa a la huancaína
pe-papa-a-la-huancaina.tip: Add a few saltine crackers to the blender to thicken.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, and the eggs 10 minutes.
Blend the cheese with the milk, chili and salt into a cream.
Slice the potatoes.
Cover with the sauce and serve with hard-boiled egg.

pe-causa-de-atun.title: Tuna causa
pe-causa-de-atun.summary: Layers of potato with tuna and avocado.
pe-causa-de-atun.tip: Let it rest chilled: it slices better.
steps: Boil the potatoes, peel and mash with lime juice, oil and salt into a dough.
Mix the tuna with mayonnaise.
Build layers: potato, tuna and avocado slices.
Finish with potato and chill 20 minutes.

pe-sopa-a-la-minuta.title: Sopa a la minuta
pe-sopa-a-la-minuta.summary: Noodle soup with beef and egg.
pe-sopa-a-la-minuta.tip: Add the egg over low heat so it forms ribbons.
steps: Sauté the onion and beef in oil with salt.
Add the water and cook 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.
Stir in the milk and beaten egg and turn off the heat.

ve-arepas-rellenas.title: Arepas filled with ham and cheese
ve-arepas-rellenas.tip: If they crack, the dough needs a little more water.
steps: Mix the cornmeal with warm water and salt and rest 5 minutes.
Shape thick discs by hand.
Cook on a griddle 6 minutes per side, until they sound hollow.
Open and fill with ham and cheese.

ve-reina-pepiada.title: Reina pepiada
ve-reina-pepiada.tip: If you don't have arepas, serve it in bread or lettuce.
steps: Boil the chicken with salt 15 minutes and shred.
Mash the avocado and mix with the mayonnaise.
Combine with the chicken and salt.
Fill arepas or bread with the mixture.

ve-cachapas.title: Cachapas with cheese
ve-cachapas.tip: The batter should be thick but with some kernels.
steps: Process the corn with the milk, sugar and salt.
Heat a skillet with butter and pour in a portion of batter.
Cook 3 minutes per side.
Fill with cheese and fold.

ve-pabellon-criollo.title: Pabellón criollo
ve-pabellon-criollo.tip: A fried egg on top makes it 'a caballo'.
steps: Cook the rice in salted water.
Sauté the onion and beef with salt 12 minutes.
Warm the beans with a little of their liquid.
Fry the sliced plantain and serve everything together.

mx-tacos-de-papa.title: Crispy potato tacos
mx-tacos-de-papa.tip: Hold the tacos with toothpicks so they don't open while frying.
steps: Boil the potatoes, peel and mash with salt and the chopped onion.
Fill the tortillas with the potato and fold.
Fry in hot oil 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with grated cheese and salsa.

mx-huevos-rancheros.title: Huevos rancheros
mx-huevos-rancheros.summary: Fried eggs on tortilla with salsa.
mx-huevos-rancheros.tip: With beans on the side it's a complete breakfast.
steps: Blend the tomato with the onion and salt and warm 5 minutes.
Brown the tortillas in oil.
Fry the eggs.
Top the tortillas with the eggs and cover with the salsa.

mx-sopa-de-tortilla.title: Tortilla soup
mx-sopa-de-tortilla.tip: Add the strips at the end so they don't soften.
steps: Cut the tortillas into strips and fry in oil.
Blend the tomato with the onion and sauté.
Add the broth and salt and boil 10 minutes.
Serve with the strips, cheese and avocado.

mx-arroz-con-pollo.title: Mexican-style chicken and rice
mx-arroz-con-pollo.tip: Don't lift the lid until the end.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil and remove.
Brown the rice in the same pot and add the tomato blended with the onion.
Add the water, salt, carrot and chicken.
Cover and cook 20 minutes over low heat.

cl-porotos-con-rienda.title: Beans with noodles (porotos con riendas)
cl-porotos-con-rienda.tip: If it gets thick, add hot water.
steps: Sauté the onion and cubed squash in oil.
Add the beans with their liquid and the water.
Cook 15 minutes and add the noodles.
Cook until tender and salt.

cl-sandwich-de-queso-derretido.title: Chilean melted cheese sandwich
cl-sandwich-de-queso-derretido.tip: Cover the skillet so the cheese melts evenly.
steps: Open the rolls.
Put cheese on one half and cook on a griddle or covered skillet until it melts.
Add mashed avocado and tomato.
Close and serve hot.

cl-pollo-arvejado.title: Chicken with peas
steps: Brown the salted chicken in a pot with oil.
Add the chopped onion and carrot.
Add the water and cook covered 20 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 8 more minutes.

uy-milanesa-al-pan.title: Milanesa sandwich
uy-milanesa-al-pan.summary: Breaded steak in a roll with lettuce and tomato.
uy-milanesa-al-pan.tip: Drain the milanesa on paper before assembling.
steps: Brown the milanesas in a skillet with oil 3 minutes per side.
Open the rolls.
Add lettuce, tomato and the hot milanesa.
Close and serve.

uy-torta-frita.title: Fried bread (tortas fritas)
uy-torta-frita.tip: The oil must be very hot.
steps: Mix the flour with salt, the fat and warm water into a dough.
Let it rest 15 minutes.
Roll out discs and cut a slit in the center.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

co-arroz-con-pollo.title: Colombian chicken and rice
co-arroz-con-pollo.summary: With vegetables, all in one pot.
co-arroz-con-pollo.tip: Let it rest 5 minutes before serving.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces with the onion.
Add the rice and stir a minute.
Add the water, salt and vegetables.
Cover and cook 20 minutes over low heat.

co-ajiaco-sencillo.title: Simple ajiaco
co-ajiaco-sencillo.summary: A thick potato soup with chicken.
co-ajiaco-sencillo.tip: Mash a few potatoes against the pot to thicken.
steps: Cook the chicken with the onion and salt 20 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and the corn.
Cook 20 minutes until the potatoes break down and thicken.
Serve with cream or avocado.

pe-tallarin-verde.title: Tallarín verde
pe-tallarin-verde.summary: Pasta with basil and spinach sauce.
pe-tallarin-verde.tip: With a grilled steak or chicken is the classic dish.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Blend the spinach, basil, cheese and milk with salt.
Warm the sauce with a little oil 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.

pe-arroz-con-pollo.title: Peruvian chicken and rice
pe-arroz-con-pollo.tip: For more color, add more cilantro.
steps: Blend the cilantro with a little water.
Brown the chicken and onion in a pot.
Add the rice, the blend, the water and salt.
Cover and cook 20 minutes.

ve-perico.title: Venezuelan perico
ve-perico.summary: Scrambled eggs with tomato and onion.
ve-perico.tip: Don't overcook them: they should stay creamy.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and tomato in oil.
Add the beaten eggs with salt.
Stir until set.
Serve with arepas.

ve-arroz-con-pollo.title: Venezuelan chicken and rice
steps: Brown the chicken with the chopped onion and pepper.
Add the rice and the grated carrot.
Add the water and salt.
Cover and cook 20 minutes over low heat.

gen-huevos-revueltos-tostadas.title: Scrambled eggs on toast
gen-huevos-revueltos-tostadas.tip: Take them off the heat a little early: they keep cooking on the plate.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a skillet over low heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir slowly until set but still creamy.
Serve over the toast.

gen-tostadas-palta-huevo.title: Avocado and egg toast
gen-tostadas-palta-huevo.tip: If the avocado isn't ripe, leave it a few hours next to a banana.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with salt and a few drops of lemon and spread on the toast.
Fry or poach the eggs the way you like.
Put an egg on each toast.

gen-pure-de-calabaza.title: Pumpkin and potato mash
gen-pure-de-calabaza.tip: Use a little of the cooking water to adjust the texture.
steps: Peel and cube the pumpkin and potatoes.
Boil in salted water 20 minutes until soft.
Drain and mash with the butter.
Serve hot.

gen-pollo-salteado-verduras.title: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry
gen-pollo-salteado-verduras.tip: Stir-fry in batches so it browns instead of steaming.
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables into thin strips.
Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot skillet with oil 5 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and salt and toss 1 minute.

gen-fideos-verduras-salteadas.title: Pasta with sautéed vegetables
gen-fideos-verduras-salteadas.tip: Save a little cooking water to bind the sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Cut the vegetables into strips or cubes and sauté with garlic and oil 6 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta.
Serve with grated cheese.

gen-arroz-atun-choclo.title: Rice with tuna and corn
gen-arroz-atun-choclo.tip: A squeeze of lemon at the end adds freshness.
steps: Cook the rice with double the water and salt, covered, about 15 minutes.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil.
Add the drained tuna and corn and warm 3 minutes.
Mix with the rice.

gen-panqueques-jamon-queso.title: Savory ham and cheese crepes
gen-panqueques-jamon-queso.tip: Rest the batter 10 minutes: the crepes come out thinner.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, flour and salt until smooth.
Make the crepes in a lightly oiled skillet.
Fill each with ham and cheese and roll up.
Warm 5 minutes in the oven or skillet until the cheese melts.

gen-wrap-pollo-verduras.title: Chicken and vegetable wrap
gen-wrap-pollo-verduras.summary: To go or a light dinner.
gen-wrap-pollo-verduras.tip: Warm the tortillas a few seconds so they don't crack.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken.
Mix it with the mayonnaise or yogurt.
Spread over the tortillas with the lettuce and tomato.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

gen-sandwich-atun.title: Tuna sandwich
gen-sandwich-atun.tip: A few drops of lemon add freshness.
steps: Drain the tuna and mix with the mayonnaise.
Spread on the bread.
Add tomato and lettuce.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half.

gen-papas-horno-romero.title: Roasted potatoes with rosemary
gen-papas-horno-romero.tip: Don't crowd them: they steam instead of browning.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with oil, salt and rosemary.
Spread on a tray without crowding.
Roast 40 minutes, turning halfway.

gen-papas-fritas-horno.title: Oven fries
gen-papas-fritas-horno.tip: Soaking them 20 minutes in cold water first makes them crispier.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the potatoes into sticks and dry well.
Toss with oil and salt and spread on a tray.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes, turning once.

gen-ensalada-garbanzos.title: Chickpea salad
gen-ensalada-garbanzos.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes before serving so it absorbs flavor.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice the tomato, onion and cucumber.
Mix everything in a bowl.
Dress with salt, oil and lemon.

gen-ensalada-tomate-cebolla.title: Tomato and onion salad
gen-ensalada-tomate-cebolla.tip: Salt the tomato 5 minutes ahead: it releases more flavor.
steps: Cut the tomato into wedges and the onion into thin slices.
Put them in a dish.
Dress with salt, oil and vinegar or lemon.

gen-ensalada-pollo.title: Chicken salad
gen-ensalada-pollo.tip: A handful of corn or chickpeas makes it more filling.
steps: Shred the chicken.
Cut the lettuce and tomato and grate the carrot.
Mix everything in a bowl.
Dress with salt, oil and lemon.

gen-verduras-al-horno.title: Roasted vegetables
gen-verduras-al-horno.summary: As a side or on their own.
gen-verduras-al-horno.tip: Cutting them evenly makes them cook at the same time.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut all the vegetables into even pieces.
Toss with oil and salt on a tray.
Roast 35 minutes, stirring halfway.

gen-zanahorias-glaseadas.title: Glazed carrots
gen-zanahorias-glaseadas.tip: Chopped parsley on top makes them prettier.
steps: Peel the carrots and slice them.
Boil 8 minutes and drain.
Sauté with the butter and sugar until glossy.
Salt lightly and serve.

gen-berenjenas-grilladas.title: Grilled eggplant
gen-berenjenas-grilladas.tip: Salted 10 minutes ahead they lose their bitterness.
steps: Cut the eggplants into 1/2-inch slices.
Cook on a griddle or skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Salt and toss with the minced garlic and lemon.
Serve warm or cold.

gen-brocoli-gratinado.title: Broccoli gratin
gen-brocoli-gratinado.tip: If you have no cream, mix a little milk with the cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Boil the broccoli florets 5 minutes and drain.
Put in a dish, cover with the cream and cheese.
Bake until browned, 15 minutes.

gen-coliflor-al-horno.title: Roasted cauliflower
gen-coliflor-al-horno.tip: The browned edges are the best part: don't crowd it.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut the cauliflower into florets and toss with oil, salt and garlic.
Spread on a tray and roast 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese for the last 5 minutes.

gen-espinacas-crema.title: Creamed spinach
gen-espinacas-crema.tip: Squeeze them with your hands to remove all the water.
steps: Wash the spinach and boil 2 minutes in salted water.
Drain well and chop.
Sauté the onion in butter and add the spinach and cream.
Cook 3 minutes and serve.

gen-omelette-espinaca-queso.title: Spinach and cheese omelet
gen-omelette-espinaca-queso.tip: Medium-low heat: it won't burn outside.
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Cook the spinach 1 minute in the skillet with the butter.
Pour in the eggs and let set over low heat.
Add the cheese, fold and serve.

gen-pasta-champinones.title: Mushroom cream pasta
gen-pasta-champinones.tip: Don't wash the mushrooms: wipe them with a cloth.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the onion and sliced mushrooms 6 minutes.
Add the cream and reduce 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.

gen-pasta-brocoli-ajo.title: Pasta with broccoli and garlic
gen-pasta-brocoli-ajo.tip: Mash the broccoli a little with the fork: it acts as the sauce.
steps: Boil the broccoli florets 4 minutes and remove.
Cook the pasta in the same water.
Brown the sliced garlic in oil and add the mashed broccoli.
Toss with the pasta and serve with cheese.

gen-guiso-garbanzos.title: Chickpea stew
gen-guiso-garbanzos.tip: Mash some chickpeas to thicken the broth.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and carrot in oil.
Add the diced potato, tomato and water.
Cook 20 minutes, add the drained chickpeas and salt.
Cook 10 more minutes.

gen-arroz-con-leche.title: Rice pudding
gen-arroz-con-leche.tip: Stir often so it doesn't stick to the bottom.
steps: Boil the rice in 1 cup of water for 10 minutes.
Add the milk, sugar and cinnamon.
Cook over low heat 25 minutes, stirring often.
Serve warm or cold.

gen-pescado-horno-limon.title: Baked fish with lemon
gen-pescado-horno-limon.tip: Don't overcook it: it dries out quickly.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the fish in a dish with oil, salt and lemon slices.
Add thinly sliced potatoes if using.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until the fish flakes.

gen-pescado-plancha-papas.title: Pan-seared fish with potatoes
gen-pescado-plancha-papas.tip: Don't move it until it releases by itself.
steps: Boil the sliced potatoes 10 minutes and drain.
Pat the fish dry, salt it and cook 3 minutes per side on the griddle with oil.
Brown the potatoes on the same griddle.
Serve with lemon.

gen-hamburguesa-pollo.title: Chicken burgers
gen-hamburguesa-pollo.tip: Wet your hands to shape them without sticking.
steps: Mix the ground chicken with the egg, breadcrumbs, grated onion and salt.
Shape 4 burgers.
Cook 5 minutes per side over medium heat.
Serve with salad or in a bun.

gen-brochetas-pollo-verduras.title: Chicken and vegetable skewers
gen-brochetas-pollo-verduras.summary: For the griddle or the oven.
gen-brochetas-pollo-verduras.tip: Soak wooden skewers 15 minutes so they don't burn.
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables into even cubes.
Thread them alternately on skewers.
Brush with oil and salt.
Cook 12 minutes on the griddle or in the oven, turning.

gen-carne-horno-papas.title: Roast beef with potatoes
gen-carne-horno-papas.tip: Let it rest 5 minutes before slicing.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Salt the meat and put it in a dish with oil.
Add the potato wedges and onion rings.
Roast 45 minutes, turning everything halfway.

gen-salchichas-pure.title: Sausages with mash
gen-salchichas-pure.tip: Prick them lightly so they don't burst.
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes 20 minutes.
Mash with the milk, butter and salt.
Cook the sausages in a skillet 10 minutes, turning.
Serve together.

gen-compota-manzana.title: Applesauce
gen-compota-manzana.tip: With sweet apples it needs almost no sugar.
steps: Peel and cube the apples.
Cook with the water, sugar and cinnamon 15 minutes.
Mash with a fork.
Serve warm or cold.

gen-sopa-fideos-verduras.title: Noodle and vegetable soup
gen-sopa-fideos-verduras.tip: If there are leftovers, it thickens and tastes better the next day.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil.
Add the diced carrot and potato and the water.
Cook 15 minutes and salt.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.

ar-carbonada.title: Carbonada criolla
ar-carbonada.summary: Beef stew with corn and squash.
ar-carbonada.tip: Traditionally served inside a hollowed-out squash, but it's just as good on a plate.
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil in a pot and salt it.
Add the chopped onion and tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the water or broth and cook covered 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrot, squash and corn in chunks and cook 20 more minutes, until everything is tender.

ar-puchero.title: Puchero
ar-puchero.summary: Boiled beef and vegetables in broth, a Sunday dish.
ar-puchero.tip: Keep the broth for a noodle soup the next day.
steps: Put the beef in the pot with cold water and the onion; bring to a boil and skim.
Cook covered over low heat 30 minutes.
Add the vegetables in large chunks and salt.
Cook 25 more minutes, until the meat and vegetables are tender, and serve with a little broth.

ar-vacio-al-horno.title: Roast flank steak with potatoes
ar-vacio-al-horno.tip: Always slice it against the grain.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the meat.
Put it in a dish with the potato wedges and onion rings; drizzle with oil.
Roast 50 minutes, turning the meat and potatoes halfway.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into thin slices.

ar-bife-de-chorizo.title: Pan-seared sirloin steak
ar-bife-de-chorizo.summary: The grill classic, made in a skillet.
ar-bife-de-chorizo.tip: Don't prick them: the juices escape.
steps: Take the steaks out of the fridge 15 minutes ahead and salt them.
Heat a skillet well with a little oil and cook the steaks 4 minutes per side.
Rest them 3 minutes.
Serve with boiled and browned potatoes, or a salad.

ar-cuadril-al-horno.title: Roast rump with vegetables
ar-cuadril-al-horno.summary: A lean cut that comes out tender.
ar-cuadril-al-horno.tip: Rest 10 minutes before slicing so it stays juicy.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the rump.
Sear it in a skillet with oil 2 minutes per side.
Put it in a dish with the chopped vegetables and the wine or water.
Cover with foil and roast 45 minutes; uncover for the last 10.

ar-matambre-relleno.title: Stuffed flank roll (matambre)
ar-matambre-relleno.summary: With hard-boiled egg, carrot and pepper.
ar-matambre-relleno.tip: Press it with a weight in the fridge so it slices neatly.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes and the carrot 8; peel and cut into strips.
Lay out the matambre, salt it and spread over the ham, cheese, egg, carrot and pepper strips.
Roll it tightly and tie with kitchen string.
Cook 40 minutes in salted water over low heat, cool and slice.

ar-merluza-a-la-romana.title: Battered hake
ar-merluza-a-la-romana.summary: Coated and fried golden, with lemon.
ar-merluza-a-la-romana.tip: Shake off the excess flour for a thin, crisp coating.
steps: Pat the fillets dry and salt them.
Dredge in flour, then dip in beaten egg.
Fry in hot oil 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper and serve with lemon.

ar-lomito-completo.title: Loaded steak sandwich (lomito)
ar-lomito-completo.summary: With ham, cheese, egg, lettuce and tomato.
ar-lomito-completo.tip: Warm the bread a few seconds so the cheese melts.
steps: Salt the steaks and cook them in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs.
Open the rolls and build with lettuce, tomato, the steak, ham and cheese.
Top with the fried egg.

ar-sandwiches-de-miga.title: Ham and cheese tea sandwiches
ar-sandwiches-de-miga.tip: Wrap them in a damp cloth for a while: they get softer.
steps: Cut the crusts off the bread.
Lightly butter each slice.
Build two layers with ham and cheese between three slices.
Cut into triangles and serve cold.

ar-pebete-jamon-queso.title: Ham and cheese roll
ar-pebete-jamon-queso.tip: A little tomato or lettuce makes it fresher.
steps: Split the rolls.
Spread with butter.
Fill with ham and cheese.
Serve cold or warm a few seconds on the griddle.

ar-fideos-manteca-queso.title: Pasta with butter and cheese
ar-fideos-manteca-queso.summary: The simplest thing when there's nothing else.
ar-fideos-manteca-queso.tip: A pinch of black pepper gives it character.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Drain it, keeping a little of the water.
Toss with the butter until it melts.
Serve with plenty of grated cheese.

ar-fugazzeta-rellena.title: Stuffed fugazzeta
ar-fugazzeta-rellena.summary: Two crusts with mozzarella and onion.
ar-fugazzeta-rellena.tip: Salt the onion beforehand: it releases water and gets sweeter.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and slice the onion thin.
Put one crust on a tray, cover with the mozzarella slices and top with the other.
Cover with the onion, a drizzle of oil, salt and oregano.
Bake 15 minutes, until golden and the cheese melts.

ar-empanadas-fritas.title: Fried beef empanadas
ar-empanadas-fritas.tip: Very hot oil: otherwise they soak it up.
steps: Sauté the onion and beef with salt and cumin; let the filling cool.
Add the chopped hard-boiled egg.
Fill the rounds and seal with a crimp.
Fry in hot oil 2 minutes per side until golden.

ar-vigilante.title: Vigilante
ar-vigilante.summary: Cheese with quince or sweet potato paste.
ar-vigilante.tip: It works as a dessert or a snack.
steps: Cut the cheese and the paste into slices of the same size.
If you like, warm the cheese slightly on the griddle.
Serve them together on the plate, one on top of the other.

ar-chipa.title: Chipá
ar-chipa.summary: Cassava starch and cheese rolls from the northeast.
ar-chipa.tip: They're best eaten hot, fresh from the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix the starch with the grated cheese, egg, soft butter and a pinch of salt.
Add milk little by little until you get a dough that doesn't stick.
Shape into balls, put on a tray and bake 20 minutes.

ar-mbaipy.title: Cheese mbaipy
ar-mbaipy.summary: Creamy cornmeal with cheese, from Paraguay and the northeast.
ar-mbaipy.tip: Always stir in the same direction to avoid lumps.
steps: Heat the milk with the water and salt.
Add the cornmeal in a rain, stirring, and cook over low heat 15 minutes.
Add the cubed cheese and the butter.
Stir until it melts and serve hot.

ar-flan-casero.title: Homemade flan with dulce de leche
ar-flan-casero.tip: It's done when a knife comes out clean.
steps: Make a caramel with 1/4 cup of sugar and pour it into the mold.
Beat the eggs with the rest of the sugar, the milk and vanilla and strain over the caramel.
Cook in a water bath in a 340°F (170°C) oven about 45 minutes.
Cool, unmold and serve with dulce de leche.

ar-pastafrola.title: Quince pastafrola
ar-pastafrola.summary: A shortcrust tart with lots of quince paste.
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, cold butter in small pieces, eggs and baking powder into a dough.
Press 2/3 of the dough into a pan and cover with the mashed paste.
Make strips with the remaining dough and form a lattice.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°F (180°C).

ar-chocotorta.title: Chocotorta
ar-chocotorta.summary: No-bake: cookies, dulce de leche and cream cheese.
ar-chocotorta.tip: The longer it chills, the better it comes together.
steps: Mix the dulce de leche with the cream cheese into a smooth cream.
Dip the cookies in milky coffee and make a layer in a dish.
Cover with the cream and repeat the layers.
Chill at least 3 hours and sprinkle with crushed cookies.

ar-budin-de-pan.title: Bread pudding
ar-budin-de-pan.tip: Check that it's firm with a knife before taking it out.
steps: Make a caramel with a little sugar in a mold.
Soak the bread in the milk, mash it and mix with the eggs, the rest of the sugar and the vanilla.
Pour into the mold and bake in a water bath 45 minutes at 340°F (170°C).
Cool, unmold and serve with dulce de leche.

ar-alfajores-de-maicena.title: Cornstarch alfajores
ar-alfajores-de-maicena.summary: With dulce de leche and shredded coconut.
ar-alfajores-de-maicena.tip: With cold dough it rolls out better and the discs don't break.
steps: Mix the soft butter with the sugar and yolks.
Add the cornstarch and flour and form a dough; rest it 15 minutes.
Roll it out, cut discs and bake 10 minutes at 340°F (170°C) without browning.
Sandwich in pairs with dulce de leche and roll the edges in coconut.

pt-bacalhau-a-bras.title: Bacalhau à Brás
pt-bacalhau-a-bras.summary: Shredded salt cod with fried potato strings and eggs.
pt-bacalhau-a-bras.tip: Don't let the eggs dry out: take them off the heat while still creamy.
steps: Desalt the cod, cook it and flake it.
Sauté the onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add the cod and the potato strings and mix 2 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir until creamy.

pt-caldo-verde.title: Caldo verde
pt-caldo-verde.summary: Potato soup with kale and sausage.
pt-caldo-verde.tip: Cut the kale into very thin ribbons so it stays delicate.
steps: Cook the potatoes and onion in salted water until soft.
Blend into a cream.
Add the finely cut kale and cook 5 minutes.
Serve with sausage slices and a drizzle of oil.

pt-frango-piri-piri.title: Piri-piri roast chicken
pt-frango-piri-piri.summary: Chicken marinated in chili and lemon.
pt-frango-piri-piri.tip: The longer it marinates, the more flavor.
steps: Mix the lemon juice, minced garlic, chili, oil and salt.
Coat the chicken with the marinade and leave 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roast 40 minutes, turning halfway.

pt-bifanas.title: Bifanas
pt-bifanas.tip: Slice the pork very thin so it cooks quickly.
steps: Slice the pork thin and season with garlic, wine, chili and salt.
Marinate 15 minutes.
Brown the steaks in oil 3 minutes per side.
Serve inside the roll with a little of the sauce.

pt-arroz-de-tomate.title: Tomato rice
pt-arroz-de-tomate.tip: It's even better with a fried egg on top.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the chopped tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the rice, water and salt.
Cover and cook 15 minutes over low heat.

pt-sardinhas-assadas.title: Grilled sardines with potatoes
pt-sardinhas-assadas.tip: Ask the fishmonger to clean the sardines.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender.
Season the sardines with salt and grill 3 minutes per side.
Drizzle with oil and lemon.
Serve with the potatoes and a salad.

cu-ropa-vieja.title: Ropa vieja
cu-ropa-vieja.tip: Save a little broth to loosen the sauce.
steps: Boil the beef in salted water 40 minutes until tender, then shred it.
Sauté the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, cumin and beef and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with white rice.

cu-moros-y-cristianos.title: Moros y cristianos
cu-moros-y-cristianos.summary: Rice and black beans cooked together.
cu-moros-y-cristianos.tip: Don't lift the lid so the rice stays loose.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the beans with their liquid and the water and bring to a boil.
Add the rice and salt, cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

cu-picadillo.title: Cuban picadillo
cu-picadillo.summary: Ground beef with olives and raisins.
cu-picadillo.tip: The sweet-savory touch is what defines it: don't skip the raisins.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and pepper in oil 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and brown it 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the tomato, olives, raisins and salt and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with white rice and a fried egg.

cu-yuca-con-mojo.title: Yuca with mojo
cu-yuca-con-mojo.summary: Boiled cassava with garlic and lime.
cu-yuca-con-mojo.tip: Serve right away: yuca hardens as it cools.
steps: Peel the yuca, cut into chunks and remove the tough core.
Boil in salted water 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Fry the minced garlic in hot oil 1 minute without burning it.
Add the lime juice and pour the mojo over the yuca.

cu-tostones.title: Tostones with mojo
cu-tostones.tip: Soak them in salted water before the second fry.
steps: Peel the plantains and cut into thick slices.
Fry 3 minutes in hot oil and drain.
Flatten with a plate and fry again until golden.
Salt and serve with garlic crushed in oil.

cu-sandwich-cubano.title: Cuban sandwich
cu-sandwich-cubano.summary: Pressed bread with ham, pork and cheese.
cu-sandwich-cubano.tip: If you have no roast pork, use more ham and cheese.
steps: Open the bread and spread with mustard.
Build with the pork, ham, cheese and pickles.
Butter the outside and toast on a griddle or skillet, pressing with a spatula.
Cook 3 minutes per side until the cheese melts and cut diagonally.

ec-encebollado.title: Encebollado
ec-encebollado.summary: Fish soup with yuca and onion.
ec-encebollado.tip: Soaking the onion in lime takes away its sharpness.
steps: Cut the yuca and boil in salted water 20 minutes.
Add the fish and cook 10 minutes; remove and flake.
Slice the onion with tomato, lime and cilantro.
Serve the broth with the yuca, fish and onion on top.

ec-locro-de-papa.title: Locro de papa
ec-locro-de-papa.summary: Creamy potato soup with cheese and avocado.
ec-locro-de-papa.tip: Mash only half the potatoes so some pieces remain.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil.
Add the potatoes in chunks and the water; cook 20 minutes.
Mash some potatoes to thicken and add the milk and salt.
Serve with crumbled cheese and avocado slices.

ec-llapingachos.title: Llapingachos
ec-llapingachos.tip: The mash must be thick or they'll break when flipped.
steps: Boil the potatoes, peel and mash with salt and the fried onion.
Shape balls, stuff with cheese and flatten them.
Brown on a griddle with a little oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve with a fried egg.

ec-menestra-de-lentejas.title: Lentil menestra
ec-menestra-de-lentejas.tip: A squeeze of lime at the end makes it better.
steps: Cook the lentils in the water 25 minutes until tender.
Sauté the onion, tomato, garlic and cumin in oil.
Mix the sofrito with the lentils and cook 10 more minutes.
Serve with rice and meat or plantain.

ec-seco-de-pollo.title: Seco de pollo
ec-seco-de-pollo.summary: Chicken stewed with beer and cilantro.
ec-seco-de-pollo.tip: A little cumin gives it more character.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in a pot with oil.
Add the chopped onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Blend the cilantro with the beer, pour it in and cover.
Cook 30 minutes over low heat and serve with rice.

ec-tigrillo.title: Tigrillo
ec-tigrillo.summary: Mashed green plantain with egg and cheese.
ec-tigrillo.tip: If it gets dry, add a splash of milk.
steps: Boil the plantains in salted water 15 minutes and mash them.
Sauté the onion in the fat.
Add the beaten eggs and stir until set.
Mix with the plantain and cheese and serve hot.

bo-sopa-de-mani.title: Peanut soup
bo-sopa-de-mani.summary: The Bolivian soup, topped with fries.
bo-sopa-de-mani.tip: Toast the peanuts before grinding: more flavor.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil and add the ground peanuts.
Add the water or broth and the diced carrot and cook 20 minutes.
Add the noodles and half the potatoes in cubes and cook until tender.
Serve with the remaining potatoes fried on top.

bo-pique-macho.title: Pique macho
bo-pique-macho.summary: Beef, sausage and fries with egg.
bo-pique-macho.tip: Cut everything the same size so it cooks at the same time.
steps: Cut the beef, sausages and potatoes into pieces and fry the potatoes.
Sauté the beef and sausages 8 minutes.
Add the onion and tomato wedges.
Plate with the fries and top with the hard-boiled egg.

bo-silpancho.title: Silpancho
bo-silpancho.summary: A thin breaded steak with rice, potato and egg.
bo-silpancho.tip: Pound the meat very thin: that's what makes it 'silpancho'.
steps: Cook the rice and the sliced potatoes.
Fry the thin breaded cutlets until golden.
Fry the eggs.
Plate with rice, potatoes and the cutlet, topped with the egg and a tomato-onion salad.

bo-arroz-con-queso.title: Rice with cheese
bo-arroz-con-queso.tip: Use a cheese that melts well.
steps: Cook the rice with the water, salt and onion, covered, 15 minutes.
Mix in the cubed cheese.
Cover 2 minutes so it melts.
Serve with meat, chicken or egg.

bo-fricase-de-pollo.title: Chicken fricassee
bo-fricase-de-pollo.summary: A thick, spicy soup with hominy.
bo-fricase-de-pollo.tip: A squeeze of lime when serving balances the heat.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion, chili and cumin in oil.
Add the chicken pieces and brown 5 minutes.
Add the water and salt and cook 30 minutes.
Add the corn and cook 10 more minutes.

py-sopa-paraguaya.title: Sopa paraguaya
py-sopa-paraguaya.summary: A cornbread with cheese and onion (not a soup).
py-sopa-paraguaya.tip: Served warm in slices, like a bread.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and brown the chopped onion in butter.
Mix the cornmeal with the milk, eggs, cubed cheese, onion and salt.
Pour into a buttered dish.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden and set.

py-chipa-guasu.title: Chipá guasú
py-chipa-guasu.tip: If the corn is canned, drain it very well.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and sauté the chopped onion in butter.
Blend the corn and mix with the eggs, milk, cheese and onion.
Salt and pour into a buttered dish.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden.

py-mbeju.title: Mbejú
py-mbeju.summary: Cassava starch and cheese pancake from a skillet.
py-mbeju.tip: Don't press it: it should stay loose and crisp.
steps: Mix the starch with the grated cheese, milk and a pinch of salt into a loose dough.
Heat a skillet with a little butter.
Spread a layer of dough and cook 3 minutes per side.
Serve hot.

py-bori-bori.title: Bori bori
py-bori-bori.summary: Soup with corn and cheese dumplings.
py-bori-bori.tip: The dumplings are done when they float.
steps: Cook the chicken with the onion and salt in the water 25 minutes and shred it.
Mix the cornmeal with the grated cheese and a little broth; shape small balls.
Cook the balls in the broth 10 minutes.
Return the chicken to the soup and serve hot.

py-soyo.title: So'o yosopy
py-soyo.summary: Thick ground beef soup with rice.
py-soyo.tip: Chopped parsley on top makes it fresher.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and tomato in oil.
Add the ground beef and brown 8 minutes.
Add the water, diced potato and salt and cook 15 minutes.
Add the rice and cook until tender.

py-pastel-mandio.title: Pastel mandi'o
py-pastel-mandio.tip: Fry them in very hot oil so they don't open.
steps: Boil the cassava, mash it and mix with salt into a dough.
Sauté the onion and beef with salt and let cool.
Shape dough discs, fill with beef and chopped hard-boiled egg and seal.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

do-mangu.title: Mangú
do-mangu.summary: Mashed green plantain with pickled onions.
do-mangu.tip: It should be smooth but not watery.
steps: Boil the peeled plantains in salted water 15 minutes.
Mash them with a little cooking water and the butter into a puree.
Brown the sliced onion with the vinegar.
Serve the puree with the onion, fried egg and cheese.

do-habichuelas-guisadas.title: Stewed beans
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and pepper with the tomato sauce in oil.
Add the beans with their liquid and the water.
Simmer 20 minutes and mash a few to thicken.
Finish with cilantro and serve over rice.

do-pollo-guisado.title: Stewed chicken
do-pollo-guisado.summary: Chicken browned in its Creole sauce.
do-pollo-guisado.tip: The caramelized sugar gives it its characteristic color.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown in a pot with the oil and sugar until it takes color.
Add the onion, pepper and tomato sauce and cook 5 minutes.
Add the water, cover and cook 30 minutes over low heat.
Serve with the juices.

do-la-bandera.title: La bandera dominicana
steps: Cook the rice with double the water and salt, covered, 18 minutes.
Brown the salted chicken with the onion and pepper and cook with a little water 25 minutes.
Warm the beans with their liquid.
Serve everything together on the plate.

do-espagueti-dominicano.title: Dominican spaghetti
do-espagueti-dominicano.summary: Pasta with salami and tomato sauce.
do-espagueti-dominicano.tip: A touch of oregano makes it tastier.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the cubed salami with the onion in oil.
Add the tomato and cook 8 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta.

do-locrio-de-salchichon.title: Salami locrio
do-locrio-de-salchichon.summary: Rice with salami in one pot.
do-locrio-de-salchichon.tip: Don't stir it while it cooks.
steps: Sauté the cubed salami with the onion and pepper in oil.
Add the tomato sauce and rice and stir 1 minute.
Cover with hot water and salt.
Cover and cook 18 minutes over low heat.

jp-oyakodon.title: Oyakodon
jp-oyakodon.tip: The eggs should stay a little creamy.
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces and slice the onion.
Cook the onion and chicken in the water or broth with the soy sauce and sugar 8 minutes.
Pour the beaten eggs on top and cover 1 minute, until set.
Serve over hot rice.

jp-arroz-frito.title: Chahan (Japanese fried rice)
jp-arroz-frito.summary: Fried rice with egg and scallion.
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet and scramble the eggs; set aside.
Stir-fry the cold rice over high heat 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and chopped scallion.
Mix with the eggs and serve.

jp-onigiri-de-atun.title: Tuna onigiri
jp-onigiri-de-atun.tip: Wet your hands with salted water so the rice doesn't stick.
steps: Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise.
Wet your hands with salted water and take a portion of rice.
Make a hollow, add the filling and close into a triangle.
Wrap with a strip of nori.

jp-sopa-miso.title: Miso soup with tofu
jp-sopa-miso.summary: Quick broth with tofu and scallion.
jp-sopa-miso.tip: Don't boil the miso: it loses aroma.
steps: Heat the water without a hard boil.
Dissolve the miso in a little hot water and pour it in.
Add the cubed tofu and the seaweed.
Cook 2 minutes and serve with the scallion.

jp-tamagoyaki.title: Tamagoyaki
jp-tamagoyaki.tip: Medium-low heat so it doesn't brown too much.
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar and soy sauce.
Heat a skillet with oil and pour in a thin layer.
When set, roll it to one side and add another layer underneath.
Repeat, roll and slice.

jp-yakisoba.title: Yakisoba
jp-yakisoba.tip: A very hot pan keeps the vegetables from releasing water.
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the sliced vegetables in oil over high heat 4 minutes.
Add the noodles and soy sauce.
Toss 2 minutes and serve.

in-dal-de-lentejas.title: Lentil dal
in-dal-de-lentejas.tip: A squeeze of lemon at the end freshens it up.
steps: Cook the lentils in the salted water 20 minutes, until they break down.
Sauté the onion, garlic and tomato in oil with the curry.
Mix the sauté into the lentils.
Cook 5 more minutes and serve with rice.

in-chana-masala.title: Chana masala
in-chana-masala.tip: Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil with the ginger and curry.
Add the tomato and cook 8 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas and salt.
Cook 10 minutes and serve with rice.

in-aloo-gobi.title: Aloo gobi
in-aloo-gobi.tip: Don't add much water: it cooks in its own steam.
steps: Cut the potato and cauliflower into small pieces.
Sauté the onion in oil with the curry.
Add the vegetables, tomato, salt and a splash of water.
Cover and cook 20 minutes over low heat.

in-aloo-palak.title: Aloo palak
in-aloo-palak.tip: Blend the spinach if you like it creamier.
steps: Boil the cubed potatoes 10 minutes and drain.
Sauté the onion with the curry in oil.
Add the chopped spinach until it wilts.
Add the potatoes, yogurt and salt and cook 5 minutes.

in-kichdi.title: Kichdi
in-kichdi.summary: Rice and lentils in one pot.
in-kichdi.tip: If it gets too thick, add hot water.
steps: Rinse the rice and lentils.
Cook them in the water with the turmeric, salt and diced carrot.
Cook covered 25 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Serve with a spoonful of butter.

in-raita.title: Cucumber raita
in-raita.summary: Fresh yogurt with cucumber and cumin.
in-raita.tip: It goes great with spicy meals.
steps: Grate or dice the cucumber and drain it.
Mix with the yogurt.
Add salt, cumin and a few drops of lemon.
Serve very cold.

gr-ensalada-griega.title: Greek salad
gr-ensalada-griega.tip: Don't toss too much so the cheese doesn't break up.
steps: Cut the tomato and cucumber into chunks and slice the onion.
Place them in a bowl with the olives.
Put the cheese on top, cubed or as one piece.
Dress with oil, oregano and salt.

gr-tzatziki.title: Tzatziki
gr-tzatziki.tip: If the cucumber releases water, the sauce turns runny.
steps: Grate the cucumber and drain it very well.
Mix it with the yogurt and chopped garlic.
Add the oil, a few drops of lemon and salt.
Chill 15 minutes before serving.

gr-souvlaki-de-pollo.title: Chicken souvlaki
gr-souvlaki-de-pollo.summary: Chicken skewers with lemon and oregano.
gr-souvlaki-de-pollo.tip: The longer it marinates, the more flavor.
steps: Cube the chicken and mix with lemon, garlic, oregano, oil and salt.
Marinate 15 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Cook 10 minutes on a griddle or skillet, turning.

gr-fasolada.title: Fasolada
gr-fasolada.summary: Bean soup with tomato and carrot.
gr-fasolada.tip: A splash of raw olive oil when serving is key.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add the tomato and water and cook 15 minutes.
Add the drained beans and salt.
Cook 20 more minutes and finish with a splash of oil.

gr-briam.title: Briam
gr-briam.tip: Stir halfway through so they cook evenly.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and cut the vegetables into thick slices.
Place them in a dish with the tomato, oil and salt.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 more minutes.

gr-moussaka-sencilla.title: Simple moussaka
gr-moussaka-sencilla.summary: Eggplant, potato and meat with béchamel.
gr-moussaka-sencilla.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes before cutting.
steps: Bake the eggplant and potato slices 15 minutes at 400°F (200°C).
Sauté the onion and beef with the tomato 15 minutes.
Make a béchamel with the milk, flour and salt.
Layer potato, eggplant and meat, cover with béchamel and bake 20 minutes.

uy-pamplona.title: Pamplona chicken
uy-pamplona.summary: Chicken breast stuffed with ham and cheese, baked.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and open each breast like a book.
Season and fill with the ham and cheese; close with toothpicks.
Brush with oil and place in a dish.
Bake 25 minutes, until golden and cooked through.

uy-chorizo-al-pan.title: Chorizo sandwich
uy-chorizo-al-pan.summary: Grilled sausage on bread with chimichurri.
uy-chorizo-al-pan.tip: Cook it slowly so it doesn't burn outside and stay raw inside.
steps: Slit the sausage lengthwise and cook over medium heat 12 minutes, turning.
Mix the oil with the chopped garlic and parsley and the chili for the chimichurri.
Open the roll and warm it a few seconds.
Fill with the sausage and chimichurri.

uy-pasta-a-la-caruso.title: Pasta Caruso
uy-pasta-a-la-caruso.tip: A little grated cheese on top finishes it.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the mushrooms and ham in strips for 5 minutes.
Add the cream and cook 5 minutes, with salt.
Toss with the drained pasta.

ve-caraotas-negras.title: Black beans
ve-caraotas-negras.summary: Stewed black beans with rice and cheese.
ve-caraotas-negras.tip: A pinch of sugar balances the stew, as in Venezuela.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the beans with their liquid and the cumin.
Simmer 20 minutes and mash a few to thicken.
Serve with white rice and grated cheese.

ve-tajadas-con-queso.title: Fried plantain with cheese
ve-tajadas-con-queso.summary: Ripe plantain fried and served with cheese.
ve-tajadas-con-queso.tip: The riper the plantain, the sweeter it gets.
steps: Peel the plantains and cut into lengthwise strips.
Fry in hot oil 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper.
Serve with sliced or grated cheese.

ve-pasticho.title: Easy pasticho
ve-pasticho.summary: Venezuelan lasagna with beef, ham and cheese.
ve-pasticho.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes before cutting.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and brown the onion and beef; add the sauce and salt.
Cook the sheets if the package says so.
Layer in a dish: pasta, beef, ham and cheese.
Finish with cheese and the milk on top and bake 30 minutes.

ve-pollo-guisado.title: Creole stewed chicken
steps: Salt the chicken and brown in a pot with oil.
Add the chopped onion, pepper and tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot in chunks and a cup of water.
Cook covered 30 minutes over low heat.

co-bandeja-paisa-sencilla.title: Simple bandeja paisa
co-bandeja-paisa-sencilla.summary: Beans, rice, chorizo, egg and plantain.
co-bandeja-paisa-sencilla.tip: With avocado and arepa it's complete.
steps: Cook the rice with water and salt, covered, 15 minutes.
Warm the beans with their liquid.
Fry the chorizo, beef, sliced plantain and eggs.
Serve everything together on one plate.

co-changua.title: Changua
co-changua.summary: Milk soup with egg, typical of Bogotá.
co-changua.tip: With the egg just set, the yolk stays creamy.
steps: Heat the milk with the water and salt.
Add the chopped scallion.
Crack the eggs gently into the soup and cook 3 minutes.
Serve with cilantro and toasted bread.

co-arroz-atollado.title: Arroz atollado
co-arroz-atollado.summary: Soupy rice with chicken and potato.
co-arroz-atollado.tip: It should be creamy, not dry.
steps: Brown the chicken seasoned with salt and cumin; set aside.
Sauté the onion and tomato; return the chicken with the water.
Cook 15 minutes and add the potato chunks and rice.
Cook 20 minutes, until soupy and creamy.

co-sudado-de-pollo.title: Sudado de pollo
co-sudado-de-pollo.summary: Stewed chicken with potato and tomato.
co-sudado-de-pollo.tip: It cooks in its own juices: don't lift the lid.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown in a pot with oil.
Add the sliced onion and tomato and the potato in chunks.
Pour in the beer or water and cover.
Cook 35 minutes over low heat and finish with cilantro.

pe-aji-de-gallina.title: Aji de gallina
pe-aji-de-gallina.summary: Shredded chicken in a creamy chili and bread sauce.
pe-aji-de-gallina.tip: Aji amarillo is sold as a paste in Peruvian shops.
steps: Cook the chicken in salted water 20 minutes and shred.
Soak the bread in the milk and blend.
Sauté the onion with the aji, add the bread mixture and nuts and cook 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and serve with potato and rice.

pe-tacu-tacu.title: Tacu tacu
pe-tacu-tacu.tip: Great for using yesterday's rice and beans.
steps: Sauté the onion and aji in a tablespoon of oil.
Mix with the rice and mashed beans.
Shape into an oval and brown in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve with a fried egg.

pe-ceviche-sencillo.title: Simple ceviche
pe-ceviche-sencillo.tip: Use very fresh fish and eat it right away.
steps: Cut the fish into cubes and salt it.
Squeeze the limes over the fish and wait 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion, chili and cilantro.
Serve immediately, with sweet potato or corn if you have it.

pe-tallarines-rojos.title: Tallarines rojos
pe-tallarines-rojos.summary: Pasta with tomato and meat sauce.
pe-tallarines-rojos.tip: A bit of oregano improves it.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the onion and garlic; add the beef and brown it.
Add the grated tomato and cook 15 minutes with salt.
Toss with the pasta.

cl-humitas.title: Baked humitas
cl-humitas.summary: Ground corn with basil, no husks.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and cut off and blend the corn.
Sauté the onion in butter and mix with the corn, basil and salt.
Pour into a buttered dish.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden.

cl-empanadas-de-pino-al-horno.title: Baked pino empanadas
cl-empanadas-de-pino-al-horno.tip: Make sure the pino is cold so it doesn't tear the dough.
steps: Sauté the onion and beef with cumin and salt; let cool.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Fill the rounds with the pino, hard-boiled egg, olive and raisins and seal.
Brush with egg and bake 25 minutes.

cl-sopaipillas.title: Sopaipillas
cl-sopaipillas.tip: Serve with chancaca syrup or pebre.
steps: Cook the pumpkin and mash it.
Mix with the flour, butter and salt into a dough.
Roll thin and cut circles; prick with a fork.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

mx-tinga-de-pollo.title: Chicken tinga
mx-tinga-de-pollo.summary: Shredded chicken in tomato chipotle sauce.
steps: Cook the chicken in salted water 20 minutes and shred it.
Blend the tomato with the chipotle.
Sauté the onion in oil and pour in the sauce; cook 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and serve on tostadas or tacos.

mx-molletes.title: Molletes
mx-molletes.summary: Bread with beans and melted cheese.
mx-molletes.tip: Add chopped serrano for a kick.
steps: Halve the bread and toast it.
Spread with beans.
Top with cheese and broil 5 minutes.
Serve with a tomato and onion pico de gallo.

mx-calabacitas-con-queso.title: Zucchini with cheese
mx-calabacitas-con-queso.summary: Zucchini with corn and melted cheese.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil.
Add the diced zucchini, chopped tomato and corn.
Cover and cook 10 minutes with salt.
Add the cheese and let it melt.

mx-huevos-divorciados.title: Huevos divorciados
mx-huevos-divorciados.summary: Two eggs with red and green salsa.
steps: Warm the tortillas in a skillet.
Fry the eggs in oil.
Place on the tortillas, one with red salsa and one with green.
Serve hot.

mx-tacos-de-carne-asada.title: Carne asada tacos
mx-tacos-de-carne-asada.tip: Cut the meat against the grain.
steps: Salt the meat and sear on a very hot griddle 3 minutes per side.
Rest it and cut into small strips.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with meat, onion, cilantro and lime.

es-patatas-bravas.title: Patatas bravas
es-patatas-bravas.tip: Fry them at two temperatures for crispness.
steps: Cube the potatoes and fry in hot oil until golden.
Heat the tomato with the paprika, vinegar and salt for the sauce.
Drain the potatoes.
Serve with the sauce on top.

es-sopa-de-ajo.title: Garlic soup
es-sopa-de-ajo.summary: Bread, garlic and paprika, piping hot.
steps: Brown the sliced garlic in oil without burning it.
Add the torn bread and paprika and stir 30 seconds.
Pour in the hot water, salt and cook 15 minutes.
Add the eggs and let them set 3 minutes.

es-pan-con-tomate-y-jamon.title: Tomato bread with ham
steps: Toast the bread.
Rub with the garlic and then with the halved tomato.
Drizzle with oil and salt.
Top with the ham.

es-pollo-al-limon.title: Lemon chicken
es-pollo-al-limon.summary: Browned chicken with lemon and garlic.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in oil.
Add the chopped garlic and the lemon juice.
Cover and cook 20 minutes over low heat.
Finish with parsley and serve with the juices.

br-galinhada.title: Galinhada
steps: Season the chicken with salt and brown in the oil.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, turmeric and water.
Cover and cook 25 minutes over low heat.

br-virado-a-paulista.title: Virado à paulista
br-virado-a-paulista.summary: Beans, sausage, egg and collard greens.
br-virado-a-paulista.tip: The greens should stay bright green and crisp.
steps: Warm the beans with a little oil and thicken with the flour.
Fry the sausage in slices.
Sauté the thinly sliced greens with garlic.
Fry the eggs and serve everything together.

br-misto-quente.title: Ham and cheese toastie
br-misto-quente.summary: Bread with ham and cheese, pressed on the griddle.
br-misto-quente.tip: Press it with a spatula so the cheese melts.
steps: Assemble the sandwiches with ham and cheese.
Butter the outside.
Brown in a skillet 2 minutes per side, pressing down.
Cut in half and serve hot.

br-brigadeiro.title: Brigadeiro
br-brigadeiro.tip: Butter your hands to roll them.
steps: Mix the condensed milk, cocoa and butter in a pot.
Cook over low heat, stirring, until it pulls away from the bottom.
Let cool and roll into balls.
Roll in the sprinkles.

br-bolo-de-cenoura.title: Carrot cake with chocolate
steps: Blend the carrots, eggs and oil.
Mix with the flour, sugar and baking powder.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°F (180°C) in a greased pan.
Cover with the chocolate sauce.

br-feijao-tropeiro.title: Feijão tropeiro
br-feijao-tropeiro.summary: Beans with cassava flour, bacon and egg.
br-feijao-tropeiro.tip: Careful with the salt: the bacon is already salty.
steps: Fry the diced bacon and sauté the onion.
Add the drained beans and heat.
Stir in the flour little by little.
Mix in the scrambled eggs and greens and serve.

br-sopa-de-mandioquinha.title: Peruvian parsnip soup
br-sopa-de-mandioquinha.tip: Great with bits of bacon on top.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the chopped root and the broth.
Cook 25 minutes until soft.
Blend and adjust the salt.

br-risoto-de-frango.title: Chicken risotto
br-risoto-de-frango.tip: Keep stirring to make it creamy.
steps: Cook the chicken in the broth and shred it.
Sauté the onion in the butter and add the rice.
Add the hot broth little by little, stirring, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and cheese.

br-torta-de-liquidificador.title: Blender pie
br-torta-de-liquidificador.tip: Works with tuna or vegetables instead of chicken.
steps: Blend the flour, milk, eggs, oil, baking powder and salt.
Pour half the batter into a greased pan.
Top with the shredded chicken and cheese and finish with the rest of the batter.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°F (180°C).

pt-francesinha-simples.title: Simple francesinha
pt-francesinha-simples.tip: Add a fried egg on top to make it complete.
steps: Grill the sausage and steak.
Build the sandwich with meat, sausage and cheese between the slices.
Top with cheese and bake 5 minutes.
Serve with hot tomato sauce on top.

pt-canja-de-galinha.title: Chicken rice soup
steps: Cook the chicken with the onion and salt in the water 25 minutes.
Remove, shred and set aside.
Add the rice and diced carrot to the broth and cook 15 minutes.
Return the chicken and serve with mint.

de-bauernfruehstueck.title: Farmer's breakfast
de-bauernfruehstueck.summary: Pan-fried potatoes with egg and bacon, straight from the skillet.
de-bauernfruehstueck.tip: Using cooked potatoes from the day before makes it extra crispy.
steps: Slice the cooked or raw potatoes and dice the onion.
Fry the bacon in oil until crisp, add the potatoes and onion and cook 12 minutes until golden.
Beat the eggs with salt and pour them over the potatoes.
Cook over low heat until set and serve straight from the pan.

de-erbsensuppe.title: Split pea soup with sausage
de-erbsensuppe.summary: Thick, warming soup made from dried peas.
de-erbsensuppe.tip: A little marjoram and a splash of vinegar at the end make it even better.
steps: Rinse the peas and soak them overnight if needed.
Dice the onion, carrots and potatoes.
Bring everything to a boil with the water or broth and simmer 40 minutes, until the peas fall apart.
Mash the soup lightly, season with salt and warm the sliced sausages in it.

de-kaiserschmarrn.title: Kaiserschmarrn
de-kaiserschmarrn.tip: Dust with powdered sugar and serve with applesauce or fruit compote.
steps: Mix the flour, milk, egg yolks, sugar and salt into a smooth batter.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold them in.
Cook the batter in hot butter in a skillet until golden, flip it and tear it into pieces with two forks.
Caramelize with the raisins and a little sugar and serve warm.

de-griessbrei.title: Semolina pudding
de-griessbrei.summary: Creamy milk porridge with cinnamon and sugar.
de-griessbrei.tip: Serve with cherries, applesauce or berries.
steps: Bring the milk and sugar to a boil.
Sprinkle in the semolina, stirring.
Let it thicken for 5 minutes over low heat.
Serve with cinnamon and a small piece of butter.

de-semmelknoedel.title: Bread dumplings (Semmelknödel)
de-semmelknoedel.summary: Dumplings made from stale bread, a classic for leftovers.
de-semmelknoedel.tip: The water should barely simmer, or the dumplings fall apart.
steps: Cut the rolls into small cubes and pour the warm milk over them.
Cook the chopped onion in butter and add it to the bread with the eggs, parsley and salt.
Mix well, rest 10 minutes and shape dumplings with wet hands.
Simmer them 15 minutes in barely boiling salted water; do not let it boil hard.

de-gurkensalat.title: Cucumber salad with yogurt
de-gurkensalat.summary: Fresh, cool and ready in ten minutes.
de-gurkensalat.tip: Salting and squeezing the cucumber keeps the salad from turning watery.
steps: Slice the cucumber thinly and salt it lightly.
Whisk the yogurt, vinegar and oil.
Squeeze out the cucumber and toss it with the dressing and dill.
Let it rest 10 minutes and serve.

ar-croquetas-de-papa.title: Potato and cheese croquettes
ar-croquetas-de-papa.tip: Let the mash cool before shaping so they hold together.
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes 20 minutes and mash with salt.
Mix in the egg and the cheese cut into small cubes.
Shape into croquettes and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

ar-tortitas-de-acelga.title: Swiss chard fritters
ar-tortitas-de-acelga.summary: Ready in minutes with what you have.
ar-tortitas-de-acelga.tip: Squeeze the chard well: leftover water keeps the fritters from browning.
steps: Boil the chard 3 minutes, drain well and chop.
Mix it with the eggs, flour, cheese and salt.
Cook spoonfuls of the mixture in hot oil 3 minutes per side.

ar-panqueques-de-espinaca-y-ricota.title: Spinach and ricotta crepes
ar-panqueques-de-espinaca-y-ricota.summary: Filled and warmed in the oven.
ar-panqueques-de-espinaca-y-ricota.tip: Topped with tomato sauce and cheese and gratinated, they are even better.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter and make the crepes in a lightly oiled skillet.
Boil the spinach 2 minutes, drain well and chop.
Mix it with the ricotta and salt.
Fill the crepes, roll them up and warm them 10 minutes in the oven at 350°F (180°C).

ar-zapallo-relleno-de-choclo-y-queso.title: Squash stuffed with corn and cheese
ar-zapallo-relleno-de-choclo-y-queso.summary: Sweet and creamy, from the oven.
ar-zapallo-relleno-de-choclo-y-queso.tip: Pierce the squash: it should be almost tender before stuffing.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C), halve the squash, scoop out the seeds and roast 30 minutes with a little salt.
Cook the chopped onion in oil and mix it with the drained corn and the cubed cheese.
Fill the halves and bake 15 more minutes, until golden.

ar-bife-a-la-criolla.title: Creole-style steak stew
ar-bife-a-la-criolla.summary: Tender beef with potato, tomato and pepper.
ar-bife-a-la-criolla.tip: If there is too much liquid, uncover for the last 5 minutes.
steps: Brown the beef strips in a pot with oil and salt them.
Add the sliced onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato, the cubed potatoes and 1 cup of water.
Cook covered 30 minutes, until everything is tender.

ar-tarta-de-atun.title: Tuna pie
ar-tarta-de-atun.tip: Drain the tuna well so the pie doesn't turn watery.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a pie dish with the crust.
Cook the chopped onion and mix it with the drained tuna and the cubed cheese.
Add the beaten eggs and salt.
Pour the filling into the pie and bake 25 minutes.

ar-fideos-con-salsa-de-espinaca.title: Pasta with creamy spinach sauce
ar-fideos-con-salsa-de-espinaca.tip: A pinch of nutmeg improves it.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water and drain.
Boil the spinach 2 minutes and blend it with the cream, garlic and salt.
Warm the sauce 3 minutes over low heat with the oil.
Toss with the pasta and serve with grated cheese.

ar-sopa-crema-de-choclo.title: Cream of corn soup
ar-sopa-crema-de-choclo.tip: A little grated cheese on top makes it tastier.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil.
Add the cubed potato, the corn and the water, salt and cook 15 minutes.
Blend until creamy and return to the pot with the milk.
Warm 3 minutes without boiling and serve.

ar-noquis-de-zapallo.title: Pumpkin gnocchi with cheese sauce
ar-noquis-de-zapallo.summary: Soft, sweet and in a creamy sauce.
ar-noquis-de-zapallo.tip: Drain the squash well: less water means less flour and lighter gnocchi.
steps: Cook the cubed squash 15 minutes, drain well and mash.
Mix with the egg, salt and the flour a little at a time until you get a soft dough that doesn't stick.
Roll into ropes, cut the gnocchi and boil in salted water until they float.
Warm the cream with the grated cheese for 2 minutes and toss with the gnocchi.

ar-pizza-de-muzzarella.title: Mozzarella pizza
ar-pizza-de-muzzarella.summary: With homemade dough and a very hot oven.
ar-pizza-de-muzzarella.tip: With the dough stretched thin and the oven very hot, the base turns out crisp.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, 2 tablespoons of oil and the warm water, knead 10 minutes and let rise 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to its maximum and stretch the dough in an oiled pizza pan.
Cover with the tomato sauce and bake 10 minutes.
Add the mozzarella and oregano and bake 10 more minutes, until melted.

ar-faina.title: Fainá (chickpea flatbread)
ar-faina.tip: Eat it hot, placed on top of a slice of pizza.
steps: Mix the chickpea flour with the water, salt and a tablespoon of oil until smooth.
Let it rest 30 minutes and skim the foam off the top.
Heat the oven to 430°F (220°C) and warm a baking dish with the rest of the oil.
Pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes, until golden. Serve with pepper.

ar-tarta-de-cebolla-y-queso.title: Onion and cheese tart
ar-tarta-de-cebolla-y-queso.summary: Sweet from the onion and well browned on top.
ar-tarta-de-cebolla-y-queso.tip: The slower you cook the onion, the sweeter it gets.
steps: Slice the onions and cook them in oil over low heat 15 minutes, until soft.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a pie dish with the crust.
Mix the onion with the eggs, cream, cubed cheese and salt.
Pour into the pie and bake 30 minutes, until set and golden.

ar-tortilla-de-zapallitos.title: Zucchini omelette
ar-tortilla-de-zapallitos.tip: Let the zucchini brown well before adding the egg.
steps: Slice the zucchini thinly and the onion in strips and sauté everything in oil 8 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and mix with the vegetables and the cubed cheese.
Pour into the skillet and cook over low heat 5 minutes until set underneath.
Flip it using a plate and cook 3 more minutes.

ar-fideos-al-pesto.title: Homemade pesto pasta
ar-fideos-al-pesto.summary: With fresh basil, garlic and cheese.
ar-fideos-al-pesto.tip: Don't heat the pesto in the pan: toss it off the heat so the basil doesn't darken.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Blend the basil with the garlic, cheese, walnuts, oil and a pinch of salt.
Drain the pasta, keeping a little cooking water.
Toss the pasta with the pesto and a splash of the water to make it creamy.

ar-budin-de-limon.title: Lemon loaf cake
ar-budin-de-limon.summary: Fragrant and moist, perfect with tea.
ar-budin-de-limon.tip: Brushing it with lemon syrup as soon as it comes out makes it juicier.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and oil a loaf pan.
Beat the eggs with the sugar, oil, milk, and the zest and juice of the lemons.
Add the flour with the baking powder and mix just until combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.

ar-manzanas-al-horno.title: Baked apples with cinnamon
ar-manzanas-al-horno.summary: A simple dessert from what's in the fruit bowl.
ar-manzanas-al-horno.tip: Cut a slit in the skin so they don't burst.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and core the apples without going all the way through.
Fill them with sugar, cinnamon, butter and the raisins.
Set them in a dish with a splash of water.
Bake 30 minutes, until tender.

ar-empanadas-de-verdura-y-queso.title: Baked vegetable and cheese empanadas
ar-empanadas-de-verdura-y-queso.tip: Letting the filling cool before assembling keeps the dough from tearing.
steps: Boil the chard 3 minutes, drain well and chop.
Cook the chopped onion in oil and mix with the chard, the cubed cheese and salt.
Fill the wrappers, seal with a crimped edge and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes, until golden.

ar-lasana-de-carne.title: Beef and cheese lasagna
ar-lasana-de-carne.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes before cutting so the portions hold together.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil, add the beef and cook 8 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and salt and cook 10 more minutes.
Boil the lasagna sheets as the package says and drain.
Build layers in a baking dish: meat sauce, pasta, cream and mozzarella, and repeat.
Finish with mozzarella and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes, until browned.

ar-pechuga-a-la-napolitana.title: Napolitana-style chicken breast
ar-pechuga-a-la-napolitana.summary: Like the milanesa, but not fried.
ar-pechuga-a-la-napolitana.tip: Butterfly the breasts so they cook evenly.
steps: Salt the breasts and brown them in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Move them to a baking dish and cover with tomato sauce.
Add the ham and mozzarella and sprinkle with oregano.
Broil in a hot oven 10 minutes, until the cheese melts.

ar-crema-de-arvejas.title: Cream of pea soup
ar-crema-de-arvejas.summary: Green, smooth and ready in 30 minutes.
