ar-crema-de-arvejas.tip: Frozen peas keep their color better.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil.
Add the cubed potato, the peas, the water and salt and cook 15 minutes.
Blend until creamy.
Serve with a swirl of cream on top.

ar-risotto-de-queso.title: Creamy cheese risotto
ar-risotto-de-queso.tip: Stir often: the rice starch is what makes it creamy.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in the butter.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the hot water little by little, stirring, until the rice is tender (about 18 minutes).
Take off the heat and stir in the grated cheese and salt.

ar-panqueques-con-dulce-de-leche.title: Crepes with dulce de leche
ar-panqueques-con-dulce-de-leche.tip: Letting the batter rest 15 minutes makes thinner crepes.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Heat a skillet with a little butter and cook one thin crepe at a time, 1 minute per side.
Spread them with dulce de leche and roll up.
Serve warm.

ar-pollo-con-crema-y-champinones.title: Chicken with cream and mushrooms
ar-pollo-con-crema-y-champinones.tip: Don't cover the mushrooms while cooking: that lets the water out so they brown.
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes, salt it and brown it in a skillet with oil.
Add the chopped onion, the garlic and the sliced mushrooms and cook 8 minutes.
Pour in the cream and cook over low heat 8 more minutes.
Serve hot.

ar-papas-rellenas-con-carne.title: Stuffed potatoes with beef
ar-papas-rellenas-con-carne.tip: It's easier to scoop them out while still warm.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins 25 minutes, halve them and scoop out the center, leaving a rim.
Cook the chopped onion in oil, add the beef and salt and cook 8 minutes.
Mix the beef with the potato flesh and fill the halves.
Top with the cheese and broil in a hot oven 10 minutes.

ar-guiso-de-zapallo-y-choclo.title: Squash and corn stew
ar-guiso-de-zapallo-y-choclo.summary: Thick and warming, with no meat.
ar-guiso-de-zapallo-y-choclo.tip: A little paprika or cumin makes it tastier.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil and add the chopped tomato.
Add the cubed squash and potato and the water and cook 20 minutes.
Add the drained corn and salt and cook 5 more minutes.
Mash lightly with a fork to thicken and serve.

ar-ensalada-de-zanahoria-y-huevo.title: Carrot and egg salad
ar-ensalada-de-zanahoria-y-huevo.summary: The classic of the Argentine table.
ar-ensalada-de-zanahoria-y-huevo.tip: Finely grated carrot absorbs the dressing better.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool and peel them.
Grate the carrots.
Slice the eggs and mix with the carrot.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.

es-croquetas-de-jamon.title: Ham croquettes
es-croquetas-de-jamon.tip: The colder the dough, the easier they are to shape.
steps: Melt the butter, add the flour and cook 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the milk little by little, stirring constantly, until you get a thick dough, and mix in the ham.
Chill it in the fridge 2 hours, shape croquettes and coat them in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

gen-salmon-al-horno-con-limon-y-verduras.title: Baked salmon with lemon and vegetables
gen-salmon-al-horno-con-limon-y-verduras.tip: Don't overcook it: salmon is best juicy.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and slice the potatoes and carrot thinly.
Put them on a tray with oil and salt and bake 15 minutes.
Add the salmon fillets with salt, pepper and lemon slices.
Bake 15 more minutes, until the fish flakes easily.

mx-esquites.title: Esquites
mx-esquites.summary: Street corn in a cup, with cream and cheese.
mx-esquites.tip: A pinch of chili powder gives it the Mexican touch.
steps: Sauté the corn kernels in the butter 8 minutes, until lightly browned.
Move to a bowl and mix with the mayonnaise and salt.
Add the grated cheese.
Serve in cups with a squeeze of lemon.

pe-papa-rellena.title: Papa rellena (stuffed potato)
pe-papa-rellena.summary: Fried mashed potato with a beef filling.
pe-papa-rellena.tip: Wet your hands to handle the mash without it sticking.
steps: Boil the potatoes, mash them with salt and the flour and let cool.
Cook the chopped onion and the beef with salt for 8 minutes.
Shape a ball of mash, fill it with the beef and chopped hard-boiled egg and close it.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

co-empanadas-colombianas.title: Colombian potato and beef empanadas
co-empanadas-colombianas.tip: The dough shouldn't be dry: if it cracks, add water.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes and mix with the beef cooked with the onion and salt.
Knead the cornmeal with warm water and salt.
Roll small balls of dough, fill them and fold into half-moons.
Fry in hot oil 4 minutes per side.

cl-tortilla-de-rescoldo.title: Tortilla de rescoldo (Chilean flatbread)
cl-tortilla-de-rescoldo.summary: The quick Chilean bread, cooked in a skillet.
cl-tortilla-de-rescoldo.tip: Prick them with a fork so they cook evenly.
steps: Mix the flour with the baking powder and the salt.
Add the melted butter and the warm water and knead into a smooth dough.
Let it rest 15 minutes and shape thick discs.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat 6 minutes per side.

ve-tequenos-al-horno.title: Baked tequeños
ve-tequenos-al-horno.tip: Use a firm cheese that doesn't melt too much.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cut the puff pastry into strips.
Wrap each cheese stick with a strip and seal the edges.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake 20 minutes, until golden.

jp-curry-japones.title: Japanese chicken and potato curry
jp-curry-japones.tip: A teaspoon of honey or grated apple gives the characteristic sweetness.
steps: Brown the cubed chicken with the chopped onion in oil.
Add the potato and carrot in chunks and the water and cook 20 minutes.
Dissolve the curry in a little of the broth and add it.
Cook 5 more minutes until thick and serve with rice.

in-aloo-matar.title: Aloo matar (potato and peas)
in-aloo-matar.summary: A simple potato and pea curry.
in-aloo-matar.tip: Fresh cilantro on top makes it more fragrant.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil until golden.
Add the chopped tomato and the curry and cook 5 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes, the water and salt and cook covered 15 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 5 more minutes.

gr-keftedes.title: Keftedes (Greek meatballs)
gr-keftedes.tip: Let the mixture rest 20 minutes in the fridge.
steps: Mix the beef with the grated onion, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano and salt.
Shape flat meatballs.
Coat them in flour or breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil 3 minutes per side.

gr-spanakopita-sencilla.title: Simple spanakopita
gr-spanakopita-sencilla.summary: Spinach and cheese pie with phyllo dough.
gr-spanakopita-sencilla.tip: Squeeze the spinach well: water softens the pastry.
steps: Boil the spinach 2 minutes, drain well and chop.
Mix with the cooked onion, crumbled feta and the eggs.
Layer phyllo sheets brushed with oil in a dish, fill and cover with more sheets.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes, until golden.

gen-pasta-con-calabacin-y-limon.title: Zucchini and lemon pasta
gen-pasta-con-calabacin-y-limon.tip: Keep a cup of the cooking water to bind the sauce.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
Grate the zucchini and sauté with the garlic in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lemon zest and juice.
Toss with the spaghetti and the grated cheese.

gen-panqueques-de-avena-y-banana.title: Oat and banana pancakes
gen-panqueques-de-avena-y-banana.tip: The riper the bananas, the sweeter they turn out.
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with the eggs and the oats.
Add the cinnamon.
Cook spoonfuls of the mix in a skillet with butter.
Brown 2 minutes per side.

gen-brownies-caseros.title: Homemade brownies
gen-brownies-caseros.tip: Take them out when the center is still barely moist.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and melt the chocolate with the butter.
Beat the eggs with the sugar and mix with the chocolate.
Add the flour and mix just until combined.
Pour into a buttered pan and bake 25 minutes.

gen-bruschettas-de-tomate-y-albahaca.title: Tomato and basil bruschetta
gen-bruschettas-de-tomate-y-albahaca.summary: Fresh, for snacking or as a starter.
gen-bruschettas-de-tomate-y-albahaca.tip: Serve right away so the bread doesn't get soggy.
steps: Slice the bread and toast it.
Rub each slice with the garlic.
Dice the tomatoes and mix with the chopped basil, the oil and salt.
Top the toasts with the mixture and serve at once.

gen-cuscus-con-vegetales.title: Couscous with vegetables
gen-cuscus-con-vegetales.tip: Fluff it with a fork so it doesn't clump.
steps: Put the couscous in a bowl, cover with the hot water and cover for 5 minutes.
Sauté the diced carrot and zucchini in oil for 8 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork.
Mix everything with lemon and salt.

gen-pollo-frito-al-horno.title: Oven-fried chicken
gen-pollo-frito-al-horno.tip: Thighs turn out juicier than breast.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the pieces.
Dip them in beaten egg and then in the breadcrumbs mixed with the paprika.
Put them in a dish with oil.
Bake 40 minutes, turning halfway.

gen-mousse-de-chocolate.title: Chocolate mousse
gen-mousse-de-chocolate.tip: Folding keeps the air in the mousse.
steps: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler and let it cool slightly.
Mix it with the yolks.
Whip the whites to stiff peaks with the sugar and the cream separately and fold everything together.
Divide into glasses and chill 3 hours.

es-pimientos-rellenos-de-carne.title: Stuffed peppers with beef and rice
es-pimientos-rellenos-de-carne.tip: Pick peppers that can stand upright in the dish.
steps: Boil the rice 12 minutes and drain; cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds.
Cook the chopped onion and the beef with salt for 8 minutes and mix with the rice.
Fill the peppers and set them in a dish with the tomato sauce.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F (180°C) for 30 minutes.

mx-enchiladas-suizas.title: Enchiladas suizas
mx-enchiladas-suizas.tip: Warming the tortillas first keeps them from tearing when rolled.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and warm the tortillas in a skillet with a little oil to soften them.
Fill them with the chicken and roll them up in a baking dish.
Mix the green salsa with the cream and pour it over the enchiladas.
Top with cheese and bake 15 minutes.

mx-burritos-de-frijol-y-queso.title: Bean and cheese burritos
mx-burritos-de-frijol-y-queso.tip: Brown them seam side down so they don't open.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil and add the mashed beans.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill them with the beans, cheese and hot sauce.
Fold them up and brown in the skillet 2 minutes per side.

pe-chicharron-de-pollo.title: Peruvian fried chicken (chicharrón de pollo)
pe-chicharron-de-pollo.summary: Crispy, with lemon and salsa criolla.
pe-chicharron-de-pollo.tip: Don't crowd the pan: too many pieces steam instead of crisping.
steps: Marinate the chicken with the chopped garlic, the lemon juice, salt and pepper for 15 minutes.
Coat it in flour.
Heat the oil and fry the pieces 12 minutes, until golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot.

co-bunuelos-de-queso.title: Cheese fritters (buñuelos)
co-bunuelos-de-queso.tip: Medium heat: if the oil is too hot, they brown outside and stay raw inside.
steps: Mix the flour with the sugar and the baking powder.
Add the grated cheese, the egg and the milk to make a soft dough.
Shape into balls with oiled hands.
Fry in oil over medium heat 5 minutes, until golden.

cl-lomo-a-lo-pobre.title: Chilean steak with fries, onion and egg (lomo a lo pobre)
cl-lomo-a-lo-pobre.summary: Steak with french fries, onion and a fried egg.
cl-lomo-a-lo-pobre.tip: If you want less oil, bake the potatoes.
steps: Cut the potatoes into sticks and fry in oil until golden; drain and salt them.
Slice the onion into rings and brown them in the same pan.
Cook the steaks on a griddle with salt 3 minutes per side.
Serve each steak over the fries, with the onion and a fried egg.

gen-crema-de-zanahoria.title: Cream of carrot and ginger soup
gen-crema-de-zanahoria.summary: Smooth, orange and with a little kick.
gen-crema-de-zanahoria.tip: A splash of orange juice at the end adds freshness.
steps: Peel and chop the carrots, potato and onion.
Cook the onion in oil and add the carrots, potato and grated ginger.
Cover with the water, salt and cook 20 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until creamy and serve hot.

gen-pescado-empanado-al-horno.title: Breaded baked fish
gen-pescado-empanado-al-horno.tip: Pat the fish dry before breading so the crumbs stick.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the fillets.
Dip them in beaten egg and then in the breadcrumbs.
Put them in a dish with oil.
Bake 20 minutes, turning halfway, and serve with lemon.

gen-calabacines-gratinados.title: Gratinated zucchini
gen-calabacines-gratinados.summary: Creamy and topped with browned cheese.
gen-calabacines-gratinados.tip: If the zucchini release water, drain them before gratinating.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and slice the zucchini.
Arrange them in a dish with oil, chopped garlic and salt.
Cover with the cream and the grated cheese.
Bake 20 minutes.

gen-ensalada-de-quinoa.title: Quinoa and vegetable salad
gen-ensalada-de-quinoa.tip: Rinse the quinoa well to remove its bitterness.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and boil it in salted water for 15 minutes.
Drain and let it cool.
Dice the tomato and cucumber and grate the carrot.
Mix everything with oil, lemon and salt.

gen-tarta-de-manzana.title: Apple pie
gen-tarta-de-manzana.tip: Poke the top crust so the steam can escape.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and peel and thinly slice the apples.
Mix them with the sugar and cinnamon.
Line a pie dish with one crust, fill with the apples and butter in small pieces and cover with the other crust.
Brush with beaten egg and bake 40 minutes.

gen-muffins-de-banana.title: Banana muffins
gen-muffins-de-banana.tip: The riper the bananas, the sweeter they turn out.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and mash the bananas.
Mix them with the eggs, sugar and oil.
Add the flour with the baking powder and mix just until combined.
Fill muffin cups and bake 25 minutes.

gen-galletas-de-avena-y-pasas.title: Oat and raisin cookies
gen-galletas-de-avena-y-pasas.tip: They're soft when they come out and firm up as they cool.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and beat the butter with the sugar and the egg.
Add the oats, flour, raisins and cinnamon.
Shape into balls and flatten them on a tray.
Bake 12 minutes, until golden.

gen-licuado-de-banana-y-avena.title: Banana and oat smoothie
gen-licuado-de-banana-y-avena.tip: With frozen bananas it comes out creamier.
steps: Peel and slice the bananas.
Put them in the blender with the milk, oats and honey.
Blend for 1 minute.
Serve cold with cinnamon on top.

jp-katsudon.title: Simple katsudon
jp-katsudon.summary: Breaded cutlet over rice with egg.
jp-katsudon.tip: Leave the egg barely set so it stays creamy.
steps: Salt the pork chops, dip them in one beaten egg and in the breadcrumbs and fry in oil until golden.
Cook the sliced onion with the soy sauce, sugar and half a glass of water for 5 minutes.
Add the cutlet cut into strips and the other 2 beaten eggs and cover 1 minute.
Serve over the rice.

in-pollo-tandoori-al-horno.title: Oven tandoori chicken
in-pollo-tandoori-al-horno.tip: The longer it marinates, the more flavor it takes on.
steps: Mix the yogurt with the curry, chopped garlic, grated ginger, lemon and salt.
Coat the chicken with the mixture and let it marinate 30 minutes.
Put it in a dish with the oil.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes, turning halfway.

gen-batatas-rellenas-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Sweet potatoes stuffed with ham and cheese
gen-batatas-rellenas-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Prick them with a fork before baking.
steps: Bake them in their skins at 400°F (200°C) for 35 minutes, until tender.
Halve them and scoop out the flesh, leaving a rim.
Mix the flesh with the ham, the cooked onion and half the cheese and fill the shells.
Top with the rest of the cheese and broil 8 minutes.

gen-fideos-con-albondigas.title: Pasta with meatballs
gen-fideos-con-albondigas.tip: Wet your hands to shape them without sticking.
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, grated onion and salt and shape meatballs.
Brown them in oil.
Add the tomato sauce and cook 20 minutes.
Boil the pasta in salted water and serve with the meatballs.

gen-torta-de-chocolate-sencilla.title: Easy chocolate cake
gen-torta-de-chocolate-sencilla.tip: Sift the cocoa so there are no lumps.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and oil a pan.
Mix the eggs with the sugar, oil and milk.
Add the flour, cocoa and baking powder and mix just until combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 35 minutes.

gen-hummus-casero.title: Homemade hummus
gen-hummus-casero.summary: To spread on bread or veggies.
gen-hummus-casero.tip: If you peel the chickpeas it comes out smoother.
steps: Drain the chickpeas and keep a little of the liquid.
Blend them with the lemon juice, garlic, cumin, oil and salt.
Add liquid until you get a smooth cream.
Serve with a drizzle of oil on top.

es-gambas-al-ajillo.title: Garlic shrimp (gambas al ajillo)
es-gambas-al-ajillo.tip: Don't let the garlic burn: it turns bitter.
steps: Peel the shrimp and salt them.
Heat the oil over low heat with the sliced garlic and the chili for 3 minutes.
Turn up the heat, add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Finish with chopped parsley and serve right away.

es-arroz-con-chorizo-y-pimientos.title: Rice with chorizo and peppers
es-arroz-con-chorizo-y-pimientos.tip: Let it rest covered so the rice finishes hydrating.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and pepper in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced chorizo and the paprika and cook 3 minutes.
Add the rice, the hot water and salt.
Cook covered over low heat 15 minutes and let rest 5.

es-pollo-al-chilindron.title: Chicken chilindrón
es-pollo-al-chilindron.summary: Chicken stewed with peppers and tomato.
es-pollo-al-chilindron.tip: The slower it cooks, the more concentrated the sauce.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in oil in a casserole; remove it.
In the same casserole cook the onion, garlic and sliced peppers for 8 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato and the paprika and cook 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, cover and cook 30 minutes over low heat.

es-ensalada-murciana.title: Murcian salad
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool and peel them.
Cut the tomatoes into cubes and the onion into thin strips.
Mix them in a bowl with the drained tuna and the olives.
Add the eggs in wedges and dress with oil and salt.

mx-papas-a-la-mexicana.title: Mexican-style potatoes
mx-papas-a-la-mexicana.tip: Brown them lightly so they don't fall apart.
steps: Cube the potatoes and boil 8 minutes; drain.
Cook the chopped onion and chili in oil.
Add the chopped tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and salt and cook 5 more minutes.

mx-tacos-al-pastor-de-sarten.title: Skillet tacos al pastor
mx-tacos-al-pastor-de-sarten.tip: Slice the pork thin so it cooks fast.
steps: Marinate the pork with the paprika, the lime juice and salt for 15 minutes.
Brown it in a very hot skillet for 8 minutes.
Add the chopped pineapple and cook 3 minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with chopped onion and cilantro.

mx-nachos-gratinados.title: Loaded nachos
mx-nachos-gratinados.tip: Build layers so every chip gets cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and spread the chips in a dish.
Top with the mashed beans and the grated cheese.
Bake 8 minutes.
Serve with chopped tomato and onion and hot sauce.

mx-chilaquiles-verdes.title: Green chilaquiles
mx-chilaquiles-verdes.tip: Mix right before eating so they keep some texture.
steps: Cut the tortillas into triangles and fry in oil until crisp.
Heat the green salsa in a skillet.
Add the chips and toss 1 minute.
Serve with cheese, cream, onion and fried eggs.

co-chuleta-valluna.title: Colombian breaded pork chop (chuleta valluna)
co-chuleta-valluna.tip: Flatten them between two sheets of plastic wrap so they come out even.
steps: Pound the chops thin and salt them.
Dip them in beaten egg and in the breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon.

co-arepas-de-choclo.title: Corn arepas
co-arepas-de-choclo.tip: The dough should be soft but manageable.
steps: Process the corn into a coarse paste.
Mix it with the cornmeal, the sugar and salt.
Shape discs and stuff them with cheese.
Cook in a skillet with butter 4 minutes per side.

pe-escabeche-de-pollo.title: Peruvian pickled chicken (escabeche de pollo)
pe-escabeche-de-pollo.summary: Chicken in an onion and vinegar sauce.
pe-escabeche-de-pollo.tip: It's better if you make it the day before.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in oil; cook it covered with half a glass of water for 20 minutes.
In another skillet cook the sliced onions with the garlic and the chili.
Add the vinegar and the cumin and cook 5 minutes.
Cover the chicken with the escabeche and let it rest 10 minutes.

cl-cazuela-de-vacuno.title: Chilean beef and vegetable soup (cazuela de vacuno)
cl-cazuela-de-vacuno.summary: Soup-stew with potato, squash and corn.
cl-cazuela-de-vacuno.tip: Skim the broth at the start so it stays clear.
steps: Boil the beef in the water with salt for 20 minutes.
Add the squash and potatoes in chunks.
Add the rice and corn and cook 20 minutes.
Serve with chopped cilantro.

cl-porotos-granados.title: Chilean bean and squash stew (porotos granados)
cl-porotos-granados.tip: Mash the squash a little to thicken.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil.
Add the beans and the water and cook 20 minutes.
Add the cubed squash and the corn and cook 15 minutes.
Salt and serve with chopped basil.

ve-yuca-frita-con-queso.title: Fried cassava with cheese
ve-yuca-frita-con-queso.tip: Dry it well before frying so it doesn't splatter.
steps: Peel the cassava, remove the hard core and cut into sticks.
Boil 15 minutes until almost tender and drain.
Fry in hot oil until golden and salt.
Serve with the cheese in cubes.

cu-pollo-asado-con-mojo.title: Cuban roast chicken with mojo
cu-pollo-asado-con-mojo.summary: Marinated in orange, lemon and garlic.
cu-pollo-asado-con-mojo.side: Moros y cristianos (rice and black beans)
cu-pollo-asado-con-mojo.tip: Baste the chicken with its juices so it turns out glossy.
steps: Mix the orange and lemon juice with the crushed garlic, cumin, oregano and salt.
Cover the chicken with the mojo and marinate 20 minutes.
Put it in a dish with the oil.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 35 minutes, basting with the juices.

ec-bolon-de-verde.title: Green plantain balls (bolón de verde)
ec-bolon-de-verde.summary: Green plantain balls stuffed with cheese.
ec-bolon-de-verde.tip: Mash them while hot: cold, they harden.
steps: Peel the plantains and boil the chunks 15 minutes, until tender.
Mash them with salt and the butter into a dough.
Shape balls stuffed with cheese.
Brown in oil 3 minutes per side.

bo-majadito-de-carne.title: Bolivian beef majadito
bo-majadito-de-carne.summary: Rice with beef, egg and fried banana.
bo-majadito-de-carne.tip: The rice should come out loose.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and the beef with salt for 8 minutes.
Add the rice and the water and cook covered 15 minutes.
Fry the eggs and the sliced banana.
Serve the rice with the eggs and banana on top.

py-kiveve-de-zapallo.title: Paraguayan squash kivevé
py-kiveve-de-zapallo.tip: Stir constantly so it doesn't stick.
steps: Boil the cubed squash 15 minutes and mash it.
Add the milk and salt and cook over low heat.
Thicken with the cornmeal, stirring 5 minutes.
Add the cubed cheese and serve hot.

do-pica-pollo.title: Dominican fried chicken (pica pollo)
do-pica-pollo.tip: Medium heat: that way it cooks through without burning.
steps: Marinate the chicken with the crushed garlic, the lime juice, the oregano and salt for 15 minutes.
Coat it in flour.
Fry in hot oil 15 minutes, turning.
Drain and serve with lime.

jp-pollo-teriyaki.title: Chicken teriyaki
jp-pollo-teriyaki.tip: Cook it over medium heat so the sugar doesn't burn.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, water, and the grated garlic and ginger.
Brown the chicken in oil 5 minutes per side.
Pour in the sauce and cook 5 minutes until it thickens and coats the chicken.
Slice the chicken and serve with the sauce.

jp-okonomiyaki.title: Okonomiyaki
jp-okonomiyaki.tip: Press it with the spatula when you flip it.
steps: Mix the flour with the water and the eggs into a smooth batter.
Add the finely chopped cabbage.
Cook portions in a skillet with oil, with the bacon on top, 5 minutes per side.
Serve with mayonnaise and soy sauce.

jp-gyudon.title: Gyudon (beef and onion rice bowl)
steps: Cook the sliced onion with the water, soy sauce and sugar for 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and the thinly sliced beef.
Cook 5 minutes until the beef is tender.
Serve over hot rice.

in-pollo-a-la-mantequilla.title: Butter chicken
in-pollo-a-la-mantequilla.summary: Chicken in a creamy tomato and spice sauce.
in-pollo-a-la-mantequilla.tip: The smoother the sauce, the creamier it gets.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and garlic in the butter.
Add the curry and the chopped tomato and cook 10 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth and return it to the pot with the chicken.
Cook 15 minutes and finish with the cream and salt.

in-pulao-de-verduras.title: Vegetable pulao
in-pulao-de-verduras.summary: Spiced rice with carrot and peas.
in-pulao-de-verduras.tip: Don't lift the lid while it cooks.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil and add the curry.
Add the diced carrot, the peas and the rice and stir 1 minute.
Cover with the water and salt.
Cook covered over low heat 15 minutes.

gr-tomates-rellenos-a-la-griega.title: Greek stuffed tomatoes (yemista)
gr-tomates-rellenos-a-la-griega.tip: Don't fill them completely because the rice swells.
steps: Cut the tops off the tomatoes, scoop out the pulp and chop it.
Mix the pulp with the raw rice, grated onion, parsley, oil and salt.
Fill the tomatoes three quarters full and put the tops back.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 45 minutes with a splash of water in the dish.

gr-papas-griegas-al-limon.title: Greek lemon potatoes
gr-papas-griegas-al-limon.tip: They turn out creamy inside and golden outside.
steps: Cut the potatoes into large wedges.
Put them in a dish with the lemon juice, garlic, oregano, oil, water and salt.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 45 minutes, turning halfway.
Take them out when the liquid has reduced.

ar-tortitas-de-choclo.title: Corn fritters
ar-tortitas-de-choclo.tip: Drain the corn well so the fritters brown.
steps: Mix the drained corn with the egg, flour, cubed cheese and salt.
Let the mixture rest 5 minutes.
Cook spoonfuls of the mix in hot oil.
Brown 3 minutes per side.

ar-bizcochuelo-de-naranja.title: Orange sponge cake
ar-bizcochuelo-de-naranja.tip: Don't open the oven during the first 25 minutes.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and butter a pan.
Beat the eggs with the sugar until thick and add the oil, zest and juice of the orange.
Fold in the flour with the baking powder.
Pour into the pan and bake 35 minutes.

ar-empanadas-de-humita.title: Corn empanadas (humita)
ar-empanadas-de-humita.summary: Filled with corn and cheese, baked.
ar-empanadas-de-humita.tip: Make sure the filling is cold before assembling.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil and add the corn.
Thicken with the flour and milk for 5 minutes and add the cubed cheese and salt.
Let cool, fill the wrappers and seal with a crimped edge.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes, until golden.

gen-cerdo-agridulce.title: Sweet and sour pork
gen-cerdo-agridulce.tip: Stir-fry over high heat so the vegetables stay crisp.
steps: Coat the cubed pork in the cornstarch and brown in oil 6 minutes.
Add the pepper and onion in chunks and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar and vinegar with a splash of water and pour in.
Cook 5 minutes until thick and glossy.

gen-pollo-a-la-naranja.title: Orange chicken
gen-pollo-a-la-naranja.tip: If the sauce is runny, turn up the heat at the end.
steps: Salt the chicken and brown it in oil.
Add the grated garlic and ginger.
Pour in the orange juice and the honey.
Cook covered 20 minutes and uncover the last 5 so it reduces.

gen-pad-thai-sencillo.title: Simple pad thai
gen-pad-thai-sencillo.tip: The noodles shouldn't boil: they soak.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in hot water 8 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry the carrot strips in oil and add the scrambled eggs.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and sugar and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Serve with chopped peanuts and lime.

gen-pasta-primavera.title: Pasta primavera
gen-pasta-primavera.tip: Cut the vegetables the same size so they cook evenly.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the diced carrot and zucchini with the peas in oil for 6 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato and cook 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve with grated cheese.

gen-pan-de-ajo-gratinado.title: Cheesy garlic bread
steps: Mix the soft butter with the chopped garlic and parsley.
Split the bread lengthwise and spread it with the mixture.
Top with the grated cheese.
Broil at 400°F (200°C) for 8 minutes.

gen-licuado-de-frutillas-y-yogur.title: Strawberry yogurt smoothie
gen-licuado-de-frutillas-y-yogur.tip: With frozen strawberries it comes out thicker.
steps: Wash the strawberries and remove the stems.
Put everything in the blender.
Blend for 1 minute.
Taste, sweeten if needed and serve cold.

gen-avena-con-manzana-y-canela.title: Oatmeal with apple and cinnamon
gen-avena-con-manzana-y-canela.tip: Stir often so it doesn't stick.
steps: Heat the milk with the oats over low heat.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Grate the apple and add it with the cinnamon.
Serve with honey on top.

gen-granola-casera.title: Homemade granola
gen-granola-casera.tip: It hardens as it cools: don't touch it until then.
steps: Heat the oven to 320°F (160°C).
Mix the oats with the oil, honey, chopped walnuts and cinnamon.
Spread on a tray and bake 20 minutes, stirring halfway.
Let cool and add the raisins.

gen-champinones-rellenos.title: Stuffed mushrooms
gen-champinones-rellenos.tip: Wipe them with a cloth: if they get wet, they release water.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and remove the stems from the mushrooms.
Chop the stems and mix with the cream cheese, garlic, parsley and salt.
Fill the caps and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Put them in a dish with oil and bake 15 minutes.

gen-lasana-de-verduras.title: Vegetable lasagna
gen-lasana-de-verduras.tip: Grate the vegetables fine so they cook quickly.
steps: Cook the grated onion, zucchini and carrot for 8 minutes and mix with the tomato sauce and salt.
Boil the lasagna sheets as the package says and drain.
Build layers in a dish: vegetable sauce, pasta, cream and cheese, and repeat.
Finish with cheese and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes.

gen-cookies-con-chips-de-chocolate.title: Chocolate chip cookies
gen-cookies-con-chips-de-chocolate.tip: Take them out while the center still looks raw: they finish cooking out of the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and beat the butter with the sugar and the egg.
Add the flour with the baking powder and the chopped chocolate.
Shape balls and place them apart on a tray.
Bake 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.

gen-tostadas-de-ricota-y-miel.title: Toast with ricotta and honey
gen-tostadas-de-ricota-y-miel.tip: If the ricotta is too firm, mix it with a spoonful of milk.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Spread them with the ricotta.
Drizzle with the honey.
Finish with chopped walnuts and cinnamon.

gen-yogur-con-frutas-y-granola.title: Yogurt with fruit and granola
gen-yogur-con-frutas-y-granola.tip: Add the granola last so it stays crunchy.
steps: Put the yogurt in a bowl.
Slice the banana and the strawberries.
Place them on the yogurt.
Add the granola and the honey.

gen-ensalada-de-frutas.title: Fruit salad
gen-ensalada-de-frutas.tip: Sprinkle the banana and apple with juice so they don't brown.
steps: Peel and cube the apple, the banana and one orange.
Cut the strawberries.
Mix everything in a bowl with the juice of the other orange.
Sweeten with sugar and serve cold.

gen-pera-al-horno-con-miel-y-nueces.title: Baked pear with honey and walnuts
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and halve the pears, removing the seeds.
Place them in a dish with a little butter.
Fill the center with the honey and chopped walnuts and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake 25 minutes, until tender.

gen-budin-de-banana.title: Banana bread
gen-budin-de-banana.tip: Poke it with a toothpick: it should come out clean.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and oil a loaf pan.
Mash the bananas and mix with the eggs, sugar and oil.
Add the flour with the baking powder and mix just until combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 40 minutes.

gen-torta-de-ricota.title: Ricotta cake
gen-torta-de-ricota.tip: Let it cool before unmolding: it settles.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and butter a pan.
Mix the ricotta with the eggs, sugar, flour and the lemon zest.
Pour into the pan.
Bake 40 minutes, until firm and golden.

gen-scones-de-queso.title: Cheese scones
gen-scones-de-queso.tip: Don't knead too much: the dough should barely come together.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and mix the flour with the baking powder and salt.
Rub in the cold cubed butter with your fingertips.
Add the cheese and the milk until a dough forms.
Cut portions, place them on a tray and bake 18 minutes.

gen-crepes-de-banana-y-chocolate.title: Banana and chocolate crepes
steps: Whisk the flour, milk and eggs into a smooth batter.
Cook thin crepes in a skillet with butter.
Fill them with sliced banana and chopped chocolate.
Roll them up and warm 1 minute so the chocolate melts.

gen-huevos-poche-con-palta.title: Poached eggs with avocado
gen-huevos-poche-con-palta.tip: Use very fresh eggs: the white stays neater.
steps: Heat water in a pot with the vinegar, without a hard boil.
Make a whirlpool and drop in the eggs one at a time; cook 3 minutes.
Toast the bread and top it with the mashed avocado and salt.
Place the drained eggs on top.

gen-avena-nocturna.title: Overnight oats
gen-avena-nocturna.tip: If it's too thick, add a splash of milk.
steps: Mix the oats with the milk, yogurt and honey in a jar.
Cover and leave in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, stir.
Serve with sliced banana.

gen-licuado-verde-de-banana-y-espinaca.title: Green banana and spinach smoothie
gen-licuado-verde-de-banana-y-espinaca.tip: With frozen banana it comes out thicker.
steps: Wash the spinach leaves.
Put everything in the blender.
Blend 1 minute until smooth.
Serve cold.

gen-bizcochuelo-de-vainilla.title: Vanilla sponge cake
gen-bizcochuelo-de-vainilla.tip: The eggs should be at room temperature.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and butter a pan.
Beat the eggs with the sugar and vanilla until thick and doubled.
Fold in the flour with the baking powder.
Bake 30 minutes without opening the oven.

co-pandebono.title: Pandebono (Colombian cheese bread)
co-pandebono.tip: They're best eaten warm, fresh from the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and mix the cornmeal with the grated cheese and the sugar.
Add the egg and the milk and knead.
Shape small balls.
Bake 18 minutes, until golden.

gen-frutillas-con-crema.title: Strawberries and cream
gen-frutillas-con-crema.tip: Chill the cream and the bowl before whipping.
steps: Wash the strawberries and remove the stems.
Whip the cream with the sugar until thick.
Halve the strawberries.
Serve with the cream on top.

gen-ensalada-de-remolacha-y-huevo.title: Beet and egg salad
gen-ensalada-de-remolacha-y-huevo.tip: Wear gloves to peel them: they stain.
steps: Boil the beets 25 minutes, peel and cube them.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes and cut into wedges.
Mix the beets with the onion in thin strips.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt and add the eggs.

gen-hummus-de-remolacha.title: Beet hummus
gen-hummus-de-remolacha.tip: Use plain cooked beets, not pickled.
steps: Drain the chickpeas and chop the beet.
Blend everything with the lemon juice, garlic and oil.
Salt and add a splash of water if needed.
Serve with a drizzle of oil.

ar-empanadas-de-atun.title: Tuna empanadas
ar-empanadas-de-atun.tip: Drain the tuna well so the filling doesn't wet the dough.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil.
Mix it with the drained tuna, chopped olives and salt.
Fill the wrappers, seal with a crimped edge and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes, until golden.

gen-medallones-de-atun-y-papa.title: Tuna and potato patties
gen-medallones-de-atun-y-papa.tip: Let the mash cool so they don't fall apart.
steps: Boil the potatoes, mash them and mix with the drained tuna, parsley and salt.
Shape patties and coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a skillet.
Brown 3 minutes per side.

gen-croquetas-de-atun.title: Tuna croquettes
gen-croquetas-de-atun.tip: The colder the dough, the easier to shape.
steps: Melt the butter, add the flour and cook 2 minutes.
Add the milk little by little until you get a thick dough and mix in the drained tuna.
Chill 2 hours, shape croquettes and coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

ar-noquis-de-ricota.title: Ricotta gnocchi
ar-noquis-de-ricota.tip: Handle the dough as little as possible: otherwise they turn tough.
steps: Mix the ricotta with the egg, grated cheese and salt.
Add the flour little by little until you get a soft dough.
Roll into ropes, cut the gnocchi and boil in salted water until they float.
Serve with hot tomato sauce.

in-bhindi-masala.title: Bhindi masala (okra with tomato)
in-bhindi-masala.tip: Dry it well: that way it doesn't turn slimy.
steps: Wash the okra, dry it very well and slice it.
Cook the chopped onion in oil and add the curry.
Add the chopped tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the okra and salt and cook 10 minutes over medium heat.

gen-tarta-de-brocoli-y-queso.title: Broccoli and cheese tart
gen-tarta-de-brocoli-y-queso.tip: Drain the broccoli well so it doesn't wet the tart.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and boil the broccoli florets 4 minutes; drain.
Line a pie dish with the crust.
Mix the broccoli with the cubed cheese, eggs, cream and salt.
Pour in and bake 30 minutes.

gen-coliflor-rebozada.title: Breaded cauliflower
steps: Cut the cauliflower into florets and boil 5 minutes; drain and dry.
Coat them in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil.
Fry until golden.

gen-pasta-con-salmon-y-crema.title: Salmon pasta with cream
gen-pasta-con-salmon-y-crema.tip: Don't overcook the salmon: it dries out.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Cook the cubed salmon in oil 3 minutes.
Add the cream, the lemon and salt and cook 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve.

gen-ensalada-de-cuscus-y-garbanzos.title: Couscous and chickpea salad
gen-ensalada-de-cuscus-y-garbanzos.tip: Let it rest in the fridge 15 minutes: it gets tastier.
steps: Hydrate the couscous with 1 cup of hot water for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Drain the chickpeas and dice the tomato and cucumber.
Mix everything.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt.

gen-ravioles-con-crema-y-nueces.title: Ravioli with cream and walnuts
gen-ravioles-con-crema-y-nueces.tip: Cook them over gentle heat so they don't open.
steps: Boil the ravioli in salted water as the package says.
Warm the cream with the chopped walnuts 3 minutes.
Drain the ravioli and toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated cheese.

gen-ensalada-de-chauchas-y-papas.title: Green bean and potato salad
gen-ensalada-de-chauchas-y-papas.tip: Chill the beans in cold water to keep their color.
steps: Boil the cubed potatoes 12 minutes and the green beans 6; drain.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes and cut them.
Mix everything in a bowl.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.

gen-sopa-de-apio-y-papa.title: Celery and potato soup
gen-sopa-de-apio-y-papa.tip: Remove the celery strings with a peeler.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and celery in oil.
Add the cubed potato, the water and salt and cook 20 minutes.
Blend until creamy.
Serve hot.

gen-repollo-salteado-con-panceta.title: Sautéed cabbage with bacon
gen-repollo-salteado-con-panceta.tip: The bacon is already salty: taste before adding salt.
steps: Cut the cabbage into thin strips.
Brown the diced bacon in a large skillet.
Add the onion and the cabbage.
Sauté 10 minutes over high heat and salt carefully.

gen-pasta-con-ricota-y-limon.title: Pasta with ricotta and lemon
gen-pasta-con-ricota-y-limon.tip: The cooking water makes the ricotta creamy.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Mix the ricotta with the zest and juice of the lemon.
Drain the pasta, keeping a little of the water.
Toss with the ricotta and the water and serve with cheese and pepper.

gen-wrap-de-huevo-y-palta.title: Egg and avocado wrap
gen-wrap-de-huevo-y-palta.tip: Wrap it in parchment to eat it by hand.
steps: Scramble the eggs in a skillet with oil and salt.
Warm the tortilla.
Mash the avocado and spread it.
Add the eggs, roll up and cut in half.

gen-arroz-con-huevo-y-soja.title: Egg and soy sauce rice
gen-arroz-con-huevo-y-soja.summary: A classic when you're in a hurry.
steps: Warm the rice in a skillet with a little oil.
Fry an egg separately.
Season the rice with the soy sauce.
Serve with the egg and the chopped scallion.

gen-palta-rellena-con-atun.title: Tuna-stuffed avocado
gen-palta-rellena-con-atun.tip: Sprinkle the avocado with lemon so it doesn't brown.
steps: Halve the avocados and remove the pits.
Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise and lemon.
Fill the avocados.
Salt and serve right away.

gen-bruschettas-de-ricota-y-tomate.title: Ricotta and tomato bruschetta
gen-bruschettas-de-ricota-y-tomate.tip: Serve right away so the bread stays crisp.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Spread them with the ricotta.
Top with diced tomato and basil.
Dress with oil and salt.

gen-sandwich-de-jamon-crudo-y-rucula.title: Cured ham and arugula sandwich
gen-sandwich-de-jamon-crudo-y-rucula.tip: Let the cheese soften on the hot bread.
steps: Toast the bread.
Add the cheese and the cured ham.
Add the arugula and the sliced tomato.
Close the sandwich and cut in half.

py-payagua-mascada.title: Payagua mascada (Paraguayan beef and cassava)
py-payagua-mascada.tip: Peel the cassava and remove its hard core.
steps: Cube the beef and brown it in oil with salt.
Add the onion rings and cook 5 minutes.
Add the cassava in chunks and water to cover.
Cook covered 30 minutes, until everything is tender.

bo-sopa-de-fideo-con-carne.title: Bolivian noodle soup with beef
bo-sopa-de-fideo-con-carne.tip: Skim the broth at the start.
steps: Boil the beef in the water with salt for 25 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes and carrot.
Add the noodles and cook 8 minutes.
Serve hot.

gen-galletitas-de-queso.title: Cheese crackers
gen-galletitas-de-queso.tip: Take them out when the edges are golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and mix the flour with the cheese and salt.
Add the soft butter and knead.
Roll out the dough and cut crackers.
Bake 12 minutes, until golden.

gen-panqueques-de-ricota-y-frutillas.title: Ricotta and strawberry crepes
steps: Whisk the flour, milk and eggs and cook thin crepes.
Mix the ricotta with the sugar.
Fill the crepes with the ricotta and the chopped strawberries.
Roll up and serve.

gen-crema-de-brocoli.title: Cream of broccoli soup
gen-crema-de-brocoli.tip: Don't overcook it so it keeps its color.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in oil.
Add the potato and the broccoli in chunks, the water and salt.
Cook 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until creamy.

gen-costillitas-de-cerdo-con-miel-y-most.title: Pork ribs with honey and mustard
gen-costillitas-de-cerdo-con-miel-y-most.tip: Covering them with foil for the first 20 minutes makes them more tender.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the ribs.
Mix the honey with the mustard and the chopped garlic.
Brush them with the mixture and set them in a dish.
Bake 45 minutes, turning and brushing halfway.

gen-chuletas-de-cerdo-a-la-mostaza.title: Pork chops with mustard
gen-chuletas-de-cerdo-a-la-mostaza.tip: Don't overcook them: pork dries out.
steps: Salt the chops and brown in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
In the same skillet cook the chopped onion.
Add the mustard and the cream and cook 3 minutes.
Return the chops to the sauce for 2 minutes.

gen-cerdo-con-manzana.title: Pork with apple
gen-cerdo-con-manzana.tip: Use tart apples: they contrast better with the meat.
steps: Salt the pork and brown in oil in a skillet; remove.
Cook the onion and add the apple in wedges.
Add the mustard and a splash of water.
Return the pork and cook covered 15 minutes.

gen-medallones-de-cerdo-con-champinones.title: Pork medallions with mushrooms
gen-medallones-de-cerdo-con-champinones.tip: Let them rest 3 minutes before serving.
steps: Cut the loin into thick medallions and salt them.
Brown them in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté the sliced mushrooms with the garlic and add the cream.
Pour the sauce over the medallions.

gen-milanesas-de-pavo-al-horno.title: Oven-baked turkey cutlets
gen-milanesas-de-pavo-al-horno.tip: Pound them thin so they cook evenly.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and salt the turkey slices.
Dip them in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Set them on a tray with oil.
Bake 25 minutes, turning halfway, and serve with lemon.

gen-chuletas-de-cordero-a-la-plancha.title: Grilled lamb chops
gen-chuletas-de-cordero-a-la-plancha.tip: Take them out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking.
steps: Season the chops with salt and pepper and rub with the garlic and rosemary.
Heat a griddle or skillet with oil.
Cook 3 minutes per side over high heat.
Let rest 3 minutes and serve.

gen-estofado-de-cordero-con-papas.title: Lamb stew with potatoes
gen-estofado-de-cordero-con-papas.tip: With shoulder or neck it comes out juicier.
steps: Salt the lamb and brown it in oil in a pot.
Add the chopped onion and the sliced carrot.
Cover with the water and cook covered 30 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes and cook 20 more minutes.

gen-brochetas-de-cerdo-y-morron.title: Pork and bell pepper skewers
gen-brochetas-de-cerdo-y-morron.tip: If you use wooden skewers, soak them first.
steps: Marinate the pork with the soy sauce and the oil for 15 minutes.
Cut the pepper and the onion into chunks.
Assemble the skewers alternating meat and vegetables.
Cook on a hot griddle 12 minutes, turning.

gen-panna-cotta-de-frutilla.title: Strawberry panna cotta
gen-panna-cotta-de-frutilla.tip: It goes in the fridge warm, not hot.
steps: Hydrate the gelatin in 3 tablespoons of cold water.
Heat the cream with the sugar and vanilla without boiling.
Dissolve the gelatin in the hot cream and divide among glasses.
Chill 4 hours and serve with chopped strawberries.

gen-tarta-de-limon.title: Lemon tart
gen-tarta-de-limon.tip: Chill it 3 hours so it sets.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C), line a pie dish with the crust and bake it 12 minutes.
Mix the condensed milk with the yolks and the juice and zest of the lemons.
Pour over the base.
Bake 15 minutes and chill well before cutting.

gen-cheesecake-sin-horno.title: No-bake cheesecake
gen-cheesecake-sin-horno.tip: Use a springform pan to remove it easily.
steps: Crush the cookies and mix with the melted butter; press into a pan.
Beat the cream cheese with the sugar.
Whip the cream and fold it in.
Pour over the base, chill 4 hours and top with strawberries.

gen-tiramisu-rapido.title: Quick tiramisu
gen-tiramisu-rapido.tip: Dip the ladyfingers quickly: if they soak, they fall apart.
steps: Beat the mascarpone with the cream and the sugar until thick.
Dip the ladyfingers in the cold coffee.
Layer ladyfingers and cream in a dish.
Dust with cocoa and chill 4 hours.

gen-helado-de-banana-y-frutilla.title: Banana and strawberry ice cream
gen-helado-de-banana-y-frutilla.summary: Just fruit, no ice cream maker.
gen-helado-de-banana-y-frutilla.tip: Process in short bursts and scrape the sides.
steps: Slice the bananas and freeze for 4 hours.
Process them with the frozen strawberries.
Add the honey if you want it sweeter.
Serve right away.

gen-churros-caseros.title: Homemade churros
gen-churros-caseros.tip: Prick them with a toothpick before frying so they don't burst.
steps: Boil the water with the salt and 1 tablespoon of sugar and add the flour all at once, stirring until it pulls away.
Transfer the dough to a piping bag with a star tip.
Fry strips of dough in hot oil until golden.
Roll them in sugar with cinnamon.

gen-panqueques-con-manzana-caramelizada.title: Crepes with caramelized apple
gen-panqueques-con-manzana-caramelizada.tip: Let the sugar brown without stirring too much.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk and eggs and cook thin crepes.
Cube the apples and cook them in the butter with the sugar until caramelized.
Fill the crepes with the apple.
Fold and serve warm.

gen-crumble-de-manzana.title: Apple crumble
gen-crumble-de-manzana.tip: Use very cold butter so it forms crumbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and cube the apples; put them in a dish with cinnamon.
Mix the oats, flour, sugar and the cold cubed butter into crumbs.
Cover the apples with the crumbs.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden.

gen-champinones-al-ajillo.title: Garlic mushrooms
gen-champinones-al-ajillo.tip: Don't wash them: they absorb water.
steps: Wipe the mushrooms with a cloth and halve them.
Heat the oil with the sliced garlic.
Add the mushrooms and sauté 8 minutes over high heat.
Salt, add the parsley and serve.

gen-tarta-de-champinones-y-queso.title: Mushroom and cheese tart
gen-tarta-de-champinones-y-queso.tip: Cook the mushrooms until they release all their water.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C), line a pie dish with the crust and sauté the sliced mushrooms until dry.
Mix the eggs with the cream, the cubed cheese and salt.
Add the mushrooms.
Pour into the tart and bake 30 minutes.

gen-pizza-con-masa-de-yogur.title: Yogurt dough pizza
gen-pizza-con-masa-de-yogur.tip: Roll it thin so it comes out crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 430°F (220°C) and mix the flour with the baking powder, the salt and the yogurt into a dough.
Stretch it in an oiled pizza pan.
Top with the sauce and bake 10 minutes.
Add the mozzarella and bake 10 more minutes.

gen-calzone-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Ham and cheese calzone
gen-calzone-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Seal the edges well so the cheese doesn't leak.
steps: Mix the flour with the yeast, the salt and the water, knead 8 minutes and let rise 30 minutes.
Roll the dough into two discs and fill half with ham, mozzarella and sauce.
Fold over, seal the edges and prick the surface.
Bake at 430°F (220°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-tarta-de-verduras-asadas.title: Roasted vegetable tart
gen-tarta-de-verduras-asadas.summary: With zucchini, bell pepper and onion.
gen-tarta-de-verduras-asadas.tip: Roasting the vegetables first keeps the tart from turning soggy.
steps: Cut the vegetables into strips and roast in oil at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.
Line a pie dish with the crust.
Mix the vegetables with the eggs and the cubed cheese.
Pour in and bake 25 minutes.

gen-provoleta-con-tomates-asados.title: Provoleta with roasted tomatoes
gen-provoleta-con-tomates-asados.tip: Flip it carefully: it breaks if you move it before it browns.
steps: Cut the tomatoes into thick slices and roast 5 minutes in a skillet.
Heat a skillet or dish and set the provoleta in it.
Cook until browned underneath and melted.
Serve with the tomatoes, oregano and olive oil.

gen-capeletis-con-salsa-de-tomate-y-ques.title: Cappelletti with tomato sauce and cheese
gen-capeletis-con-salsa-de-tomate-y-ques.tip: Cook them over gentle heat so they don't open.
steps: Boil the cappelletti in salted water as the package says.
Heat the tomato sauce.
Drain the cappelletti and toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated cheese and basil.

gen-cuscus-con-pollo-y-verduras.title: Couscous with chicken and vegetables
gen-cuscus-con-pollo-y-verduras.tip: Fluff the couscous with a fork so it doesn't clump.
steps: Cube the chicken and vegetables and sauté in oil 10 minutes with salt.
Hydrate the couscous with 1 cup of hot water for 5 minutes and fluff it.
Mix the couscous with the chicken and vegetables.
Serve hot.

gen-tostadas-de-atun-y-tomate.title: Tuna and tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise and lemon.
Slice the tomato.
Top the toast with the tomato and the tuna mixture.

gen-ketchup-casero.title: Homemade ketchup
gen-ketchup-casero.tip: It keeps a week in the fridge.
steps: Chop the tomatoes and the onion and cook 20 minutes over low heat.
Blend and strain.
Return to the pot with the sugar, the vinegar and the salt.
Cook 15 minutes until thick and let cool.

gen-caldo-de-verduras-casero.title: Homemade vegetable broth
gen-caldo-de-verduras-casero.summary: The base for soups and rice.
gen-caldo-de-verduras-casero.tip: Store it in portions to use when needed.
steps: Wash the vegetables and cut into large pieces.
Put them in a pot with the water and salt.
Cook over low heat 35 minutes.
Strain the broth and use or freeze it.

gen-sopa-de-pollo-y-arroz.title: Chicken and rice soup
gen-sopa-de-pollo-y-arroz.tip: Skim the broth at the start so it stays clear.
steps: Boil the chicken in the water with salt and the onion for 25 minutes; remove and shred.
Add the cubed carrot and the rice and cook 15 minutes.
Return the shredded chicken.
Serve hot.

gen-sopa-de-lentejas-y-espinaca.title: Lentil and spinach soup
gen-sopa-de-lentejas-y-espinaca.tip: Salt at the end: salt toughens lentils.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and garlic in oil.
Add the lentils and the water and cook 25 minutes.
Add the chopped spinach and cook 5 minutes.
Salt and serve.

gen-ensalada-de-rucula-queso-y-nueces.title: Arugula, cheese and walnut salad
steps: Wash and dry the arugula.
Put it in a bowl with the shaved cheese and the walnuts.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.
Toss and serve right away.

gen-ensalada-de-zapallo-asado-y-rucula.title: Roasted squash and arugula salad
gen-ensalada-de-zapallo-asado-y-rucula.tip: Leave the squash skin on: it softens when roasted.
steps: Cube the squash, put it in a dish with oil and salt and roast at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes.
Let it cool slightly.
Mix it with the arugula, the cubed cheese and the walnuts.
Dress with oil and serve.

gen-ensalada-de-repollo-y-zanahoria.title: Cabbage and carrot salad (coleslaw)
gen-ensalada-de-repollo-y-zanahoria.tip: With yogurt instead of mayonnaise it's lighter.
steps: Cut the cabbage into very thin strips.
Grate the carrots.
Mix them with the mayonnaise, the lemon and salt.
Let it rest 10 minutes in the fridge.

gen-ensalada-de-porotos-y-atun.title: Bean and tuna salad
gen-ensalada-de-porotos-y-atun.tip: Rinse the beans to remove the can liquid.
steps: Drain and rinse the beans.
Mix them with the drained tuna, the onion in thin strips and the diced tomato.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.
Let rest 10 minutes and serve.

cu-frijoles-negros.title: Cuban black beans
cu-frijoles-negros.summary: With an onion and pepper sofrito.
cu-frijoles-negros.tip: A splash of vinegar at the end wakes them up.
steps: Cook the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the beans with their liquid and the cumin.
Cook over low heat 30 minutes.
Mash a few to thicken and salt.

cu-masitas-de-cerdo-fritas.title: Cuban fried pork bites (masitas de cerdo)
cu-masitas-de-cerdo-fritas.tip: First cooked in its juices and then fried: that keeps it tender.
steps: Marinate the pork with the lemon juice, the crushed garlic and salt for 15 minutes.
Cook it in a pot with a little water 15 minutes, until it evaporates.
Add the oil and fry the cubes until golden.
Drain and serve with lemon.

do-yaniqueques.title: Yaniqueques (Dominican fried bread)
do-yaniqueques.tip: Prick them with a fork so they don't puff too much.
steps: Mix the flour with the baking powder, the sugar and the salt.
Add the water and knead into a soft dough.
Roll it thin and cut discs.
Fry in hot oil until they puff and turn golden.

es-ensalada-de-pimientos-asados.title: Roasted pepper salad
es-ensalada-de-pimientos-asados.tip: Keep the juices they release: they add lots of flavor.
steps: Roast the whole peppers at 430°F (220°C) for 25 minutes, turning.
Cover them 10 minutes so they loosen and peel them.
Cut into strips.
Dress with the chopped garlic, olive oil, vinegar and salt.

gen-pollo-al-horno-con-batatas-y-romero.title: Roast chicken with sweet potatoes and rosemary
gen-pollo-al-horno-con-batatas-y-romero.tip: Keep the chicken skin side up so it browns.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cut the sweet potatoes into wedges.
Put the chicken and the sweet potatoes in a dish with oil, garlic, rosemary and salt.
Toss well.
Bake 45 minutes, turning halfway.

gen-albondigas-de-pollo-con-arroz.title: Chicken meatballs with rice
gen-albondigas-de-pollo-con-arroz.tip: Wet your hands to shape them.
steps: Mix the chicken with the egg, the breadcrumbs, the grated onion and salt; shape meatballs.
Brown them in oil.
Boil the rice in salted water.
Serve the meatballs over the rice.

gen-merluza-con-tomate-y-aceitunas.title: Hake with tomato and olives
gen-merluza-con-tomate-y-aceitunas.tip: Don't overcook it: it falls apart.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and put the sliced onion and tomato in a dish with oil.
Set the salted fillets on top.
Cover with the olives.
Bake 18 minutes.

gen-panceta-a-la-plancha-con-huevo.title: Griddled bacon with egg and toast
gen-panceta-a-la-plancha-con-huevo.tip: No oil needed: the bacon renders its own fat.
steps: Heat a griddle or non-stick skillet with no oil.
Lay the bacon slices down and cook 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Move them to paper towels and fry the eggs in the fat they released.
Toast the bread and serve everything together.

gen-tostado-de-panceta-y-queso.title: Bacon and cheese toastie
gen-tostado-de-panceta-y-queso.tip: Brown the bread with a little butter so it turns out crispier.
steps: Fry the bacon slices in a skillet until crisp.
Build the sandwiches with cheese and bacon between two slices of bread.
Spread butter on the outside of the bread.
Toast them in the skillet 2 minutes per side, pressing down, until the cheese melts.

gen-ensalada-con-panceta-crocante.title: Salad with crispy bacon and egg
gen-ensalada-con-panceta-crocante.tip: The bacon is already salty: taste before dressing.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool and peel them.
Fry the diced bacon with no oil until crisp.
Build the salad with the lettuce, tomato wedges and the sliced eggs.
Add the bacon and dress with oil and lemon juice.

gen-papas-al-horno-con-panceta-y-queso.title: Baked potatoes with bacon and cheese
gen-papas-al-horno-con-panceta-y-queso.tip: Prick the potatoes before baking: they cook more evenly.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and cut the potatoes into thick slices.
Toss them with the oil and salt and bake 30 minutes.
Add the diced bacon and the cheese on top.
Bake 15 minutes more, until the cheese browns, and sprinkle with chopped scallion.

gen-spaghetti-a-la-carbonara.title: Spaghetti carbonara
gen-spaghetti-a-la-carbonara.tip: Mix off the heat: otherwise the eggs scramble.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in plenty of salted water.
Fry the diced bacon in a skillet with no oil.
Beat the eggs with the grated cheese and plenty of pepper.
Drain the pasta, saving a cup of the water, toss it with the bacon off the heat and add the eggs, stirring fast, with a splash of cooking water.

gen-revuelto-de-huevos-con-panceta.title: Scrambled eggs with bacon
gen-revuelto-de-huevos-con-panceta.tip: Take the eggs off the heat while still moist: they finish setting on their own.
steps: Dice the bacon and fry it in a skillet with no oil.
Add the chopped scallion and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir over low heat.
Remove them when barely set and serve right away.

gen-colita-de-cuadril-rellena.title: Stuffed beef rump tail
gen-colita-de-cuadril-rellena.summary: Filled with spinach, ham and cheese.
gen-colita-de-cuadril-rellena.tip: Tie it well with kitchen string so it doesn't open while baking.
steps: Open the beef rump tail like a book, without cutting all the way through, and salt it.
Cover with the ham, the cooked and drained spinach and the cheese, and roll it up.
Tie with string, brown on all sides in a pot with oil and put it in a 350°F (180°C) oven.
Cook 1 hour, rest 10 minutes and cut into slices.

gen-colita-de-cuadril-al-horno-con-papas.title: Roasted beef rump tail with potatoes
gen-colita-de-cuadril-al-horno-con-papas.tip: Rest it covered with foil before slicing: it stays juicier.
steps: Salt the beef rump tail and brown it on all sides in a very hot skillet.
Put the potatoes and the onion in quarters in a dish with oil and salt.
Set the meat on top and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour.
Take it out, rest 10 minutes and cut into thin slices.

gen-colita-de-cuadril-a-la-cacerola.title: Pot-braised beef rump tail
gen-colita-de-cuadril-a-la-cacerola.summary: With wine and vegetables, very tender.
gen-colita-de-cuadril-a-la-cacerola.tip: Cook it low and covered: patience makes it tender.
steps: Brown the salted beef rump tail in a pot with oil and remove it.
In the same pot, sauté the chopped onion, carrot and garlic.
Return the meat, add the wine and water to cover half of it.
Cover and cook over low heat 1 hour 30 minutes, turning now and then.

gen-peceto-relleno-con-verduras.title: Stuffed beef eye round with vegetables
gen-peceto-relleno-con-verduras.summary: With carrot, bell pepper and hard-boiled egg.
gen-peceto-relleno-con-verduras.tip: Serve it sliced, warm or cold.
steps: Open the eye round into one long strip and salt it.
Top with grated carrot, bell pepper strips and chopped hard-boiled egg.
Roll it up, tie it with string and brown it in a pot with oil.
Add a glass of water, cover and cook 1 hour over low heat.

gen-vitel-tone.title: Vitello tonnato
gen-vitel-tone.tip: It's made the day before and tastes even better.
steps: Boil the eye round 1 hour with onion, carrot and salt; let it cool in the broth.
Blend the tuna with the mayonnaise, lemon and a few capers into a cream.
Cut the meat into thin slices.
Cover with the sauce and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

gen-nalga-a-la-mostaza-con-papas.title: Beef round with mustard and potatoes
gen-nalga-a-la-mostaza-con-papas.tip: Let the beef marinate in the mustard 30 minutes before baking.
steps: Rub the beef with the mustard, chopped garlic, salt and pepper.
Put the diced potatoes in a dish with oil.
Set the meat on top and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 50 minutes.
Slice it and serve with the potatoes.

gen-osobuco-braseado-con-verduras.title: Braised osso buco with vegetables
gen-osobuco-braseado-con-verduras.tip: The slower it cooks, the more it falls off the bone.
steps: Dredge the osso buco in flour and brown it in a pot with oil.
Add the chopped onion, carrot and garlic and sauté 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomato and a glass of water or wine.
Cover and cook over very low heat 2 hours, until the meat falls apart.

gen-entrana-a-la-plancha-con-chimichurri.title: Grilled skirt steak with chimichurri
gen-entrana-a-la-plancha-con-chimichurri.tip: Cook it only a few minutes: overdone, it turns tough.
steps: Mix chopped parsley, garlic, oregano, vinegar, oil and salt for the chimichurri.
Salt the skirt steak and cook it on a very hot griddle 4 minutes per side.
Rest 3 minutes and cut into strips against the grain.
Serve with the chimichurri on top.

gen-tira-de-asado-al-horno-con-papas.title: Oven-roasted short ribs with potatoes
gen-tira-de-asado-al-horno-con-papas.tip: A very hot oven at the end makes it crisp outside.
steps: Salt the short ribs and place them in a dish bone side down.
Cover with foil and bake at 340°F (170°C) for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the potato wedges with oil and salt around the meat.
Uncover, raise the oven to 425°F (220°C) and cook 30 minutes more until everything is golden.

gen-rollo-de-carne-picada-relleno.title: Stuffed meatloaf roll
gen-rollo-de-carne-picada-relleno.summary: With ham and cheese in the center.
gen-rollo-de-carne-picada-relleno.tip: Press the meat firmly when shaping the roll so it doesn't crack.
steps: Mix the ground beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, chopped onion and salt.
Spread it on parchment paper, cover with the ham and cheese and roll up.
Move it to a dish and brush with tomato sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45 minutes.

gen-bondiola-braseada-con-cebolla.title: Braised pork shoulder with onion
gen-bondiola-braseada-con-cebolla.tip: It also makes great sandwiches the next day.
steps: Salt the pork shoulder and brown it on all sides in a pot with oil.
Add the sliced onions and the garlic and sauté a few minutes.
Pour in water or broth to cover a third of the meat.
Cover and cook over low heat 2 hours, turning halfway.

gen-pechugas-rellenas-de-espinaca-y-rico.title: Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta
gen-pechugas-rellenas-de-espinaca-y-rico.tip: Close them with toothpicks so the filling doesn't escape.
steps: Mix the cooked, drained spinach with the ricotta, salt and pepper.
Open the breasts like a book and fill with the mixture.
Close with toothpicks and brown in a skillet with oil.
Finish in a 350°F (180°C) oven for 20 minutes.

gen-muslos-de-pollo-al-limon-y-ajo.title: Lemon garlic chicken thighs
gen-muslos-de-pollo-al-limon-y-ajo.summary: With golden skin and citrus sauce.
gen-muslos-de-pollo-al-limon-y-ajo.tip: Marinating from the night before intensifies the flavor.
steps: Mix the lemon juice with the chopped garlic, oil, oregano and salt.
Coat the thighs with the mixture and leave 20 minutes.
Place them in a dish, skin side up.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 45 minutes, basting with their juices.

gen-lomo-de-cerdo-relleno-con-manzana.title: Pork loin stuffed with apple
gen-lomo-de-cerdo-relleno-con-manzana.tip: Tie it with kitchen string so it keeps its shape.
steps: Open the pork loin like a book and salt it.
Fill it with diced apple and chopped bacon.
Roll it up, tie it and brown it in a pot with oil.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 45 minutes and cut into slices.

gen-pollo-al-verdeo-con-arroz.title: Chicken with scallions
gen-pollo-al-verdeo-con-arroz.tip: Add the scallions at the end to keep their color.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces with oil and salt; remove.
In the same pot, sauté the chopped scallions.
Return the chicken, add the cream and a splash of water.
Cover and cook 25 minutes over low heat.

gen-pescado-al-papillote-con-verduras.title: Fish en papillote with vegetables
gen-pescado-al-papillote-con-verduras.tip: Seal the paper well so the steam can't escape.
steps: Cut the carrot and zucchini into thin slices.
Make parchment packets with the fish, the vegetables, salt and a splash of oil.
Seal them well and set on a baking sheet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-salmon-con-salsa-de-mostaza-y-miel.title: Salmon with honey mustard sauce
gen-salmon-con-salsa-de-mostaza-y-miel.tip: Don't overcook it: it should stay pink inside.
steps: Mix the mustard with the honey.
Salt the salmon and brown 3 minutes per side in a skillet with oil.
Brush with the honey mustard sauce.
Cook 2 minutes more and serve with the remaining sauce.

gen-risotto-de-calabaza.title: Pumpkin risotto
gen-risotto-de-calabaza.tip: Stir often and add the broth little by little.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in butter and add the rice.
Add the diced pumpkin and the hot broth a ladle at a time.
Cook 18 minutes stirring, until the rice is creamy.
Mix in the grated cheese and serve right away.

gen-ravioles-con-salsa-rosa.title: Ravioli with pink sauce
gen-ravioles-con-salsa-rosa.tip: Taste the sauce before salting: the cheese already adds salt.
steps: Boil the ravioli in plenty of salted water.
Heat the tomato sauce in a skillet.
Add the cream and stir 3 minutes.
Drain the ravioli, toss with the sauce and serve.

gen-lasana-de-calabaza-y-espinaca.title: Pumpkin and spinach lasagna
gen-lasana-de-calabaza-y-espinaca.tip: You can assemble it a day ahead.
steps: Cook the pumpkin and the spinach and mix them with the ricotta.
In a dish, alternate layers of sauce, lasagna sheets and the filling.
Finish with sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-noquis-con-salsa-de-carne.title: Gnocchi with meat sauce
gen-noquis-con-salsa-de-carne.tip: Cook the sauce over low heat so it thickens.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic and add the ground beef.
Add the crushed tomato and salt and cook 20 minutes.
Boil the gnocchi until they float.
Drain, toss with the sauce and sprinkle with cheese.

gen-tortilla-de-papas-rellena-de-jamon-y.title: Potato omelet stuffed with ham and cheese
gen-tortilla-de-papas-rellena-de-jamon-y.tip: Flip it using a large, sturdy plate.
steps: Fry the sliced potatoes with the onion until tender.
Mix with the beaten eggs and salt.
Cook half in a skillet, add the ham and cheese and cover with the rest.
Brown both sides until the cheese melts.

gen-tarta-de-calabaza-y-queso.title: Pumpkin and cheese tart
gen-tarta-de-calabaza-y-queso.tip: Cooking the pumpkin first keeps the tart from getting soggy.
steps: Cook the diced pumpkin until tender and mash it.
Mix with the eggs, grated cheese and salt.
Line a tart pan with the dough and pour in the filling.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-ensalada-de-lentejas-con-verduras.title: Lentil salad with vegetables
gen-ensalada-de-lentejas-con-verduras.tip: Dress it while the lentils are still warm: they absorb more flavor.
steps: Boil the lentils until tender and drain them.
Dice the tomato, bell pepper and onion.
Mix everything with the lentils.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt.

gen-tostadas-francesas-con-canela.title: Cinnamon French toast
gen-tostadas-francesas-con-canela.tip: Use day-old bread: it soaks up the mixture without falling apart.
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and cinnamon.
Dip the bread slices in the mixture on both sides.
Brown them in a skillet with butter, 2 minutes per side.
Serve hot with a sprinkle of sugar on top.

gen-muffins-de-manzana-y-canela.title: Apple cinnamon muffins
gen-muffins-de-manzana-y-canela.tip: Don't overmix the batter: they stay lighter.
steps: Mix the flour with the sugar and cinnamon.
Add the eggs, milk and oil and stir just until combined.
Fold in the diced apple and divide among muffin cups.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 25 minutes.

gen-budin-de-manzana.title: Apple loaf cake
gen-budin-de-manzana.tip: Toss the apple in a little flour so it doesn't sink.
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar and the oil.
Add the flour with the baking powder and mix until combined.
Fold in the diced apple and pour into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 45 minutes.

gen-galletitas-de-avena-y-miel.title: Oat and honey cookies
gen-galletitas-de-avena-y-miel.tip: Let them cool on a rack so they turn out crisp.
steps: Mix the soft butter with the honey and the egg.
Add the oats and flour and mix into a dough.
Shape into balls and flatten them on a baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 12 minutes.

gen-calamares-a-la-romana.title: Fried calamari
gen-calamares-a-la-romana.tip: Dry the rings well before battering: it keeps the oil from splattering.
steps: Cut the squid into rings and pat dry with paper towels.
Dredge in flour, then in the egg beaten with salt.
Fry in very hot oil 2 minutes, until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon.

gen-camarones-al-ajillo.title: Garlic shrimp
gen-camarones-al-ajillo.tip: Cook them just 2 minutes: overdone, they turn rubbery.
steps: Heat the oil with the sliced garlic over medium heat.
Add the peeled shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Add a squeeze of lemon and the chopped parsley.
Serve right away, with bread for dipping.

gen-mejillones-a-la-provenzal.title: Mussels provençal
gen-mejillones-a-la-provenzal.tip: Discard any that don't open when cooked.
steps: Wash the mussels and open them by steaming in a covered pot with a little white wine.
Mix the chopped garlic and parsley with the breadcrumbs and oil.
Spoon a little of the mixture onto each mussel.
Broil them 5 minutes and serve hot.

gen-pulpo-con-papas-y-pimenton.title: Octopus with potatoes and paprika
gen-pulpo-con-papas-y-pimenton.tip: Cook it with a whole onion in the water for extra flavor.
steps: Boil the octopus in water with onion for 45 minutes, until tender.
Boil the potatoes in thick slices in the same water.
Slice the octopus and set it over the potatoes.
Dress with oil, paprika and salt.

gen-tostadas-de-sardinas-con-tomate.title: Sardine toasts with tomato
gen-tostadas-de-sardinas-con-tomate.tip: Pick sardines in olive oil: they taste better.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Rub half a tomato over each toast.
Top with the drained sardines.
Finish with a few drops of lemon.

gen-arroz-con-mariscos.title: Seafood rice
gen-arroz-con-mariscos.tip: The seafood broth gives the flavor: don't throw it out.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and bell pepper with garlic.
Add the rice and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the hot broth and add the seafood.
Cook 18 minutes without stirring and let rest 5 minutes.

gen-morcilla-con-pure-de-papas.title: Blood sausage with mashed potatoes
gen-morcilla-con-pure-de-papas.tip: Prick it before cooking so it doesn't burst.
steps: Boil the potatoes, mash them with butter and a little milk, and salt.
Prick the blood sausage and cook it in a skillet over medium heat 10 minutes.
Turn it so it browns on all sides.
Serve it sliced over the mash.

gen-higado-encebollado.title: Liver and onions
gen-higado-encebollado.tip: Cook it briefly: overcooked liver turns tough.
steps: Slice the onions and sauté in oil until soft.
Salt the liver slices and dredge in flour.
Cook 2 minutes per side in another skillet.
Mix with the onions and serve right away.

gen-mondongo-a-la-criolla.title: Creole tripe stew
gen-mondongo-a-la-criolla.tip: Boiling it first with lemon removes the strong smell.
steps: Boil the cut tripe 30 minutes with lemon and drain.
Sauté the onion, bell pepper and garlic and add the crushed tomato.
Add the tripe, the cooked chickpeas and water to cover.
Cover and cook over low heat 1 hour 30 minutes.

gen-chorizo-al-vino-blanco.title: Chorizo in white wine
gen-chorizo-al-vino-blanco.tip: Prick the chorizos before cooking so they release fat.
steps: Brown the pricked chorizos in a skillet with no oil.
Add the sliced onion and the chopped garlic.
Pour in the white wine and add a bay leaf.
Cook 15 minutes over low heat until the sauce reduces.

gen-sandwich-de-mortadela-y-queso.title: Mortadella and cheese sandwich
gen-sandwich-de-mortadela-y-queso.tip: Heat it on the griddle so the cheese melts.
steps: Cut the bread in half and spread a little mayonnaise.
Add the mortadella and cheese slices.
Close it and brown on a griddle 2 minutes per side.
Cut in half and serve hot.

gen-duraznos-al-horno-con-miel.title: Roasted peaches with honey
gen-duraznos-al-horno-con-miel.tip: Pick firm peaches: they stay whole in the oven.
steps: Halve the peaches and remove the pits.
Place them cut side up in a dish.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 25 minutes.

gen-batido-de-durazno-y-yogur.title: Peach and yogurt smoothie
gen-batido-de-durazno-y-yogur.tip: Freeze the peach first for a thicker texture.
steps: Peel the peaches and cut into chunks.
Put them in the blender with the yogurt and milk.
Add the honey and blend 1 minute.
Serve very cold.

gen-pera-al-vino-tinto.title: Pears in red wine
gen-pera-al-vino-tinto.tip: The longer in the wine, the more color the fruit takes.
steps: Peel the pears, leaving the stem.
Bring the wine, sugar and cinnamon to a boil in a pot.
Add the pears and cook 25 minutes over low heat, turning them.
Reduce the syrup and serve the pears drizzled with it.

gen-anana-a-la-plancha-con-canela.title: Grilled pineapple with cinnamon
gen-anana-a-la-plancha-con-canela.tip: Cut even slices so they brown the same.
steps: Peel the pineapple and cut into 1 cm slices.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Sear on a hot griddle 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm.

gen-compota-de-ciruelas.title: Stewed plums
gen-compota-de-ciruelas.summary: Homemade, with a touch of lemon.
gen-compota-de-ciruelas.tip: It keeps several days in the fridge.
steps: Halve the plums and remove the pits.
Put them in a pot with the sugar, lemon peel and a little water.
Cook over low heat 20 minutes, until tender.
Let it cool slightly and serve warm or cold.

gen-higos-con-queso-y-miel.title: Figs with cheese and honey
gen-higos-con-queso-y-miel.tip: Serve at room temperature for more aroma.
steps: Cut the figs in a cross without separating the base.
Fill each with a spoonful of cream cheese.
Drizzle with honey.
Finish with chopped walnuts.

gen-torta-de-nueces-y-miel.title: Walnut and honey cake
gen-torta-de-nueces-y-miel.tip: Toast the walnuts 5 minutes first: it brings out the aroma.
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar until foamy.
Add the honey, oil and the flour with the baking powder.
Fold in the chopped walnuts and pour into a buttered pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-polenta-cremosa-con-hongos.title: Creamy polenta with mushrooms
gen-polenta-cremosa-con-hongos.tip: Always stir in the same direction to avoid lumps.
steps: Bring the broth to a boil and pour in the polenta in a stream, stirring.
Cook 5 minutes until thick and stir in cheese and butter.
In a skillet, sauté the mushrooms with garlic.
Serve the polenta topped with the mushrooms.

gen-polenta-con-ragu-de-carne.title: Polenta with meat ragù
gen-polenta-con-ragu-de-carne.tip: Slow cooking the sauce makes the difference.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic and brown the ground beef.
Add the crushed tomato and cook 25 minutes.
Make the polenta with water and salt until thick.
Serve with the sauce and grated cheese.

gen-quinoa-salteada-con-verduras.title: Sautéed quinoa with vegetables
gen-quinoa-salteada-con-verduras.tip: Rinse the quinoa before cooking to remove the bitterness.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and boil 12 minutes in salted water.
Sauté the carrot, zucchini and onion in oil.
Add the quinoa and stir 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and serve.

gen-ensalada-de-quinoa-palta-y-tomate.title: Quinoa, avocado and tomato salad
gen-ensalada-de-quinoa-palta-y-tomate.tip: Dress it just before serving so the avocado doesn't darken.
steps: Boil the quinoa and let it cool.
Dice the avocado and tomato.
Mix everything with the quinoa.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt.

gen-tofu-salteado-con-verduras.title: Stir-fried tofu with vegetables
gen-tofu-salteado-con-verduras.tip: Dry the tofu well so it browns instead of releasing water.
steps: Cut the tofu into cubes and pat dry with paper.
Brown in a hot skillet with oil and remove.
Stir-fry the bell pepper, carrot and onion in strips.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and toss.

gen-coliflor-con-salsa-blanca.title: Cauliflower with white sauce
gen-coliflor-con-salsa-blanca.tip: Boil it briefly: it should stay firm.
steps: Boil the cauliflower florets 8 minutes and drain.
Melt the butter, add the flour and milk and stir until thick.
Place the cauliflower in a dish, cover with the sauce and grated cheese.
Bake until golden, 15 minutes.

gen-brocoli-salteado-con-ajo-y-limon.title: Sautéed broccoli with garlic and lemon
gen-brocoli-salteado-con-ajo-y-limon.tip: Don't overcook it: it should stay crisp.
steps: Boil the broccoli florets 3 minutes and drain.
Brown the sliced garlic in oil.
Add the broccoli and sauté 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and salt.

gen-ensalada-de-remolacha-rucula-y-queso.title: Beet, arugula and cheese salad
gen-ensalada-de-remolacha-rucula-y-queso.tip: Use pre-cooked beets to save time.
steps: Dice the cooked beets.
Toss them with the arugula in a bowl.
Add the diced cheese.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.

gen-mandioca-al-horno-con-queso.title: Baked cassava with cheese
gen-mandioca-al-horno-con-queso.tip: Boil it before baking so it turns out tender.
steps: Peel the cassava and cut into chunks.
Boil 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Place in a dish with oil and salt.
