Top with cheese and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 minutes.

gen-rollitos-de-repollo-rellenos-de-carn.title: Stuffed cabbage rolls with beef
gen-rollitos-de-repollo-rellenos-de-carn.tip: Blanch the leaves so they roll without tearing.
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves 3 minutes in boiling water.
Mix the ground beef with the onion, cooked rice and salt.
Fill the leaves, roll them up and arrange in a pot.
Cover with tomato sauce and cook covered 30 minutes.

gen-ensalada-de-apio-manzana-y-nueces.title: Celery, apple and walnut salad
gen-ensalada-de-apio-manzana-y-nueces.tip: Squeeze lemon on the apple so it doesn't darken.
steps: Cut the celery and apple into thin sticks.
Chop the walnuts coarsely.
Mix everything with plain yogurt and a few drops of lemon.
Serve right away.

gen-provoleta-con-miel-y-nueces.title: Provolone with honey and walnuts
gen-provoleta-con-miel-y-nueces.tip: Cook the provolone at the last minute: it hardens as it cools.
steps: Place the provolone in a hot skillet with no oil.
Brown it 2 minutes per side until melted.
Move it to a plate and drizzle with honey.
Finish with chopped walnuts and oregano.

gen-sandwich-de-salchicha-con-cebolla-ca.title: Sausage sandwich with caramelized onions
gen-sandwich-de-salchicha-con-cebolla-ca.tip: Cook the onion slowly: it should caramelize without burning.
steps: Slice the onions and cook over low heat 20 minutes.
Cook the sausages in a skillet until browned.
Open the buns and spread with mustard.
Assemble the sandwiches with sausage and onion.

gen-salchichas-al-horno-con-papas.title: Baked sausages with potatoes
gen-salchichas-al-horno-con-papas.tip: Prick the sausages so they don't burst.
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with oil and salt.
Bake the potatoes at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.
Add the pricked sausages and the onion wedges.
Bake 20 minutes more, until everything is golden.

gen-hamburguesa-con-huevo-y-panceta.title: Burger with egg and bacon
gen-hamburguesa-con-huevo-y-panceta.tip: Leave the yolk runny: it works as a sauce.
steps: Fry the bacon in a skillet until crisp.
Cook the burgers 4 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs in the same skillet.
Build the buns with the patty, bacon and egg.

gen-batata-asada-con-manteca-y-romero.title: Roasted sweet potato with butter and rosemary
gen-batata-asada-con-manteca-y-romero.tip: Prick them with a fork so they cook evenly.
steps: Wash the sweet potatoes and halve them lengthwise.
Brush with melted butter and salt.
Sprinkle with chopped rosemary.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-ensalada-tibia-de-garbanzos-y-atun.title: Warm chickpea and tuna salad
gen-ensalada-tibia-de-garbanzos-y-atun.tip: Let the dressing rest 5 minutes so it takes on flavor.
steps: Warm the cooked chickpeas in a skillet.
Mix them with the drained tuna and the diced onion.
Add the chopped parsley.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.

gen-tarta-de-puerros-y-queso.title: Leek and cheese tart
gen-tarta-de-puerros-y-queso.tip: Cook the leeks until very soft so they aren't stringy.
steps: Slice the leeks and sauté in butter until soft.
Mix with the eggs, cream and grated cheese.
Line a tart pan with the dough and pour in the filling.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-noquis-de-batata-con-salsa-de-queso.title: Sweet potato gnocchi with cheese sauce
gen-noquis-de-batata-con-salsa-de-queso.tip: Add the flour little by little: the dough should be soft.
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes, mash them and mix with flour and salt.
Roll into ropes, cut the gnocchi and boil until they float.
Heat the cream with the grated cheese until melted.
Toss the gnocchi with the sauce and serve.

gen-matambre-a-la-leche.title: Matambre braised in milk
gen-matambre-a-la-leche.summary: Slow-cooked in milk, tender and juicy.
gen-matambre-a-la-leche.tip: Better made the day before: it slices more easily cold.
steps: Salt the flank steak and brown it in a pot with oil.
Add the chopped garlic and pour in milk to halfway up.
Cover and cook over very low heat 1 hour 15 minutes, turning once.
Rest 10 minutes and slice with its sauce.

gen-falda-braseada-con-cerveza.title: Beer-braised beef plate
gen-falda-braseada-con-cerveza.tip: The beer should cover just a third of the meat.
steps: Salt the beef plate and brown it on all sides in a pot with oil.
Add the sliced onion and the carrot rounds.
Pour in the beer and cover.
Cook over low heat 2 hours until the meat falls apart.

gen-guiso-de-fideos-con-carne.title: Noodle and beef stew
gen-guiso-de-fideos-con-carne.tip: Add the noodles once the broth is already boiling.
steps: Brown the cubed beef with the onion and bell pepper.
Add the crushed tomato and water to cover and cook 20 minutes.
Add the noodles and more water if needed.
Cook 10 minutes, until al dente, and serve.

gen-alitas-de-pollo-al-horno-con-miel.title: Honey-baked chicken wings
gen-alitas-de-pollo-al-horno-con-miel.tip: Pat them dry before baking: they turn out crispier.
steps: Mix the honey with the soy sauce and the chopped garlic.
Coat the wings with the mixture and leave 15 minutes.
Place them in a dish and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 40 minutes.
Turn them halfway and brush with the remaining sauce.

gen-pollo-a-la-cerveza.title: Beer chicken
gen-pollo-a-la-cerveza.tip: The alcohol cooks off: only the flavor remains.
steps: Salt the chicken pieces and brown them in a pot with oil.
Add the sliced onion and the garlic.
Pour in the beer and add a bay leaf.
Cover and cook 35 minutes over low heat.

gen-arroz-amarillo-con-arvejas.title: Yellow rice with peas
gen-arroz-amarillo-con-arvejas.tip: Cook the rice covered and without stirring so it stays fluffy.
steps: Sauté the chopped garlic in oil.
Add the rice and the turmeric and stir 1 minute.
Add twice the volume of hot salted water and the peas.
Cook covered 18 minutes over low heat and rest 5.

gen-pizza-de-rucula-y-jamon-crudo.title: Arugula and prosciutto pizza
gen-pizza-de-rucula-y-jamon-crudo.tip: Add the arugula right out of the oven so it doesn't wilt.
steps: Roll out the pizza dough and top with tomato sauce.
Add the mozzarella and bake at 425°F (220°C) for 15 minutes.
Take it out and arrange the prosciutto on top.
Finish with the arugula and a drizzle of oil.

gen-focaccia-de-tomates-cherry.title: Cherry tomato focaccia
gen-focaccia-de-tomates-cherry.summary: Fluffy, with olive oil and rosemary.
gen-focaccia-de-tomates-cherry.tip: Dimple the dough with your fingers so it absorbs the oil.
steps: Mix the flour with the yeast, salt and warm water and knead.
Let it rest 40 minutes and stretch it into an oiled pan.
Dimple the dough and top with cherry tomatoes and rosemary.
Drizzle with oil and bake at 425°F (220°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-pan-casero-sencillo.title: Simple homemade bread
gen-pan-casero-sencillo.tip: A pot of water in the oven gives a crisp crust.
steps: Mix the flour with the yeast, salt and warm water into a dough.
Knead 10 minutes and let it rise covered for 1 hour.
Shape into a round loaf and let rise 30 minutes more.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 30 minutes.

gen-huevos-rellenos.title: Deviled eggs
gen-huevos-rellenos.tip: Peel them under cold water: they come off more easily.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool and peel.
Halve them and remove the yolks.
Mix the yolks with the drained tuna and the mayonnaise.
Fill the whites with the mixture.

gen-galletitas-de-limon.title: Lemon cookies
gen-galletitas-de-limon.tip: Zest only the yellow part of the peel: the white is bitter.
steps: Mix the soft butter with the sugar and the lemon zest.
Add the egg and flour and form a dough.
Cut circles and place them on a baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 12 minutes.

gen-gelatina-con-frutas.title: Fruit gelatin
gen-gelatina-con-frutas.tip: Add the fruit when the gelatin starts to set so it doesn't sink.
steps: Dissolve the gelatin in hot water as directed on the package.
Add the cold water and let it cool a little.
Add the chopped fruit and pour into molds.
Refrigerate 4 hours until set.

gen-barritas-de-cereal-y-miel.title: Honey cereal bars
gen-barritas-de-cereal-y-miel.tip: Press the mixture firmly into the pan so it doesn't fall apart.
steps: Heat the honey with the butter until combined.
Add the oats and the chopped walnuts.
Pour into a lined pan and press firmly.
Chill 2 hours and cut into bars.

gen-cupcakes-de-vainilla.title: Vanilla cupcakes
gen-cupcakes-de-vainilla.tip: Don't fill the cups more than two-thirds.
steps: Beat the butter with the sugar until creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time and the vanilla extract.
Fold in the flour with the baking powder and the milk.
Divide into cups and bake at 350°F (180°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-torta-de-zanahoria.title: Carrot cake
gen-torta-de-zanahoria.tip: Grate the carrot finely: it blends into the batter better.
steps: Mix the eggs with the sugar and the oil.
Add the flour with the baking powder and the cinnamon.
Fold in the grated carrot and pour into a pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-falafel-al-horno.title: Baked falafel
steps: Process the chickpeas with the onion, garlic, parsley and cumin.
Add the flour and shape into balls.
Place them on an oiled sheet and brush with oil.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes, turning them.

gen-shawarma-de-pollo-casero.title: Homemade chicken shawarma
gen-shawarma-de-pollo-casero.tip: Marinating it ahead gives more flavor.
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and marinate with cumin, paprika and garlic.
Brown in a hot skillet 8 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with the chopped cucumber.
Fill the pita with the chicken, the sauce and the tomato.

gen-ramen-casero-con-huevo.title: Homemade ramen with egg
gen-ramen-casero-con-huevo.tip: Cook the noodles separately so they don't cloud the broth.
steps: Heat the broth with the soy sauce and the grated ginger.
Boil the noodles separately and drain.
Boil the eggs 7 minutes and peel them.
Serve the noodles with the broth, the halved egg and the scallion.

gen-feijoada-rapida.title: Quick feijoada
gen-feijoada-rapida.tip: It thickens better if you mash a few beans against the pot.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic with the diced chorizo and bacon.
Add the cooked black beans and water to cover.
Cook 40 minutes over low heat.
Serve with rice and orange slices.

gen-pao-de-queijo.title: Brazilian cheese bread
gen-pao-de-queijo.tip: Best eaten warm, fresh from the oven.
steps: Heat the milk with the oil and salt and pour over the starch.
Mix until cooled and add the eggs and the grated cheese.
Shape into balls with oiled hands.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-pescado-con-salsa-de-limon-y-alcapar.title: Fish with lemon caper sauce
gen-pescado-con-salsa-de-limon-y-alcapar.tip: Pat the fillets dry so they brown without breaking.
steps: Salt the fillets and dredge them in flour.
Brown 3 minutes per side in a skillet with butter and remove.
In the same skillet add the lemon juice and the capers.
Pour the sauce over the fish and serve.

gen-pozole-rojo-rapido.title: Quick red pozole
gen-pozole-rojo-rapido.tip: Add the chili gradually: you can raise the heat to taste.
steps: Boil the chicken in water with onion and garlic.
Add the cooked corn and the blended guajillo chili.
Cook 30 minutes and shred the chicken.
Serve hot with radish and lettuce.

gen-pita-de-pollo-con-tzatziki.title: Chicken pita with tzatziki
gen-pita-de-pollo-con-tzatziki.tip: Drain the cucumber well so the tzatziki isn't watery.
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and brown with salt and oregano.
Mix the yogurt with the grated cucumber and the garlic.
Warm the pita breads.
Fill them with the chicken, tzatziki and tomato.

gen-curry-de-garbanzos.title: Chickpea curry
gen-curry-de-garbanzos.tip: Let the spices toast for a minute to release their aroma.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic with the curry powder.
Add the crushed tomato and the cooked chickpeas.
Add the coconut milk and cook 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.

gen-cazuela-de-pescado-y-verduras.title: Fish and vegetable stew
gen-cazuela-de-pescado-y-verduras.tip: Add the fish at the end: it cooks very quickly.
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and garlic.
Add the diced potatoes and the broth and cook 15 minutes.
Add the fish in chunks and cook 7 minutes more.
Finish with chopped parsley.

gen-albondigas-de-lentejas.title: Lentil balls
gen-albondigas-de-lentejas.tip: Make them an even size so they cook alike.
steps: Mash the cooked lentils with the grated onion and the egg.
Add the breadcrumbs and salt and shape into balls.
Brown them in a skillet with oil.
Finish 10 minutes in tomato sauce.

gen-tomates-gratinados-con-ajo-y-perejil.title: Gratinated tomatoes with garlic and parsley
gen-tomates-gratinados-con-ajo-y-perejil.tip: Pick firm tomatoes so they don't fall apart in the oven.
steps: Halve the tomatoes and set them cut side up in a dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the chopped garlic and parsley and salt.
Cover each half with the mixture and drizzle with oil.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes, until golden.

gen-papas-bravas.title: Patatas bravas
gen-papas-bravas.tip: Fry the potatoes twice for extra crispness.
steps: Cut the potatoes into cubes and boil 5 minutes.
Dry them and fry in hot oil until golden.
Mix the tomato sauce with paprika and a touch of chili.
Serve with the sauce on top.

gen-papas-gratinadas-a-la-crema.title: Potato gratin with cream
gen-papas-gratinadas-a-la-crema.tip: Slice the potatoes thin and even.
steps: Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer in a dish with cream, salt and chopped garlic.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-ensalada-de-pasta-con-atun-y-tomate.title: Pasta salad with tuna and tomato
gen-ensalada-de-pasta-con-atun-y-tomate.tip: Rinse the pasta with cold water to stop the cooking.
steps: Boil the pasta, drain and rinse.
Dice the tomato and onion.
Mix them with the pasta and the drained tuna.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.

gen-ensalada-waldorf.title: Waldorf salad
gen-ensalada-waldorf.tip: Cut the apple last so it doesn't darken.
steps: Dice the apple and celery.
Chop the walnuts.
Mix everything with the yogurt and mayonnaise.
Serve cold.

gen-ensalada-de-garbanzos-y-pepino.title: Chickpea and cucumber salad
gen-ensalada-de-garbanzos-y-pepino.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes so it picks up flavor.
steps: Drain the cooked chickpeas.
Dice the cucumber and tomato.
Mix everything with chopped onion.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt.

gen-tostadas-de-queso-crema-y-pepino.title: Cream cheese and cucumber toast
gen-tostadas-de-queso-crema-y-pepino.tip: Slice the cucumber very thin so it sits well.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Spread with the cream cheese.
Top with thin cucumber slices.
Finish with salt and pepper.

gen-sandwich-de-pollo-y-palta.title: Chicken and avocado sandwich
gen-sandwich-de-pollo-y-palta.tip: Use already-cooked chicken to save time.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken.
Mash the avocado with lemon and salt.
Spread the bread with the avocado.
Build the sandwiches with chicken and tomato.

gen-wrap-de-atun-y-verduras.title: Tuna and vegetable wrap
gen-wrap-de-atun-y-verduras.tip: Warm the tortilla briefly so it doesn't tear when rolled.
steps: Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Grate the carrot and shred the lettuce.
Fill the tortillas with everything.
Roll them up and cut in half.

gen-salpicon-de-carne.title: Beef salpicón
gen-salpicon-de-carne.summary: With boiled beef, egg and tomato.
gen-salpicon-de-carne.tip: Perfect for using up leftover beef.
steps: Dice the cooked beef into small cubes.
Boil the eggs 10 minutes and chop them.
Mix them with the diced tomato and onion.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt.

gen-tarta-de-ricota-y-limon.title: Ricotta lemon tart
gen-tarta-de-ricota-y-limon.tip: Let it cool before slicing: it sets better.
steps: Mix the ricotta with the sugar, eggs and lemon zest.
Line a tart pan with the dough and pour in the filling.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.
Let it cool and serve.

gen-peras-con-chocolate.title: Pears with chocolate
steps: Peel the pears and halve them.
Boil them 10 minutes in sugar water.
Melt the chocolate with a little milk.
Serve the pears covered with the warm chocolate.

gen-pollo-con-champinones-y-crema.title: Chicken with mushrooms and cream
gen-pollo-con-champinones-y-crema.tip: Brown the mushrooms well before adding the cream.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces with salt and oil and remove.
Sauté the sliced mushrooms with the garlic.
Return the chicken and add the cream.
Cook covered 15 minutes over low heat.

gen-choclo-asado-con-manteca-y-queso.title: Grilled corn with butter and cheese
gen-choclo-asado-con-manteca-y-queso.tip: Boiling them 5 minutes first makes them more tender.
steps: Boil the corn 5 minutes and drain.
Brush with melted butter and salt.
Brown on a griddle or in a 425°F (220°C) oven for 15 minutes.
Finish with grated cheese on top.

gen-cebollas-rellenas-de-carne.title: Beef-stuffed onions
gen-cebollas-rellenas-de-carne.tip: Remove the inner layers carefully so you don't break the edge.
steps: Boil the onions 10 minutes and hollow them out.
Mix the ground beef with the chopped center of the onion and salt.
Fill the onions and place them in a dish with tomato sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-avena-cocida-con-frutas-y-miel.title: Oatmeal with fruit and honey
gen-avena-cocida-con-frutas-y-miel.tip: Cook the oats in milk for a creamier texture.
steps: Put the oats and milk in a pot and cook 5 minutes, stirring.
Serve in a bowl and add the sliced banana.
Top with honey and cinnamon.
Eat it warm.

gen-avena-nocturna-con-yogur.title: Overnight oats with yogurt
gen-avena-nocturna-con-yogur.tip: Leave it covered in the fridge overnight.
steps: Mix the oats with the yogurt and milk in a jar.
Add the honey and stir.
Refrigerate overnight.
In the morning add fresh fruit and eat it cold.

gen-tostadas-con-huevo-y-tomate.title: Toast with egg and tomato
gen-tostadas-con-huevo-y-tomate.tip: A pinch of pepper adds an extra touch.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Fry the eggs in a skillet with a little oil.
Place tomato slices on each toast.
Top with an egg and season with salt.

gen-tostadas-con-mermelada-y-queso.title: Toast with jam and cheese
gen-tostadas-con-mermelada-y-queso.tip: Try it with fresh or creamy cheese.
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread the toast with the cream cheese.
Cover with a layer of jam.
Serve right away.

gen-panqueques-de-banana-madura.title: Ripe banana pancakes
gen-panqueques-de-banana-madura.tip: The riper the banana, the sweeter they turn out.
steps: Mash the bananas with a fork.
Mix with the eggs and flour into a batter.
Cook spoonfuls in a skillet with butter, 2 minutes per side.
Serve with honey or dulce de leche.

gen-waffles-caseros.title: Homemade waffles
gen-waffles-caseros.tip: Let the batter rest 5 minutes before cooking.
steps: Mix the flour with the baking powder and sugar.
Add the milk, eggs and melted butter.
Cook the batter in a hot waffle iron 3 minutes.
Serve with fruit and honey.

gen-pan-frances-al-horno-con-dulce-de-le.title: Baked French bread with dulce de leche
gen-pan-frances-al-horno-con-dulce-de-le.tip: Warm the dulce de leche a few seconds so it spreads better.
steps: Slice the baguette rolls in half lengthwise.
Toast them in the oven 5 minutes.
Spread with dulce de leche.
Serve right away.

gen-sandwiches-de-miga-de-pollo-y-mayone.title: Chicken salad finger sandwiches
gen-sandwiches-de-miga-de-pollo-y-mayone.tip: Remove the crusts before cutting into triangles.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken and mix with the mayonnaise.
Spread the mixture on the bread.
Assemble the sandwiches and trim the crusts.
Cut in half and serve cold.

gen-tostadas-con-palta-y-tomate.title: Avocado and tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon and salt.
Spread it on the toast.
Top with tomato slices and pepper.

gen-huevo-poche-sobre-tostada.title: Poached egg on toast
gen-huevo-poche-sobre-tostada.tip: Use very fresh eggs so the white doesn't fall apart.
steps: Heat water with a splash of vinegar, below a hard boil.
Make a whirlpool and drop in an egg, cook 3 minutes.
Lift it out with a slotted spoon and drain.
Serve on toast with salt and pepper.

gen-yogur-con-avena-y-manzana.title: Yogurt with oats and apple
gen-yogur-con-avena-y-manzana.tip: Toast the oats dry for 2 minutes for more aroma.
steps: Grate the apple with its skin.
Mix it with the yogurt and oats.
Add the cinnamon and honey.
Serve cold.

gen-smoothie-de-banana-y-espinaca.title: Banana and spinach smoothie
gen-smoothie-de-banana-y-espinaca.tip: Freeze the banana for a creamier result.
steps: Put the banana pieces in the blender.
Add the spinach, milk and honey.
Blend 1 minute until smooth.
Serve right away.

gen-licuado-de-banana-y-dulce-de-leche.title: Banana and dulce de leche shake
gen-licuado-de-banana-y-dulce-de-leche.tip: Add ice if you want it colder.
steps: Slice the banana.
Put it in the blender with the milk and the dulce de leche.
Blend 1 minute.
Serve in glasses.

gen-chocolatada-casera.title: Homemade chocolate milk
gen-chocolatada-casera.tip: Dissolve the cocoa first in a little warm milk to avoid lumps.
steps: Mix the cocoa with the sugar and a little warm milk.
Add the rest of the milk.
Heat without boiling, stirring.
Serve hot or cold.

gen-cafe-con-leche-espumoso-y-tostadas.title: Frothy latte and toast
gen-cafe-con-leche-espumoso-y-tostadas.tip: Heat the milk without boiling so it froths better.
steps: Heat the milk and whisk until foamy.
With the coffee prepared, combine with the milk.
Toast the bread and spread with butter.
Serve everything together.

gen-bizcochitos-de-queso.title: Cheese biscuits
gen-bizcochitos-de-queso.tip: Let them cool slightly: they're best warm.
steps: Mix the flour with the grated cheese and the cold butter in small pieces.
Add the egg and a little milk and form a dough.
Roll it out, cut small squares and place on a sheet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 minutes.

gen-medialunas-de-manteca-rapidas.title: Quick butter croissants
gen-medialunas-de-manteca-rapidas.tip: Chill the dough between folds so the butter doesn't melt.
steps: Mix the flour with the yeast, sugar, salt and warm milk and knead.
Roll it out, spread with butter and fold twice.
Cut triangles and roll them into crescents.
Let rise 30 minutes and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-scones-dulces-con-pasas.title: Sweet raisin scones
gen-scones-dulces-con-pasas.tip: Don't knead too much: they turn tough.
steps: Mix the flour with the baking powder, sugar and cold butter until crumbly.
Add the raisins, milk and egg.
Form a dough and cut circles.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 minutes.

gen-muffins-de-arandanos.title: Blueberry muffins
gen-muffins-de-arandanos.tip: Toss the blueberries in flour so they don't sink.
steps: Mix the flour with the sugar and baking powder.
Add the eggs, milk and oil.
Fold in the blueberries and divide among cups.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 25 minutes.

gen-tortitas-de-avena-y-banana.title: Oat and banana patties
gen-tortitas-de-avena-y-banana.tip: Use very ripe bananas: they provide all the sweetness.
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with the oats and egg.
Form patties with a spoon.
Cook them in a non-stick skillet 3 minutes per side.
Serve warm, with honey if you like.

gen-budin-de-pan-con-banana.title: Banana bread pudding
gen-budin-de-pan-con-banana.tip: Soak the bread well so there are no dry spots.
steps: Soak the stale bread in the warm milk for 10 minutes.
Mix with the eggs, sugar and mashed banana.
Pour into a caramelized pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-tortilla-de-arroz-sobrante.title: Leftover rice omelet
gen-tortilla-de-arroz-sobrante.tip: Use cold rice: it mixes better with the egg.
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Mix with the cooked rice and the chopped onion.
Cook in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Serve cut into wedges.

gen-bolitas-de-arroz-con-queso.title: Cheesy rice balls
gen-bolitas-de-arroz-con-queso.tip: Chill the balls 15 minutes before frying.
steps: Mix the cooked rice with the egg and grated cheese.
Shape into balls with a cube of cheese in the center.
Roll them in breadcrumbs.
Fry or bake until golden.

gen-croquetas-de-arroz.title: Rice croquettes
gen-croquetas-de-arroz.tip: Make them the same size so they brown evenly.
steps: Mix the rice with the chopped ham, cheese and egg.
Shape croquettes and roll in breadcrumbs.
Brown in a skillet with oil.
Drain on paper towels.

gen-torrejas-de-pan-viejo.title: Stale bread French toast
gen-torrejas-de-pan-viejo.tip: Soak them only briefly so they don't fall apart.
steps: Dip the slices in the milk and then in beaten egg.
Fry in oil until golden.
Roll in sugar and cinnamon.
Serve hot.

gen-pan-rallado-casero.title: Homemade breadcrumbs
gen-pan-rallado-casero.tip: Store them in a tightly closed jar.
steps: Cut the stale bread into chunks.
Dry it in a 300°F (150°C) oven for 15 minutes.
Process until fine.
Store in a jar.

gen-sopa-de-pan-y-ajo.title: Garlic bread soup
gen-sopa-de-pan-y-ajo.tip: Serve it very hot in small crocks.
steps: Brown the sliced garlic in oil and add the paprika.
Add the stale bread in pieces and the broth.
Cook 10 minutes until the bread breaks down.
Add the eggs and bake 5 minutes.

gen-budin-de-verduras-con-sobras.title: Leftover vegetable loaf
gen-budin-de-verduras-con-sobras.tip: Any cooked vegetable works in this loaf.
steps: Chop whatever cooked vegetables you have.
Mix with the eggs and grated cheese.
Pour into an oiled pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-croquetas-de-pure-sobrante.title: Leftover mashed potato croquettes
gen-croquetas-de-pure-sobrante.tip: Let the mash cool so you can shape it.
steps: Mix the mashed potatoes with the grated cheese and egg.
Shape croquettes and roll in breadcrumbs.
Brown in a skillet with oil.
Serve hot.

gen-fideos-con-huevo-y-queso.title: Noodles with egg and cheese
gen-fideos-con-huevo-y-queso.tip: Mix it off the heat so the egg doesn't scramble.
steps: Heat the cooked noodles in a skillet with butter.
Beat the egg with the grated cheese.
Take the skillet off the heat and mix everything.
Serve right away.

gen-pasta-frita-al-horno-con-queso.title: Baked pasta with cheese
gen-pasta-frita-al-horno-con-queso.tip: Top with plenty of cheese so it gratinates well.
steps: Mix the cooked noodles with tomato sauce.
Move to a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.

gen-tortilla-de-fideos.title: Noodle omelet
gen-tortilla-de-fideos.tip: Use thin noodles that have cooled.
steps: Mix the cooked noodles with the beaten eggs and cheese.
Cook in a skillet with oil 4 minutes per side.
Let it rest 2 minutes before cutting.
Serve in portions.

gen-pollo-desmenuzado-en-wraps.title: Shredded chicken wraps
gen-pollo-desmenuzado-en-wraps.tip: Warm the tortillas briefly so they don't tear.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken.
Mix with the chopped tomato and mayonnaise.
Fill the tortillas and roll them up.
Cut in half.

gen-empanadas-de-pollo-con-sobras.title: Empanadas with leftover chicken
gen-empanadas-de-pollo-con-sobras.summary: With chicken from the day before.
gen-empanadas-de-pollo-con-sobras.tip: Let the filling cool before assembling.
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with the sautéed onion.
Add the chopped bell pepper and salt.
Fill the dough rounds and seal with a crimp.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-hamburguesas-de-arroz-y-verduras.title: Rice and vegetable burgers
gen-hamburguesas-de-arroz-y-verduras.tip: Chill the mixture 15 minutes so it firms up.
steps: Mix the cooked rice with the grated carrot and the egg.
Add the breadcrumbs and salt.
Shape patties and cook in a skillet.
Brown 4 minutes per side.

gen-bruschetta-de-pan-viejo-y-tomate.title: Stale bread and tomato bruschetta
gen-bruschetta-de-pan-viejo-y-tomate.tip: Rub the garlic on while the bread is still hot.
steps: Slice the stale bread and toast it.
Rub with garlic.
Top with chopped tomato and basil.
Drizzle with oil and salt.

gen-torta-de-banana-madura.title: Overripe banana cake
gen-torta-de-banana-madura.tip: The blacker the banana, the more flavor.
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with the sugar and eggs.
Add the oil and the flour with the baking powder.
Pour into a buttered pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-mermelada-rapida-de-frutas-blandas.title: Quick jam from soft fruit
gen-mermelada-rapida-de-frutas-blandas.summary: With fruit that's no longer firm.
gen-mermelada-rapida-de-frutas-blandas.tip: Store it in clean, tightly closed jars.
steps: Chop the fruit and put it in a pot with the sugar.
Add the lemon juice.
Cook over low heat 30 minutes until thick.
Pour into jars while hot.

gen-compota-de-manzanas-arrugadas.title: Wrinkly apple compote
gen-compota-de-manzanas-arrugadas.summary: With apples that have lost their firmness.
gen-compota-de-manzanas-arrugadas.tip: Leave the peel on for more flavor and fiber.
steps: Cut the apples into cubes.
Put them in a pot with water, sugar and cinnamon.
Cook over low heat 20 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.

gen-yogur-casero.title: Homemade yogurt
gen-yogur-casero.summary: With milk and a little yogurt.
gen-yogur-casero.tip: Use plain unsweetened yogurt as the starter.
steps: Warm the milk until lukewarm, not hot.
Mix with the plain yogurt.
Pour into a jar and leave 8 hours in a warm place.
Store in the refrigerator.

gen-hamburguesas-de-garbanzos.title: Chickpea burgers
gen-hamburguesas-de-garbanzos.tip: Drain the chickpeas well so the mixture doesn't get soft.
steps: Mash the cooked chickpeas with the grated onion and garlic.
Add the breadcrumbs, cumin and salt.
Shape into patties and let them rest 10 minutes.
Brown 4 minutes per side in a skillet with oil.

gen-hamburguesas-de-remolacha.title: Beet burgers
gen-hamburguesas-de-remolacha.tip: Grate the beet finely so it blends well.
steps: Mix the grated beet with the cooked rice and the egg.
Add the breadcrumbs and salt.
Shape into patties and chill 15 minutes.
Brown them in a skillet 4 minutes per side.

gen-berenjenas-al-horno-con-tomate-y-que.title: Baked eggplant with tomato and cheese
gen-berenjenas-al-horno-con-tomate-y-que.tip: Cut thick slices so they don't dry out.
steps: Slice the eggplants and salt them.
Place in a dish with oil and bake 15 minutes.
Top each slice with tomato and cheese.
Bake 15 minutes more.

gen-zapallitos-rellenos-de-ricota.title: Zucchini stuffed with ricotta
gen-zapallitos-rellenos-de-ricota.tip: Hollow out the zucchini well to make room for the filling.
steps: Halve the zucchini and hollow them out.
Mix the ricotta with the chopped pulp and salt.
Fill the zucchini and top with grated cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.

gen-tarta-de-espinaca-y-queso.title: Spinach and cheese tart
gen-tarta-de-espinaca-y-queso.tip: Drain the spinach well so the tart doesn't get soggy.
steps: Cook the spinach and drain it very well.
Mix it with the eggs and grated cheese.
Line a tart pan with the dough and pour in the filling.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-pastel-de-berenjenas-y-papas.title: Eggplant and potato bake
gen-pastel-de-berenjenas-y-papas.tip: Brown the eggplant first so it doesn't release water.
steps: Slice the potatoes and eggplants thinly.
Layer in a dish with tomato sauce.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-wok-de-verduras-con-salsa-de-soja.title: Vegetable stir-fry with soy sauce
gen-wok-de-verduras-con-salsa-de-soja.tip: Cook over high heat so the vegetables stay crisp.
steps: Cut all the vegetables into thin strips.
Heat oil in a large skillet.
Stir-fry the vegetables 5 minutes over high heat.
Add the soy sauce and garlic and toss.

gen-arroz-con-lentejas.title: Rice with lentils
gen-arroz-con-lentejas.tip: Cook the lentils until tender but whole.
steps: Boil the lentils 20 minutes.
Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the rice and the lentils with their broth.
Cook covered 15 minutes.

gen-lentejas-a-la-criolla.title: Creole lentils
gen-lentejas-a-la-criolla.tip: Let the stew rest a few minutes before serving.
steps: Sauté the onion, bell pepper and carrot.
Add the paprika and the crushed tomato.
Add the lentils and water to cover.
Cook 30 minutes over low heat.

gen-guiso-de-garbanzos-y-espinaca.title: Chickpea and spinach stew
gen-guiso-de-garbanzos-y-espinaca.tip: Add the spinach at the end so it doesn't darken.
steps: Sauté the garlic with the cumin and paprika.
Add the crushed tomato and the cooked chickpeas.
Cook 15 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook 3 minutes more.

gen-chili-vegetariano.title: Vegetarian chili
gen-chili-vegetariano.tip: Let it rest so it thickens and takes on flavor.
steps: Sauté the onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add the crushed tomato, the beans and the corn.
Season with cumin and paprika.
Cook 25 minutes over low heat.

gen-tacos-de-papa-y-queso.title: Potato and cheese tacos
gen-tacos-de-papa-y-queso.tip: Brown the tacos lightly so they don't break.
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash with salt.
Mix with the grated cheese.
Fill the tortillas and fold them.
Brown in a skillet with oil.

gen-quesadillas-de-espinaca-y-queso.title: Spinach and cheese quesadillas
gen-quesadillas-de-espinaca-y-queso.tip: Use medium heat so the cheese melts without burning the tortilla.
steps: Sauté the spinach with garlic 2 minutes.
Put cheese and spinach on a tortilla and cover with another.
Brown in a skillet 2 minutes per side.
Cut into triangles.

gen-fideos-de-arroz-con-verduras.title: Rice noodles with vegetables
gen-fideos-de-arroz-con-verduras.tip: Soak the noodles in hot water: no need to boil them.
steps: Soak the rice noodles as directed on the package.
Stir-fry the carrot and zucchini strips.
Add the noodles and the soy sauce.
Toss 2 minutes and serve.

gen-cuscus-con-verduras-asadas.title: Couscous with roasted vegetables
gen-cuscus-con-verduras-asadas.tip: Hydrate the couscous with hot broth for more flavor.
steps: Cut the zucchini, bell pepper and onion and roast 25 minutes with oil.
Hydrate the couscous with hot water and leave 5 minutes.
Mix with the vegetables.
Season with lemon and salt.

gen-tabule-de-cuscus.title: Couscous tabbouleh
gen-tabule-de-cuscus.tip: The more parsley, the more authentic.
steps: Hydrate the couscous with hot water and let it rest.
Chop the tomato and parsley.
Mix everything with lemon juice and oil.
Serve cold.

gen-verduras-asadas-al-horno-con-romero.title: Rosemary roasted vegetables
gen-verduras-asadas-al-horno-con-romero.tip: Cut everything the same size so it cooks evenly.
steps: Cut the vegetables into large pieces.
Toss them with oil, salt and rosemary.
Place on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake at 425°F (210°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-pimientos-rellenos-de-arroz-y-queso.title: Rice and cheese stuffed peppers
gen-pimientos-rellenos-de-arroz-y-queso.tip: Pre-cook the peppers 10 minutes so they turn out tender.
steps: Boil the peppers 5 minutes.
Mix the rice with the cheese and chopped tomato.
Fill the peppers.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.

gen-pizza-de-berenjenas.title: Eggplant pizza
gen-pizza-de-berenjenas.tip: Salt the slices and let them rest to remove the bitterness.
steps: Cut the eggplants into thick slices.
Roast them in the oven 10 minutes.
Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
Broil 10 minutes more.

gen-revuelto-de-espinaca-y-huevo.title: Spinach scramble
gen-revuelto-de-espinaca-y-huevo.tip: Cook over low heat so the eggs stay creamy.
steps: Sauté the spinach with a little garlic.
Add the beaten eggs.
Stir over low heat until set.
Serve right away.

gen-sopa-de-calabaza-y-zanahoria.title: Pumpkin and carrot soup
gen-sopa-de-calabaza-y-zanahoria.tip: A squeeze of lemon when serving brightens the flavor.
steps: Sauté the onion in a little oil.
Add the diced pumpkin and carrots.
Cover with water or broth and cook 25 minutes.
Blend and serve hot.

gen-sopa-de-tomate-casera.title: Homemade tomato soup
gen-sopa-de-tomate-casera.tip: Use very ripe tomatoes for more flavor.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes and the broth.
Cook 20 minutes.
Blend and finish with basil.

gen-sopa-minestrone.title: Minestrone soup
gen-sopa-minestrone.tip: Cut all the vegetables the same size.
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and celery.
Add the potato, zucchini and broth.
Cook 20 minutes and add the noodles.
Cook 8 minutes more.

gen-sopa-de-repollo-y-zanahoria.title: Cabbage and carrot soup
gen-sopa-de-repollo-y-zanahoria.tip: Cut the cabbage thin so it cooks quickly.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil.
Add the shredded cabbage and the carrot.
Cover with broth and cook 25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

gen-crema-de-espinaca.title: Cream of spinach soup
gen-crema-de-espinaca.tip: Add the spinach at the end to keep its color.
steps: Sauté the onion and the diced potato in a little oil.
Cover with broth and cook 15 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook 3 minutes more.
Blend and serve hot.

gen-crema-de-coliflor.title: Cauliflower cream soup
gen-crema-de-coliflor.tip: A little nutmeg goes very well.
steps: Sauté the onion in butter.
Add the cauliflower florets and the broth.
Cook 20 minutes.
Blend and serve hot.

gen-ensalada-de-zanahoria-y-manzana.title: Carrot and apple salad
gen-ensalada-de-zanahoria-y-manzana.tip: Grate the apple last so it doesn't darken.
steps: Grate the carrots and the apple.
Mix with the lemon juice.
Add the yogurt and toss.
Serve cold.

gen-ensalada-de-arroz-con-choclo.title: Rice and corn salad
steps: Boil the rice and let it cool.
Mix with the corn, tomato and onion in small cubes.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.
Serve it well chilled.

gen-ensalada-de-lechuga-y-huevo-duro.title: Lettuce and hard-boiled egg salad
gen-ensalada-de-lechuga-y-huevo-duro.tip: Cook the eggs 10 minutes so the yolk is firm.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes and peel them.
Tear the lettuce into pieces.
Mix with the eggs in quarters.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt.

gen-ensalada-de-tomate-mozzarella-y-alba.title: Tomato, mozzarella and basil salad
gen-ensalada-de-tomate-mozzarella-y-alba.tip: Use ripe tomatoes and fresh mozzarella.
steps: Slice the tomatoes and the mozzarella.
Alternate them on a platter.
Add the basil leaves.
Dress with oil and salt.

gen-salsa-de-tomate-casera.title: Homemade tomato sauce
gen-salsa-de-tomate-casera.tip: Cook it slowly: the sauce gains flavor.
steps: Peel and chop the tomatoes.
Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes and cook 30 minutes.
Season with salt, basil and a pinch of sugar.

gen-salsa-criolla.title: Creole salsa
gen-salsa-criolla.tip: Let it rest so it takes on flavor.
steps: Dice the tomato, onion and bell pepper.
Mix with the chopped parsley.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt.
Let it rest 20 minutes.

gen-pesto-de-albahaca.title: Basil pesto
gen-pesto-de-albahaca.tip: Add the oil little by little while processing.
steps: Process the basil with the garlic and walnuts.
Add the grated cheese.
Add the oil gradually until creamy.
Salt it and use it on pasta.

gen-hummus-de-zanahoria.title: Carrot hummus
gen-hummus-de-zanahoria.tip: Cook the carrots well so it turns out smooth.
steps: Boil the carrots until tender.
Process them with the chickpeas and garlic.
Add lemon, cumin and oil.
Process until creamy.

gen-dip-de-yogur-y-ajo.title: Yogurt and garlic dip
gen-dip-de-yogur-y-ajo.tip: Chill it so the flavor develops.
steps: Mix the yogurt with the grated garlic.
Add the lemon and the oil.
Season with salt and dill.
Serve cold.

gen-pure-mixto-de-papa-y-zanahoria.title: Potato and carrot mash
gen-pure-mixto-de-papa-y-zanahoria.tip: Boil them together so they cook evenly.
steps: Peel and cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks.
Boil 20 minutes until tender.
Drain and mash with the butter.
Salt and serve hot.

gen-pure-de-papas-con-queso.title: Cheesy mashed potatoes
gen-pure-de-papas-con-queso.tip: Boil them with the skin on so they absorb less water.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender.
Mash them with the butter and milk.
Add the grated cheese.
Serve hot.

gen-papas-al-horno-con-ajo-y-perejil.title: Garlic parsley roasted potatoes
gen-papas-al-horno-con-ajo-y-perejil.tip: Cut them evenly so they cook the same.
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges.
Toss them with oil, chopped garlic and salt.
Bake at 425°F (210°C) for 40 minutes.
Finish with chopped parsley.

gen-esparragos-con-huevo.title: Asparagus with egg
gen-esparragos-con-huevo.tip: Don't overcook them: they should stay firm.
steps: Boil the asparagus 4 minutes and drain.
Fry the eggs in a skillet.
Serve the asparagus with the egg on top.
Season with salt and pepper.

gen-chauchas-salteadas-con-ajo.title: Garlic green beans
gen-chauchas-salteadas-con-ajo.tip: Don't overcook them: they should stay firm.
steps: Boil the green beans 4 minutes and drain.
Brown the sliced garlic in oil.
Add the beans and sauté 3 minutes.
Salt and serve hot.

gen-pollo-con-pimientos-asados.title: Chicken with roasted peppers
gen-pollo-con-pimientos-asados.tip: Peel the roasted peppers while they're still warm.
steps: Roast the bell peppers in the oven and peel them.
Brown the salted chicken pieces.
Add the pepper strips and the garlic.
Cook covered 25 minutes over low heat.

gen-pollo-a-la-mostaza-con-papas.title: Mustard chicken with potatoes
gen-pollo-a-la-mostaza-con-papas.tip: Marinate it in the mustard 20 minutes before baking.
steps: Mix the mustard with the garlic and oil.
Rub the chicken pieces with the mixture.
Place the potato wedges around them.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 45 minutes.

gen-pollo-con-vegetales-al-horno.title: Roasted chicken with vegetables
gen-pollo-con-vegetales-al-horno.tip: Put the vegetables under the chicken: they absorb its juices.
steps: Cut the carrots, onion and zucchini into chunks.
Toss them with oil and salt in a dish.
Set the salted chicken on top.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 50 minutes.

gen-pollo-en-salsa-de-tomate-y-morrones.title: Chicken in tomato and pepper sauce
gen-pollo-en-salsa-de-tomate-y-morrones.tip: Cook the sauce a few minutes before adding the chicken.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces and remove.
Sauté the bell pepper and onion.
Add the crushed tomato and return the chicken.
Cook covered 30 minutes.

gen-pollo-al-disco-con-verduras.title: Chicken and vegetable skillet stew
gen-pollo-al-disco-con-verduras.tip: Cook over medium heat without rushing.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil.
Add the sliced onion, bell pepper and carrot.
Add the potatoes and a glass of water.
Cover and cook 45 minutes.

gen-pollo-con-crema-y-verdeo.title: Chicken with cream and scallions
gen-pollo-con-crema-y-verdeo.tip: Add the cream at the end so it doesn't split.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces with salt.
Add the chopped scallions.
Pour in the cream and cook 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

gen-pollo-a-la-portuguesa.title: Portuguese-style chicken
gen-pollo-a-la-portuguesa.summary: With tomato, bell pepper and onion.
gen-pollo-a-la-portuguesa.tip: Serve with white rice to soak up the sauce.
steps: Brown the chicken with salt in a pot.
Add the onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add the chopped tomato and the white wine.
Cover and cook 35 minutes.

gen-pollo-al-curry-con-papas.title: Chicken curry with potatoes
gen-pollo-al-curry-con-papas.tip: Toast the curry a minute in the oil to release its aroma.
steps: Sauté the onion with the curry.
Add the cubed chicken and brown it.
Add the potatoes and the cream.
Cook covered 25 minutes.

gen-pechuga-a-la-plancha-con-salsa-de-li.title: Griddled chicken breast with lemon sauce
gen-pechuga-a-la-plancha-con-salsa-de-li.tip: Flatten the breast so it cooks evenly.
steps: Flatten the chicken breasts and salt them.
Cook on a hot griddle 5 minutes per side.
Warm the lemon juice with the butter.
Pour the sauce over the breasts.

gen-pechuga-rellena-de-queso-y-panceta.title: Chicken breast stuffed with cheese and bacon
gen-pechuga-rellena-de-queso-y-panceta.tip: Close it with toothpicks so the filling stays in.
steps: Open the breasts and fill with cheese and bacon.
Close with toothpicks.
Brown in a skillet 4 minutes per side.
Finish in a 350°F (180°C) oven for 15 minutes.

gen-suprema-de-pollo-con-pure.title: Breaded chicken cutlet with mashed potatoes
gen-suprema-de-pollo-con-pure.tip: Bread the cutlets twice for extra crunch.
steps: Dip the cutlets in egg and breadcrumbs.
Brown in a skillet with oil.
Boil the potatoes and make a mash with butter.
Serve the cutlets with the mash.

gen-milanesas-de-pollo-con-salsa.title: Chicken milanesas with sauce
gen-milanesas-de-pollo-con-salsa.tip: Add the sauce right before serving.
steps: Coat the cutlets in egg and breadcrumbs.
Brown in a skillet with oil.
Warm the tomato sauce.
Serve the milanesas with the sauce on top.

gen-muslos-de-pollo-al-horno-con-batatas.title: Roasted chicken thighs with sweet potatoes
gen-muslos-de-pollo-al-horno-con-batatas.tip: Cut the sweet potatoes thick so they don't fall apart.
steps: Salt the thighs and put them in a dish.
Add the sweet potato chunks with oil.
Turn them halfway so they brown evenly.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 50 minutes.

gen-tiras-de-pollo-con-salsa-agridulce.title: Chicken strips in sweet and sour sauce
gen-tiras-de-pollo-con-salsa-agridulce.tip: Add the sauce at the end so it doesn't burn.
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and brown.
Add the bell pepper and onion strips.
Pour in the tomato sauce with sugar and vinegar.
Cook 8 minutes.

gen-albondigas-de-carne-al-horno.title: Baked beef meatballs
gen-albondigas-de-carne-al-horno.tip: Wet your hands to shape the meatballs without sticking.
steps: Mix the ground beef with the egg, breadcrumbs and onion.
Shape into meatballs.
Place in a dish and cover with tomato sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.

gen-bife-de-lomo-con-salsa-de-pimienta.title: Beef tenderloin with peppercorn sauce
gen-bife-de-lomo-con-salsa-de-pimienta.tip: Rest the meat 3 minutes before slicing.
steps: Salt the steaks and sear in a hot skillet.
Remove them and make the sauce with cream and pepper.
Cook the sauce 3 minutes.
Pour it over the steaks.

gen-carne-al-horno-con-cebolla-y-papas.title: Roast beef with onions and potatoes
gen-carne-al-horno-con-cebolla-y-papas.tip: Cover it with foil so it doesn't dry out.
steps: Salt the beef and place in a dish with onion rings.
Surround with potato wedges and oil.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F (180°C) for 60 minutes.
Uncover and brown 15 minutes more.

gen-carne-a-la-pizza.title: Pizza-style beef
gen-carne-a-la-pizza.tip: Use thin steaks so they cook quickly.
steps: Brown the salted steaks in a skillet.
Move to a dish and cover with tomato sauce.
Add mozzarella and oregano.
Broil 10 minutes.

gen-carne-con-arvejas.title: Beef with peas
gen-carne-con-arvejas.tip: Add the peas at the end so they don't fall apart.
steps: Brown the cubed beef with onion.
Add the tomato and water to cover.
Cook covered 40 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 10 minutes more.

gen-estofado-de-carne-con-zanahorias-y-a.title: Beef stew with carrots and peas
gen-estofado-de-carne-con-zanahorias-y-a.tip: Cook over low heat so the beef turns out tender.
steps: Brown the cubed beef.
Add the onion, carrot and crushed tomato.
Add water and cook covered 45 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 10 minutes.

gen-peceto-al-horno-con-verduras.title: Roasted eye round with vegetables
gen-peceto-al-horno-con-verduras.tip: Slice it thin against the grain.
steps: Salt the eye round and brown in a skillet.
Place in a dish with potatoes and onions.
Drizzle with oil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 50 minutes.
Rest and slice.

gen-roast-beef-con-salsa.title: Roast beef with gravy
gen-roast-beef-con-salsa.summary: With a sauce from its juices.
steps: Salt and brown the roast beef in a skillet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 40 minutes.
Rest and slice thin.
Mix the juices with a little broth for the sauce.

gen-bola-de-lomo-a-la-cacerola.title: Pot-roasted top round
gen-bola-de-lomo-a-la-cacerola.tip: Cook it covered and without hurrying.
steps: Salt the top round and brown on all sides.
Add the onion, carrot and bell pepper.
Add wine and water to halfway.
Cover and cook 90 minutes over low heat.

gen-budin-de-carne-con-huevo.title: Meatloaf with egg
gen-budin-de-carne-con-huevo.summary: With a hard-boiled egg in the center.
gen-budin-de-carne-con-huevo.tip: Place the egg right in the middle for neater slices.
steps: Mix the ground beef with the breadcrumbs, onion and raw egg.
Put half in a loaf pan, add hard-boiled eggs and cover with the rest.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 50 minutes.
Let it rest 10 minutes before slicing.

gen-costillas-de-cerdo-al-horno-con-barb.title: Oven-baked pork ribs with barbecue sauce
gen-costillas-de-cerdo-al-horno-con-barb.tip: Cook them covered at first so they turn out tender.
steps: Salt the ribs and coat with barbecue sauce.
Cover with foil and bake at 340°F (170°C) for 90 minutes.
Uncover and brown 15 minutes more.
Serve hot, with extra sauce.

gen-bondiola-al-horno-con-miel-y-mostaza.title: Honey mustard roast pork shoulder
gen-bondiola-al-horno-con-miel-y-mostaza.tip: Turn it halfway and brush with the glaze.
steps: Mix the honey with the mustard.
Salt the pork shoulder and brush with the mixture.
Cover with foil and bake at 340°F (170°C) for 90 minutes.
Uncover and brown 20 minutes.

gen-cerdo-a-la-mostaza-con-arroz.title: Mustard pork
gen-cerdo-a-la-mostaza-con-arroz.tip: Don't overcook it: it should stay juicy.
steps: Cut the pork into cubes and brown.
Add the cream and the mustard.
Cook 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

gen-solomillo-de-cerdo-con-salsa-de-manz.title: Pork tenderloin with apple sauce
gen-solomillo-de-cerdo-con-salsa-de-manz.tip: Brown the meat well to seal in the juices.
steps: Salt the tenderloin and brown in a skillet.
Cook it in the oven 15 minutes at 350°F (180°C).
Cook the apple with butter and water until it falls apart.
Serve sliced, with the sauce.

gen-chorizo-con-papas-y-pimientos.title: Chorizo with potatoes and peppers
steps: Cook the pricked chorizos in a skillet.
Add the sliced potatoes and the bell pepper strips.
Salt and cook covered 20 minutes.
Turn them from time to time until golden.

gen-salchichas-con-salsa-de-tomate.title: Sausages in tomato sauce
gen-salchichas-con-salsa-de-tomate.tip: Slice them so they absorb more sauce.
steps: Slice the sausages.
Brown them with the onion.
Add the tomato sauce and cook 10 minutes.
Serve piping hot.

gen-merluza-al-horno-con-papas-y-tomate.title: Baked hake with potatoes and tomato
gen-merluza-al-horno-con-papas-y-tomate.tip: Put the potatoes underneath: they cook in the juices.
steps: Slice the potatoes and tomatoes.
Layer in a dish with oil.
Place the salted fillets on top.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-merluza-al-limon.title: Lemon hake
gen-merluza-al-limon.tip: Don't move it much while cooking.
steps: Salt the fillets and dredge in flour.
Brown in a skillet with butter.
Add the lemon juice.
Serve with parsley.

gen-filet-de-pescado-con-crema-de-verdeo.title: Fish with creamy scallion sauce
gen-filet-de-pescado-con-crema-de-verdeo.tip: Add the cream at the end so it doesn't split.
steps: Brown the salted fish in a skillet.
Sauté the scallions in another.
Add the cream and cook 5 minutes.
Cover the fish with the sauce.

gen-pescado-en-salsa-de-tomate.title: Fish in tomato sauce
gen-pescado-en-salsa-de-tomate.tip: Add the fish once the sauce has thickened.
steps: Sauté the garlic and the crushed tomato.
Cook the sauce 15 minutes.
Add the fillets and cook 8 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

gen-tarta-de-pescado.title: Fish tart
gen-tarta-de-pescado.tip: Flake the fish well so no bones remain.
steps: Boil the hake and flake it.
Sauté the onion and mix with the fish and eggs.
Line a tart pan with the dough and pour in the filling.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-atun-sellado-con-sesamo.title: Sesame-seared tuna
gen-atun-sellado-con-sesamo.tip: Sear it over high heat and for just seconds.
steps: Coat the tuna with sesame seeds.
Sear 1 minute per side in a very hot skillet.
Slice it thin.
Serve with soy sauce.

gen-salmon-en-papillote-con-limon.title: Salmon en papillote with lemon
gen-salmon-en-papillote-con-limon.tip: Seal the paper well so the steam doesn't escape.
steps: Place the salmon on parchment with lemon slices.
Add salt, oil and parsley.
Close the packet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 18 minutes.

gen-calamares-en-salsa.title: Squid in sauce
gen-calamares-en-salsa.tip: Cook squid either very briefly or long, never in between.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic.
Add the crushed tomato and the wine.
Add the squid and cook 30 minutes.
Season with parsley.

gen-bacalao-con-papas.title: Cod with potatoes
gen-bacalao-con-papas.tip: Soak the cod 24 hours ahead, changing the water.
steps: Boil the potatoes in slices.
Cook the soaked cod and flake it.
Mix with sautéed onion and olives.
Finish with chopped hard-boiled egg.

gen-camarones-con-arroz.title: Shrimp with rice
gen-camarones-con-arroz.tip: Cook the shrimp only at the end.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic.
Add the rice and the chopped tomato.
Pour in the broth and cook 15 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 3 minutes.

gen-fideos-con-salsa-de-hongos.title: Noodles in mushroom sauce
gen-fideos-con-salsa-de-hongos.tip: Brown the mushrooms well before adding the cream.
steps: Boil the noodles in salted water.
Sauté the mushrooms with the garlic in oil.
Add the cream and cook 5 minutes.
Toss with the noodles and serve.

gen-tallarines-con-crema-y-panceta.title: Tagliatelle with cream and bacon
gen-tallarines-con-crema-y-panceta.tip: Brown the bacon without oil: it renders its own fat.
steps: Boil the tagliatelle in salted water.
Brown the diced bacon.
Add the cream and cook 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and the grated cheese.

gen-fideos-con-atun-y-aceitunas.title: Pasta with tuna and olives
gen-fideos-con-atun-y-aceitunas.tip: Drain the tuna well so the sauce isn't oily.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the garlic and the crushed tomato.
Add the tuna and the olives.
Toss with the pasta.

gen-spaghetti-al-ajo-y-aceite.title: Spaghetti with garlic and oil
gen-spaghetti-al-ajo-y-aceite.tip: Brown the garlic only lightly: burnt, it turns bitter.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
Brown the sliced garlic in oil over low heat.
Drain the pasta and toss it with the oil.
Finish with parsley and chili flakes.

gen-fideos-con-pollo-y-brocoli.title: Pasta with chicken and broccoli
gen-fideos-con-pollo-y-brocoli.tip: Add the broccoli to the pasta water for the last 3 minutes.
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes and brown it.
Boil the pasta and the broccoli together.
Toss with the chicken, garlic and a drizzle of oil.
Serve hot.

gen-monitos-con-salsa-de-queso.title: Bow-tie pasta with cheese sauce
gen-monitos-con-salsa-de-queso.tip: Add the cheese off the heat so it doesn't split.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Warm the milk with the butter and the chopped cheese.
Stir until melted.
Toss with the pasta.

gen-noquis-a-la-sorrentina.title: Gnocchi sorrentina
steps: Boil the gnocchi until they float.
Toss them with the tomato sauce.
Move to a dish and cover with mozzarella.
Broil in the oven 10 minutes.

gen-noquis-con-salsa-de-tomate-y-albahac.title: Gnocchi with tomato and basil sauce
gen-noquis-con-salsa-de-tomate-y-albahac.tip: Add the basil off the heat so it doesn't darken.
steps: Boil the gnocchi until they float.
Warm the tomato sauce with garlic.
Toss the gnocchi with the sauce.
Finish with basil and grated cheese.

gen-lasana-de-pollo-y-espinaca.title: Chicken and spinach lasagna
gen-lasana-de-pollo-y-espinaca.tip: Let it rest 10 minutes before cutting.
steps: Cook the shredded chicken with the spinach and garlic.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Layer sheets, filling and sauce.
Top with cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-canelones-de-carne.title: Beef cannelloni
gen-canelones-de-carne.tip: Fill them with a piping bag to go faster.
steps: Cook the ground beef with onion and salt.
Fill the crêpes or sheets and roll them up.
Place in a dish with tomato sauce.
Top with cheese and broil 20 minutes.

gen-macarrones-gratinados-con-jamon.title: Baked macaroni with ham
gen-macarrones-gratinados-con-jamon.tip: Cook the pasta just al dente: it finishes in the oven.
steps: Boil the macaroni.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Toss with the chopped ham and the sauce.
Top with cheese and broil 15 minutes.

gen-fideos-al-verdeo-con-queso.title: Scallion pasta with cheese
gen-fideos-al-verdeo-con-queso.tip: Use only the green part for a milder flavor.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Sauté the scallions in butter.
Add the cream and toss with the pasta.
Finish with grated cheese.

gen-porotos-con-pasta.title: Beans with pasta
gen-porotos-con-pasta.tip: Add a little water if it gets too thick.
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and tomato.
Add the cooked beans and water.
Cook 15 minutes and add the short pasta.
Cook 10 minutes more.

gen-polenta-con-salsa-de-hongos.title: Polenta with mushroom sauce
gen-polenta-con-salsa-de-hongos.tip: Always stir the polenta in the same direction.
steps: Cook the polenta with water and salt until thick.
Sauté the mushrooms with onion and garlic.
Add the cream.
Serve the polenta with the sauce.

gen-polenta-con-queso-y-huevo.title: Polenta with cheese and egg
gen-polenta-con-queso-y-huevo.tip: Leave the yolk slightly runny so it works as a sauce.
steps: Cook the polenta with water and salt.
Add the cheese and the butter.
Fry the eggs.
Serve the polenta with the egg on top.

gen-arroz-con-pollo-y-morrones.title: Chicken rice with bell peppers
steps: Brown the chicken pieces.
Sauté the onion and bell peppers.
Add the rice and the hot broth.
Cook covered 20 minutes.

gen-arroz-con-atun.title: Rice with tuna
gen-arroz-con-atun.tip: Mix in the tuna at the end so it doesn't fall apart.
steps: Boil the rice in salted water.
Sauté the onion and tomato.
Add the drained tuna.
Toss with the rice.

gen-arroz-con-chorizo.title: Rice with chorizo
gen-arroz-con-chorizo.tip: Brown the chorizo so it renders its fat.
steps: Brown the sliced chorizo.
Sauté the onion and bell pepper.
Add the rice and the broth.
Cook covered 18 minutes and add the peas.

gen-risotto-de-pollo-y-champinones.title: Chicken and mushroom risotto
gen-risotto-de-pollo-y-champinones.tip: Add the hot broth a ladle at a time.
steps: Sauté the chicken and mushrooms and set aside.
Sauté the onion and the rice.
Add the broth a ladle at a time for 18 minutes.
Toss with the chicken and the cheese.

gen-arroz-con-verduras-al-horno.title: Baked rice with vegetables
gen-arroz-con-verduras-al-horno.tip: Cover it with foil so the rice hydrates.
steps: Mix the rice with the cut vegetables in a dish.
Add the hot broth and oil.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-paella-de-mariscos.title: Seafood paella
gen-paella-de-mariscos.tip: Don't stir the rice once it boils.
steps: Sauté the onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add the rice, paprika and broth.
Add the seafood and cook 18 minutes.
Let it rest 5 minutes.

gen-guiso-de-arroz-con-verduras.title: Rice and vegetable stew
gen-guiso-de-arroz-con-verduras.tip: Add water if it gets too thick.
steps: Sauté the onion, bell pepper and carrot.
Add the tomato and the rice.
Add water and cook 20 minutes.
Season with salt and paprika.

gen-lentejas-con-arroz-y-chorizo.title: Lentils with rice and chorizo
gen-lentejas-con-arroz-y-chorizo.tip: Soak the lentils a while so they cook faster.
steps: Brown the chorizo and the onion.
Add the lentils and water to cover.
Cook 25 minutes and add the rice.
Cook 15 minutes more.

gen-guiso-de-porotos-con-verduras.title: Bean and vegetable stew
gen-guiso-de-porotos-con-verduras.tip: Cook it slowly so the beans turn out creamy.
steps: Sauté the onion and bell pepper.
Add the diced pumpkin and potato.
Add the cooked beans and water.
Cook 25 minutes.

gen-garbanzos-con-chorizo.title: Chickpeas with chorizo
gen-garbanzos-con-chorizo.tip: Add the paprika off the heat so it doesn't turn bitter.
steps: Brown the chorizo with the onion.
Add the cooked chickpeas and the tomato.
Add the paprika and a little water.
Cook 20 minutes.

gen-torta-de-chocolate-con-dulce-de-lech.title: Chocolate cake with dulce de leche
gen-torta-de-chocolate-con-dulce-de-lech.tip: Let the cake cool before filling it.
steps: Mix the flour with the cocoa, sugar and baking powder.
Add the eggs, milk and oil.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes.
Cut it in half and fill with dulce de leche.

gen-brownie-con-helado.title: Brownie with ice cream
gen-brownie-con-helado.tip: Serve it warm so the ice cream melts slightly.
steps: Melt the chocolate with the butter.
Mix with the sugar, eggs and flour.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 25 minutes.
Serve with a scoop of ice cream.

gen-helado-casero-de-frutilla.title: Homemade strawberry ice cream
gen-helado-casero-de-frutilla.tip: Freeze the strawberries first for a firmer ice cream.
steps: Blend the frozen strawberries with the yogurt and honey.
Process until creamy.
Serve right away or freeze 30 minutes.
Serve in glasses with a strawberry on top.

gen-crumble-de-manzana-y-avena.title: Apple oat crumble
gen-crumble-de-manzana-y-avena.tip: Serve it warm, with vanilla ice cream.
steps: Cut the apples and mix with cinnamon and sugar.
Mix the oats with the flour and cold butter into crumbs.
Cover the apples with the topping.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-panqueques-con-frutillas-y-crema.title: Crêpes with strawberries and cream
gen-panqueques-con-frutillas-y-crema.tip: Rest the batter 10 minutes for softer crêpes.
steps: Mix the flour with the eggs and milk.
Cook the crêpes in a skillet with butter.
Fill with strawberries and cream.
Roll up and serve.

gen-tarta-de-frutillas.title: Strawberry tart
steps: Line a tart pan with sweet dough and bake 15 minutes.
Make a cream with milk, eggs, sugar and cornstarch.
Fill the tart with the cream.
Top with strawberries.

gen-tarta-de-limon-y-merengue.title: Lemon meringue tart
gen-tarta-de-limon-y-merengue.tip: Whip the whites to firm peaks.
steps: Line a tart pan with dough and bake 15 minutes.
Cook the lemon juice with condensed milk and yolks.
Top with the whites whipped with sugar.
Broil 10 minutes.

gen-mousse-de-chocolate-y-naranja.title: Chocolate orange mousse
gen-mousse-de-chocolate-y-naranja.tip: Chill it 3 hours so it sets.
steps: Melt the chocolate with orange juice.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold everything together gently.
Chill before serving.

gen-budin-de-zanahoria.title: Carrot loaf cake
gen-budin-de-zanahoria.tip: Grate the carrot finely so it blends in.
steps: Mix the eggs with the sugar and oil.
Add the flour with the baking powder.
Fold in the grated carrot and the cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 45 minutes.

gen-torta-de-naranja.title: Orange cake
steps: Mix the eggs with the sugar and oil.
Add the orange juice and zest.
Add the flour with the baking powder.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-budin-de-pan-con-caramelo.title: Bread pudding with caramel
gen-budin-de-pan-con-caramelo.tip: Caramelize the mold before pouring in the mixture.
steps: Soak the bread in warm milk.
Mix with eggs and sugar.
Pour into a caramelized mold.
Bake in a water bath 50 minutes at 340°F (170°C).

gen-pastafrola-de-batata.title: Sweet potato pastafrola
steps: Mix the flour with the butter, sugar and egg into a dough.
Line a pan and fill with sweet potato paste.
Cover with strips of dough.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-pan-dulce-casero.title: Homemade panettone-style sweet bread
gen-pan-dulce-casero.tip: Let the dough rise in a warm place.
steps: Mix the flour with the yeast, sugar and warm milk.
Add the butter and the dried fruit.
Let rise 1 hour and shape.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 40 minutes.

gen-brigadeiros.title: Brigadeiros
gen-brigadeiros.tip: Grease your hands to roll the balls.
steps: Cook the condensed milk with cocoa and butter until it pulls away.
Let it cool.
Roll into balls with greased hands.
Coat in chocolate sprinkles.

gen-tacos-de-pollo-con-guacamole.title: Chicken tacos with guacamole
gen-tacos-de-pollo-con-guacamole.tip: Warm the tortillas dry so they don't tear.
steps: Cook the chicken strips with salt and cumin.
Mash the avocado with lemon, tomato and onion.
Warm the tortillas.
Build the tacos with the chicken and guacamole.

gen-tacos-de-carne-con-cebolla-y-cilantr.title: Beef tacos with onion and cilantro
gen-tacos-de-carne-con-cebolla-y-cilantr.tip: Cut the beef very small so it browns quickly.
steps: Cut the beef into small cubes and salt it.
Brown them in a very hot skillet.
Warm the tortillas.
Build the tacos with beef, chopped onion and cilantro.

gen-enchiladas-de-pollo.title: Chicken enchiladas
gen-enchiladas-de-pollo.tip: Dip the tortillas in the sauce so they don't tear.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken.
Fill the tortillas with chicken and roll them up.
Place in a dish and cover with tomato sauce.
Add cheese and broil 15 minutes.

gen-burritos-de-carne-y-arroz.title: Beef and rice burritos
gen-burritos-de-carne-y-arroz.tip: Don't overfill them so you can close them.
steps: Cook the ground beef with onion and cumin.
Mix with the cooked rice.
Fill the tortillas and fold them closed.
Brown them in a skillet.

gen-nachos-con-queso-y-frijoles.title: Nachos with cheese and beans
gen-nachos-con-queso-y-frijoles.tip: Broil them right before eating so they stay crisp.
steps: Place the nachos in a dish.
Cover with beans and grated cheese.
Broil 8 minutes in the oven.
Serve with salsa and avocado.

gen-tacos-al-pastor-de-cerdo.title: Pork tacos al pastor
gen-tacos-al-pastor-de-cerdo.tip: Marinate the meat ahead for more flavor.
steps: Cut the pork into thin strips and marinate with garlic and paprika.
Brown in a hot skillet 8 minutes.
Add pineapple chunks and onion.
Build the tacos with warm tortillas.

gen-quesadillas-de-pollo.title: Chicken quesadillas
gen-quesadillas-de-pollo.tip: Use medium heat so the cheese melts.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken.
Place chicken and cheese on a tortilla.
Cover with another and brown in a skillet.
Cut into triangles.

gen-arepas-con-carne-mechada.title: Arepas with shredded beef
gen-arepas-con-carne-mechada.tip: Cook the beef until it falls apart on its own.
steps: Boil the beef with onion until it shreds.
Sauté it with tomato and paprika.
Make the arepas with cornmeal and water.
Fill them with the beef.

gen-pabellon-de-pollo.title: Chicken pabellón
gen-pabellon-de-pollo.tip: Serve it with fried plantain if you like.
steps: Cook the shredded chicken with onion and tomato.
Cook the black beans with cumin.
Boil the rice.
Serve everything together on a plate.

gen-arroz-con-frijoles-negros-y-platano.title: Rice with black beans and plantain
gen-arroz-con-frijoles-negros-y-platano.tip: Brown the plantain well so it caramelizes.
steps: Boil the rice.
Cook the beans with garlic and cumin.
Fry the sliced plantain.
Serve everything together.

gen-empanadas-de-carne-al-horno-estilo-c.title: Baked Creole-style beef empanadas
gen-empanadas-de-carne-al-horno-estilo-c.tip: Let the filling cool before assembling.
steps: Sauté the onion with the ground beef and cumin.
Add the chopped hard-boiled egg and olives.
Fill the dough rounds and seal.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.

gen-locro-de-maiz-y-zapallo.title: Corn and pumpkin locro
gen-locro-de-maiz-y-zapallo.tip: Soak the corn from the night before.
steps: Boil the corn with the beans until tender.
Add the pumpkin, chorizo and bacon.
Cook 40 minutes over low heat.
Serve with hot sauce.

gen-choripan-con-chimichurri.title: Chorizo sandwich with chimichurri
gen-choripan-con-chimichurri.tip: Butterfly the chorizo so it cooks evenly.
steps: Cook the chorizos on a griddle or grill.
Mix parsley, garlic, oregano, oil and vinegar.
Fill the rolls with the chorizo.
Top with chimichurri.

gen-provoleta-con-tomate-y-oregano.title: Provolone with tomato and oregano
gen-provoleta-con-tomate-y-oregano.tip: Cook the provolone over medium heat without moving it.
steps: Put the provolone in a hot skillet.
Brown 2 minutes per side.
Top with diced tomato.
Finish with oregano.

gen-revuelto-de-papas-y-chorizo.title: Potato and chorizo scramble
gen-revuelto-de-papas-y-chorizo.tip: Cook the potatoes first so they're tender.
steps: Boil the diced potatoes.
Brown the sliced chorizo.
Add the potatoes and the beaten eggs.
Stir until set.

gen-sandwich-de-vacio-y-provoleta.title: Flank steak and provolone sandwich
steps: Cook the beef on a griddle.
Slice it thin.
Build the sandwiches with provolone and tomato.
Warm them so the cheese melts.

gen-pizza-de-muzzarella-casera.title: Mozzarella pizza with homemade dough
gen-pizza-de-muzzarella-casera.tip: Let the dough rise well before stretching.
steps: Mix the flour with the yeast and warm water and knead.
Let rise 40 minutes and stretch it out.
Top with sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 450°F (230°C) for 15 minutes.

gen-faina-con-muzzarella.title: Chickpea flatbread with mozzarella
steps: Mix the chickpea flour with water, salt and oil.
Let it rest.
Pour into an oiled pan.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) 20 minutes and top with mozzarella.

gen-tortilla-espanola-con-cebolla.title: Spanish omelet with onion
gen-tortilla-espanola-con-cebolla.tip: Confit the potatoes over low heat so they turn out tender.
steps: Fry the potatoes and the onion in oil.
Mix with the beaten eggs.
Cook in a skillet 4 minutes per side.
Serve warm.

gen-pimientos-del-piquillo-rellenos.title: Stuffed piquillo peppers
gen-pimientos-del-piquillo-rellenos.tip: Use jarred peppers to save time.
steps: Mix the cooked ground beef with cream cheese.
Fill the peppers.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°F (180°C).
Serve warm.

gen-croquetas-de-jamon-caseras.title: Homemade ham croquettes
gen-croquetas-de-jamon-caseras.tip: Chill the dough well before shaping.
steps: Make a thick white sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Add the chopped ham.
Let cool, shape croquettes and coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden.

gen-gazpacho-de-remolacha.title: Beet gazpacho
gen-gazpacho-de-remolacha.tip: Chill it 2 hours for more flavor.
steps: Process the cooked beet with the tomato.
Add garlic, cucumber, oil and vinegar.
Process until creamy.
Serve well chilled.

gen-pisto-manchego-con-huevo.title: Manchego pisto with egg
steps: Sauté the onion and bell pepper.
Add the zucchini and tomato.
Cook 25 minutes over low heat.
Serve with fried eggs.

gen-moussaka-de-berenjenas.title: Eggplant moussaka
gen-moussaka-de-berenjenas.tip: Brown the eggplant so it doesn't soak up oil.
steps: Brown the eggplant slices.
Cook the ground beef with tomato.
Alternate layers and cover with white sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes.

gen-souvlaki-de-cerdo.title: Pork souvlaki
gen-souvlaki-de-cerdo.tip: Cut the pork into even cubes so it cooks evenly.
steps: Marinate the pork with garlic, lemon and oregano.
Thread the skewers.
Cook them on a griddle 12 minutes.
Serve in pita with tzatziki.

gen-ensalada-griega-con-queso-feta.title: Greek salad with feta
gen-ensalada-griega-con-queso-feta.tip: Add the feta last so it doesn't fall apart.
steps: Cut the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Add olives and cubed feta.
Dress with oil, oregano and salt.
Serve in a dish.

gen-falafel-con-salsa-de-yogur.title: Falafel with yogurt sauce
gen-falafel-con-salsa-de-yogur.tip: Use soaked raw chickpeas for a firmer falafel.
steps: Process the chickpeas with onion, garlic and parsley.
Shape into balls and fry.
Mix the yogurt with lemon and garlic.
Serve with the sauce.

gen-kebab-de-carne-con-ensalada.title: Beef kebab with salad
gen-kebab-de-carne-con-ensalada.tip: Marinate it ahead so it turns out tender.
steps: Mix the ground beef with onion, garlic and spices.
Shape into sticks and cook on a griddle.
Serve in pita with salad.
Serve with yogurt.

gen-curry-de-pollo-con-leche-de-coco.title: Chicken curry with coconut milk
gen-curry-de-pollo-con-leche-de-coco.tip: Let the curry toast for a minute.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic with the curry.
Add the cubed chicken and brown it.
Add the coconut milk and cook 20 minutes.
Serve with rice.

gen-arroz-frito-estilo-chino.title: Chinese-style fried rice
gen-arroz-frito-estilo-chino.tip: Use cold rice from the day before so it stays loose.
steps: Scramble the eggs in a skillet and remove.
Stir-fry the carrot and peas.
Add the rice and the soy sauce.
Add the egg and toss.

gen-sopa-de-fideos-y-huevo-estilo-orient.title: Asian-style noodle and egg soup
gen-sopa-de-fideos-y-huevo-estilo-orient.tip: Add the beaten egg in a thin stream so it forms ribbons.
steps: Heat the broth with the soy sauce.
Add the noodles and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream.
Finish with scallion.

gen-pad-thai-de-pollo.title: Chicken pad thai
gen-pad-thai-de-pollo.tip: Stir everything quickly over high heat.
steps: Soak the rice noodles.
Stir-fry the chicken with garlic.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and egg.
Finish with peanuts and lemon.

gen-bao-de-cerdo-desmenuzado.title: Pulled pork bao
gen-bao-de-cerdo-desmenuzado.tip: Cook the pork slowly until it falls apart.
steps: Cook the pork with soy sauce and honey 90 minutes.
Shred it.
Warm the buns by steaming.
Fill them with the pork and cucumber.

gen-tostadas-de-ricota-con-miel-y-nueces.title: Ricotta toast with honey and walnuts
gen-tostadas-de-ricota-con-miel-y-nueces.tip: Toast the walnuts 2 minutes to bring out the aroma.
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with ricotta.
Drizzle with honey.
Finish with chopped walnuts.

gen-pan-de-ajo-casero.title: Homemade garlic bread
gen-pan-de-ajo-casero.tip: Spread it over the entire surface so it doesn't dry out.
steps: Mix softened butter with garlic and parsley.
Split the baguettes lengthwise.
Spread with the mixture.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) 10 minutes.

gen-sopa-de-lima.title: Lime soup
gen-sopa-de-lima.tip: Add the lime when serving so it doesn't turn bitter.
steps: Boil the chicken with onion and garlic.
Shred it and return it to the broth.
Add the lime juice.
Serve with fried tortilla strips.

gen-ceviche-de-camarones.title: Shrimp ceviche
gen-ceviche-de-camarones.tip: Serve it right away so it doesn't turn rubbery.
steps: Cook the shrimp 2 minutes and cool them.
Mix with lime juice.
Add red onion, cilantro and tomato.
Let it rest 10 minutes.

gen-pollo-en-pepitoria.title: Chicken in pepitoria sauce
gen-pollo-en-pepitoria.tip: Grind the almonds to thicken the sauce.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces.
Add onion and white wine.
Add ground almonds and water.
Cook 35 minutes over low heat.

gen-fabada-rapida.title: Quick fabada
gen-fabada-rapida.tip: Cook slowly so it turns creamy.
steps: Sauté the onion with the chorizo and bacon.
Add the cooked beans and water.
Cook 35 minutes over low heat.
Serve piping hot.

gen-huevos-al-horno-con-espinaca.title: Baked eggs with spinach
gen-huevos-al-horno-con-espinaca.tip: Cook until the white is set and the yolk stays runny.
steps: Sauté the spinach with garlic and divide it among ramekins.
Make a well and crack an egg into each one.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.

ec-churrasco-ecuatoriano.title: Ecuadorian churrasco
ec-churrasco-ecuatoriano.summary: Steak with egg, rice and potatoes.
ec-churrasco-ecuatoriano.tip: Brown the steak well and serve it with a runny-yolk egg.
steps: Salt the steak and cook it on a hot griddle.
Fry the eggs and the potatoes.
Boil the rice.
Serve everything together with a tomato and onion salad.

ec-guatita.title: Ecuadorian guatita
ec-guatita.tip: Boiling the tripe with lemon removes the strong smell.
steps: Boil the tripe with lemon and salt until tender.
Sauté the onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add the potatoes, the tripe and ground peanuts with a little milk.
Cook 20 minutes until thick.

ec-menestra-de-lentejas-con-arroz.title: Lentil menestra with rice
ec-menestra-de-lentejas-con-arroz.tip: Make the sofrito slowly: that's where the flavor is.
steps: Boil the lentils until tender.
Make a sofrito with onion, garlic, tomato and cumin.
Mix it into the lentils and let it thicken.
Serve with white rice.

ec-hornado-de-cerdo.title: Ecuadorian hornado
ec-hornado-de-cerdo.summary: Roast pork marinated in garlic and beer.
ec-hornado-de-cerdo.tip: Marinate it the night before for more flavor.
steps: Marinate the pork with garlic, cumin, salt and beer.
Cover with foil and bake at 340°F (170°C) for 100 minutes.
Uncover and brown 30 minutes more.
Slice and serve with its juices.

bo-saice.title: Bolivian saice
bo-saice.tip: Control the chili: adjust it to the heat you prefer.
steps: Sauté the onion with the ground chili and garlic.
Add the ground beef and cook until dry.
Add the peas and the diced potato.
Cook with a little water until thick.

bo-fricase-pacenio.title: Fricasé paceño
bo-fricase-pacenio.summary: Pork soup with yellow chili and corn.
bo-fricase-pacenio.tip: Serve it very hot, as in La Paz.
steps: Boil the pork with onion and garlic until tender.
Add the yellow chili and oregano.
Add the potatoes and the corn.
Cook 20 minutes more.

bo-charquekan.title: Charquekan
bo-charquekan.summary: Dried beef with potato, corn and egg.
bo-charquekan.tip: If you use jerky, soak it first to remove the salt.
steps: Boil and shred the dried beef.
Brown it in a skillet with onion and garlic.
Serve with boiled potatoes and corn.
Top with a fried egg and fresh cheese.

bo-sandwich-de-chola.title: Sándwich de chola
bo-sandwich-de-chola.tip: Slice the pork into thin strips.
steps: Roast the salted pork until very tender.
Slice it.
Build the sandwiches with onion and chili.
Serve hot.

uy-asado-de-tira.title: Uruguayan short ribs
uy-asado-de-tira.tip: Cook it slowly at a low temperature.
steps: Salt the short ribs.
Cover with foil and bake at 320°F (160°C) for 100 minutes.
Uncover and brown 25 minutes at 425°F (220°C).
Cut between the bones and serve.

uy-falso-conejo.title: Falso conejo
uy-falso-conejo.summary: Beef roll stuffed with egg and bacon.
uy-falso-conejo.tip: Tie it well so it doesn't open while cooking.
steps: Open the beef into one strip and salt it.
Fill with hard-boiled egg, bacon and bell pepper.
Roll it up, tie it and brown it.
Cook covered with broth for 60 minutes.

uy-buenuelos-de-acelga.title: Swiss chard fritters
uy-buenuelos-de-acelga.tip: Drain the chard well so the batter isn't runny.
steps: Boil and chop the chard, drain it very well.
Mix with egg, flour and grated cheese.
Fry spoonfuls of batter in hot oil.
Drain on paper towels.

py-albondigas-paraguayas.title: Paraguayan meatballs
py-albondigas-paraguayas.tip: Wet your hands to shape them without sticking.
steps: Mix the ground beef with onion, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shape into meatballs.
Cook them in tomato sauce 25 minutes.
Serve with boiled cassava.

py-vori-vori.title: Vori vori
py-vori-vori.summary: Soup with corn and cheese dumplings.
py-vori-vori.tip: Keep the dumplings small so they cook fast.
steps: Boil the chicken with onion and bell pepper.
Mix the corn flour with grated cheese and water.
Shape into small balls.
Cook them in the soup 15 minutes.

ec-cebiche-de-camaron.title: Ecuadorian shrimp cebiche
ec-cebiche-de-camaron.tip: Serve it very cold with toasted corn.
steps: Cook the shrimp 2 minutes and cool them.
Mix lime and orange juice with tomato.
Add red onion and cilantro.
Toss with the shrimp and rest 15 minutes.

py-kiveve.title: Kiveve
py-kiveve.summary: Pumpkin mash with cheese and corn.
py-kiveve.tip: Stir constantly so it doesn't stick.
steps: Boil the pumpkin in chunks until tender.
Mash it and move to the pot.
Stir in the corn flour.
Add the cubed cheese.

py-chipa-so-o.title: Chipa so'o
py-chipa-so-o.tip: Rest the dough before rolling it out.
steps: Mix the tapioca starch with cheese and egg.
Sauté the ground beef with onion and cumin.
Fill small balls of dough with the meat.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes.

do-catibias.title: Dominican catibías
do-catibias.tip: Squeeze the grated cassava well so it isn't watery.
steps: Grate the cassava and squeeze it well.
Sauté the ground beef with onion.
Fill small dough balls with the beef.
Fry until golden.

do-moro-de-guandules.title: Moro de guandules
