do-moro-de-guandules.summary: Rice with pigeon peas and sofrito.
do-moro-de-guandules.tip: Let the moro rest covered a few minutes.
steps: Make a sofrito with onion, garlic and tomato.
Add the rice and the peas.
Cover with water and cook covered.
Stir and serve.

cu-bistec-empanizado.title: Cuban breaded steak
cu-bistec-empanizado.tip: Pound the steaks well so they come out thin.
steps: Pound the steaks and season with lime.
Dip in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden.
Serve with lime.

do-pastelon-de-platano-maduro.title: Pastelón de plátano maduro
do-pastelon-de-platano-maduro.tip: Fry the plantain until well browned.
steps: Fry ripe plantain slices.
Cook the ground beef with sofrito.
Layer in a dish with cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

cu-picadillo-a-la-cubana.title: Cuban picadillo
cu-picadillo-a-la-cubana.tip: The sweet-and-sour touch comes from the raisins.
steps: Sauté the onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add the ground beef and cook.
Add tomato, olives and raisins.
Cook 15 minutes over low heat.

cu-vaca-frita.title: Vaca frita
cu-vaca-frita.tip: Brown it until crisp at the edges.
steps: Boil the beef until it shreds.
Marinate it with lime, garlic and salt.
Sauté in a skillet with onion until browned.
Serve hot.

cu-congri.title: Cuban congrí
cu-congri.tip: Cook the rice with the beans' cooking liquid.
steps: Cook the beans with garlic and cumin.
Sauté onion and bell pepper with bacon.
Add rice and broth.
Cook covered 20 minutes.

cu-boliche-mechado.title: Boliche mechado
steps: Stuff the beef with chorizo and garlic.
Brown it all over.
Cook it with onion, tomato and wine.
Cook covered 100 minutes.

cl-completo-chileno.title: Chilean completo
cl-completo-chileno.summary: Hot dog with avocado and tomato.
steps: Boil the sausages.
Toast the hot dog buns.
Build with sausage, avocado and tomato.
Finish with mayonnaise.

cl-pan-amasado.title: Pan amasado
cl-pan-amasado.tip: Knead it well so it turns out soft.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt and warm water.
Knead 10 minutes.
Let rise 1 hour and shape into rolls.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 25 minutes.

cl-lentejas-chilenas.title: Chilean lentils
cl-lentejas-chilenas.tip: Add pumpkin to thicken the broth.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and garlic.
Add the lentils and diced pumpkin.
Cover with water and cook 35 minutes.
Season with cumin.

cl-mote-con-huesillo.title: Mote con huesillo
cl-mote-con-huesillo.tip: Serve it very cold in summer.
steps: Boil the dried peaches with sugar and cinnamon.
Let them cool in the syrup.
Cook the wheat berries until tender.
Serve the wheat with the peaches and syrup.

co-calentado-paisa.title: Calentado paisa
co-calentado-paisa.tip: Use rice and beans from the day before.
steps: Warm the rice with the beans in a skillet.
Add chopped onion.
Fry the eggs.
Serve everything together.

co-patacones-con-hogao.title: Patacones with hogao
co-patacones-con-hogao.tip: Flatten the plantains with a board and fry again.
steps: Fry slices of green plantain.
Flatten them and fry again until golden.
Make the hogao with tomato and onion.
Serve with the sauce.

co-arroz-con-coco.title: Coconut rice
co-arroz-con-coco.tip: Use full-fat coconut milk for more flavor.
steps: Cook the rice with coconut milk and water.
Add sugar, raisins and salt.
Cook covered until absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes.

co-almojabanas.title: Almojábanas
steps: Mix the grated cheese with the corn flour.
Add egg and milk and form a dough.
Shape into small rolls.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.

pe-causa-limena.title: Causa limeña
pe-causa-limena.summary: Yellow potato with chicken and avocado.
steps: Mash the potato with lime and oil.
Mix the chicken with mayonnaise.
Layer potato, chicken and avocado.
Chill 30 minutes.

pe-anticuchos-de-pollo.title: Chicken anticuchos
pe-anticuchos-de-pollo.tip: Marinate them for several hours for more flavor.
steps: Marinate the chicken with chili, garlic and vinegar.
Thread the skewers.
Cook them on a griddle.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

pe-aguadito-de-pollo.title: Chicken aguadito
pe-aguadito-de-pollo.tip: The blended cilantro gives it its color.
steps: Blend the cilantro with a little broth.
Sauté the onion and garlic.
Add the chicken, rice and broth.
Add the green sauce and cook 25 minutes.

pe-pollo-a-la-brasa.title: Peruvian rotisserie chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken with garlic, cumin, soy sauce and lemon.
Place in a dish and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 50 minutes.
Turn it halfway.
Serve with fries.

ve-tequenos.title: Tequeños
ve-tequenos.tip: Seal the edges well so the cheese doesn't leak.
steps: Roll out the dough and cut into strips.
Wrap sticks of cheese with the dough.
Seal the edges.
Fry until golden.

ve-mandocas.title: Mandocas
ve-mandocas.tip: Mix well so there are no lumps.
steps: Mix the corn flour with ripe plantain and cheese.
Shape into rings.
Fry until golden.
Serve with cheese.

ve-casabe-con-queso.title: Cassava bread with cheese
ve-casabe-con-queso.tip: It goes well with any stew.
steps: Toast the cassava bread in a skillet.
Top with fresh cheese.
Broil 3 minutes.
Serve hot.

ve-pisca-andina.title: Pisca andina
steps: Heat the broth with the potato and onion.
Cook 15 minutes.
Add the beaten egg.
Finish with cheese and cilantro.

ar-pollo-al-champinon-con-arroz.title: Chicken with mushrooms and rice
ar-pollo-al-champinon-con-arroz.summary: Creamy chicken with mushrooms, served over rice.
ar-pollo-al-champinon-con-arroz.tip: Add the cream at the end so it does not split.
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces and brown it in a skillet with oil.
Add the chopped onion and the sliced mushrooms.
Cook for 10 minutes, then stir in the cream with salt.
Boil the rice and serve the chicken on top.

ar-tarta-de-zapallo-y-cebolla.title: Pumpkin and onion tart
ar-tarta-de-zapallo-y-cebolla.summary: Quick tart with a soft pumpkin and onion filling.
ar-tarta-de-zapallo-y-cebolla.tip: Cook the pumpkin first so the filling is not watery.
steps: Cook the pumpkin in cubes until tender and mash it lightly.
Sauté the thinly sliced onion until golden.
Mix the pumpkin, onion, eggs, cheese and salt.
Pour the filling over the crust and bake for 30 minutes in a medium oven.

ar-fideos-con-salsa-de-berenjenas.title: Pasta with eggplant sauce
ar-fideos-con-salsa-de-berenjenas.summary: Pasta with eggplant, tomato and a touch of garlic.
ar-fideos-con-salsa-de-berenjenas.tip: Salt the eggplant and leave it for 10 minutes to take away the bitterness.
steps: Cut the eggplant into cubes and sauté it in oil until soft.
Add the chopped garlic and the crushed tomatoes.
Simmer the sauce for 15 minutes with salt.
Boil the pasta, drain it and toss it with the sauce.

ar-pastelitos-de-membrillo.title: Quince pastries
ar-pastelitos-de-membrillo.summary: Fried pastries filled with quince paste.
ar-pastelitos-de-membrillo.tip: Prick them with a fork so they do not puff up when frying.
steps: Cut the quince paste into small squares.
Place a square on each dough round and seal the edges well with a fork.
Fry the pastries in hot oil until golden.
Drain them on paper towels and sprinkle with sugar.

ar-sopa-de-calabaza-y-choclo.title: Pumpkin and corn soup
ar-sopa-de-calabaza-y-choclo.summary: Thick, sweet soup with pumpkin and corn kernels.
ar-sopa-de-calabaza-y-choclo.tip: Blend only half so it keeps some small pieces.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until translucent.
Add the cubed pumpkin, the corn kernels and the broth.
Cook for 25 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Blend part of it, stir and season.

mx-tostadas-de-tinga.title: Chicken tinga tostadas
mx-tostadas-de-tinga.summary: Crispy tostadas topped with shredded chicken in tomato and chipotle sauce.
mx-tostadas-de-tinga.tip: Add the tinga right before eating so the tostada does not go soft.
steps: Shred the cooked chicken.
Blend the tomatoes with the chipotle and cook for 10 minutes.
Sauté the sliced onion, add the chicken and the sauce and cook for 10 minutes.
Top the tostadas with the tinga and the sour cream.

mx-flautas-de-pollo.title: Chicken flautas
mx-flautas-de-pollo.summary: Rolled tortillas with chicken, fried until crisp.
mx-flautas-de-pollo.tip: Secure them with a toothpick or fry them seam side down.
steps: Mix the shredded chicken with the chopped onion, the cheese and salt.
Warm the tortillas so they do not break when rolled.
Fill them with the chicken and roll them up tightly.
Fry them in hot oil until golden and crisp.

mx-arroz-verde.title: Green rice
mx-arroz-verde.summary: Rice with parsley, cilantro and poblano, deep green in color.
mx-arroz-verde.tip: Do not lift the lid while it cooks so the rice stays fluffy.
steps: Sauté the rice in oil until it turns translucent.
Blend the cilantro, parsley, onion and garlic with a little broth.
Add the blend and the rest of the broth to the rice.
Cook covered over low heat for 18 minutes with salt.

ar-postre-de-vainillas-con-dulce-de-lech.title: Ladyfinger and dulce de leche dessert
ar-postre-de-vainillas-con-dulce-de-lech.summary: Layers of ladyfingers, dulce de leche and cream, no baking.
ar-postre-de-vainillas-con-dulce-de-lech.tip: Chill it for 4 hours so the ladyfingers soften well.
steps: Mix the dulce de leche with the whipped cream.
Briefly dip the ladyfingers in milk and make a layer in a dish.
Cover with the dulce de leche cream and repeat the layers.
Chill for 4 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.

mx-caldo-tlalpeno.title: Tlalpeño chicken soup
mx-caldo-tlalpeno.summary: Chicken broth with chickpeas, vegetables, chipotle and avocado.
mx-caldo-tlalpeno.tip: Add the chipotle little by little: the broth gets spicier as it simmers.
steps: Simmer the chicken in the broth with the onion for 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.
Add the diced carrots, the chickpeas and the chipotle.
Cook 10 more minutes with salt and serve with avocado.

cl-pantrucas.title: Pantrucas
cl-pantrucas.summary: Chilean soup with pieces of dough, beef and vegetables.
cl-pantrucas.tip: Roll the dough thin and tear it into uneven pieces: they cook faster.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil, add the cubed beef and cover with water; cook for 25 minutes.
Add the diced potato and carrot and cook 10 more minutes.
Mix the flour, egg, salt and a little water into a dough and roll it thin.
Cut or tear the dough into pieces, drop them in the soup and cook for 5 minutes.

cl-pollo-al-jugo-con-arroz-graneado.title: Chicken in its juices with fluffy rice
cl-pollo-al-jugo-con-arroz-graneado.summary: Juicy chicken in its own sauce, with fluffy rice.
cl-pollo-al-jugo-con-arroz-graneado.tip: Sear the chicken well before covering it so the sauce has flavor.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in a pot with oil and salt.
Add the sliced onion, the garlic and the grated carrot.
Cover with a little water and cook covered for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice with garlic and oil until fluffy and serve with the chicken.

co-carne-desmechada-con-arroz.title: Shredded beef with rice
co-carne-desmechada-con-arroz.summary: Boiled and shredded beef in a creole tomato and onion sauce.
co-carne-desmechada-con-arroz.tip: Shred it while it is warm: it pulls apart much better.
steps: Boil the beef in water with half an onion and salt until very tender.
Shred it with two forks.
Make a sofrito with the chopped onion, tomato and pepper and the cumin.
Mix the beef with the sofrito, cook for 10 minutes and serve with rice.

co-platanos-maduros-con-queso.title: Ripe plantains with cheese
co-platanos-maduros-con-queso.summary: Golden ripe plantain filled with melted cheese.
co-platanos-maduros-con-queso.tip: Use very ripe, almost black plantains so they caramelize.
steps: Peel the plantains and slit them lengthwise without cutting all the way through.
Brown them in a skillet with butter until caramelized.
Fill them with strips of cheese.
Cover for 3 minutes so the cheese melts and serve hot.

co-arepa-de-huevo.title: Egg arepa
co-arepa-de-huevo.summary: Fried arepa with an egg cooked inside.
co-arepa-de-huevo.tip: Open the pocket carefully: the egg has to stay sealed in.
steps: Mix the cornmeal with warm water and salt into a soft dough.
Shape 4 thick round arepas and fry until they puff.
Open a pocket in each one, add an egg and seal with a little dough.
Fry again until the egg is cooked and the arepa is golden.

pe-sopa-de-quinua-con-verduras.title: Quinoa and vegetable soup
pe-sopa-de-quinua-con-verduras.summary: Light soup with quinoa, potato and carrot.
pe-sopa-de-quinua-con-verduras.tip: Rinse the quinoa well to remove the bitterness.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until soft.
Add the broth and the well-rinsed quinoa and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the cubed potato and carrot and cook 15 more minutes.
Season and, if you like, stir in a beaten egg at the end.

pe-pollo-saltado-con-arroz.title: Chicken saltado with rice
pe-pollo-saltado-con-arroz.summary: Stir-fried chicken with onion, tomato and soy sauce over high heat.
pe-pollo-saltado-con-arroz.tip: Use a very hot pan and do not overfill it so the vegetables stay crisp.
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and the onion and tomato into wedges.
Stir-fry the chicken in very hot oil until browned.
Add the onion, tomato, soy sauce and vinegar and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Serve over freshly cooked rice.

ve-quesillo.title: Quesillo
ve-quesillo.summary: Creamy Venezuelan flan with caramel and condensed milk.
ve-quesillo.tip: Cook it covered in a water bath so it has no bubbles.
steps: Make a caramel with the sugar and coat the bottom of a mold.
Blend the condensed milk, milk, eggs and vanilla.
Pour the mixture into the mold, cover with foil and cook in a water bath for 50 minutes.
Let it cool, chill it and unmold it cold.

ve-patacon-con-queso-y-jamon.title: Patacón with cheese and ham
ve-patacon-con-queso-y-jamon.summary: Sandwich of fried green plantain with cheese and ham.
ve-patacon-con-queso-y-jamon.tip: Flatten the plantains firmly and fry them twice so they get crisp.
steps: Peel the plantains and cut them into thick slices.
Fry them for 3 minutes, flatten them and fry again until golden.
Lightly salt them and build a sandwich with two patacones per serving.
Fill with cheese and ham and serve hot.

uy-pollo-al-horno-con-boniato.title: Roast chicken with sweet potato
uy-pollo-al-horno-con-boniato.summary: Golden roast chicken with tender sweet potatoes and onion.
uy-pollo-al-horno-con-boniato.tip: Baste the chicken with its juices halfway through so it stays moist.
steps: Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into thick slices; cut the onion into wedges.
Put everything in a baking dish with the chicken, garlic, oil, salt and rosemary.
Bake for 60 minutes at 400 °F.
Baste with the juices halfway through and serve.

ec-sopa-de-bolas-de-verde.title: Green plantain ball soup
ec-sopa-de-bolas-de-verde.summary: Broth with green plantain balls filled with cheese.
ec-sopa-de-bolas-de-verde.tip: Oil your hands to shape the balls without them sticking.
steps: Boil the peeled plantains until tender and mash them with salt.
Shape balls, open them, add a cube of cheese and close them.
Heat the broth with the chopped onion and oil.
Add the balls and cook for 10 minutes; serve with cilantro.

cu-fricase-de-pollo.title: Cuban chicken fricassee
cu-fricase-de-pollo.summary: Chicken stewed with potatoes in a mild tomato sauce.
cu-fricase-de-pollo.tip: Simmer it on low heat until the sauce thickens.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces with oil and salt.
Add the chopped onion and pepper and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, the cubed potatoes and a little water.
Cook covered for 35 minutes and add the olives at the end.

bo-picante-de-pollo.title: Spicy chicken stew
bo-picante-de-pollo.summary: Chicken stewed in a mild chili sauce with potatoes and rice.
bo-picante-de-pollo.tip: Taste the chili before adding it all: it can be hotter than it looks.
steps: Brown the chicken with oil and salt and set it aside.
In the same pot, sauté the chopped onion with the paprika.
Return the chicken, add water, the potatoes and the peas and cook for 35 minutes.
Serve with freshly cooked rice.

py-reviro.title: Reviro
py-reviro.summary: Paraguayan scrambled flour, warm and fluffy, with egg.
py-reviro.tip: Stir constantly so it breaks into small crumbs.
steps: Mix the flour with water, salt and milk into a loose, lumpy batter.
Heat the oil and sauté the chopped onion.
Pour in the batter and stir until cooked and crumbly.
Add the eggs and stir until set.

do-tostones-con-huevo.title: Tostones with eggs
do-tostones-con-huevo.summary: Fried and flattened green plantain with scrambled eggs and onion.
do-tostones-con-huevo.tip: Fry them twice: first to cook them, then to brown them.
steps: Peel the plantains and cut them into thick slices.
Fry them for 3 minutes, flatten them and fry again until golden.
Sauté the onion and scramble the eggs with salt.
Serve the tostones with the eggs.

jp-nikujaga.title: Nikujaga
jp-nikujaga.summary: Japanese stew of beef, potatoes and onion in a sweet soy sauce.
jp-nikujaga.tip: Let it rest covered for a while: the potatoes absorb the flavor better.
steps: Cut the beef into thin strips, the potatoes and carrot into chunks and the onion into wedges.
Sauté the beef in a little oil and add the onion.
Add the potato, carrot, water to almost cover, the soy sauce and the sugar.
Cook covered over low heat for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

jp-sunomono-de-pepino.title: Cucumber sunomono
jp-sunomono-de-pepino.summary: Japanese cucumber salad in sweet vinegar.
jp-sunomono-de-pepino.tip: Salt the cucumber and squeeze it well so it stays crunchy.
steps: Slice the cucumber very thin.
Toss it with a little salt and leave it for 10 minutes.
Squeeze it to remove the water.
Dress with the vinegar, sugar and soy sauce and sprinkle with sesame.

in-rajma-masala.title: Rajma masala
in-rajma-masala.summary: Indian stew of red kidney beans in a tomato and spice sauce.
in-rajma-masala.tip: Mash a few beans in the pot to thicken the sauce.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until golden.
Add the garlic, the chopped tomatoes and the garam masala and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the beans with a little water and salt.
Cook for 15 minutes and mash a few to thicken.

in-curry-de-huevo.title: Egg curry
in-curry-de-huevo.summary: Hard-boiled eggs in a tomato and onion sauce with curry.
in-curry-de-huevo.tip: Prick the boiled eggs with a fork so they absorb the sauce better.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them and peel them.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil with the garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes and the curry and cook for 10 minutes with a little water and salt.
Add the whole eggs and cook 5 more minutes.

gr-gigantes-al-horno.title: Baked giant beans
gr-gigantes-al-horno.summary: Large white beans baked in tomato sauce.
gr-gigantes-al-horno.tip: Cover the dish with foil for the first half so they do not dry out.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in oil.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes with salt.
Mix with the beans in a baking dish and add a little water.
Bake for 40 minutes at 350 °F and sprinkle with parsley.

es-fabada-sencilla.title: Simple fabada
es-fabada-sencilla.summary: Asturian stew of white beans with chorizo, blood sausage and pork belly.
es-fabada-sencilla.tip: Cook it over very low heat without stirring so the beans do not break.
steps: Put the chorizo, blood sausage and pork belly in a pot with water and boil for 15 minutes.
Add the cooked beans, the chopped onion and the paprika.
Cook over very low heat for 30 minutes without stirring.
Slice the sausages, adjust the salt and serve hot.

es-arroz-caldoso-de-pollo.title: Soupy rice with chicken
es-arroz-caldoso-de-pollo.summary: Creamy rice with chicken, pepper and tomato, almost a soup.
es-arroz-caldoso-de-pollo.tip: Add the hot broth gradually and stir little so the rice stays creamy.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté the chopped garlic, pepper and tomato.
Add the rice, the chicken and the hot broth with salt.
Cook for 18 minutes over medium heat; it should stay soupy.

gen-shakshuka.title: Shakshuka
gen-shakshuka.summary: Eggs poached in a tomato sauce with pepper and spices.
gen-shakshuka.tip: Make wells in the sauce with a spoon so each egg stays in place.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and pepper in oil.
Add the crushed tomatoes, the cumin and salt and cook for 10 minutes.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 6 minutes until the whites set.

gen-sopa-de-lentejas-rojas-y-zanahoria.title: Red lentil and carrot soup
gen-sopa-de-lentejas-rojas-y-zanahoria.summary: Quick, creamy soup: red lentils break down without soaking.
gen-sopa-de-lentejas-rojas-y-zanahoria.tip: You do not need to soak red lentils: they cook in 15 minutes.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and carrot in oil.
Add the rinsed lentils, the broth and the cumin.
Cook for 20 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend the soup, season and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

gen-ensalada-de-atun-y-porotos.title: Tuna and white bean salad
gen-ensalada-de-atun-y-porotos.summary: Fresh, filling salad with tuna, white beans and red onion.
gen-ensalada-de-atun-y-porotos.tip: Drain the beans and tuna well so the salad is not watery.
steps: Drain the tuna and the beans.
Dice the tomato and slice the onion thin.
Mix everything in a bowl.
Dress with oil, lemon and salt.

gen-tostadas-de-ricota-y-tomate.title: Ricotta and tomato toast
gen-tostadas-de-ricota-y-tomate.summary: Creamy toast with ricotta, tomato and a drizzle of olive oil.
gen-tostadas-de-ricota-y-tomate.tip: Add the tomato right before eating so the bread does not get soggy.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Spread them with the ricotta.
Top with tomato slices.
Season with oil, salt and oregano.

es-huevos-a-la-flamenca.title: Flamenco eggs
es-huevos-a-la-flamenca.summary: Baked eggs on a tomato sauce with chorizo and peas.
es-huevos-a-la-flamenca.tip: Cook the eggs just until the white sets and the yolk stays runny.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and the sliced chorizo in oil.
Add the crushed tomatoes and the peas and cook for 10 minutes with salt.
Divide the sauce between two small dishes and crack two eggs into each.
Bake for 8 minutes at 400 °F until the white sets.

gen-sopa-de-calabaza-y-coco.title: Pumpkin and coconut soup
gen-sopa-de-calabaza-y-coco.summary: Creamy, mild pumpkin soup with coconut milk and ginger.
gen-sopa-de-calabaza-y-coco.tip: Add the coconut milk at the end and do not boil it hard so it does not split.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil with the grated ginger.
Add the cubed pumpkin and the broth and cook for 20 minutes.
Blend everything until creamy.
Stir in the coconut milk, heat without boiling and season.

pt-bacalhau-com-natas.title: Cod with cream
pt-bacalhau-com-natas.summary: Flaked salt cod with potatoes and cream, baked until golden.
pt-bacalhau-com-natas.tip: Soak the salt cod the day before, changing the water several times.
steps: Cook the cod, drain it and flake it, removing the bones.
Cut the potatoes into sticks and fry or roast them until golden.
Sauté the sliced onion in oil, add the cod and the cream.
Mix with the potatoes in a baking dish, sprinkle with cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

fr-croque-madame.title: Croque madame
fr-croque-madame.summary: Gratinated croque monsieur topped with a fried egg.
fr-croque-madame.tip: Cook the egg separately so the yolk stays runny.
steps: Spread two slices of bread with cream and top them with ham and cheese.
Close with the other slices and sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 400 °F for 10 minutes until gratinated.
Fry the eggs in the butter and place one on each croque.

it-risotto-alla-milanese.title: Risotto alla milanese
it-risotto-alla-milanese.summary: Creamy saffron risotto with butter and Parmesan.
it-risotto-alla-milanese.tip: Add the hot stock little by little and stir often to get the creaminess.
steps: Cook the chopped onion in the butter until soft.
Add the rice and toast for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock little by little.
Halfway through, add the saffron dissolved in a ladle of stock.
Cook about 18 minutes, finish with butter and Parmesan and serve at once.

de-koenigsberger-klopse.title: Königsberger meatballs
de-koenigsberger-klopse.summary: Meatballs in a light sauce with capers, served with potatoes.
de-koenigsberger-klopse.tip: Poach the meatballs only gently so they do not fall apart.
steps: Soak the roll, squeeze it out and knead it with the meat, egg, chopped onion and salt.
Shape meatballs and poach them in barely simmering salted broth for 15 minutes.
Reduce some of the broth with the cream and capers.
Warm the meatballs in the sauce and serve with boiled potatoes.

br-bolo-de-fuba.title: Brazilian cornmeal cake
br-bolo-de-fuba.summary: Simple, moist cornmeal cake, typical of afternoon coffee.
br-bolo-de-fuba.tip: Beat the eggs and sugar well until pale: that is what makes the cake fluffy.
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar until pale and creamy.
Add the milk and the oil and mix.
Add the cornmeal, the flour and the baking powder and stir until combined.
Pour into a greased pan and bake at 350 °F for 40 minutes.

br-strogonoff-de-cogumelos.title: Mushroom stroganoff
br-strogonoff-de-cogumelos.summary: Creamy mushrooms in a cream, ketchup and mustard sauce.
br-strogonoff-de-cogumelos.tip: Brown the mushrooms without stirring too much so they release less water.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil.
Add the sliced mushrooms and brown them over high heat.
Add the ketchup, the mustard and the salt.
Lower the heat, add the cream and warm it without boiling.

ar-pastel-de-papa.title: Argentine potato pie
ar-pastel-de-papa.summary: Ground beef with onion under a gratinated mashed potato topping.
ar-pastel-de-papa.tip: Keep the mash fairly firm so it browns nicely on top.
steps: Boil the potatoes, mash them and add salt; keep the mash firm.
Soften the chopped onion in oil and add the beef until browned.
Place the beef in a dish and cover with the mash.
Sprinkle the cheese and broil for 15 minutes in a hot oven.

ar-pizzetas-caseras.title: Homemade mini pizzas
ar-pizzetas-caseras.summary: Small soft-crust pizzas with sauce, cheese and whatever is in the fridge.
ar-pizzetas-caseras.tip: Prick the dough before adding the sauce so it does not puff up.
steps: Mix the flour with salt, oil and warm water into a soft dough and rest it for 15 minutes.
Roll it thin and cut discs the size of a small plate.
Top with sauce, cheese and olives.
Bake for 12 minutes in a hot oven until the cheese bubbles.

ar-milanesas-de-zapallitos.title: Zucchini cutlets
ar-milanesas-de-zapallitos.summary: Long zucchini slices breaded and fried until golden: light and crispy.
ar-milanesas-de-zapallitos.tip: Pat them dry before dipping in egg so the breading sticks.
steps: Slice the zucchini lengthwise into thin strips and salt them.
Pat them dry with paper towels.
Dip them in beaten egg and then in breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden on both sides.

ar-sopa-de-verduras-con-fideos.title: Vegetable noodle soup
ar-sopa-de-verduras-con-fideos.summary: Homemade broth with carrot, potato, pumpkin and short noodles.
ar-sopa-de-verduras-con-fideos.tip: Add the noodles at the end so they do not overcook.
steps: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil with the whole onion and salt.
Add the carrot, potato and pumpkin in cubes and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.
Serve hot with grated cheese if you like.

ar-tarta-de-berenjena.title: Eggplant tart
ar-tarta-de-berenjena.summary: Tart with roasted eggplant, tomato and melted cheese.
ar-tarta-de-berenjena.tip: Roast the eggplant first so it releases water and does not soften the crust.
steps: Slice the eggplants, salt them and roast in the oven until soft.
Line a tart pan with the crust and prick it.
Arrange the eggplant with tomato slices and the cheese.
Cover with the eggs beaten with salt and bake for 30 minutes in a medium oven.

ar-hamburguesa-de-pollo-casera.title: Homemade chicken burgers
ar-hamburguesa-de-pollo-casera.summary: Ground chicken patties with onion and parsley, juicy and easy.
ar-hamburguesa-de-pollo-casera.tip: Wet your hands to shape the patties without sticking.
steps: Mix the chicken with the grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, parsley and salt.
Shape patties the size of a bun.
Cook them on a hot griddle with a little oil.
Flip after 5 minutes and cook until done through.

ar-escalopes-con-papas.title: Veal cutlets with potatoes
ar-escalopes-con-papas.summary: Thin steaks pan-fried until golden, served with crispy potatoes.
ar-escalopes-con-papas.tip: Pound the meat very thin so it cooks quickly and stays tender.
steps: Pound the cutlets thin, salt them and dust with flour.
Slice the potatoes and fry in oil until tender and golden.
Brown the cutlets for 2 minutes per side in another pan.
Serve with the potatoes and a squeeze of lemon.

ar-torrejas-de-arroz.title: Rice fritters
ar-torrejas-de-arroz.summary: Fried patties made with leftover rice, egg and cheese.
ar-torrejas-de-arroz.tip: Drain the rice well so the fritters do not fall apart in the pan.
steps: Mix the rice with the eggs, cheese, chopped scallion and salt.
Heat oil in a skillet.
Shape patties with a spoon and fry until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

mx-sopes-de-frijol.title: Bean sopes
mx-sopes-de-frijol.summary: Thick masa discs topped with beans, lettuce, cheese and salsa.
mx-sopes-de-frijol.tip: Pinch a rim around each disc so it holds the toppings.
steps: Mix the flour with warm water and salt into a soft dough.
Shape thick discs and cook them on a griddle for 3 minutes per side.
Pinch the edges while hot to form the sope.
Top with beans, shredded lettuce and crumbled cheese.

mx-huevos-en-salsa-verde.title: Eggs in green salsa
mx-huevos-en-salsa-verde.summary: Eggs poached in a tomatillo sauce with a little heat.
mx-huevos-en-salsa-verde.tip: Simmer the salsa for a couple of minutes before adding the eggs.
steps: Boil the tomatillos with the chili for 5 minutes and blend with the onion.
Cook the salsa in a skillet with oil and salt for 5 minutes.
Make wells and crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook until the whites are set.

mx-frijoles-charros.title: Charro beans
mx-frijoles-charros.summary: Bean stew with bacon, chorizo and sausage.
mx-frijoles-charros.tip: Use already cooked beans so it is ready in under an hour.
steps: Brown the chopped bacon and chorizo in a pot.
Add the chopped onion and tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beans with their broth and salt.
Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes until thickened.

mx-albondigas-al-chipotle.title: Chipotle meatballs
mx-albondigas-al-chipotle.summary: Beef meatballs in a tomato and chipotle sauce.
mx-albondigas-al-chipotle.tip: Start with a little chipotle and add more to taste: it is quite hot.
steps: Mix the beef with the rice, egg and salt and shape into balls.
Blend the tomatoes with the chipotle and strain the sauce.
Cook the sauce in a pot for 5 minutes.
Add the meatballs and cook covered for 25 minutes.

mx-papas-con-rajas.title: Potatoes with peppers
mx-papas-con-rajas.summary: Sautéed potatoes with pepper strips and onion, simple and filling.
mx-papas-con-rajas.tip: Cut the potatoes evenly so they cook at the same time.
steps: Cube the potatoes and fry in oil until tender.
Add the onion and the pepper strips.
Sauté for 8 more minutes with salt.
Serve with crumbled cheese on top.

mx-pollo-con-rajas-y-crema.title: Chicken with peppers and cream
mx-pollo-con-rajas-y-crema.summary: Shredded chicken with pepper strips in a creamy sauce.
mx-pollo-con-rajas-y-crema.tip: Cook and shred the chicken ahead: it comes together in minutes.
steps: Boil the chicken for 20 minutes with salt and shred it.
Sauté the onion and pepper strips in oil.
Add the chicken and the cream.
Cook for 8 minutes over low heat and serve with rice.

mx-chiles-rellenos-de-queso.title: Cheese-stuffed peppers
mx-chiles-rellenos-de-queso.summary: Roasted peppers or poblanos stuffed with cheese, battered and fried.
mx-chiles-rellenos-de-queso.tip: Peel them after roasting in a closed bag: the skin comes off easily.
steps: Roast the peppers until the skin blackens, peel them and open carefully.
Stuff them with the cheese and dust with flour.
Whisk the whites to stiff peaks, fold in the yolks and coat each pepper.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

mx-arroz-con-elote.title: Corn rice
mx-arroz-con-elote.summary: Fluffy rice with corn kernels, onion and a touch of broth.
mx-arroz-con-elote.tip: Rinse the rice so it stays loose.
steps: Soften the chopped onion in oil and add the rinsed rice.
Toast for 2 minutes until translucent.
Add the corn, the hot broth and salt.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes over low heat.

cl-barros-luco.title: Barros Luco sandwich
cl-barros-luco.summary: The Chilean sandwich of thin beef strips with melted cheese.
cl-barros-luco.tip: Slice the meat very thin and cook it fast so it stays tender.
steps: Season the beef cut into thin strips with salt.
Sauté it in a skillet with oil over high heat for 3 minutes.
Lay the cheese over the hot meat so it melts.
Assemble the sandwich with the bread and serve warm.

cl-chorrillana.title: Chorrillana
cl-chorrillana.summary: French fries topped with beef, caramelized onion and a fried egg.
cl-chorrillana.tip: Serve it right away so the fries stay crispy.
steps: Cut the potatoes into sticks and fry until golden.
Sauté the sliced onion until golden and set aside.
Sauté the beef strips with salt over high heat.
Layer on a platter: fries, beef, onion and the fried eggs on top.

co-lentejas-con-platano-maduro.title: Lentils with sweet plantain
co-lentejas-con-platano-maduro.summary: Lentil stew with a tomato-onion sauce, served with fried ripe plantain.
co-lentejas-con-platano-maduro.tip: The plantain must be very ripe, with a dark peel, so it caramelizes.
steps: Cook the lentils in water until tender, about 25 minutes.
Make a sauce by sautéing chopped onion and tomato in oil.
Mix it with the lentils and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Fry slices of ripe plantain until golden and serve alongside.

co-papas-criollas-salteadas.title: Sautéed baby potatoes
co-papas-criollas-salteadas.summary: Small potatoes sautéed with garlic, scallion and cilantro.
co-papas-criollas-salteadas.tip: Boil the potatoes with their skins: they are tastier and firmer.
steps: Boil the potatoes with their skins for 12 minutes and drain.
Heat oil and brown them whole or halved.
Add the chopped garlic and the scallion.
Season with salt and finish with chopped cilantro.

co-huevos-con-hogao.title: Eggs with Colombian hogao
co-huevos-con-hogao.summary: Scrambled or fried eggs with the Colombian tomato and onion sauce.
co-huevos-con-hogao.tip: Cook the hogao over low heat so the flavor concentrates.
steps: Sauté the chopped scallion with the garlic in oil.
Add the grated tomato and cook for 8 minutes into a hogao.
Season with salt and set the sauce aside.
Cook the eggs as you like and serve with the hogao on top.

co-pescado-frito-con-patacones.title: Fried fish with patacones
co-pescado-frito-con-patacones.summary: Golden fish fillets with smashed fried green plantain.
co-pescado-frito-con-patacones.tip: Smash the patacones in two steps: fry, smash, then fry again.
steps: Season the fish with salt and lemon and dust with flour.
Cut the plantain into thick slices and fry for 3 minutes.
Smash them with the bottom of a glass and fry again until golden.
Fry the fish and serve with the patacones and salt.

pe-papa-a-la-ocopa.title: Potatoes in ocopa sauce
pe-papa-a-la-ocopa.summary: Boiled potatoes covered in a creamy cheese, peanut and mild chili sauce.
pe-papa-a-la-ocopa.tip: Blend the sauce with the milk little by little until creamy and thick.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and slice them.
Blend the cheese with the peanuts, milk, crackers and salt into a creamy sauce.
Arrange the potatoes on a platter.
Cover with the sauce and serve with hard-boiled egg.

pe-sopa-criolla-sencilla.title: Peruvian creole soup
pe-sopa-criolla-sencilla.summary: Beef soup with thin noodles, milk and egg.
pe-sopa-criolla-sencilla.tip: Add the egg at the end and stir so it forms ribbons.
steps: Sauté the onion with the beef strips and add 4 cups of water.
Cook for 15 minutes and add the noodles.
Add the milk and salt and cook 5 more minutes.
Stir in the beaten egg and serve hot.

pe-arroz-con-atun.title: Peruvian tuna fried rice
pe-arroz-con-atun.summary: Stir-fried rice with tuna, onion, bell pepper and peas.
pe-arroz-con-atun.tip: Drain the tuna well so the rice does not get soggy.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and pepper in oil.
Add the peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice and the drained tuna.
Stir-fry for 5 minutes over high heat and season with salt.

ve-ensalada-de-gallina.title: Venezuelan chicken salad
ve-ensalada-de-gallina.summary: Shredded chicken with potato, carrot, peas and mayonnaise.
ve-ensalada-de-gallina.tip: Mix once everything is cold so the mayonnaise does not split.
steps: Boil the chicken with salt for 25 minutes and shred it.
Boil the potatoes and carrots in cubes along with the peas.
Let everything cool.
Mix with the mayonnaise and chill before serving.

ve-yuca-sancochada-con-mojo.title: Boiled cassava with mojo
ve-yuca-sancochada-con-mojo.summary: Boiled cassava with a garlic, onion and lemon sauce.
ve-yuca-sancochada-con-mojo.tip: Cook the cassava until it just starts to split: that is the right point.
steps: Peel the cassava, cut into chunks and boil with salt for 25 minutes until tender.
Soften the thinly sliced onion with the garlic in oil.
Turn off the heat and add the lemon juice.
Serve the drained cassava with the mojo on top.

ve-pasta-con-pollo.title: Chicken pasta
ve-pasta-con-pollo.summary: Pasta with chicken pieces, cream and sautéed vegetables.
ve-pasta-con-pollo.tip: Save a little cooking water to bind the sauce.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté the cubed chicken with onion and pepper in oil.
Add the cream and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve hot.

uy-guiso-de-arroz-y-carne.title: Beef and rice stew
uy-guiso-de-arroz-y-carne.summary: Everyday stew with cubed beef, rice and vegetables.
uy-guiso-de-arroz-y-carne.tip: Brown the meat well before adding water: it adds flavor.
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil and add the chopped onion.
Add the potatoes and carrot in cubes and cover with water.
Cook for 20 minutes and add the rice with salt.
Cook 15 more minutes until the rice is done.

ec-encebollado-sencillo.title: Ecuadorian tuna soup
ec-encebollado-sencillo.summary: Ecuadorian tuna soup with cassava and pickled red onion.
ec-encebollado-sencillo.tip: Leave the onion in lime juice for 10 minutes to pickle it.
steps: Boil the cubed cassava in 4 cups of salted water for 20 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato and the tuna with its juice.
Cook 10 more minutes.
Serve with the sliced onion marinated in lemon.

ec-seco-de-carne.title: Ecuadorian beef stew
ec-seco-de-carne.summary: Beef stewed in an onion, tomato and cilantro sauce, served with rice.
ec-seco-de-carne.tip: Let the meat simmer covered over low heat: it softens and the sauce thickens.
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil with salt and garlic.
Add the chopped onion and tomato and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add water to cover and cook covered for 40 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve with rice.

bo-papas-rellenas-bolivianas.title: Bolivian stuffed potatoes
bo-papas-rellenas-bolivianas.summary: Mashed potato balls stuffed with beef, egg and olives, fried until golden.
bo-papas-rellenas-bolivianas.tip: Use a firm mash and cool the filling before shaping.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes firmly with salt.
Sauté the onion with the beef and salt; add the chopped egg and olives.
Shape the mash into balls, press a hollow and fill.
Close them, coat if you like, and fry until golden.

py-mandioca-frita.title: Fried cassava
py-mandioca-frita.summary: Boiled then fried cassava sticks, crispy outside and tender inside.
py-mandioca-frita.tip: Boil the cassava before frying: it turns creamy inside.
steps: Peel the cassava, remove the fibrous core and cut into sticks.
Boil with salt for 15 minutes until nearly tender.
Drain and dry well.
Fry in hot oil until golden and serve right away.

jp-tonkatsu.title: Tonkatsu
jp-tonkatsu.summary: Panko-breaded pork cutlet, crispy and juicy.
jp-tonkatsu.tip: Rest the cutlet for 2 minutes before slicing so the juices stay in.
steps: Snip the edges of the chops to stop curling and salt them.
Coat them in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Fry in hot oil for about 4 minutes per side.
Slice into strips and serve with shredded cabbage and rice.

jp-tonjiru.title: Tonjiru
jp-tonjiru.summary: Japanese pork soup with root vegetables and miso.
jp-tonjiru.tip: Dissolve the miso off the heat so it keeps its aroma.
steps: Sauté the pork strips in a pot until they change color.
Add the carrot, potato and onion in chunks with 4 cups of water.
Cook for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Turn off the heat and dissolve the miso in the soup before serving.

jp-chawanmushi.title: Chawanmushi
jp-chawanmushi.summary: Steamed savory egg custard, silky as cream.
jp-chawanmushi.tip: Steam over very low heat so no bubbles form.
steps: Beat the eggs without making foam and mix with the warm broth, soy sauce and salt.
Strain the mixture and divide between two cups with the shrimp or ham.
Cover the cups and steam over low heat for 15 minutes.
Serve warm once the center is set.

jp-nasu-dengaku.title: Nasu dengaku
jp-nasu-dengaku.summary: Roasted eggplant with a sweet and salty miso glaze.
jp-nasu-dengaku.tip: Score the flesh so the miso soaks in well.
steps: Halve the eggplants, score the flesh in a grid and brush with oil.
Roast in the oven for 20 minutes until soft.
Mix the miso with the sugar and a splash of water.
Spread the mix over the eggplants, broil for 3 minutes and sprinkle with sesame.

jp-karaage.title: Karaage
jp-karaage.summary: Japanese fried chicken marinated in soy and ginger, very crispy.
jp-karaage.tip: Marinate at least 15 minutes and coat it in starch or cornstarch.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and mix with the soy sauce, grated ginger and garlic.
Let it marinate for 15 minutes.
Coat in cornstarch, shaking off the excess.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy.

in-masala-omelette.title: Masala omelette
in-masala-omelette.summary: Egg omelette with onion, tomato, chili and cilantro.
in-masala-omelette.tip: Chop everything very small so it spreads evenly through the egg.
steps: Finely chop the onion, tomato, chili and cilantro.
Beat the eggs with the vegetables and salt.
Pour into a skillet with hot oil.
Cook 2 minutes per side until golden.

in-jeera-rice.title: Jeera rice
in-jeera-rice.summary: Fragrant basmati rice with toasted cumin.
in-jeera-rice.tip: Toast the cumin in the oil until fragrant before adding the rice.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear.
Heat the oil and toast the cumin with the chopped onion.
Add the rice and 2 cups of water with salt.
Cover and cook 15 minutes over low heat; rest for 5 minutes.

in-baingan-bharta.title: Baingan bharta
in-baingan-bharta.summary: Smoky mashed roasted eggplant with onion, tomato and spices.
in-baingan-bharta.tip: Roast the eggplant whole until the skin chars: that gives the smoky flavor.
steps: Roast the whole eggplants until soft and the skin chars; peel and mash them.
Sauté the onion with the cumin and chili in oil.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in the eggplant and salt and cook 5 more minutes.

in-poha.title: Poha
in-poha.summary: Indian breakfast of flattened rice with onion, potato and turmeric.
in-poha.tip: Rinse the flattened rice only briefly, without soaking, so it does not fall apart.
steps: Rinse the poha in a strainer and let it drain.
Sauté the onion and diced potato in oil until tender.
Add the turmeric, peanuts and salt.
Add the poha, toss gently for 3 minutes and serve with lemon.

in-dal-tadka.title: Dal tadka
in-dal-tadka.summary: Creamy yellow lentils finished with a sizzling garlic, cumin and onion tempering.
in-dal-tadka.tip: The tadka goes in at the end and very hot: it is what perfumes the dish.
steps: Cook the lentils with water, the chopped tomato and salt until they fall apart, about 25 minutes.
Heat the oil and brown the chopped onion with the garlic and cumin.
Pour this tempering over the lentils.
Stir and serve with rice.

gr-avgolemono.title: Avgolemono
gr-avgolemono.summary: Greek chicken and rice soup thickened with egg and lemon.
gr-avgolemono.tip: Add the hot broth to the egg spoonful by spoonful so it does not curdle.
steps: Boil the chicken with the carrot and salt in 6 cups of water for 20 minutes; shred it.
Cook the rice in the broth for 12 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice and slowly add hot broth.
Pour everything back into the pot with the chicken, without boiling, and serve.

gr-kolokithokeftedes.title: Zucchini fritters
gr-kolokithokeftedes.summary: Fried zucchini patties with cheese and herbs, for dipping in yogurt.
gr-kolokithokeftedes.tip: Squeeze the grated zucchini well with salt so they are not watery.
steps: Grate the zucchini, salt it and let it drain for 10 minutes; squeeze in a towel.
Mix with the crumbled cheese, egg and flour.
Shape patties with a spoon.
Fry in hot oil until golden on both sides.

gr-fakes.title: Fakes
gr-fakes.summary: Thick Greek lentil soup with tomato, garlic and a splash of vinegar.
gr-fakes.tip: Add a splash of vinegar when serving: it lifts the whole flavor.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in oil.
Add the chopped tomato and the rinsed lentils with 4 cups of water.
Cook for 30 minutes over low heat until thick; salt at the end.
Serve with a drizzle of oil and vinegar.

es-potaje-de-garbanzos.title: Spanish chickpea stew
es-potaje-de-garbanzos.summary: Chickpea stew with spinach and paprika, traditional for Lent.
es-potaje-de-garbanzos.tip: Use cooked chickpeas and add the paprika off the heat so it does not turn bitter.
steps: Brown the sliced garlic in oil and take the pot off the heat to add the paprika.
Add the cubed potato, the chickpeas and water to cover.
Cook for 20 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the spinach and cook 5 more minutes with salt.

es-tortilla-de-calabacin.title: Spanish zucchini tortilla
es-tortilla-de-calabacin.summary: Juicy Spanish omelette with slow-cooked zucchini and onion.
es-tortilla-de-calabacin.tip: Cook the zucchini covered so it softens without browning.
steps: Dice the zucchini and onion and cook in oil, covered, for 12 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and mix with the drained vegetables.
Set the mixture in a skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Flip with a plate and cook 3 more minutes.

es-pimientos-de-padron.title: Padrón peppers
es-pimientos-de-padron.summary: Blistered green peppers fried with coarse salt: some are hot and some are not.
es-pimientos-de-padron.tip: Fry a few at a time so they blister without going soft.
steps: Wash and dry the peppers well.
Heat the oil in a skillet over high heat.
Fry the peppers for 3 minutes, turning, until blistered.
Drain and sprinkle with coarse salt.

es-merluza-en-salsa-verde.title: Hake in green sauce
es-merluza-en-salsa-verde.summary: Hake in a light garlic and parsley sauce with peas.
es-merluza-en-salsa-verde.tip: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the sauce binds without breaking the fish.
steps: Brown the sliced garlic in oil and add the flour.
Add 1 cup of water or broth, the parsley and peas and cook 5 minutes.
Place the salted hake in the pan.
Cook covered for 8 minutes, swirling the pan until the sauce binds.

es-judias-con-chorizo.title: White beans with chorizo
es-judias-con-chorizo.summary: White bean stew with chorizo and paprika.
es-judias-con-chorizo.tip: Prick the chorizo before cooking so it releases its fat and color.
steps: Brown the sliced chorizo and the chopped onion in oil.
Take off the heat, add the paprika and the beans.
Cover with water or broth.
Cook for 25 minutes over low heat until thick.

es-bocadillo-de-calamares.title: Squid sandwich
es-bocadillo-de-calamares.summary: The Madrid classic: battered squid in crusty bread.
es-bocadillo-de-calamares.tip: Dry the rings well before coating so they stay crispy.
steps: Pat the squid rings dry with paper towels and salt them.
Dredge them in flour, shaking off the excess.
Fry in very hot oil for 2 minutes until golden.
Fill the rolls with the squid and squeeze lemon over.

es-sopa-de-fideos.title: Spanish noodle soup
es-sopa-de-fideos.summary: Chicken broth with thin noodles, the most comforting spoon dish.
es-sopa-de-fideos.tip: Add the noodles to boiling broth and cook only as long as the package says.
steps: Heat the broth with the thinly sliced carrot.
When it boils, add the noodles.
Cook for the time indicated on the package.
Taste for salt and serve with chopped hard-boiled egg.

es-croquetas-de-pollo.title: Chicken croquettes
es-croquetas-de-pollo.summary: Creamy croquettes of shredded chicken in béchamel.
es-croquetas-de-pollo.tip: Chill the mixture for several hours so it is easy to shape.
steps: Make a thick béchamel with 3 tablespoons of oil, 3 of flour and the milk.
Add the shredded chicken and salt and chill in the fridge.
Shape croquettes and coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

gen-sopa-de-zapallo-y-jengibre.title: Pumpkin and ginger soup
gen-sopa-de-zapallo-y-jengibre.summary: Silky pumpkin soup with a fresh touch of ginger.
gen-sopa-de-zapallo-y-jengibre.tip: Grate the ginger finely and add it at the end so it does not turn bitter.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until translucent.
Add the cubed pumpkin and the broth and cook for 20 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and salt.
Blend until creamy and serve hot.

gen-pasta-con-tomates-cherry.title: Cherry tomato pasta
gen-pasta-con-tomates-cherry.summary: Quick pasta with sautéed cherry tomatoes, garlic and basil.
gen-pasta-con-tomates-cherry.tip: Sauté the tomatoes over high heat until they burst and release their juice.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Brown the sliced garlic in oil and add the halved tomatoes.
Cook for 8 minutes until they break down into a sauce.
Toss with the pasta and finish with basil.

gen-pollo-con-garbanzos.title: Chicken with chickpeas
gen-pollo-con-garbanzos.summary: Chicken stew with chickpeas, tomato and mild spices.
gen-pollo-con-garbanzos.tip: Use canned or already cooked chickpeas to have it ready in under an hour.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil with salt; set aside.
In the same pot sauté the onion, tomato and paprika.
Return the chicken with the chickpeas and a cup of water.
Cook covered for 25 minutes over low heat.

gen-pizza-de-pan-de-molde.title: Sandwich bread pizzas
gen-pizza-de-pan-de-molde.summary: Quick pizzas built on slices of sandwich bread.
gen-pizza-de-pan-de-molde.tip: Lightly toast the bread before assembling so it does not get soggy.
steps: Lightly toast the bread slices.
Top with tomato sauce and chopped ham.
Add the cheese and sprinkle with oregano.
Broil for 6 minutes until the cheese melts.

gen-rollitos-de-jamon-y-queso.title: Ham and cheese rolls
gen-rollitos-de-jamon-y-queso.summary: Dough rolls filled with ham and cheese, baked until golden.
gen-rollitos-de-jamon-y-queso.tip: Seal the edges well with a little water so they do not leak cheese.
steps: Place a slice of ham and one of cheese on each round.
Roll up and seal the edges with a little water.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 20 minutes in a hot oven until golden.

gen-ensalada-de-pasta-con-pollo.title: Chicken pasta salad
gen-ensalada-de-pasta-con-pollo.summary: Cold pasta salad with chicken, tomato and corn.
gen-ensalada-de-pasta-con-pollo.tip: Rinse the pasta in cold water to stop the cooking and keep it from sticking.
steps: Boil the pasta, drain and rinse in cold water.
Cube the chicken and tomatoes.
Mix with the corn, pasta, oil and mayonnaise.
Season with salt and chill before serving.

gen-arroz-con-espinaca.title: Spinach rice
gen-arroz-con-espinaca.summary: Green rice with spinach, garlic and onion.
gen-arroz-con-espinaca.tip: Blend the raw spinach with the cooking water for a bright green color.
steps: Blend the raw spinach with 2 cups of water.
Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in oil and add the rice.
Add the green purée and salt.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes over low heat.

gen-crema-de-puerros.title: Leek cream soup
gen-crema-de-puerros.summary: Smooth leek and potato soup, ideal for cold days.
gen-crema-de-puerros.tip: Use only the white and light green parts of the leek, well washed.
steps: Slice the leeks and sweat them in oil without browning.
Add the cubed potatoes and the broth.
Cook for 20 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend, add the cream and salt and serve hot.

gen-bocaditos-de-espinaca.title: Spinach bites
gen-bocaditos-de-espinaca.summary: Baked balls of spinach, cheese and breadcrumbs.
gen-bocaditos-de-espinaca.tip: Squeeze the cooked spinach very well so the mixture stays firm.
steps: Cook the spinach, drain it well and chop finely.
Mix with the cheese, eggs, breadcrumbs and salt.
Shape walnut-sized balls.
Bake for 20 minutes in a medium oven until golden.

gen-pollo-al-limon-con-arroz.title: Lemon chicken with rice
gen-pollo-al-limon-con-arroz.summary: Golden chicken in a lemon and garlic sauce, served with rice.
gen-pollo-al-limon-con-arroz.tip: Add the lemon at the end so it does not turn bitter.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil with salt and chopped garlic.
Add the juice of one lemon and 1/2 cup of water.
Cook covered for 20 minutes over low heat.
Serve with boiled rice and slices of the other lemon.

br-bife-a-cavalo.title: Steak with a fried egg
br-bife-a-cavalo.summary: Pan-seared steak topped with a fried egg, served with rice and beans.
br-bife-a-cavalo.tip: Fry the egg last so the yolk stays runny.
steps: Season the steaks with salt and chopped garlic.
Cook them in a hot skillet with oil for 3 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs in another pan.
Serve each steak topped with an egg.

br-pudim-de-leite.title: Brazilian condensed milk flan
br-pudim-de-leite.summary: Creamy Brazilian flan made with condensed milk and caramel.
br-pudim-de-leite.tip: Cook in a water bath and strain the mixture so it has no bubbles.
steps: Make a caramel with the sugar and pour it into a mold.
Blend the condensed milk, milk and eggs and strain.
Pour into the mold and bake in a covered water bath for 50 minutes.
Chill well before unmolding.

br-bolinho-de-chuva.title: Brazilian rain fritters
br-bolinho-de-chuva.summary: Sweet fried dough balls with cinnamon sugar, typical of rainy days.
br-bolinho-de-chuva.tip: Drop the batter by spoonfuls into medium-hot oil so they cook through.
steps: Mix the flour with the egg, milk and 2 tablespoons of sugar into a thick batter.
Heat the oil over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter and fry until golden.
Roll in cinnamon sugar while hot.

br-aipim-frito.title: Brazilian fried cassava
br-aipim-frito.summary: Cassava sticks fried with salt and lime, crispy and golden.
br-aipim-frito.tip: Boil the cassava until it just splits and dry it well before frying.
steps: Peel the cassava and cut into sticks without the fibrous core.
Boil with salt for 15 minutes and drain well.
Fry in hot oil until golden.
Serve with salt and a squeeze of lime.

br-vaca-atolada.title: Brazilian beef rib and cassava stew
br-vaca-atolada.summary: Beef ribs with cassava cooked until the cassava thickens the broth.
br-vaca-atolada.tip: Cook slowly until the cassava breaks down and thickens the stew.
steps: Brown the ribs in oil with salt and garlic.
Add the chopped onion and tomato and cover with water.
Cook covered for 1 hour until the meat is tender.
Add the cassava in chunks and cook 30 more minutes until thick.

br-sopa-de-ervilha.title: Brazilian pea soup
br-sopa-de-ervilha.summary: Creamy pea soup with potato and bacon.
br-sopa-de-ervilha.tip: If using dried peas, soak them overnight.
steps: Brown the chopped bacon and onion in a pot.
Add the cubed potato, the peas and the broth.
Cook for 25 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend half to thicken and serve hot.

fr-boeuf-bourguignon-simple.title: Beef bourguignon
fr-boeuf-bourguignon-simple.summary: Beef braised slowly in red wine with onion and carrot.
fr-boeuf-bourguignon-simple.tip: Brown the meat in batches and cook over very low heat until it falls apart.
steps: Brown the bacon and the cubed beef in a pot with oil.
Add the onion and carrot in chunks and sauté.
Cover with the red wine and salt and cook covered for 2 hours over low heat.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

fr-pot-au-feu-simple.title: Easy pot-au-feu
fr-pot-au-feu-simple.summary: Boiled beef with carrots, leeks and potatoes in its broth.
fr-pot-au-feu-simple.tip: Skim the broth at the start so it stays clear.
steps: Put the beef in cold water with salt and the onion; bring to a boil and skim.
Simmer for 1 1/2 hours over low heat.
Add the carrots, leeks and potatoes in chunks.
Cook 30 more minutes and serve the beef with the vegetables and broth.

fr-crepes-sucrees.title: Sweet crêpes
fr-crepes-sucrees.summary: Thin crêpes of flour, milk and egg, to fill with sugar or jam.
fr-crepes-sucrees.tip: Rest the batter for 30 minutes so the crêpes are thin and lump-free.
steps: Whisk the flour with the eggs, milk, sugar and melted butter until smooth.
Let the batter rest.
Cook a ladle of batter in a hot pan for 1 minute per side.
Serve with sugar and lemon or with jam.

fr-salade-de-lentilles.title: Lentil salad
fr-salade-de-lentilles.summary: Warm lentils with onion, mustard and vinaigrette.
fr-salade-de-lentilles.tip: Dress the lentils while still warm: they absorb the flavor better.
steps: Cook the lentils in unsalted water for 20 minutes and drain.
Whisk the mustard with the vinegar, oil and salt.
Dress the warm lentils with the vinaigrette.
Add the chopped onion and serve warm or cold.

fr-clafoutis-aux-pommes.title: Apple clafoutis
fr-clafoutis-aux-pommes.summary: French baked dessert with apples in a soft custard-like batter.
fr-clafoutis-aux-pommes.tip: Use a buttered dish and serve warm so it is creamier.
steps: Peel and slice the apples; arrange them in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar, flour and milk.
Pour the batter over the apples.
Bake for 35 minutes in a medium oven until golden and set.

fr-soupe-aux-poireaux.title: French leek and potato soup
fr-soupe-aux-poireaux.summary: Rustic leek and potato soup with a touch of butter.
fr-soupe-aux-poireaux.tip: Wash the leeks well: dirt hides between the layers.
steps: Slice the leeks and sweat them in butter without browning.
Add the cubed potatoes and the broth.
Cook for 20 minutes until tender.
Mash lightly with a fork or blend and serve hot.

it-pasta-alla-gricia.title: Pasta alla gricia
it-pasta-alla-gricia.summary: Roman pasta with crispy guanciale, pecorino and black pepper.
it-pasta-alla-gricia.tip: Toss off the heat with a little pasta water for a creamy sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water and save a cup of the water.
Brown the diced bacon in a skillet until crisp.
Add the pasta to the skillet with a little pasta water and the pepper.
Off the heat, toss with the grated cheese and serve.

it-saltimbocca-alla-romana.title: Saltimbocca alla romana
it-saltimbocca-alla-romana.summary: Veal cutlets with prosciutto and sage, browned in butter.
it-saltimbocca-alla-romana.tip: Pin the sage and prosciutto with a toothpick and cook quickly.
steps: Place a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each cutlet and secure with a toothpick.
Melt the butter in a skillet and brown the cutlets prosciutto-side down for 2 minutes.
Flip and cook 1 more minute.
Deglaze with the white wine and serve with the sauce.

it-panzanella.title: Panzanella
it-panzanella.summary: Tuscan stale bread salad with tomato, onion and basil.
it-panzanella.tip: Soak the bread only briefly and squeeze it: it should be damp, not soggy.
steps: Cube the bread, soak it briefly in water and squeeze it out.
Cut the tomatoes into chunks and the onion into thin slices.
Mix everything with the basil.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt and let it rest for 15 minutes.

it-crostata-di-marmellata.title: Jam crostata
it-crostata-di-marmellata.summary: Italian shortcrust tart filled with jam and topped with lattice strips.
it-crostata-di-marmellata.tip: Chill the dough for 30 minutes so it does not shrink when baking.
steps: Mix the flour with the cold butter, sugar and egg into a dough and chill for 30 minutes.
Roll out two thirds and line a pan.
Fill with the jam.
Top with lattice strips of dough and bake for 35 minutes in a medium oven.

it-torta-della-nonna.title: Italian grandmother's tart
it-torta-della-nonna.summary: Pastry cream and pine nut tart on a shortcrust base.
it-torta-della-nonna.tip: Cool the cream before filling so the crust does not get soggy.
steps: Cook the milk with the yolks, sugar and flour until thick and let it cool.
Line a pan with the pastry.
Pour in the cream and sprinkle with pine nuts.
Bake for 35 minutes in a medium oven until golden.

it-fagioli-all-uccelletto.title: Beans all'uccelletto
it-fagioli-all-uccelletto.summary: White beans with tomato, garlic and sage, Tuscan style.
it-fagioli-all-uccelletto.tip: Let the tomato cook a few minutes with the garlic before adding the beans.
steps: Brown the garlic and sage in oil.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the beans and salt.
Cook for 15 minutes over low heat until thick.

de-apfelstrudel.title: Apple strudel
de-apfelstrudel.summary: Thin pastry rolled around apples with cinnamon and breadcrumbs.
de-apfelstrudel.tip: Stretch the dough as thin as possible: you should see the table through it.
steps: Peel and slice the apples and mix with the sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle the pastry with the breadcrumbs and spread the apples over it.
Roll up, brush with butter and place on a tray.
Bake for 35 minutes in a medium oven until golden.

de-kartoffelgratin.title: German potato gratin
de-kartoffelgratin.summary: Thinly sliced potatoes baked with cream and cheese.
de-kartoffelgratin.tip: Slice the potatoes thin and even, ideally with a mandoline, so they cook uniformly.
steps: Rub a dish with garlic and layer in the thinly sliced potatoes.
Pour in the cream with salt and part of the cheese.
Top with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 50 minutes in a medium oven until golden and tender.

de-rotkohl-mit-aepfeln.title: Red cabbage with apples
de-rotkohl-mit-aepfeln.summary: Braised red cabbage with apple, vinegar and a touch of sweetness.
de-rotkohl-mit-aepfeln.tip: Vinegar fixes the color: add it from the start.
steps: Slice the cabbage thinly and sweat it with the onion in oil.
Add the cubed apples, vinegar, sugar, salt and half a glass of water.
Cook covered over low heat for 40 minutes.
Uncover and reduce a few minutes until thick.

de-pfannkuchensuppe.title: Pancake soup
de-pfannkuchensuppe.summary: Broth with strips of pancake, a classic of German cooking.
de-pfannkuchensuppe.tip: Cut the pancakes into thin strips and add them when serving so they do not fall apart.
steps: Whisk the flour with the eggs, milk and salt into a smooth batter.
Cook thin pancakes in an oiled pan.
Cut them into thin strips.
Serve the hot broth with the strips and chopped chives.

de-leberkaese-mit-spiegelei.title: Leberkäse with fried egg
de-leberkaese-mit-spiegelei.summary: Browned slices of German meatloaf-style cold cut topped with a fried egg and bread.
de-leberkaese-mit-spiegelei.tip: Brown the slices over medium-high heat so they crisp on the outside.
steps: Brown the slices in a skillet with oil for 3 minutes per side.
Keep them warm.
Fry the eggs in the same pan.
Serve with the eggs on top and bread.

de-schupfnudeln-mit-sauerkraut.title: Potato noodles with sauerkraut
de-schupfnudeln-mit-sauerkraut.summary: Pan-fried potato noodles with sauerkraut and bacon.
de-schupfnudeln-mit-sauerkraut.tip: Brown the potato noodles well in the pan until crisp.
steps: Brown the chopped bacon and onion in a large skillet.
Add the sauerkraut and sauté for 5 minutes.
Separately, brown the potato noodles in oil until crisp.
Combine and serve hot.

jp-shogayaki.title: Shogayaki
jp-shogayaki.summary: Pork stir-fried with ginger and soy, quick and perfect with rice.
jp-shogayaki.tip: Slice the meat very thin so it cooks in a minute and stays tender.
steps: Mix the soy sauce with the grated ginger and the sugar.
Cut the onion into half-moons and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add the pork and cook until browned.
Pour in the sauce and let it cling to the meat for 1 minute.

jp-kitsune-udon.title: Kitsune udon
jp-kitsune-udon.summary: Japanese thick noodle soup with sweet fried tofu and scallions.
jp-kitsune-udon.tip: Cook the udon separately so the broth stays clear.
steps: Boil the broth with the soy sauce and sugar.
Add the tofu and cook 5 minutes so it absorbs the flavor.
Boil the udon separately, drain and divide among bowls.
Top with the hot broth, the tofu and chopped scallions.

jp-omurice.title: Omurice
jp-omurice.summary: Chicken fried rice wrapped in a soft omelet with ketchup.
jp-omurice.tip: Take the omelet off the heat while the center is still creamy.
steps: Sauté the onion and the chicken cut into small cubes.
Add the rice and 3 tablespoons of ketchup and mix well.
Beat the eggs and cook them in an oiled skillet as a soft omelet.
Put the rice in the center, fold the omelet over and serve with more ketchup.

in-palak-paneer.title: Palak paneer
in-palak-paneer.summary: Creamy spinach with cubes of fresh cheese and mild spices.
in-palak-paneer.tip: Brown the cheese cubes first so they do not fall apart.
steps: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes and blend it.
Sauté onion, garlic and cumin; add the chopped tomato.
Add the spinach and cook 5 minutes.
Add the cubed cheese and the cream and heat 3 more minutes.

in-paneer-bhurji.title: Paneer bhurji
in-paneer-bhurji.summary: Crumbled fresh cheese sautéed with onion, tomato and spices.
in-paneer-bhurji.tip: Add a pinch of salt only at the end so the cheese does not dry out.
steps: Crumble the cheese by hand.
Sauté the onion with the cumin until translucent.
Add the chopped tomato and the turmeric and cook 4 minutes.
Add the cheese, stir and cook 3 more minutes.

gr-spanakorizo.title: Spanakorizo
gr-spanakorizo.summary: Greek spinach rice with lemon and dill, light and fresh.
gr-spanakorizo.tip: Serve warm with a good drizzle of raw olive oil.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in olive oil.
Add the chopped spinach until it wilts.
Add the rice and 2 cups of hot water and cook covered for 15 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped dill.

gr-dakos.title: Dakos
gr-dakos.summary: Cretan hard bread rusk topped with grated tomato, cheese and olive oil.
gr-dakos.tip: With really ripe tomatoes you need nothing else.
steps: Briefly wet the hard bread with water and drain it.
Grate the tomatoes and spoon the pulp over the bread.
Crumble the feta on top.
Season with oregano and olive oil.

gr-fasolakia-yiahni.title: Fasolakia yiahni
gr-fasolakia-yiahni.summary: Green beans stewed with tomato, potato and olive oil, Greek style.
gr-fasolakia-yiahni.tip: The slower it cooks, the more flavor and the creamier the sauce.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add the green beans and the diced potatoes.
Pour in the tomato and half a cup of water.
Cook covered over low heat for 30 minutes until everything is tender.

gr-saganaki.title: Saganaki
gr-saganaki.summary: Fried cheese, golden outside and melted inside, with lemon.
gr-saganaki.tip: Wetting the cheese before flouring helps the crust stick.
steps: Cut the cheese into 1/2-inch slices and dip them in water.
Dredge in flour, shaking off the excess.
Brown 1 minute per side in hot olive oil.
Serve right away with lemon juice.

in-upma.title: Upma
in-upma.summary: Savory Indian semolina breakfast with onion, vegetables and spices.
in-upma.tip: Add the semolina slowly while stirring to avoid lumps.
steps: Dry-toast the semolina for 3 minutes and set aside.
Heat the oil with the mustard seeds and sauté the onion.
Add the carrot, peas and 2 cups of water; bring to a boil.
Rain in the semolina while stirring and cook covered for 3 minutes.

in-aloo-paratha.title: Aloo paratha
in-aloo-paratha.summary: Indian flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato.
in-aloo-paratha.tip: Use very dry potatoes so the filling does not tear the dough.
steps: Make a dough with the flour, salt and warm water and rest it for 15 minutes.
Mash the potatoes and mix with cumin, chili and salt.
Roll out small dough balls, fill with the mash and seal.
Roll them out again and cook in a skillet with butter until golden on both sides.

in-lemon-rice.title: Lemon rice
in-lemon-rice.summary: South Indian rice with lemon, turmeric and toasted peanuts.
in-lemon-rice.tip: Perfect for using up yesterday’s rice.
steps: Heat the oil and toast the peanuts with the mustard seeds.
Add the turmeric and turn off the heat.
Add the cooked rice and mix well.
Finish with the lemon juice and salt.

jp-horenso-goma-ae.title: Horenso no goma-ae
jp-horenso-goma-ae.summary: Blanched spinach in a creamy sesame and soy dressing.
jp-horenso-goma-ae.tip: Squeeze the spinach thoroughly so the dressing does not get watery.
steps: Blanch the spinach for 1 minute and rinse in cold water.
Squeeze it dry and cut into pieces.
Toast and grind the sesame; mix with the soy sauce and sugar.
Toss the spinach with the dressing.

fr-omelette-aux-fines-herbes.title: Omelette aux fines herbes
fr-omelette-aux-fines-herbes.summary: Fluffy omelet scented with parsley and chives.
fr-omelette-aux-fines-herbes.tip: Take it off the heat while still creamy: it finishes cooking in the pan.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Add the chopped parsley and chives.
Melt the butter in a skillet and pour in the eggs.
Draw the edges toward the center, then fold the omelet.

fr-riz-au-lait.title: French rice pudding
fr-riz-au-lait.summary: Creamy dessert of rice slowly cooked in milk with vanilla.
fr-riz-au-lait.tip: Stir often: milk sticks quickly to the bottom of the pot.
steps: Heat the milk with the vanilla.
Add the rice and sugar.
Cook over low heat for 35 minutes, stirring often.
Serve warm or cold.

fr-gateau-au-yaourt.title: French yogurt cake
fr-gateau-au-yaourt.summary: Very simple cake where the yogurt pot is the measuring cup.
fr-gateau-au-yaourt.tip: Use the empty yogurt pot to measure all the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Mix the yogurt, sugar and eggs.
Add the flour, baking powder and oil.
Pour into a buttered pan and bake 35 minutes.

it-pappa-al-pomodoro.title: Pappa al pomodoro
it-pappa-al-pomodoro.summary: Tuscan soup of stale bread, tomato and basil.
it-pappa-al-pomodoro.tip: Eat it warm, with a drizzle of raw olive oil.
steps: Sauté the garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and cook 10 minutes.
Add the torn bread and 2 cups of hot water.
Cook 15 minutes, stirring, and finish with the basil.

it-frittelle-di-zucchine.title: Zucchini fritters
it-frittelle-di-zucchine.summary: Crispy fritters of grated zucchini and cheese.
it-frittelle-di-zucchine.tip: Squeezing the zucchini well is the key to crispy fritters.
steps: Grate the zucchini and squeeze it well.
Mix with eggs, flour, Parmesan and salt.
Fry spoonfuls of batter in hot oil.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

it-pasta-e-lenticchie.title: Pasta and lentils
it-pasta-e-lenticchie.summary: Thick lentil and short pasta soup, cheap and filling.
it-pasta-e-lenticchie.tip: Add hot water if it gets too thick.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the lentils, the tomato purée and 4 cups of water.
Cook 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Add the pasta and cook 10 more minutes.

de-linsen-mit-spaetzle.title: Lentils with spätzle
de-linsen-mit-spaetzle.summary: Swabian classic: lentil stew with spätzle and sausages.
de-linsen-mit-spaetzle.tip: A splash of vinegar at the end rounds out the stew.
steps: Dice the onion and carrot and sauté in the oil.
Add the lentils and 4 cups of water and cook 25 minutes.
Cook the spätzle following the package directions.
Serve everything with the sausages and a splash of vinegar.

de-maultaschen-in-bruehe.title: Maultaschen in broth
de-maultaschen-in-bruehe.summary: Swabian stuffed pasta pockets in hot broth.
de-maultaschen-in-bruehe.tip: Do not boil hard or the pockets burst.
steps: Bring the broth to a boil.
Add the maultaschen and simmer 8 minutes.
Scatter onion rings on top.
Serve sprinkled with chives.

de-zwiebelkuchen.title: German onion tart
de-zwiebelkuchen.summary: Savory tart with onions, bacon and sour cream.
de-zwiebelkuchen.tip: It is best eaten warm, with young wine.
steps: Slice the onions and cook with the bacon in butter for 10 minutes.
Whisk the sour cream with the eggs and season with salt and caraway.
Line a pan with the dough and spread the onions over it.
Pour over the egg mixture and bake 35 minutes at 400 °F.

de-wuerstchen-eintopf.title: German sausage stew
de-wuerstchen-eintopf.summary: Hearty stew with sausages, potatoes and vegetables.
de-wuerstchen-eintopf.tip: Mashing a few potatoes thickens the stew.
steps: Dice the onion, carrots and potatoes.
Brown everything briefly in the oil and cover with broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the sliced sausages and heat 5 minutes.

de-quarkkeulchen.title: Quarkkeulchen
de-quarkkeulchen.summary: Saxon pancakes of quark and potato.
de-quarkkeulchen.tip: Shape with floured hands so the dough does not stick.
steps: Mash the potatoes and mix with the quark, flour, egg and sugar.
Shape small flat patties.
Brown in butter over medium heat on both sides.
Serve with applesauce and cinnamon sugar.

de-milchreis-mit-zimt.title: Milk rice with cinnamon
de-milchreis-mit-zimt.summary: Creamy rice pudding with cinnamon and sugar.
steps: Bring the milk, rice and a pinch of salt to a boil.
Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring.
Add the sugar and stir a moment longer.
Serve with cinnamon sugar and butter.

de-rote-bete-salat.title: German beet salad
de-rote-bete-salat.summary: Fresh salad of cooked beets with onion and vinegar.
de-rote-bete-salat.tip: Cut with gloves on, as beets stain fingers.
steps: Slice the cooked beets.
Finely dice the onion.
Whisk vinegar, oil, salt and caraway into a dressing.
Toss everything together and let it sit 20 minutes.

de-rahmschnitzel.title: Cream schnitzel
de-rahmschnitzel.summary: Pan-fried cutlet in a creamy mushroom sauce.
de-rahmschnitzel.tip: Pound the cutlets evenly thin so they cook fast.
steps: Salt the cutlets, dredge in flour and brown in butter.
Remove and keep warm.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms in the same fat.
Add the cream, reduce and return the cutlets to the sauce briefly.

pt-arroz-de-marisco.title: Portuguese seafood rice
pt-arroz-de-marisco.summary: Soupy Portuguese rice with shrimp and mussels in tomato sauce.
pt-arroz-de-marisco.tip: The rice should stay loose and brothy.
steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil and add the chopped tomato.
Add the rice and 3 cups of hot water.
Cook 10 minutes and add the seafood.
Cook 5 more minutes until soupy and finish with cilantro.

pt-sopa-de-peixe.title: Portuguese fish soup
pt-sopa-de-peixe.summary: Light and tasty fish soup with tomato, potato and herbs.
pt-sopa-de-peixe.tip: Add the fish at the end so it does not fall apart.
steps: Sauté the onion in oil and add the chopped tomato.
Add the diced potatoes and 4 cups of water.
Cook 15 minutes and add the fish in pieces.
Cook 5 more minutes and finish with parsley.

pt-bacalhau-a-gomes-de-sa.title: Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá
pt-bacalhau-a-gomes-de-sa.summary: Flaked salt cod with potato, onion, boiled egg and olives.
pt-bacalhau-a-gomes-de-sa.tip: Soak the salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing the water.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins and slice.
Poach the cod in flakes and drain.
Sauté the sliced onions in oil until soft.
Layer with the potatoes and cod and bake 15 minutes; serve with egg and olives.

pt-arroz-doce.title: Portuguese rice pudding
pt-arroz-doce.summary: Creamy dessert with lemon zest and cinnamon.
pt-arroz-doce.tip: Stir constantly so the bottom does not burn.
steps: Boil the rice in water for 5 minutes and drain.
Add the milk, lemon zest and sugar and cook 25 minutes, stirring.
Remove from the heat and stir in the beaten yolks.
Serve cold with cinnamon.

pt-carne-de-porco-a-alentejana.title: Alentejo-style pork and clams
pt-carne-de-porco-a-alentejana.summary: Marinated pork with clams and fried potatoes.
pt-carne-de-porco-a-alentejana.tip: The longer the marinade, the tastier the pork.
steps: Marinate the cubed pork with garlic, wine and salt for 30 minutes.
Fry the diced potatoes until golden.
Brown the pork in oil and add the clams until they open.
Toss with the potatoes and serve with cilantro.

fr-gratin-de-poireaux-au-jambon.title: Leek and ham gratin
fr-gratin-de-poireaux-au-jambon.summary: Leeks wrapped in ham, covered in béchamel and baked until golden.
fr-gratin-de-poireaux-au-jambon.tip: Squeeze the leeks well so the gratin is not watery.
steps: Boil the leeks for 10 minutes and drain.
Wrap each leek in a slice of ham.
Make a béchamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Pour over, sprinkle with cheese and bake 20 minutes at 400°F.

fr-veloute-de-champignons.title: Cream of mushroom soup
fr-veloute-de-champignons.summary: Velvety white mushroom soup with cream.
fr-veloute-de-champignons.tip: Keep a few sautéed mushrooms for garnish.
steps: Sauté the onion in the butter and add the sliced mushrooms.
Add the diced potato and the broth.
Cook 20 minutes, then blend.
Stir in the cream and adjust the seasoning.

fr-blanquette-de-poulet.title: Chicken blanquette
fr-blanquette-de-poulet.summary: Chicken simmered in a creamy white sauce with carrots and mushrooms.
fr-blanquette-de-poulet.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon at the end to brighten the sauce.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the onion and carrots in 3 cups of water for 25 minutes.
Strain the broth and keep the meat and vegetables.
Make a roux with the butter and flour and whisk in 1 1/2 cups of broth.
Return everything with the cream and mushrooms and cook 10 minutes.

fr-quiche-saumon-poireaux.title: Salmon and leek quiche
fr-quiche-saumon-poireaux.summary: Savory tart with salmon and leeks, soft and creamy.
fr-quiche-saumon-poireaux.tip: Blind-bake the crust for 10 minutes to keep it crisp.
steps: Soften the sliced leeks in a skillet for 8 minutes.
Line a pan with the crust and spread the leeks and salmon pieces over it.
Beat the eggs with the cream, salt and pepper and pour over.
Top with cheese and bake 35 minutes at 350°F.

fr-moules-marinieres.title: Mussels in white wine
fr-moules-marinieres.summary: Mussels cooked in white wine with shallots and parsley.
fr-moules-marinieres.tip: Discard mussels that stay open before cooking and those that stay closed after.
steps: Scrub the mussels and remove the beards.
Sauté the shallots in the butter.
Add the wine and mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes, shaking the pot.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the broth.

fr-endives-au-jambon.title: Ham-wrapped endives
fr-endives-au-jambon.summary: Braised endives wrapped in ham and baked with béchamel.
fr-endives-au-jambon.tip: Squeeze the endives to remove water and avoid bitterness.
steps: Steam or boil the endives 15 minutes and drain well.
Wrap each in a slice of ham.
Make a béchamel and pour it over the endives.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 20 minutes at 400°F.

it-ribollita.title: Ribollita
it-ribollita.summary: Tuscan vegetable and bean soup thickened with stale bread.
it-ribollita.tip: It tastes even better the next day.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion, carrots and kale in the oil.
Add the beans and 4 cups of water and cook 30 minutes.
