Add the bread in pieces and stir until it breaks down.
Let rest and serve with a drizzle of oil.

it-focaccia-semplice.title: Simple focaccia
it-focaccia-semplice.summary: Fluffy focaccia with olive oil and coarse salt.
it-focaccia-semplice.tip: Whisk oil and water together and pour over before baking.
steps: Knead the flour, water, yeast, 2 tablespoons of oil and the salt.
Let rise covered for 1 hour.
Stretch into a pan, dimple with your fingers and top with oil and coarse salt.
Bake 25 minutes at 425°F.

it-risotto-alla-zucca.title: Pumpkin risotto
it-risotto-alla-zucca.summary: Creamy risotto with pumpkin and Parmesan.
it-risotto-alla-zucca.tip: Blend half the pumpkin for extra creaminess.
steps: Sauté the onion in butter and add the diced pumpkin.
Add the rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add hot broth little by little, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Finish with Parmesan and butter and serve.

it-tiramisu.title: Tiramisu
it-tiramisu.summary: Chilled dessert with ladyfingers, coffee and mascarpone.
it-tiramisu.tip: Do not soak the ladyfingers too long or they fall apart.
steps: Whisk the yolks with the sugar and fold in the mascarpone.
Whip the whites to stiff peaks and fold into the cream.
Dip the ladyfingers in coffee and layer with the cream.
Chill 4 hours and dust with cocoa.

it-panna-cotta.title: Panna cotta
it-panna-cotta.summary: Silky cream dessert with berry sauce.
it-panna-cotta.tip: Do not boil the cream or it loses its silkiness.
steps: Soften the gelatin in cold water.
Warm the cream with the sugar and vanilla without boiling.
Dissolve the squeezed gelatin in the warm cream.
Pour into molds and chill 4 hours until set.

it-penne-alla-vodka.title: Penne alla vodka
it-penne-alla-vodka.summary: Penne in a tomato, cream and vodka sauce.
it-penne-alla-vodka.tip: Let the vodka cook off fully before adding the tomato.
steps: Cook the penne al dente.
Sauté the chopped onion and deglaze with the vodka.
Add the tomato sauce and cook 8 minutes, then the cream.
Toss the penne with the sauce and Parmesan.

es-flan-de-huevo.title: Homemade egg flan
es-flan-de-huevo.summary: Classic dessert of egg, milk and caramel.
es-flan-de-huevo.tip: Strain the mixture so the flan has no bubbles.
steps: Make a caramel with 1/4 cup of sugar and coat the bottom of a mold.
Whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar, the milk and the vanilla.
Pour into the mold and bake in a water bath 45 minutes at 340°F.
Chill and unmold.

es-arroz-con-leche.title: Spanish rice pudding
es-arroz-con-leche.summary: Creamy dessert with cinnamon and lemon peel.
es-arroz-con-leche.tip: Stir often so it turns creamy and does not stick.
steps: Heat the milk with the cinnamon and lemon peel.
Add the rice and cook on low heat 35 minutes, stirring often.
Add the sugar and cook 5 more minutes.
Remove the cinnamon and peel and serve warm or cold.

es-escalivada.title: Catalan roasted vegetables
es-escalivada.summary: Roasted eggplant, pepper and onion dressed with olive oil.
es-escalivada.tip: Covering the roasted vegetables makes them easier to peel.
steps: Roast the whole eggplants, peppers and onions at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Let them cool covered and peel.
Cut everything into strips.
Dress with olive oil, minced garlic and salt.

es-patatas-a-la-riojana.title: Rioja-style potatoes
es-patatas-a-la-riojana.summary: Potato stew with chorizo and paprika.
es-patatas-a-la-riojana.tip: Snap the potatoes instead of cutting them so they release starch.
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the sliced chorizo and the paprika.
Add the potatoes in chunks and cover with water.
Cook 30 minutes on low heat until the broth thickens.

es-caldo-gallego.title: Galician broth
es-caldo-gallego.summary: Galician soup of potatoes, white beans, greens and chorizo.
es-caldo-gallego.tip: It tastes better the next day.
steps: Boil the chorizo and bacon in 6 cups of water for 30 minutes.
Add the potatoes in chunks and cook 15 minutes.
Add the chopped greens and the beans.
Cook 15 more minutes and season with salt.

es-empanadillas-de-atun.title: Tuna turnovers
es-empanadillas-de-atun.summary: Fried turnovers filled with tuna, tomato and egg.
es-empanadillas-de-atun.tip: You can bake them at 400°F for 15 minutes for less oil.
steps: Mix the drained tuna with the tomato sauce and the chopped egg.
Put a spoonful of filling on each round.
Fold and seal the edges with a fork.
Fry in hot oil until golden and drain on paper.

pt-pasteis-de-bacalhau.title: Salt cod fritters
pt-pasteis-de-bacalhau.summary: Fried salt cod and potato fritters with parsley.
pt-pasteis-de-bacalhau.tip: Let the mixture rest 15 minutes before shaping.
steps: Boil the potatoes and the cod and flake the fish.
Mash the potatoes and mix with the cod, grated onion, parsley and eggs.
Shape into ovals using two spoons.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

pt-feijoada-a-portuguesa.title: Portuguese bean stew
pt-feijoada-a-portuguesa.summary: White or red beans simmered with chorizo, bacon and cabbage.
pt-feijoada-a-portuguesa.tip: Mash some of the beans in the pot to thicken the broth.
steps: Sauté the onion with the bacon and the sliced chorizo.
Add the diced carrot and the beans with 2 cups of water.
Cook 30 minutes on low heat.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook 10 more minutes.

pt-omelete-de-chourico.title: Chorizo omelet
pt-omelete-de-chourico.tip: Go easy on the salt because the chorizo is already salty.
steps: Fry the sliced chorizo in the oil until it releases its fat.
Add the chopped onion and cook 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and parsley and pour into the pan.
Cook on low heat and fold in half.

fr-salade-lyonnaise.title: Lyonnaise salad
fr-salade-lyonnaise.summary: Frisée with bacon, croutons and a poached egg.
fr-salade-lyonnaise.tip: Deglaze the pan with hot vinegar and serve the salad warm.
steps: Brown the bacon in a dry pan and set aside, keeping the fat.
Toast the cubed bread in that fat.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes in barely simmering vinegared water.
Dress the greens with vinegar and mustard, then add bacon, croutons and eggs.

fr-brandade-de-morue.title: Salt cod brandade
fr-brandade-de-morue.summary: Gratinéed purée of desalted salt cod and potatoes.
fr-brandade-de-morue.tip: Add the hot milk gradually for a creamy texture.
steps: Poach the cod in the milk 10 minutes and flake it.
Boil and mash the potatoes.
Mix with the cod, crushed garlic, oil and a little hot milk.
Pour into a dish and broil 15 minutes at 400°F.

fr-cake-jambon-olives.title: Ham and olive savory cake
fr-cake-jambon-olives.summary: Moist savory loaf with ham, olives and grated cheese.
fr-cake-jambon-olives.tip: Keeps 3 days and freezes well in slices.
steps: Mix the flour, 2 teaspoons baking powder and salt.
Add the eggs, milk and 1/4 cup oil.
Fold in the diced ham, olives and cheese.
Pour into a loaf pan and bake 45 minutes at 350°F.

fr-poulet-basquaise.title: Basque-style chicken
fr-poulet-basquaise.summary: Chicken stewed with peppers, tomatoes and Espelette pepper.
fr-poulet-basquaise.tip: The longer it simmers, the sweeter and richer the sauce.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in oil and set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic and sliced peppers.
Add the chopped tomatoes, the pepper and the chicken.
Cover and simmer 40 minutes.

fr-tomates-farcies.title: Stuffed tomatoes
fr-tomates-farcies.summary: Oven-baked tomatoes stuffed with ground meat.
fr-tomates-farcies.tip: Set the tomatoes in a snug dish so they stay upright.
steps: Cut the tops off the tomatoes and scoop them out, keeping the pulp.
Mix the meat, onion, garlic, parsley and chopped pulp.
Fill the tomatoes and put the tops back.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°F.

fr-pommes-de-terre-sarladaises.title: Garlic parsley potatoes
fr-pommes-de-terre-sarladaises.summary: Golden, crispy pan-fried potatoes with garlic and parsley.
fr-pommes-de-terre-sarladaises.tip: Add the garlic last so it does not burn.
steps: Slice the potatoes thinly and pat them dry.
Fry them in the hot fat 15 minutes, turning often.
Cover 10 minutes so they cook through.
Add the minced garlic and parsley and salt at the end.

jp-gyoza.title: Homemade gyoza
jp-gyoza.summary: Japanese pork and cabbage dumplings, pan-fried and steamed.
jp-gyoza.tip: Squeeze the cabbage in a towel so the filling stays dry.
steps: Mix the pork with the finely chopped cabbage, scallions, ginger and soy sauce.
Put a spoonful of filling in each wrapper, wet the edge and pleat to seal.
Brown the gyoza 2 minutes on one side in an oiled pan.
Add 1/4 cup water, cover and cook 5 minutes until it evaporates.

jp-soba-frio.title: Cold soba with dipping sauce
jp-soba-frio.summary: Chilled buckwheat noodles with a soy dipping sauce.
jp-soba-frio.tip: Rinsing in cold water removes starch and keeps the noodles from sticking.
steps: Boil the noodles per the package (about 5 minutes).
Rinse under cold water and drain well.
Mix the soy sauce with 1/2 cup water, the sugar and grated ginger for the sauce.
Serve the cold noodles with the sauce, chopped scallions and sesame.

in-khichdi.title: Khichdi
in-khichdi.summary: Soft rice and lentil stew with spices, pure comfort food.
in-khichdi.tip: If it gets too thick, add a splash of hot water.
steps: Wash the rice and lentils until the water runs clear.
Sauté the cumin and chopped onion in the ghee.
Add the rice, lentils, turmeric, salt and 4 cups water.
Cook covered 25 minutes on low heat until creamy.

gr-bifteki.title: Bifteki
gr-bifteki.summary: Greek beef patties with oregano and onion, pan-grilled.
gr-bifteki.tip: Chill them 15 minutes before cooking so they hold their shape.
steps: Mix the beef with the grated onion, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano, salt and pepper.
Shape 4 patties, with a piece of feta in the center if you like.
Cook on a hot griddle or pan 5 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon and tzatziki.

gr-horiatiki.title: Greek village salad (horiatiki)
gr-horiatiki.summary: Tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta with oregano.
gr-horiatiki.tip: No lettuce or vinegar: the flavor comes from ripe tomatoes and good oil.
steps: Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into large chunks.
Add the onion in half-moons and the olives.
Dress with olive oil, salt and oregano.
Top with a slab of feta and serve right away.

it-polpettone.title: Baked Italian meatloaf
it-polpettone.summary: Ground beef loaf with eggs and Parmesan, baked in the oven.
steps: Soak the bread in the milk and squeeze it out.
Mix the meat with the bread, eggs, Parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf and set in a baking dish with a little oil.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°F, turning halfway.

it-pollo-ai-peperoni.title: Roman chicken with peppers
it-pollo-ai-peperoni.summary: Chicken stewed with bell peppers and tomato, a Roman classic.
it-pollo-ai-peperoni.tip: Add the peppers halfway through if you want them firmer.
steps: Brown the chicken in oil and set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic and sliced peppers.
Deglaze with the wine, add the tomatoes and the chicken.
Cook covered 35 minutes on low heat.

it-involtini-di-melanzane.title: Eggplant rolls
it-involtini-di-melanzane.summary: Grilled eggplant slices filled with ricotta and basil and baked.
it-involtini-di-melanzane.tip: Slices about 1/4 inch thick roll without breaking.
steps: Slice the eggplants lengthwise and grill with a little oil.
Spread each slice with ricotta and basil and roll up.
Arrange the rolls in a dish on top of the tomato sauce.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and bake 20 minutes at 400°F.

jp-korokke.title: Korokke
jp-korokke.summary: Japanese potato and beef croquettes, breaded and fried.
jp-korokke.tip: Chill the mixture before shaping so it holds together.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes.
Sauté the onion with the beef and mix into the mash, with salt and pepper.
Shape into ovals and coat in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden.

in-sambar.title: Sambar
in-sambar.summary: South Indian lentil stew with vegetables, tamarind and spices.
in-sambar.tip: Without tamarind, finish with lemon juice.
steps: Cook the lentils with turmeric and 4 cups water until they break down.
Add the diced carrot, potato, tomato and onion with 1 cup water.
Stir in the tamarind, 2 teaspoons curry powder and salt.
Cook 20 more minutes until the vegetables are tender.

de-rinderrouladen.title: German beef rolls
de-rinderrouladen.summary: Beef rolls with bacon, pickle and mustard in red wine gravy.
de-rinderrouladen.tip: Thicken the gravy at the end with a little flour.
steps: Spread the beef slices with mustard and top with bacon, pickle strips and onion.
Roll up and secure with kitchen twine or toothpicks.
Brown well on all sides and deglaze with wine and 1 cup water.
Braise covered 90 minutes on low heat.

de-apfelpfannkuchen.title: Thick apple pancakes
de-apfelpfannkuchen.summary: Thick pancakes with apple slices, dusted with cinnamon and sugar.
de-apfelpfannkuchen.tip: Rest the batter 10 minutes for fluffier pancakes.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Peel the apples and slice thinly.
Heat butter in a pan, add the apple slices and pour the batter over.
Cook until golden on both sides and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

fr-moelleux-au-chocolat.title: Molten chocolate cakes
fr-moelleux-au-chocolat.summary: Small chocolate cakes with a gooey center.
fr-moelleux-au-chocolat.tip: Unmold while warm to keep the center molten.
steps: Melt the chocolate and butter over a double boiler.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar and fold in the chocolate.
Add the flour and pour into buttered ramekins.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°F: the center should stay runny.

fr-tarte-tatin.title: Tarte Tatin
fr-tarte-tatin.tip: Flip it while warm, or the caramel hardens and sticks.
steps: Make a caramel with the sugar in an oven-safe skillet and add the butter.
Pack the peeled apple quarters tightly into the caramel.
Cover with the pastry, tucking in the edges.
Bake 35 minutes at 375°F, cool 5 minutes and flip onto a plate.
